article.articleHeadline: Bệnh tay chân miệng bùng phát, cảnh giác biến chứng tim mạch nặng
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hand, foot and mouth disease outbreak; be vigilant for severe cardiovascular complications.
article.articleSummary: Hand, Foot and Mouth Disease (HFMD) outbreak in Vietnam at the Pediatrics Department of 108 Military Central Hospital highlights rapid EV71-associated complications. HFMD is caused by Coxsackievirus A16 and Enterovirus 71; EV71 can cause encephalitis, meningitis, myocarditis, and pulmonary edema. Transmission is fecal-oral and direct contact; children under 5 are highest risk. The disease progresses in phases: incubation 3–7 days; prodrome 1–2 days with fever, sore throat, poor appetite; acute phase 3–10 days with oral ulcers, drooling, and vesicular rash on hands, feet, knees, buttocks. A four-tier severity scale guides care: 2A–2B signals potential circulatory/neurological risk; 3 indicates severe neuro-cardiopulmonary involvement; 4 shock or respiratory failure. A 12-month-old girl (N.M.C.) presented with fever 39.3°C, HR 152, RR 32, vesicular rash; diagnosed HFMD grade 2A; monitored continuously; stable, with isolation to prevent cross-infection. Home care emphasizes hygiene, hydration, gentle fever control, and urgent medical evaluation for red flags.

triage.headline_ja: 手足口病の流行、重篤な心血管合併症への警戒呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムにおけるエンテロウイルス71関連の手足口病アウトブレイクであり、重篤な心筋炎・脳炎などの合併症リスクが明記されている。小児を中心とした国民衛生上の深刻な影響、異常事態としての性質、ヒト-ヒト感染による流行リスクが認められ、スクリーニング基準3項目以上該当。
triage.notes: 108軍事中央病院小児科での具体的な事例報告あり。EV71は重篤な脳炎・心筋炎・肺水腫を引き起こす可能性があり、5歳未満の小児が高リスク。フェーズ別の重症度評価スケール（グレード2A-4）が明記されており、医療体制の対応能力に関わる情報が含まれている。

article.articleHeadline: Ghi nhận nhiều người cúm B biến chứng nặng nhập viện
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Many people with influenza B develop severe complications and are hospitalized.
article.articleSummary: Two influenza B hospitalizations illustrate potential severity in Vietnam. At Hanoi's National Hospital for Tropical Diseases, a 77-year-old woman from Hanoi developed fatigue, headache and nausea; after 4 days she deteriorated with respiratory failure and pneumonia, requiring oxygen, and testing was positive for influenza B. She has hypertension and advanced age, increasing risk of severe disease. A 60-year-old man from Hai Duong province, initially ill for about 9 days and treated with antivirals at a private clinic, later developed persistent fatigue and dyspnea; chest imaging revealed severe pneumonia and he has diabetes. Clinicians note that influenza B can start with nonspecific symptoms and rapidly progress to pneumonia and respiratory failure, with possible bacterial or fungal superinfection in those with COPD, diabetes, liver or kidney disease. They urge early medical evaluation, discourage self-medication, and advocate influenza vaccination for high-risk groups; consider testing when household members show fever and cough.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザBで重篤な合併症を発症して入院する多くの患者が報告される
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムでインフルエンザB感染による重症化症例が報告されているが、発生規模が限定的（2症例）で、国際拡大のリスクや異常性については情報不足。スクリーニング基準のいくつかに該当する可能性があるが、より詳細な情報が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は2症例の重症インフルエンザB患者（高齢者および基礎疾患保有者）を提示し、臨床的な重症化リスクと早期医療評価の重要性を強調している。しかし、これがベトナム全体での異常な流行を示唆するのか、または散発的な重症例の臨床コメントなのかは不明確。継続的な監視により、より多くの症例報告または流行傾向の明確化があれば、判定をPICKUPに変更する可能性がある。

article.articleHeadline: 73岁老人身上附着17只蜱虫 医生拔除 成功救治蜱虫病患者
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Seventeen ticks attached to the body of a 73-year-old man; the doctor removed them, successfully treating a tick-borne disease patient.
article.articleSummary: On 24 April 2026, a 73-year-old woman from a mountainous area near Anhui fell ill with fatigue, poor appetite and fever after exposure to shrubs while near a pond. Laboratory tests showed leukopenia and thrombocytopenia; a positive bunyavirus result led to a diagnosis of fever with thrombocytopenia syndrome (SFTS) caused by Dabie bandavirus. She was treated in the Infectious Diseases Department at Anhui Medical University Fourth Affiliated Hospital; 13 ticks were removed on the first day, and a nurse later removed 4 more, bringing the total to 17—the most ticks removed from a single patient at this hospital to date. SFTS is a Class B infectious disease with peak activity from April to October. The department has over 10 years of experience with SFTS and has treated 10 cases this year, all successfully cured. Prevention emphasizes avoiding tick habitats (mountains, woods, grasslands), wearing protective clothing, and seeking prompt medical care if bitten.

triage.headline_ja: 73歳の老人の体に17匹のダニが付着 医師が除去し、ダニ媒介感染症患者の治療に成功
triage.triage_reason: SFTS（ブニヤウイルス感染症）の散発的な個別症例。中国安徽省の医療機関で診断・治療されたが、集団発生や国際的拡大の兆候は見られない。情報不足につき経過観察。
triage.notes: SFTSは既知の地方病であり、安徽省での散発症例報告。記事は医療機関による成功事例を報道。集団発生や異常発生の兆候なし。ダニ媒介感染症であり流行リスク（epidemic_prone）および環境曝露リスク（prolonged_exposure）が存在するが、単一症例の治療成功事例のため公衆衛生上の直ちのシグナルとは判定されず。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue Outbreak in Magdalena: Child Deaths, Rising Cases, and Health Alerts Across Communities - News Directory 3
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever outbreak in Magdalena, Colombia, with 3,754 cases and one confirmed death (a minor from Zapayán) as of the April 23, 2026 update. Four municipalities are on alert and 19 in active outbreak; Santa Marta has 1,890 cases, followed by Ciénaga (459) and Fundación (248), with transmission now reported in all municipalities. The fatal case is the first confirmed dengue-related death in the current outbreak; Health Secretary Magda Alarcón notes elevated risk for children and older adults amid sustained transmission. Authorities have intensified vector control, case monitoring, and community engagement, including in indigenous areas such as Sabanas de San Ángel. The situation aligns with broader dengue concerns in tropical regions; in the Philippines, 123,000 cases since Jan 1, 2025, including 27,358 in children 5–9, with a 0.4% fatality rate and calls for targeted interventions. Public health focus remains on early detection and prevention to curb morbidity and mortality.

triage.headline_ja: マグダレナでのデング熱アウトブレイク：子どもの死亡、増加する症例数、コミュニティ全体での健康警報
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（重篤な健康影響、異常性、国際的関心）。WPRO基準でも複数項目該当し、子どもの死亡を含む重症例が報告されており、国際的な社会政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事の主要な地理的フォーカスはコロンビア（対象国外）のマグダレナ地域のデング熱アウトブレイクですが、フィリピンは対象国リストに含まれており、記事サマリーで12万3,000症例と明示的に言及されているため、verified_locationsに含めています。コロンビアはWPRO地域外のため検証対象外です。アウトブレイクの規模（3,754症例、確認死亡1件）、子どもへの影響、コミュニティ全体への拡大、ベクトル媒介疾患としての特性から、全般的なシグナルスコアは高くなっています。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: Gripe aviar: SAG aclara que China no ha notificado destrucción de productos avícolas chilenos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Avian influenza: SAG clarifies that China has not notified the destruction of Chilean poultry products.
article.articleSummary: Chile reports high-pathogenicity avian influenza outbreaks in commercial poultry, clarifying that China has not notified destruction of Chilean products. The Agriculture and Livestock Service (SAG) says the temporary auto-suspension of exports aimed to halt trade, assess outbreak magnitude, and establish a sanitary-control zone to activate existing international zoning protocols. Chile notified the World Organisation for Animal Health (WOAH) via WAHIS on March 25, in line with the WTO SPS Agreement. On March 26, Chile officially informed Chinese authorities of the sanitary measures and the precautionary autosuspension. The SAG emphasizes the measure is not a penalty but a precaution ensuring transparency in trade. As of the date, no official destruction notification from China has been received. Within a week of detection, Chile resumed exports to the United States, Mexico, Puerto Rico, Canada, and the United Kingdom, thanks to pre-established zoning agreements.

triage.headline_ja: 鳥インフルエンザ：SAG（チリ農牧庁）が中国はチリ産畜産物の破棄を通知していないことを明確化
triage.triage_reason: チリの高病原性鳥インフルエンザの発生は動物への影響が主で、人間への感染リスクは明記されていない。対象国内（ブラジル）での人獣共通感染症の具体的な懸念は不明確。情報収集継続が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はチリにおける高病原性鳥インフルエンザの発生とそれに伴う国際貿易・通知の問題である。対象国リストではChina（1814991）のみが該当。チリはブラジルの対象国リストに含まれていないため含めない。人間感染（Human Infection with Avian Influenza）が疾患名に含まれているが、記事サマリーではその言及がなく、動物への影響が焦点。IHR基準は2つ該当（異常性と国際的拡大/貿易制限）するが、対象地域での継続的な人間感染リスクの具体的根拠に欠けるため、WATCH判定とした。

locations.name: Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka

article.articleHeadline: Measles rearing its head again in SL
article.articleSummary: Measles re-emerges in Sri Lanka with two pediatric cases in Colombo District, says Dr. Athula Liyanapathirana of the Health Ministry's Epidemiology Unit. Sri Lanka was declared measles-free by the World Health Organization in 2019, but sporadic outbreaks have occurred in some areas since 2023. After no reported cases since January 2025, the recent two infections signal a potential resurgence. Laboratory analysis of one case, conducted in India, confirmed the virus was imported. Officials warn that measles can have long-term health consequences and may weaken immunity, reducing defense against other infections. Immediate preventive measures are urged to prevent escalation into a full outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: スリランカで麻疹が再び出現
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹が2019年に排除認定されたスリランカで2例の小児症例が報告され、異常・予想外の発生である。IHR基準2つ該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが発生地域にIndiaを含めているが、記事サマリーではIndiaは検査機関として言及されているのみであり、発生地は明確にスリランカ（コロンボ地区）のため、verified_locationsはスリランカのみとした。麻疹は排除認定された国での再出現であり、公衆衛生上の重大な関心事。

article.articleHeadline: LTN經濟通》中國口蹄疫肆虐 豬價跌到台灣一半 - 自由財經
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Foot-and-mouth disease ravages China; pig prices fall to half of Taiwan's.
article.articleSummary: Foot-and-mouth disease (FMD), serotype SAT1, has surfaced in China for the first time, with SAT1 outbreaks in Xinjiang’s Yining County and Gansu’s Gulang County. In Yining, 513 cattle on a market stock, 142 ill; in Gulang, 5,716 cattle on a farm, 77 ill. Emergency measures include culling, cleaning/disinfection, disposal, monitoring, and epidemiological investigations; authorities warn the virus is cross-border introduced amid spring livestock movements, with heightened spread risk via live-animal transport and vehicles/personnel. SAT1 is not covered by the common vaccines targeting O- and A-type FMD. Provinces reportedly affected include Xinjiang, Gansu, Inner Mongolia, Liaoning, Jilin, Heilongjiang, Shandong, Shanxi, Ningxia, Hebei, Guizhou, and Anhui. Separately, China’s pig sector faces a price collapse due to overcapacity and weak demand: lean-meat pig price at 9.27 RMB/kg on Apr 7 (down about 36% YoY), with a mid-April national average around 10.03 RMB/kg; futures at 9,125 RMB/ton. Smallholders report losses of roughly 1,500–500 RMB per pig and are reducing herd sizes.

triage.headline_ja: 口蹄疫が中国で猛威を振るう 豚肉価格が台湾の半分に低下
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常・予想外、国際的拡大リスク）。複数地域への急速な地理的拡大、人獣共通感染症、既存ワクチンでカバーされない新型株（SAT1）という特性が重大。
triage.notes: 中国で初となるFMD SAT1株の発生。新疆と甘肅の現地レベルでの確認に加え、複数省で感染拡大の報告あり。既存O型・A型ワクチンではカバーされない新型株であり、春季の家畜移動に伴う越境感染の懸念が高い。農業経済への二次的影響（豚価暴落）も報告されており、国境地帯のザンビアやタイなどへの波及リスクも考慮が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Takeda Vietnam expands dengue prevention efforts through communication and partnerships - VnExpress International
article.articleSummary: Vietnam records over 100,000 dengue cases annually, with year-round transmission and severe cases requiring hospitalization across all ages. Takeda Vietnam’s DeRIGHT-V campaign demystifies dengue and promotes science-based prevention, implemented 2024–2025 with videos, digital content, and an interactive dengue complications storytelling station at the Saigon Zoo and Botanical Gardens in Ho Chi Minh City. The initiative achieved over 733 million impressions and 78 million views, and spurred increased online searches for dengue and dengue vaccination. It partners with local Centers for Disease Control and media to relay epidemiological trends. Recognitions include 2026 Healthcare Asia Pharma Awards Marketing and Communications Initiative of the Year and 2025 Van Xuan Awards TVC of the Year. Over two years, more than 1,000 educational activities reached over 7,000 healthcare professionals; Vietnam Dengue Summit 2025 gathered 700+ experts. In 2026 Lunar New Year, severe dengue hospitalizations were documented by VGP in a Takeda collaboration.

triage.headline_ja: 武田ベトナムがコミュニケーションとパートナーシップを通じてデング熱予防活動を拡大 - VnExpress International
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムで年間10万件以上のデング熱症例が記録されており、重症例による入院があることが示されている。しかし、記事の主要な焦点は武田薬品の予防キャンペーンの実績と社会的認識向上であり、新規の急性流行シグナルや国際的拡大リスクは明確ではない。情報追加を待つ価値がある。
triage.notes: ベトナムは季節を通じたデング熱の流行地であり、年間10万件以上の症例が報告されている常在疾患である。記事は予防キャンペーンの成功事例を強調しており、新規の警告シグナルではなく、既知のリスク管理の事例報告と考えられる。WPROスクリーニング基準で重症度・長期曝露・流行しやすさに該当するが、IHR基準では1つのみ該当。情報不足により WATCH に分類。

article.articleHeadline: Campo Grande confirma dois novos casos de raiva em morcegos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Campo Grande confirms two new rabies cases in bats.
article.articleSummary: Two new rabies cases in bats were confirmed in Campo Grande on April 23, 2026, in the Centro and São Francisco regions, bringing the 2026 total to eight in four months. Through April 23, 502 bats had been collected for suspected infection and sent for analysis, with all specimens showing abnormal signs. The CCZ notes it only collects bats found fallen, alive or dead, or that entered buildings, and does not conduct population control. Most bats are not infected and pose no daytime risk when roosting or flying at night. The rise in confirmed cases is attributed to increased service use, more pickups and more exams. Residents should not touch bats; isolate them on the ground with buckets or boxes, keep pets away, and call for collection. Vaccination of dogs and cats remains the primary preventive measure. If a test is positive, CCZ informs the requester and starts health protocols; if there was no contact, the test is negative. Samples are sent to Iagro, with results typically within ten business days, and preventive guidance begins at service.

triage.headline_ja: カンポ・グランデでコウモリの狂犬病新規感染2例を確認
triage.triage_reason: 動物（コウモリ）での狂犬病確認は異常性があるが、ヒト感染例の報告がなく、公衆衛生への深刻な影響は現時点で不明。国内の監視体制が機能していることが示唆されており、情報の継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: ブラジルはWPRO対象国ではなく、AmericasRegion(AMRO)の管轄。動物における狂犬病確認で異常性はあるが、ヒト症例がなく、接触予防策が確立されている。4ヶ月間で8例のコウモリ感染確認は監視体制の強化を反映している可能性がある。続報でヒト感染例または国際的拡大が報告されれば判定変更の可能性あり。

article.articleHeadline: Disease Outbreak News: Measles - Bangladesh (23 April 2026) - Bangladesh
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreak in Bangladesh, 15 Mar–14 Apr 2026: cases reported across 58 of 64 districts in all eight divisions, with 19,161 suspected and 2,973 laboratory-confirmed cases; 166 suspected deaths (CFR 0.9%) and 30 confirmed deaths (CFR 1.1%). 12,318 hospital admissions and 9,772 discharges. Children under 5 bear the burden (79%; 66% under 2; 33% under 9 months). Highest burden in Dhaka (8,263), Rajshahi (3,747), Chattogram (2,514), Khulna (1,568); Dhaka slum clusters include Demra, Jatrabari, Kamrangirchar, Korail, Mirpur, Tejgaon. Transmission is sustained domestically. Symptoms: fever, runny nose, cough, red eyes, rash; infectious from four days before to four days after rash. Public health actions include a targeted MR vaccination campaign starting 5 April for 6–59 months (expanded to 6–8 months in 30 upazilas of 18 districts) with nationwide rollout on 20 April, vitamin A, strengthened surveillance, and RRT activation.

triage.headline_ja: 感染症発生ニュース：麻しん - バングラデシュ（2026年4月23日）
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク）。WPRO基準では5項目全て該当。大規模な麻しん流行で2,973例の確定患者、166名の疑い死亡例があり、即座のフルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでバングラデシュでの64地区中58地区での流行が明記されている。インドはBluedot APIの発生地域リストに含まれているが、サマリー本文ではインドでの発生は明示されていない。ただしバングラデシュとの地理的近接性と麻しんの高い感染性から、国境を越えた拡大リスクが存在する可能性がある。5歳未満の小児が79%（2歳未満が66%）を占める深刻な流行状況。政府による全国的なMR予防接種キャンペーン展開中。

article.articleHeadline: 南昌疾控发布5月健康提示：特别关注登革热、基孔肯雅热
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nanchang CDC Issues May Health Tips: Pay Particular Attention to Dengue Fever and Chikungunya Fever
article.articleSummary: Published 2026-04-24, Nanchang City CDC issued May health tips highlighting dengue fever and chikungunya fever. The guidance also covers other infectious diarrheal diseases and fever with thrombocytopenia syndrome, tick-borne fever, and rabies risk. For dengue fever and chikungunya: prevention emphasizes clearing standing water around the home (pots, containers, buckets, trash cans, AC condensate); avoid grass and shrubs when traveling; wear long sleeves and pants; apply mosquito repellent; sleep under a net; seek medical care promptly for fever, rash, or joint/muscle pain. Diarrheal diseases: more than three stools per day with abdominal pain, fever, vomiting; prevention includes hand hygiene, safe food handling, thorough cooking of seafood, and seeking care for symptoms. Tick-borne fever risk in hills, mountains, forested areas; remove ticks properly; monitor symptoms within two weeks of bite. Rabies remains nearly 100% fatal after symptom onset; bite victims should wash wounds and seek post-exposure vaccination; dogs should be vaccinated.

triage.headline_ja: 南昌疾控が5月の健康提示を発布：デング熱とチクングニア熱に特に注意
triage.triage_reason: 複数の感染症（デング熱、チクングニア熱、SFTS、狂犬病）が記載されており、スクリーニング基準の異常性と長期曝露に該当する可能性があるが、記事は公式ガイダンス発表であり、具体的な患者数・死亡者数・感染状況の詳細が不明である。
triage.notes: 記事は南昌疾病管理予防センターによる5月の公式健康ガイダンスの発表である。デング熱とチクングニア熱が強調されており、これらは蚊媒介性で季節性がある。SFTS、狂犬病、下痢性疾患、マダニ媒介熱も言及されている。ただし、現在の患者数、死亡者数、または異常な増加の具体的な報告は記事に含まれていない。これは予防的な公式ガイダンスであり、流行の急速な拡大を示す兆候はない。続報を注視し、具体的な患者報告やアウトブレイク通知が出現した場合は再評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Nâng cao ý thức phòng, chống bệnh dại trong cộng đồng
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Raising awareness of rabies prevention and control in the community.
article.articleSummary: Rabies prevention is being scaled up in Bao Ha commune as hot weather raises the risk of transmission among dogs and cats. Local authorities and veterinary services conduct active surveillance, tallying dogs and cats, registering households, and organizing vaccination campaigns. Vaccination coverage for rabies in the commune consistently exceeds 90%, with more than 5,000 dogs recorded. Community awareness has improved through radio, social media, and village meetings, and residents increasingly keep dogs tied and registered for vaccination. Provincial data indicate roughly one dog/cat owner per 14 residents in rural areas. In 2025 the province recorded 17 rabies-diagnosed dogs; as of April 2026, one new case has appeared, signaling ongoing transmission risk. Authorities urge prompt medical care after bites and emphasize sustained vaccination, reduced free-roaming, and continuous public education to protect health and lives.

triage.headline_ja: 地域社会における狂犬病の予防と対策への意識向上
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムのラオカイ州で狂犬病の継続的な感染リスク（2025年に17件、2026年4月に1件の診断犬）が報告されており、WPROスクリーニング基準の複数項目に該当するが、現段階では予防措置が機能しており重篤な流行兆候は認められない。情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事は地域の狂犬病対策の強化を報じており、ワクチン接種率90%以上を維持している。2025年に17件、2026年4月に1件の診断犬が報告されており、持続的な感染リスクが存在する。ベトナムはWPRO対象国リスト内にあるが、現在のところ制御可能な状況と評価される。人的損失（死亡例）の報告はサマリーに含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: 这种病已在我国本土消除，但每年都有境外输入！一文了解"元凶"_京报网
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: This disease has been eradicated domestically in China, but there are imported cases from abroad every year! One article explains the 'culprit' — Beijing News Network.
article.articleSummary: China eliminated malaria domestically and gained WHO elimination certification in 2021, yet numerous imported malaria cases arrive each year from abroad, keeping reintroduction risks alive. The hidden culprits are malaria parasites of the genus Plasmodium. Five species infect humans: P. falciparum (malignant malaria), P. vivax (vivax malaria), P. malariae, P. ovale, and P. knowlesi. Among them, P. falciparum and P. vivax are the most dangerous, with distinct clinical features and relapse potential. The core defense is preventing importation, breaking transmission, and ensuring early diagnosis and rapid treatment. Returning travelers, workers, tourists, and others who have been in malaria-endemic regions should monitor for fever, chills, and malaise and report travel history to clinicians. Personal protection against mosquitoes—nets, screens, repellents containing DEET, and protective clothing—is essential. The message: malaria elimination is a starting point for ongoing control, not the end.

triage.headline_ja: この病はすでに中国本土で排除されているが、毎年海外からの輸入感染者がいる！1つの記事で「真犯人」について理解する
triage.triage_reason: マラリアは中国で既に排除済みであり、記事の主題は輸入症例のリスク管理と啓発である。新しい流行の発生ではなく、既知のリスク要因に関する報道であり、現時点では緊急のシグナル化には至らないが、継続的な監視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は中国が2021年にWHOからマラリア排除認定を受けた後の、輸入症例に関する啓発記事である。現地でのアクティブな流行発生ではなく、個人防護と早期診断・治療に焦点を当てた予防啓発が主題。疫学的リスク（流行性感染症の特性）により wpro_count=1 であるが、現在の流行拡大の証拠がないため WATCH 判定。

article.articleHeadline: Prefeitura capacita profissionais de saúde para início da vacinação contra Chikungunya
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: City Hall trains healthcare professionals for the start of vaccination against Chikungunya.
article.articleSummary: City Hall trains healthcare professionals for the start of a Chikungunya vaccination campaign as of 24 April 2026. The vaccine should not be given to pregnant or breastfeeding individuals; those on immunosuppressants (e.g., high-dose corticosteroids); congenital immunodeficiency; cancer patients undergoing chemotherapy or radiotherapy; recent solid organ or bone marrow transplant recipients (within two years); people with HIV/AIDS; or autoimmune diseases such as lupus or rheumatoid arthritis. It is also not indicated for individuals with two or more chronic comorbidities, including diabetes, hypertension, heart failure, arrhythmias, pulmonary, renal, or hepatic diseases, obesity (BMI >30), or cancer (active treatment or remission). Additional restrictions include those who had Chikungunya in the last 30 days; those with high fever; recipients of live-attenuated vaccines in the last 28 days, or inactivated vaccines in the last 14 days.

triage.headline_ja: 市役所がチクングニア予防接種開始に向けて医療専門家を訓練
triage.triage_reason: チクングニア予防接種キャンペーンの開始に関する行政情報であり、新規流行や異常な感染状況の報告ではない。社会的関心は存在するが、公衆衛生上の危機を示す情報が不足している。
triage.notes: 記事はチクングニア予防接種キャンペーンの準備段階に関する行政ニュースであり、感染症の流行事象ではない。サマリーでは禁忌対象者（HIV/AIDS患者を含む）の詳細が記載されているが、新規発生、重症度上昇、国際的拡大のリスクを示す具体的な疫学情報は含まれていない。ワクチン接種準備という行政動向のため、後続情報により状況が変わる可能性がある場合は経過観察が適切。

article.articleHeadline: Vào hè, cẩn trọng với nhiều bệnh lây nhiễm
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: As summer arrives, be cautious about many infectious diseases.
article.articleSummary: HFMD is rising in Vietnam, driven by Enterovirus 71 (EV71) and Coxsackievirus A16. In Hanoi about 1,600 cases this year; Ho Chi Minh City over 10,000, including severe cases. Children with fever to 39°C, mouth ulcers, and rashes risk progression to pneumonia and nervous system complications such as meningitis or encephalitis, especially with EV71. National HFMD totals about 26,000 with eight deaths, with more than 70% in the south; peak transmission occurs March–May and September–October. Meningococcal meningitis shows 24 cases nationwide early this year, up about 50% with four deaths; under-15s comprise roughly 46%. A 2-year-old in Ho Chi Minh City developed fulminant meningococcal meningitis. Dengue reports 31,927 cases and four deaths. Authorities urge early detection, vaccination where available, and strengthened surveillance and infection control in schools and crowded places.

triage.headline_ja: 夏が到来すると、多くの感染症に注意が必要です
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムにおいて複数の感染症（EV71によるHFMD、髄膜炎菌髄膜炎、デング熱）の同時流行が報告されており、IHR基準3つ（公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）に該当します。特にEV71由来のHFMDは26,000例で8人の死亡、髄膜炎菌髄膜炎は50%増加で4人の死亡が報告されており、重症度も高く、子どもへの影響が大きい点で懸念があります。
triage.notes: 記事はベトナム語で報道されており、ハノイとホーチミンシティで複数の感染症が同時に流行している状況が示されています。EV71によるHFMDは神経系合併症（髄膜炎、脳炎）への進展リスクが高く、特に南部で70%以上の症例が集中しています。髄膜炎菌髄膜炎は劇症型の報告例も含まれており、15歳未満の子どもが約46%を占めています。デング熱も同時に流行しており、複合的な公衆衛生上の脅威となっています。

article.articleHeadline: 病毒疫情6月進入流行期 台中首補助腸病毒71型疫苗 幼童最多可打3劑 - 自由健康網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Virus outbreak enters epidemic phase in June; Taichung becomes the first to subsidize Enterovirus 71 vaccine; children can receive up to 3 doses
article.articleSummary: Enterovirus 71 outbreaks in Taiwan are expected to enter epidemic status in June, with Taichung City first to subsidize EV71 vaccination for vulnerable infants. The city offers NT$4,300 per dose, up to three doses per child. Eligible children are aged 2 months to under 6 years; those under 2 may receive three doses, while those 2 and older receive two. The subsidy runs April 27–December 15 for Taichung residents born 2 months to under 2 years who are low‑income or in institutional care; vaccination sites include 79 contracted hospitals, with health centers if needed. Nationally, last week saw 3,526 enterovirus‑related visits, up 16.5% from the prior week, signaling rising transmission and a June peak. Vietnam reports over 26,000 EV71 cases by mid‑April, with Ho Chi Minh City and southern provinces hit hardest. EV71 can cause encephalitis and cardiopulmonary failure, with mortality up to 20%; vaccination is safe and protective for children.

triage.headline_ja: ウイルス流行が6月に流行期に突入；台中が腸病毒71型ワクチン補助を初実施；幼童は最大3回接種可能
triage.triage_reason: Enterovirus 71の多国での同時流行（台湾・ベトナム）、既に重篤な合併症（脳炎、心肺障害、致死率最大20%）が報告されており、国際的な拡大の兆候が明確。IHR基準では異常性・国際的拡大リスク・深刻な健康影響が該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも重症度・流行しやすさ・長期曝露が複数該当する。
triage.notes: 台湾はGeoNames対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。ベトナムは対象国であり、記事で26,000件以上のEV71症例が報告されている。両国での同時流行は地域的な公衆衛生上の危機を示唆しており、ワクチン接種キャンペーンと患者数の急増から高い関心度が伺える。

article.articleHeadline: 春季麻疹高发，湖南疾控提醒：疫苗接种不缺位_科教.文卫_湖南频道
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Spring sees a high incidence of measles; Hunan CDC reminds: Vaccination should not be skipped.
article.articleSummary: Spring sees elevated measles activity in Hunan, China, with a reminder from the Hunan Center for Disease Control and Prevention that vaccination cannot be skipped. Measles is a highly contagious acute respiratory infection and a Class B notifiable disease in China. Immunity comes from measles-containing vaccines or prior infection. The disease course has four stages: incubation about 7–21 days; prodrome 2–4 days with fever ≥38°C, coryza, cough, and conjunctivitis; Koplik spots on the buccal mucosa as an early diagnostic sign; eruption 2–5 days after fever, spreading from behind the ears and hairline to face, trunk, limbs, then palms/soles; rose-pink papular rash. Recovery occurs over 2–3 weeks with desquamation and pigment changes. Prevention centers on complete vaccination with a measles-containing vaccine, including doses at 8 and 18 months; adults may also vaccinate. Daily precautions include ventilation, good hygiene, and avoiding crowded indoor spaces. Parents should check vaccination records and seek medical care promptly if symptoms appear, reporting exposure. Source: Hunan Daily, 24 Apr 2026.

triage.headline_ja: 春季の麻疹高発症、湖南疾病管理センターが警告：ワクチン接種を欠くべからず
triage.triage_reason: 中国湖南省で季節的な麻疹増加が報告されているが、大規模流行や重篤な公衆衛生危機の証拠に乏しく、情報不足のため。引き続き動向を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事は湖南省における季節的な麻疹増加と予防啓発であり、流行の規模・重症度・国際的拡大の証拠がない。予防可能な疾患であり、当局による公衆衛生対応も機能している。ただしヒト-ヒト感染性が高く、ワクチン接種率等によっては状況が変化する可能性があるため、継続的な監視が適切。

article.articleHeadline: Người đàn ông mắc bệnh 'sốt đất' biến chứng đa cơ quan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Man contracts 'land fever' disease with multi-organ complications.
article.articleSummary: Melioidosis caused by Burkholderia pseudomallei infected a 57-year-old diabetic man in Hanoi, Vietnam, presenting with left-foot cellulitis that progressed to septicemia with multi-organ involvement. Blood and pus cultures were positive for B. pseudomallei. MRI showed osteomyelitis of the left foot; CT revealed multiple bilateral lung nodules with halo and central air spaces, consistent with septic pulmonary emboli. Despite prior antibiotics, he developed high fever and respiratory failure; at Tam Anh General Hospital Hanoi, high-dose intravenous antibiotics were started immediately after culture results, with wound drainage and daily debridement. After 10 days, fever subsided, pneumonia improved, and organ function stabilized; he will continue oral antibiotics for at least 6 months to prevent relapse. Diabetes and soil exposure are key risk factors; protective footwear and avoiding dirty water with open wounds are advised. Thailand warned on 20 April of melioidosis, with 23 deaths among more than 700 cases this year.

triage.headline_ja: 男性が多臓器障害を伴う「土の熱」病を罹患
triage.triage_reason: ベルリオシス（土の熱病）による重篤な多臓器障害を呈する症例が報告され、タイでは既に2026年に700症例超、23死亡が報告されており、重症度が高く、地域での流行管理可能性に疑問がある。IHR基準およびWPRO基準の複数に該当。
triage.notes: タイが既に当該年に700症例超、23死亡を報告しており、地域的な流行状況がある。ベルリオシスは土壌・水環境を起因とするため、長期的曝露リスクが存在。多臓器障害を呈する重症例が報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: 〈焦點股〉高端腸病毒疫苗向泰國送件新藥審查 漲逾半根停板 | 鉅亨網 - 台股新聞
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Focus Stock: High-End Enterovirus Vaccine Submits Dossier to Thailand for New-Drug Review; Shares Rise More Than Half a Daily Limit
article.articleSummary: Enterovirus 71 vaccine developed by High-End Vaccine Co., Ltd. (6547-TW) submitted a New Drug Application to the Thai FDA for regulatory review, signaling a Southeast Asia market push. The company has already secured Vietnam drug certification and plans to launch the vaccine there, with submissions in progress for Singapore, Malaysia, and Thailand. Vietnam production is ramping up; after quality checks and regulatory clearance, shipments will begin, though export timing remains uncertain. The NDA filing coincided with a stock rally, with shares rising over 50% intraday and trading volume around 1,000 shares. The report focuses on regulatory and market expansion efforts rather than clinical outbreak data, and does not provide country-level case or death counts.

triage.headline_ja: 焦点株：高端腸病毒71型ワクチンがタイの新薬審査に申請、株価は50%以上上昇して一時上限に到達
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はEnterovirus 71ワクチンの規制承認申請と企業の市場展開に関するニュースであり、感染症の流行・アウトブレイク情報ではない。公衆衛生上の急迫した脅威や異常な疾病動向の報告は含まれていない。
triage.notes: 本記事はEnterovirus 71の実際の疾病発生・流行ニュースではなく、ワクチン開発企業による新薬承認申請プロセスと企業株価の報道である。シグナルトリアージの対象は感染症の発生・疫学的異常事象であり、医療製品の規制承認申請は除外される。

article.articleHeadline: Bác sĩ cảnh báo bệnh viêm gan lây qua đường tiêu hóa, quan hệ tình dục ít người biết tới
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Doctors warn of hepatitis transmitted via the gastrointestinal tract and sexual activity, something few people know about.
article.articleSummary: Hepatitis A virus (HAV) infection diagnosed in Hanoi, Vietnam, in a 25-year-old man (V.Q.A.) admitted to Bệnh viện E with high fever (39°C) and fatigue. Laboratory tests showed markedly elevated liver enzymes (AST 1028 U/L, ALT 529 U/L). Clinicians confirmed acute HAV infection, a hepatitis transmitted via the gastrointestinal tract. HAV spreads primarily through the fecal–oral route, including contaminated food or water, direct contact, or sexual activity (including oral–anal contact), and by consuming raw or undercooked seafood from polluted waters. In adults, illness often begins with flu-like symptoms, followed by jaundice and dark urine, which appeared about five days after admission in this case. No specific antiviral therapy exists; management is supportive, with hepatoprotective agents (e.g., liver cell membrane protectants like BDD), L‑ornithine L‑aspartate, and B vitamins, along with rest and nutrition. Prevention centers on vaccination, safe food and water, thorough hand hygiene, and safe sex practices to curb fecal–oral transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 医師が警告：A型肝炎は消化器経路と性的活動を通じて感染、多くの人が知らない
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムにおけるA型肝炎の個別症例報告。IHR基準は2つ未満だが、WPROスクリーニング基準（異常性・重症度）に部分的に該当。情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 単一症例報告であり、集団発生やアウトブレイクの兆候は見られない。患者は重症度があるが、ハノイの医療機関で診断・治療中。A型肝炎は予防可能であり、通常は自限性疾患。今後、症例数の増加や地域的拡大の情報があれば再評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Oz man running across India for leprosy awareness reaches Noida
article.articleSummary: Leprosy awareness campaign across India led by Melbourne-based runner Om Satija. He started Jan 26 from Kanyakumari and is running approximately 50 km daily to Srinagar, aiming to reach by May; in Noida (Greater Noida region, Sector 15A) he crossed three checkpoints and was joined by four Shiv Nadar University students who ran 30 km to India Gate in Delhi. Satija is supported by the Udayaan Foundation in Kolkata, which works with leprosy-affected children; his fundraising target is ₹60 lakh to educate around 1,000 children over five years, with about ₹17 lakh raised so far. Leprosy, caused by bacteria, often begins with white patches and takes years to develop; it is curable but highly stigmatized, with India accounting for about 52% of global cases, disproportionately affecting economically weaker communities.

triage.headline_ja: オーストラリア人がハンセン病啓発のためインド全土を走行、ノイダに到達
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はハンセン病啓発キャンペーンの活動報道であり、新規感染症イベント（アウトブレイク、クラスター、異常な患者急増など）ではない。IHR基準およびスクリーニング基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事は感染症イベント通知ではなく、チャリティ・啓発キャンペーンの進捗報告である。メルボルン在住のランナーがインド全土を走行し、ハンセン病対策・教育の募金活動を行っている活動報道であり、シグナルトリアージの対象外。

article.articleHeadline: JJ: Uma cidade concentra 42% das mortes por chikungunya do país
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: JJ: A city accounts for 42% of the country's chikungunya deaths.
article.articleSummary: Dourados, Mato Grosso do Sul, Brazil, accounts for 42% of chikungunya deaths recorded in Brazil in 2026, according to the Ministry of Health Arboviral Monitoring Panel. By April 17, Brazil reported 19 chikungunya deaths, with 12 in Mato Grosso do Sul and eight of those in Dourados. Among the deceased are two indigenous infants aged 1 and 3 months. The municipality reported 4,959 probable chikungunya cases and 2,204 laboratory-confirmed, yielding an incidence of 2,037.6 per 100,000 inhabitants. The observed incidence far exceeds the epidemic threshold of 300 per 100,000, per the World Health Organization and the Ministry of Health. Chikungunya is transmitted by Aedes aegypti, the same mosquito that spreads dengue and Zika. The article reflects ongoing outbreak dynamics as of April 17, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: JJ: ブラジルのチクングニア死亡の42%が1つの都市に集中
triage.triage_reason: チクングニアの明らかな流行で、深刻な死亡者数（19人中8人がDourados）、WHOの流行閾値300/10万を大きく超える発生率（2,037.6/10万）、多数の確定症例、ベクター媒介により、IHR基準2項目以上とWPRO基準3項目以上が該当。国家的な公衆衛生対応の実施を示唆。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年4月17日時点のデータを報告。ブラジル保健省の公式アルボウイルス監視パネルデータに基づく。Dourados市（マットグロッソドスル州）での極度に集中した死亡は、局所的な感染制御の失敗を示唆。乳幼児を含む脆弱集団への影響。ベクター制御を含む継続的な対応が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Sesap confirma 12 casos de Mpox em 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Sesap confirms 12 Mpox cases in 2026.
article.articleSummary: Mpox infections in Rio Grande do Norte, Brazil, reach 12 confirmed in 2026, with 69 notifications, 40 discarded, and 6 under investigation. Cases are detected in Natal (capital) and the metropolitan area including São Gonçalo do Amarante. All confirmed cases are mild with no hospitalizations; 6 remain under investigation. The first case, a 44-year-old Natal resident, was diagnosed February 20 and officially reported March 13; he completed a 15-day isolation and recovered. As of April 24, 2026, the Sesap urges early diagnosis, isolation of suspected/confirmed cases, hand hygiene, not sharing personal items, and condom use. LACEN/RN conducts testing with up to 7 days for results. About 71% of 2026 cases are men aged 20–40. Severe disease tends to occur in immunosuppressed or HIV-positive individuals. Hospitals Giselda Trigueiro (Natal) and Rafael Fernandes (Mossoró) are reference centers. The OMS renamed mpox from monkeypox in 2022 to reduce stigma.

triage.headline_ja: Sesapが2026年のMpox感染者12例を確認
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル（Rio Grande do Norte州）でのMpox 12例確認は既知の病態で重症例なし。IHR基準は2つ未満だが、WPROスクリーニング基準の「異常性」「流行しやすさ」に該当し、引き続き経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年という未来の日付を含むが、現実の2024-2025年Mpoxの流行パターンと一致。Rio Grande do Norte州のNatal都市圏での局地的流行。全12例が軽症で入院なし。男性20-40歳が71%を占める。免疫不全者・HIV陽性者での重症化リスクが記載されている。公衆衛生当局（Sesap）による主動的な検査・隔離対応が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: Over 50 taken ill after eating food at community feast in Odisha's Banki village
article.articleSummary: Over 50 people, including women and children, fell ill after consuming food at a community feast in Kalapathar village, Banki block, Cuttack district, Odisha, on Wednesday evening. About 26 were admitted to Kalapathar Primary Health Centre with vomiting and diarrhea; others are treated at home and remain stable. An eight-member medical team from Subarnapur CHC and Kalapathar PHC, led by Dr. Milan Tripathy and Dr. Kanija Fatima, arrived to assess and treat. Health workers disinfected the area with bleaching powder; ORS packets and halogen tablets were distributed. Water samples were collected and sent to a laboratory for testing. CDMO Dr Prasant Kumar Hota said the illness is suspected gastroenteritis/food poisoning from contaminated food or water; test reports are awaited. No new cases reported; door-to-door follow-up continues.

triage.headline_ja: オディシャ州バンキ村の地域イベントで食事後に50人以上が罹患
triage.triage_reason: 未知の疾患との記載であり、食中毒/胃腸炎の疑いの集団発生である。詳細な検査結果待ちの段階で、現在のところ国際的拡大リスクは明確でなく、情報が不足している。
triage.notes: 疾患は『Unknown Illness』と分類されており、記事上では食中毒/胃腸炎の疑いに過ぎない。26人が入院し、他は自宅での治療で安定している。医学的調査が進行中であり、水・食品サンプルの検査結果が待機状況。地域限定的な食中毒イベントで、現時点では重症者や死亡者の報告はない。検査結果が判明するまで継続的な監視が推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: Cegah DBD & Chikungunya, Gently Baby Hadirkan Lotion Anti Nyamuk Tanpa DEET - Tribun-medan.com
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Prevent Dengue Fever & Chikungunya, Gently Baby Introduces Mosquito-Repellent Lotion Without DEET - Tribun-medan.com
article.articleSummary: About 150,000 dengue fever and chikungunya cases have been reported in Indonesia. Dengue and chikungunya are transmitted by Aedes aegypti, causing sudden high fever lasting several days. With seasonal changes, protecting infants' skin from bites is critical, given that about 30% of baby skin is thinner than adults. GENTLY Baby launches Skin Protector Lotion Plus, a DEET-free mosquito lotion formulated for newborns and up, containing citronella oil, lavender oil, centella asiatica, and panthenol. It provides up to 8 hours of protection and may soothe bite irritation; it is hypoallergenic, dermatologically tested, and halal-certified. Price about Rp 30,000; available on TikTok Shop, Shopee, Tokopedia, Lazada, and in baby shops and pharmacies across Indonesia. Addresses parent concerns by offering natural, skin-safe bite prevention to reduce dengue/chikungunya risk.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱とチクングニア熱の予防：Gently Babyが無DEET蚊よけローションを発売 - Tribun-medan.com
triage.triage_reason: 記事の主要内容は商品紹介（蚊よけローション）であり、感染症の実際の流行状況の報告ではない。デング熱とチクングニア熱の事例数が記載されているが、記事はこれらを背景情報として製品マーケティングに用いているのみで、新規発生・拡大・制御不能な感染症イベントを報告していない。
triage.notes: 本記事はインドネシアにおけるデング熱とチクングニア熱の既知の発生状況を背景として、民間企業による蚊よけ製品の販売促進記事である。感染症の新規発生、急速な拡大、制御不能な状況といった公衆衛生緊急事態の特徴を示していない。シグナルトリアージの対象外と判断する。

article.articleHeadline: Puluhan Siswa SMKN 1 Amuntai HSU Keracunan MBG, Loka POM Tabalong Ungkap Dugaan Penyebabnya - Banjarmasinpost.co.id
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dozens of SMKN 1 Amuntai HSU students poisoned by MBG, Tabalong BPOM reveals suspected cause
article.articleSummary: Mass food poisoning in Amuntai, Hulu Sungai Utara Regency, South Kalimantan, affecting 53 students at SMKN 1 Amuntai. Suspected source is MBG meals. Symptoms include abdominal pain beginning about one hour after eating. Tabalong BPOM (Loka POM Tabalong) is investigating, collecting samples from two points: leftovers from SPPG (Gizi Fulfillment Service) and students’ lunch boxes. Laboratory testing was conducted last night and is in incubation; results are expected in one to two days. Authorities are coordinating with SPPG and partners to prevent recurrence. No final pathogen confirmed in this update, though a bacterial source is suspected. The investigation aims to identify the causative pathogen and confirm the infection route, with ongoing monitoring of the MBG-associated meal program.

triage.headline_ja: Amuntaiの SMKN 1 の数十人の学生が MBG により食中毒に、Tabalong BPOM が疑わしい原因を明かす
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアで 53 人の学生が食中毒症状を呈しており、異常で予想外なイベントとして検出されている。しかし、病原体が未確定であり、学校限定のアウトブレイクの可能性が高く、死亡やより重篤な症例の報告がないため、現段階では詳細な情報を待つ必要がある。
triage.notes: 病原体が未確定のため Unknown Illness として分類されている。学校限定のアウトブレイク（SMKN 1 Amuntai）で 53 人が関連している。地方保健当局（Tabalong BPOM）が能動的に調査中。検体の検査結果待ち。死亡例の報告なし。確定診断が得られれば判定を見直す必要あり。

article.articleHeadline: Ángel Viudes: "El virus chikungun ya no es un problema de África y Asia, sino de salud pública global"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ángel Viudes: "The chikungunya virus is no longer a problem in Africa and Asia, but a global public health issue."
article.articleSummary: Chikungunya virus (VCHIK) has become a global public health threat. First detected in 1952 in Tanzania, its name evokes severe joint pain. Transmission is mainly via female Aedes mosquitoes (A. aegypti and A. albopictus, the tiger mosquito). A mutation after 2004 facilitated adaptation to A. albopictus, with spread driven by human mobility and used-tire trade; climate change expands vector ranges and speeds viral replication. The disease is highly symptomatic: acute fever, rash, and symmetric debilitating joint pain; about 95% become symptomatic. Subacute phase spans weeks to months; chronic arthritis-like pain persists in 40-80% for months or years, with fatigue, depression, and sleep issues. Mortality is under 1%, higher in newborns, elderly, and those with comorbidities, with rare encephalopathy or fulminant hepatitis. Economic losses up to 185 billion dollars in large outbreaks. 2025 saw over 0.5 million cases globally, Brazil as epicenter; Europe over 1,100 cases, notably autochthonous transmission in France and Italy. 2026 trend up; Spain reports travel-related cases; VIMKUNYA vaccine for ages 12+ available by prescription; travelers should seek pre-travel advice.

triage.headline_ja: アン헬ビウデス氏：「チクングニヤウイルスはアフリカとアジアの問題ではなく、世界的な公衆衛生課題である」
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目（深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）に該当。2025年に世界で50万件以上の症例があり、ブラジルが中心地、ヨーロッパでも2026年に拡大傾向が見られ、複数国で国内伝播が確認されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはチクングニヤウイルスの世界的拡大について述べており、ブラジルが2025年のエピセンターとして明記されている。タンザニアは1952年の初検出地として歴史的背景として言及されているが、現在のイベント発生国ではないため除外。イタリア、フランス、スペインは対象国リストに含まれない。アフリカ大陸全体の言及があるが、対象国としてはGhanaおよびDRCが該当可能だが、サマリーではこれらの具体的国名が明記されていないため verified_locations に含めない。ワクチン利用可能性も言及されており、公衆衛生対応が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: Tak Bisa Pasif Lawan Tuberkulosis, Wamenkes Benny Minta Gencar Skrining Kelompok Berisiko
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Can't Be Passive in the Fight Against Tuberculosis, Deputy Health Minister Benny Urges Stepped-Up Screening of At-Risk Groups.
article.articleSummary: Indonesia's Deputy Health Minister Benjamin P. Octavianus (Benny) urged active TB case finding through screening of at-risk groups and routine contact investigations in Jakarta on April 23, 2026. He emphasized completing treatment for TB-positive patients and strengthening community support, with prevention accelerated—prioritizing preventive therapy for household contacts, children, and vulnerable groups. The minister highlighted the need for accurate, real-time data to guide decisions and urged cross-sector collaboration beyond health, involving local government, business, communities, academics, and development partners. The goal is TB elimination by 2030; while challenging, it is deemed achievable with sustained, collective action, and he stressed that eliminating TB requires coordinated efforts across sectors.

triage.headline_ja: 結核対策に受け身になれない、保健副大臣ベニーが高リスク層への積極的スクリーニングを要請
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアにおける結核対策の政策・啓発イベントであり、新規の発生や流行情報ではない。スクリーニング強化の呼びかけは制度的対応を反映しているが、公開情報に基づく重症度や急速な拡大の具体的証拠に欠ける。
triage.notes: 結核は既知の慢性感染症であり、本記事は新規発生やアウトブレイクを示すものではなく、保健副大臣による既存対策強化の方針表明である。2030年根絶目標に向けた制度的取組みを示しているが、急性のシグナルではない。続報により新規感染者数の急増や抗性菌の出現などが報告される場合は判定変更の対象となる。

article.articleHeadline: Casos e mortes por meningite deixam municípios de MT em alerta  | Diario de Cuiabá
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cases and Deaths from Meningitis Put Municipalities in Mato Grosso on Alert
article.articleSummary: Meningitis cases in Mato Grosso trigger municipal alerts. Through epidemiological week 14 (Mar 29–Apr 4), the state reports 24 confirmed cases and 13 under investigation. Cuiabá accounts for seven cases from January to Apr 21, including two deaths; the city will offer meningitis vaccination on Saturday, Apr 25, during the Dia D influenza vaccination drive, though vaccines are available year-round at all 72 Family Health Units (USFs). In Sinop, about 503 km north, a 5-year-old girl and a teenage girl from the same family died this week. The 5-year-old contracted meningitis type B, for which there is no SUS vaccine; private doses cost roughly R$700–R$800. Sinop SMS says cases are monitored with no outbreak risk, with active contact tracing, sanitary measures, school cleaning, and temporary suspension of classes at Escola Municipal Tempo de Infância. Meningitis is inflammation of the meninges and can be viral or bacterial; vaccines include meningococcal C (MenC) and ACWY under SUS schedules.

triage.headline_ja: マット・グロッソ州の自治体が髄膜炎の症例と死亡により警戒態勢に
triage.triage_reason: 記事の主題は髄膜炎（Meningitis）であり、疾患名フィールドの「インフルエンザ」は誤分類と考えられる。ブラジルでの散発的な髄膜炎症例報告であり、IHR基準およびWPRO基準の判定基準には該当せず、対象国ではない。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが付与した疾患名「インフルエンザ」と記事サマリーの実際の主題「髄膜炎」に不一致がある。発生地域はブラジル（Mato Grosso州）であり、CEPR対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations は空配列とした。ブラジルでの散発的な髄膜炎症例は、国際的拡大リスクやIHR基準を満たさないと判断される。

article.articleHeadline: Salud define vacuna para combatir el dengue en Costa Rica | Teletica
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health Ministry Selects Vaccine to Combat Dengue in Costa Rica
article.articleSummary: Dengue in Costa Rica: The Health Ministry is advancing negotiations to acquire the Qdenga vaccine, but a final decision awaits results from its use in Argentina, Brazil, and Colombia. With about 800 dengue cases reported already ahead of the rainy season, authorities emphasize prevention tools. Qdenga has over a decade of clinical data and is approved for ages 4–60 in the three countries, given in two doses three months apart. Efficacy is reported at 89% against classic dengue and 90% against severe dengue. A final decision is not expected before the current rainy period; in the interim, the Ministry will bolster nationwide fumigation efforts to prevent a surge similar to 2024, when more than 31,000 cases were recorded. Public health messaging urges residents to eliminate mosquito breeding sites to reduce transmission and dengue-related deaths.

triage.headline_ja: コスタリカでデング熱に対するワクチン決定
triage.triage_reason: コスタリカはモニタリング対象国外であり、既報の感染事象の管理的対応（ワクチン導入検討）を扱っている。情報不足のため、続報注視が適切。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はコスタリカのワクチン導入検討であり、ブラジルはワクチン使用結果の参考国として言及されている。対象国リストではブラジル（3469034）のみが該当。デング熱流行は季節的なリスク要因として継続する懸念がある。最終的な対応決定は雨季後となる予定。

article.articleHeadline: കൊടും ചൂടിൽ ആശങ്കയായി മഞ്ഞപ്പിത്ത രോഗവ്യാപനം. ജലസ്രോതസ്സുകൾ വരണ്ടതോടെ വിലയ്ക്ക് വെള്ളം വാങ്ങിയാണ് പലയിടത്തും ഉപയോഗിക്കുന്നത്. ഇവയുടെ ഗുണനിലവാരം പരിശോധിക്കപ്പെടുന്നില്ല. വിനോദ യാത്രയ്ക്ക് പോയ് വരുന്നവരിലും വെള്ളത്തിലൂടെയും ഭക്ഷണത്തിലൂടെയും മഞ്ഞപ്പിത്തം പോലെയുള്ള ജലജന്യ രോഗങ്ങള്‍ ഉണ്ടാകാന്‍ സാധ്യതയുമേറെ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Malaria transmission becomes a concern in the scorching heat. With water sources drying up, people are buying water at a price for use in many places. The quality of these waters is not being tested. Leisure travelers are also at greater risk of waterborne diseases such as malaria through water and food.
article.articleSummary: Five Hepatitis A cases have been reported in Erumeli Muttappally, Kottayam district, amid extreme heat and reliance on possibly untested drinking water. Contaminated water and inadequate hygiene are implicated; authorities have chlorinated bore wells within a half-kilometer radius and plan quality testing of piped drinking water. Hepatitis A is a waterborne virus; children are often asymptomatic, while adults typically present with illness. Common symptoms include fatigue, fever, abdominal pain, vomiting, diarrhea, loss of appetite, and jaundice (yellowing of eyes, urine, skin). Incubation is 2–6 weeks; symptoms usually appear within about 28 days. There is no specific antiviral treatment; management focuses on fluids and rest. Preventive measures include drinking boiled water, proper handwashing, chlorination of wells, maintaining distance between septic tanks and wells, and vaccination (two doses over six months). Blood tests confirm infection; high-risk individuals may have more severe disease.

triage.headline_ja: 猛烈な暑さの中、肝炎A感染症の拡大が懸念。水源が枯渇し、品質未検査の購入水が使用されている。観光客を含め、水や食物を通じた水系感染症のリスクが増加
triage.triage_reason: インドのケーララ州コッタヤムで5例のA型肝炎報告があり、飲料水汚染と公衆衛生上の懸念が存在。水系感染症として制御可能性が問題となり、地域の衛生インフラの脆弱性を示す。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはA型肝炎を明示し、ケーララ州コッタヤムでの確認事例（5例）を報告。水質汚染と極度の気候条件が引き金となり、当局は既に対応（井戸の塩素化、水質検査計画）を開始している。見出しの翻訳では「マラリア」と記されているが、記事サマリーおよび疾患名はA型肝炎であり、これが正確な疾患である。

article.articleHeadline: Typhoid cases rise, doctors recommend vaccines - www.lokmattimes.com
article.articleSummary: Typhoid fever is rising in India, affecting 45 lakh people and causing 9,000 deaths annually, with Uttar Pradesh accounting for 27% of cases. In Lucknow (June 30), experts urge vaccination, especially for children and immunocompromised individuals. Symptoms include high fever, headache, weakness, fatigue, discomfort, cough and constipation; severe cases can cause intestinal bleeding, bowel perforation and meningitis. Two vaccines exist: conjugated vaccine (TCV) and non-conjugated Vi polysaccharide vaccine (ViCPS). TCV is recommended for infants, children 6 months and older, and adults up to 45 years, providing 90% protection with a single shot; ViCPS requires boosters every three years. Prices: ViCPS Rs 200 per dose; TCV Rs 2,000 per dose. At KGMU, 7–8 typhoid patients visit the OPD, with numbers expected to rise; Balrampur hospital emphasizes vaccination. The government does not mandate typhoid vaccination, but the Indian Paediatric Society urges prioritising children; prevention includes clean water and food. Campaigns are needed.

triage.headline_ja: インドで腸チフス患者数が増加、医師がワクチン接種を推奨
triage.triage_reason: インドで年間45万人の患者と9,000人の死亡が報告される腸チフスの増加が確認されており、ウッタルプラデーシュ州では全国の27%の症例を占める。IHR基準（深刻な影響、異常性）が該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準（重症度、感染しやすさ）も満たす。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから、インドのウッタルプラデーシュ州ルックノーで腸チフスの患者数増加が確認されている。年間45万人の患者と9,000人の死亡という深刻な公衆衛生影響が述べられており、医療機関での患者増加予測も報告されている。ただし、国際的な拡大リスクについては記事に明示されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Dog meat seller dies of rabies in Vietnam's Mekong Delta
article.articleSummary: Rabies fatal case in Vietnam's Mekong Delta: Nguyen Ngoc Son, a dog meat trader from My Tinh An Commune, was admitted on 15 April to Tien Giang General Hospital with dizziness and unilateral weakness. He developed hydrophobia and dysphagia, and on 17 April rabies infection was laboratory-confirmed at the Ho Chi Minh City Hospital for Tropical Diseases. He died on 20 April. The patient had no history of dog bites; investigators suspect infection occurred via contact with blood or secretions from an infected dog, potentially entering through skin abrasions during handling or processing dog meat. An epidemiological investigation was launched, close contacts were identified for vaccination, and the source was traced with veterinary authorities to related slaughterhouses. As of 24 April 2026, authorities are issuing public warnings about rabies risks for those handling, slaughtering, or processing animals. Rabies remains fatal once symptoms appear; vaccination and safe handling are emphasized as prevention.

triage.headline_ja: ベトナムのメコンデルタ地域で犬肉販売者が狂犬病で死亡
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病の確認死亡例（ベトナム）であり、IHR基準では異常性と重症度が認められる。また、職業曝露（犬肉処理）に関連した感染経路の不確実性と公衆衛生上の警告発令により、WPROスクリーニング基準の複数項目に該当する。
triage.notes: 狂犬病は一度症状発症後は致死的である。患者は犬肉処理作業中に血液・分泌物との接触を通じて感染した可能性が高い。当局は濃厚接触者への予防接種、感染源追跡、および動物処理従事者への公衆衛生警告を実施済み。職業関連曝露リスクと感染経路の不確実性（噛傷歴なし）が特筆される。

article.articleHeadline: AI-powered drones slash malaria cases - MyJoyOnline
article.articleSummary: Malaria in Ghana's Eastern Region shows promising results from a pilot using drone-assisted Larval Source Management (LSM). At Asuom Health Centre, Kwaebibirem Municipality, four months of drone/AI targeting breeding sites reduced outpatient malaria cases by nearly half versus the same period last year. The approach maps water bodies with high-resolution drone imagery and AI to identify risk, guiding larviciding by local partners. In a four-community comparison, drone-based sites identified more than 200% more high-risk water bodies and used 50–75% less larvicide and labor than manual searches. Ghana’s NMESP 2024–2028 aims to cut malaria mortality by 90% and incidence by 50%, targeting elimination in 21 low-burden districts. The system, led by Sora Technology, aligns with WHO guidance that LSM reduces mosquitoes and delays insecticide resistance, though EPA cautions on regulatory compliance.

triage.headline_ja: AI搭載ドローンがガーナのマラリア患者数を削減
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はマラリア流行の新規報告ではなく、既知の地域型マラリアに対する技術的な管理・制御成功事例の報道です。IHR基準は該当せず、WPROスクリーニング基準も満たしません。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はマラリアの新規発生ではなく、既知地域におけるドローン・AI技術を用いたマラリア制御の有効性を示す事例報告です。患者数減少は技術導入による改善を示しており、シグナルとしての特徴を持ちません。

article.articleHeadline: 美軍趕赴荷莫茲　士兵在泰國「遭猴抓傷」緊急離隊 | ETtoday國際新聞 | ETtoday新聞雲
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: U.S. troops rush to Homs; a soldier in Thailand was scratched by a monkey and evacuated from his unit on an emergency basis.
article.articleSummary: On 24 April 2026, a U.S. Navy sailor aboard the mine-countermeasures ship USS Chief was scratched by a monkey while in Phuket, Thailand. He was evacuated to a forward-deployed base in Sasebo, Japan for treatment, and the mission went ahead as planned with USS Pioneer to the Strait of Hormuz to clear mines. The attacking species was not confirmed; Phuket hosts large long-tailed macaque populations known for aggression. CDC warns macaques can carry Herpes B virus; without prompt medical care after scratches or bites, infections can be severe. The incident underscores infection-control considerations for sailors during shore visits, though officials say the operation schedule remains unaffected.

triage.headline_ja: 米軍ホルムズ海峡へ急行、タイで兵士がサルに引っかかれ緊急離隊
triage.triage_reason: B型ウイルス（Herpes B）の職業的曝露事例だが、現在のところ確定診断なし。記事では「CDCが警告」との言及のみで、感染症の実際の発生は確認されていない。医療措置講じられており、管理下にある。
triage.notes: B型ウイルスは確認されておらず、サル抓傷後の予防的医療対応の事例。患者は既に隔離・治療中で、感染症として確定していない。Herpes B感染リスクは存在するが現在のところシグナルとしての閾値には達していない。続報で感染確認があれば再評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Penyebaran HIV AIDS di Kota Kupang Mengkhawatirkan, IRT Tempati Posisi Kedua Tertinggi - Pos-kupang.com
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The spread of HIV/AIDS in Kupang City is alarming, housewives occupy the second-highest position - Pos-kupang.com.
article.articleSummary: HIV/AIDS in Kupang City, Indonesia, shows housewives as the second-highest infected profession after private-sector workers, per the Kupang City AIDS Commission (KPAD). Female sex workers (PSP) account for about 8% of cases, ranking fourth or fifth by profession. KPAD Secretary Julius Tanggu Bore says many housewives are at risk because they may acquire infection from partners who seek sexual partners outside and bring the virus home. A 19-year-old PSP tested HIV-positive on 2 December 2025 at Pasir Panjang Health Center. Tanggu Bore notes a PSP can serve up to 15 clients per day; if an average of five do not use condoms, this implies about 150 unprotected encounters per month (≈1,800 per year). KPAD conducts quarterly mobile counseling and testing visits targeting key populations, especially PSP, notifying locations in advance so participants attend. This reflects an iceberg-like effort to identify new cases and interrupt transmission.

triage.headline_ja: クパン市のHIV/AIDS蔓延が懸念される、主婦が2番目に高い感染職業に - Pos-kupang.com
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア（クパン市）でのHIV/AIDS感染の懸念が報告されており、WPROスクリーニング基準の複数項目（異常性、重症度の可能性、流行しやすさ）に該当する可能性があるが、現時点では具体的な流行規模、死亡数、国家レベルの支援必要性の情報が不足しているため、続報を注視する段階と判定。
triage.notes: クパン市（インドネシア東部）でのHIV/AIDS感染が報告された。主婦が2番目に高い感染職業として識別されており、性的暴露経路による継続的な伝播リスクが指摘されている。ただし、記事には全体的な症例数増加トレンド、死亡率、国家的対応の規模についての具体的データが含まれていないため、情報が限定的である。地域内での定期的な検査活動と啓発が行われているが、管理可能性についての評価には追加情報が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Malaria vs dengue: Key differences in symptoms, causes and treatment explained clearly
article.articleSummary: New Delhi-based overview as of 2026-04-24: Malaria and dengue differ in cause, symptoms and treatment. Malaria is caused by a parasite transmitted by infected mosquitoes and typically presents with cyclical fever plus chills, sweating, headache and weakness. Dengue is a viral infection spread by mosquito bites and more often causes high fever, intense body aches, pain behind the eyes, rash, nausea and sometimes bleeding signs. Treatments diverge: malaria requires specific anti-malarial drugs; dengue management is supportive, focusing on hydration, monitoring platelets and watching for warning signs. Accurate diagnosis hinges on blood testing, as fever alone cannot distinguish the diseases. Malaria risk is higher in endemic areas, with travel exposure guiding early testing. Both conditions demand timely medical care to prevent complications, according to Dr Manohar KN, Lead Consultant at SPARSH Hospital, New Delhi.

triage.headline_ja: マラリアとデング熱：症状、原因、治療の主な違いを明確に説明
triage.triage_reason: 記事は医学情報提供記事であり、新規の感染症アウトブレイク・イベントを報告していない。既知の疾患の臨床的特徴の比較教育コンテンツであり、爆発的感染拡大や異常なシグナルの報告がない。
triage.notes: 本記事はニューデリーの医療専門家による既知の感染症（マラリア・デング熱）の臨床的特徴比較に関する教育コンテンツである。新規のアウトブレイク報告、異常な増加、または緊急の公衆衛生上の懸念を含んでいない。Bluedot APIによる自動タグ付けであり、実際のイベントシグナルではない。

article.articleHeadline: Campak Kulonprogo Bergeser ke Dewasa, Dinkes Pastikan Bukan KLB
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles in Kulon Progo Shifts to Adults; Health Office Confirms It Is Not an Outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Measles in Kulon Progo, Indonesia, is shifting to adults but is not declared an outbreak. As of week 15, 2026, the district health office logged 228 suspected cases with 8 laboratory-confirmed positives: 5 measles and 3 rubella; all confirmed patients have recovered. Positive cases emerged in Samigaluh, Lendah, Sentolo, and Galur, with a sporadic, non-clustered spread that does not meet KLB criteria. A notable trend is adults being affected despite most individuals having vaccination histories, underscoring imperfect herd immunity and ongoing vaccine hesitancy in parts of the community. The health office continues weekly W2 surveillance to monitor transmission. At RSUD Nyi Ageng Serang Sentolo, three suspected cases were referred; two were hospitalized, one outpatient, but all laboratory results were negative and patients were discharged. Emphasis remains on intensified immunization education to prevent future surges.

triage.headline_ja: クロンプロゴの麻疹が成人にシフト、保健局がアウトブレイクではないことを確認
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹・風疹の検出は注視する価値があるが、公式にはアウトブレイク（KLB）として宣言されておらず、確定症例数は限定的（8件）、全例回復済み、散発的な拡がりで集計なし。ただしワクチン接種歴のある成人への拡大傾向は集団免疫の低下を示唆し、情報追跡が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年4月24日付けであり、現在の日付から未来のイベントである点に注意。クロンプロゴ地域（ジョグジャカルタ特別州）での麻疹・風疹の患者検出が記述されているが、公式にはアウトブレイク基準を満たさないとされている。成人への拡大傾向およびワクチン接種歴のある者の罹患という点が通常と異なり、スクリーニング基準の『異常性』『流行可能性』に該当。ただし限定的な患者数、全例回復、散発的パターンであるため、フルリスク評価前のWATCH段階が適切。

article.articleHeadline: Establishment of multiple predictive models for early identification of the dengue cases in outpatient healthcare systems - Scientific Reports
article.articleSummary: Dengue predictive models were developed in Futian District, Shenzhen, China, using outpatient visit data from Jan 1, 2018 to Dec 15, 2024. In a case-control study, 206 dengue cases and 824 controls (n=1,030) were drawn from clinics and analyzed via logistic regression. Data were split 7:3 into training and validation sets. Three early-identification models were built across data availability scenarios: Model 1 used symptom descriptions alone (training C-index 0.793; validation 0.779); Model 2 added epidemiological exposure factors (training 0.844; validation 0.867); Model 3 added complete blood count parameters (training 0.973; validation 0.957). All models achieved high predictive accuracy, suggesting integration into clinical decision support to flag high-risk patients and support community self-assessment. The study demonstrates feasibility of pre-diagnosis dengue risk stratification using readily available outpatient data.

triage.headline_ja: 外来医療システムにおけるデング熱患者の早期識別のための複数予測モデルの確立
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は2018年～2024年の過去データを用いた後ろ向き研究・モデル開発論文であり、新規の感染症アウトブレイク報告ではない。現在進行中の流行イベントを示す証拠がない。
triage.notes: 本記事はNature Scientific Reportsに掲載された学術論文で、深圳市富田地区での過去データを用いたデング熱予測モデルの開発研究である。新規アウトブレイク、異常な発生率上昇、または国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念を示唆する情報は含まれていない。シグナルトリアージの対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Woman dies and over 150 fall sick after suspected food poisoning caused by Dahi Bhalla and Paneer: Why these foods are risky during extreme heat
article.articleSummary: Suspected food poisoning traced to Dahi Bhalla and paneer at a wedding in Kamalpur Kazi village, Dhanaura tehsil, Amroha district, India. On April 19, more than 500 attendees consumed dairy-based dishes; by April 20, over 150 people reported vomiting, diarrhea, and abdominal pain, and an 80-year-old woman died. The cause remains unconfirmed as the family refused autopsy; authorities consider contaminated food, likely worsened by extreme heat, as the probable source. Bacterial growth in perishable dairy foods like yogurt (dahi) and paneer is heightened in hot temperatures, particularly when dishes are served at room temperature. Possible pathogens include E. coli or Salmonella; risks also arise from fermentation issues in bhallas and from spoiled paneer or contaminated water or curd used in soaking. Several victims were treated at a village health camp.

triage.headline_ja: 女性が死亡し150人以上が発症：ダヒ・バッラとパニールによる食中毒疑い―極端な熱中でこれらの食品が危険な理由
triage.triage_reason: インドのウッタル・プラデーシュ州で500人以上が被曝した結集性食中毒イベント。死亡例1件、患者150人以上で中等度の重症度を示す。IHR基準の公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性を満たし、水系感染症としての長期曝露リスクも懸念される。フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 結集性食中毒イベント。ウッタル・プラデーシュ州アムローハ地区ダナウラ・テシルのカマルプール・カジ村での結婚式に関連。500人以上の被曝者、150人以上の患者報告、死亡例1件。原因は未確認だが、極度な暑さの中での乳製品（ダヒ・バッラとパニール）の不適切な保管が疑われる。E. coliとサルモネラが可能な病原体として言及されている。オートプシー拒否により確定診断が得られていない。

article.articleHeadline: Pemkot Jakbar targetkan 11 ribu lebih kasus TBC terdeteksi pada 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: West Jakarta City Government Targets Detecting More Than 11,000 TB Cases by 2026.
article.articleSummary: West Jakarta, Indonesia: The West Jakarta City Government targets detecting 11,955 tuberculosis (TB) cases in 2026. From January 1 to April 15, 2026, 3,027 cases were identified, part of Jakarta’s drive to eliminate TB by 2030. Detection uses active and passive strategies: active case finding through community health screenings, Free Health Checks (CKG), and TB cadres in the field; passive case finding for suspects presenting at health facilities. Diagnostic workups emphasize quick confirmation via sputum smear tests and X-ray as indicated. TB treatment is delivered to a standard quality across facilities, with monitoring of medication adherence and contact tracing, followed by preventive therapy for healthy close contacts. Prevention efforts include health education, immunization, clean-living practices, cough etiquette, and ensuring access to health services for symptomatic individuals.

triage.headline_ja: ジャカルタ西部市政府、2026年までに1万1000件以上のTB症例検出を目標
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はインドネシア・ジャカルタ西部の結核検出目標に関する一般的な公衆衛生計画の報道であり、異常な感染症イベント（集団発生、予想外の増加、重症化など）を示唆するものではない。IHR基準・WPROスクリーニング基準いずれも該当せず、シグナル性なし。
triage.notes: 本記事は既存の結核対策の進捗報告であり、異常なアウトブレイクではなく通常の疾病管理プログラムの一環。2026年の検出目標（11,955件）は計画的な検査拡大の数値目標であって、急激な集団発生を示していない。シグナルトリアージでは見送り。

article.articleHeadline: তীব্র গরম ও দূষণে ঝুঁকি বাড়ে ব্যাক্টেরিয়াল মেনিনজাইটিসের, কী এই রোগ, সতর্ক থাকার উপায় কী?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Extreme heat and pollution increase the risk of bacterial meningitis: What is this disease, and what precautions should be taken?
article.articleSummary: Extreme heat and air pollution in India raise the risk of bacterial meningitis, especially meningococcal meningitis caused by Neisseria meningitidis. A Kolkata Medical College physician notes hot weather and polluted air enable the bacteria to enter via the mouth/respiratory tract and rapidly reach the brain, causing fever, severe headache, vomiting, confusion, seizures, neck stiffness, and sometimes rash; children may show fever and rash with meningococcal infection. While meningitis can be viral, bacterial forms are more dangerous. Diagnosis relies on MRI or CT imaging, with lumbar puncture and blood tests. Treatment uses antibiotics and injections, sometimes for 10–14 days. Outcomes depend on early detection. Modern antimicrobials, antifungals, and antivirals improve management, highlighting the need for prompt diagnosis and treatment in affected patients. The context emphasizes heat and pollution as risk amplifiers in Kolkata, India.

triage.headline_ja: インド西ベンガル州で細菌性髄膜炎のリスク増加：極端な熱と大気汚染が危険因子
triage.triage_reason: インドでの髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎に関する一般的な情報・啓発記事であり、具体的な患者数やアウトブレイク事象の報告がない。ただしスクリーニング基準（異常性・公衆衛生リスク）に部分的に該当するため、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 本記事は具体的なアウトブレイク報告ではなく、インドの気候・環境条件下における髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎の感染リスク因子に関する医学的・啓発的な記事。患者数、確定診断、実際の発生増加の報告がないため、IHR基準は該当せず。ただし髄膜菌性髄膜炎は重篤性が高く、環境要因により感染リスクが増加する状況が記述されているため、WPRO基準（重症度・曝露継続・流行易感性）に複数該当。医療機関の注意喚起として機能しており社会的関心もあるが、アウトブレイク事象としてのシグナルではない。

article.articleHeadline: Terkuak Bahaya Ikan Sapu-Sapu, E Coli 100 Kali di Atas Batas, Dokter Ungkap Risiko Mengerikan - Serambinews.com
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Revealed: The Dangers of the Sapu-Sapu Fish, E. coli 100 Times Above the Limit, A Doctor Reveals a Terrifying Risk - Serambinews.com
article.articleSummary: As of 24 April 2026, three samples of wild sucker fish (sapu-sapu) from the Ciliwung River, Indonesia, tested for safety. Laboratory results showed heavy metals present but below the Indonesian National Standard (SNI) threshold, while Escherichia coli (E. coli) levels were about 100 times above the safe limit (standard <3). Health expert Dr. Sadam warns that such high E. coli exposure can cause acute gastroenteritis with symptoms like severe abdominal cramps, vomiting, and diarrhea, risking food poisoning if consumed. Long-term risks from persistent heavy metals include accumulation leading to kidney and liver damage, and potential neurological effects. Based on the findings, the riverine sapu-sapu are deemed unsafe for consumption. The research, initially aimed at invasive-species control, suggests avoiding these fish as food while not addressing environmental remediation.

triage.headline_ja: 暴露：サプサプ魚の危険性、E. coli 基準値の100倍、医師が恐ろしいリスクを明かす
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアの川で採取した魚からE. coliが基準値の100倍検出された食品安全イベント。ヒト健康への潜在的リスク（急性胃腸炎）は確認されるが、実際の患者発生報告がなく、局所的な食品汚染の問題であり国際的拡大リスクは限定的と判断される。情報不足のため WATCH 段階での経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事は食品安全警告であり、感染症の流行ではなく環境汚染に関連した水産物の安全性問題。実患者の報告がないため重症度はNo、しかし Ciliwung 川からの継続的な魚の摂取リスク（prolonged_exposure）と異常な汚染検出（unusual）が存在。政府衛生部門の対応状況が記事に記載されていないため、manageability は評価不可。

article.articleHeadline: Aid Cuts Threaten Zimbabwe's Malaria Progress as Cases and Deaths Rise - Save the Children - News Directory 3
article.articleSummary: Malaria in Zimbabwe is surging due to aid cuts reversing years of progress. As of mid-April 2026, Zimbabwe recorded over 65,000 malaria cases for 2026 and 174 malaria-related deaths, nearly double the numbers for the same period in 2025; in Jan–Apr 2024 there were about 17,000 cases and 34 deaths. The rebound follows the premature end of Zimbabwe's largest malaria programme and the closure of the Zimbabwe Assistance Program in Malaria, causing shortages of insecticide-treated nets, delays in vector control, and weakened disease surveillance. Heavy rainfall and fluctuating weather patterns further boost transmission amid reduced intervention. Globally, malaria remains the leading killer of children over one month of age, accounting for about 17% of deaths in this group in endemic sub-Saharan Africa per WHO. The cuts echo regionally, with Zambia reporting more hospitalizations after suspended indoor residual spraying, and US funding cuts reducing USAID malaria programs and overall aid.

triage.headline_ja: 援助削減がジンバブエのマラリア対策の進展を脅かす、感染者数と死亡数が増加 - セーブ・ザ・チルドレン
triage.triage_reason: ジンバブエでマラリア感染者が2026年1月〜4月で前年同期比で2倍以上に急増（17,000件→65,000件以上）し、死亡数も2倍に増加。公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常な感染動向、地域的な対策崩壊が確認されており、IHR基準2つ以上に該当。
triage.notes: 記事はジンバブエとザンビアの両国に言及しているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはザンビア（895949）のみ。ジンバブエ（878675）は対象国に含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。ザンビアについては屋内残留噴霧の中止後に入院者数が増加していることが確認される。米国の援助削減によるUSAID資金削減も言及されており、国際的な支援メカニズムの重要性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: DBD di Denpasar Tunjukkan Tren Penurunan, Hingga April 2026 Tercatat 96 Kasus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue Fever in Denpasar Shows a Declining Trend; As of April 2026, 96 Cases Recorded.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever in Denpasar, Bali, is trending downward in 2026. From January through 23 April, Denpasar recorded 96 dengue cases, compared with 928 cases in the same period of 2025. Monthly totals are 31 in January, 38 in February, 19 in March, and 8 by 23 April. Health authorities credit persistent prevention efforts, including extensive community education on dengue prevention, targeted vector-control through larval source reduction (PSN), and epidemiology-guided fogging rather than mass spraying. Ultra-low-volume (ULV) fogging is in its second cycle, with about seven days between cycles, and is scheduled to end on 26 April 2026. Officials emphasize that the decline reflects coordinated action and urge residents to maintain environmental cleanliness to sustain the trend. The update was provided by Denpasar Health Office director dr. AA Ayu Agung Candrawati on 24 April 2026.

triage.headline_ja: デンパサールのデング熱が低下傾向を示す。2026年4月までに96件の症例が記録されている。
triage.triage_reason: デング熱の症例数が前年同期比で大幅に減少（96件 vs 928件）しており、公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスクいずれも認められない。社会的関心も限定的である。
triage.notes: デング熱は常在地域での既知の疾患であり、今回の報道は減少傾向を示す正常な公衆衛生管理の例である。予防対策の有効性を示す肯定的なニュースであり、新規の感染症危機を示唆していない。

article.articleHeadline: 财新周刊｜鹦鹉热潜行
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Caixin Weekly | Psittacosis Lurks
article.articleSummary: Psittacosis risk lurks in pet birds in Nanjing, China. In January 2026, a woman in her 20s bought a parrot chick at a city flower-and-bird market, asking for a quarantine certificate. The stall owner said none existed but claimed health could be judged by observation. The buyer took the bird home. By early February, the parrot developed red eyes. She suspected infection with Chlamydia psittaci (psittacosis) and treated the bird with erythromycin and levofloxacin eye drops, noting the condition improved within two days. The report highlights the danger of psittacosis linked to keeping parrots and the lack of quarantine documentation for birds sold in markets.

triage.headline_ja: 財新週刊｜オウム病が潜行
triage.triage_reason: 中国南京のペット鳥市場におけるオウム病リスクの報告。単一の事例報告であり、公衆衛生への深刻な影響は明確でないが、市場での検疫体制の問題という異常な状況が示唆されている。動物由来感染症の管理可能性に関する懸念がある。
triage.notes: 記事は単一症例報告であり、広範なアウトブレイク（複数症例）の証拠は含まれていない。しかし、南京のペット鳥市場における検疫体制の欠落と継続的な曝露リスクが示唆されている。オウム病は既知の人獣共通感染症であるが、現時点では国際的拡大のリスク情報は記事に含まれていない。継続的な市場監視と追加情報の確認が推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: Vírus Lujo stále desí vedcov: Objavil sa len raz, no už pri prvom ohnisku zabil 80 % nakazených
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Lujo virus continues to terrify scientists: It appeared only once, but at the very first outbreak it killed 80% of those infected.
article.articleSummary: Lujo virus, an Old World arenavirus causing hemorrhagic fever (LUHF), has appeared only once: the 2008 outbreak in Zambia and South Africa. Five people were infected and four died (case fatality ~80%). The index case was a 36-year-old Lusaka woman who traveled to South Africa for a family wedding; she died 13 days after symptoms began in Johannesburg. Transmission occurred to healthcare workers; a paramedic and a nurse died, another nurse and a cleaner were cases, with the last patient surviving after antiviral therapy once the illness was recognized. Incubation 7–13 days; initial fever, headache, myalgias, followed by rash, facial/neck swelling, diarrhea, sore throat; bleeding was not dominant. Human-to-human spread appears late in illness, via bodily fluids. Reservoirs likely rodent-related, possibly similar to Mastomys natalensis reservoirs identified for Lassa fever. Spike protein binding to neuropilin-2 is a unique entry mechanism.

triage.headline_ja: ルジョウウイルスは科学者を今なお恐怖させている：1度だけ出現したが、初回流行では感染者の80％が死亡した
triage.triage_reason: ラッサ熱関連の高致死性出血熱ウイルス（ルジョウウイルス）の歴史的発生事例に関する記事。2008年のザンビア・南アフリカでの唯一の公式発生で80％の致命率を示しており、IHR基準（重大な公衆衛生影響、異常性）および WPRO 基準（高い重症度、限定的管理可能性）を満たす。フルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 記事は2008年の過去の発生を検証・解説する形式だが、ルジョウウイルスの高い致命率（80%）、ヒト-ヒト感染の可能性、動物由来の推定感染源の存在により、潜在的な公衆衛生脅威として認識される。南アフリカ（Johannesburg）での感染事例も記載されているが、サマリーの主題はザンビアでの初発ケースであり、ザンビアのみ verified_locations に含める。

article.articleHeadline: Warga serbu layanan radiologi gratis: upaya FKUI deteksi dini TBC di kawasan padat jakarta
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Residents flock to free radiology services: FKUI's early TB detection effort in the densely populated areas of Jakarta.
article.articleSummary: Tuberculosis screening and free health checks organized by the University of Indonesia's Faculty of Medicine (FKUI) took place in Cilincing, North Jakarta, on 24 April 2026. Health workers collected blood samples during the screening, described as free radiology services to support early TB detection. The initiative aims to curb TB in Jakarta's densely populated areas, aligning with Health Ministry data that TB can reach about one million cases and 125,000 deaths annually in Indonesia. The program highlights FKUI's public health intervention to identify TB early, though the article does not specify laboratory confirmation methods beyond blood sampling. The effort illustrates Jakarta's urban TB control strategies and the role of academic institutions in community screening.

triage.headline_ja: 市民が無料放射線科サービスに殺到：ジャカルタの密集地域での結核早期発見のためのFKUI（インドネシア大学医学部）の取り組み
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアの結核スクリーニング・公衆衛生活動に関する記事。公式な異常警告信号としてのシグナルは認められないが、結核の国内負担の大きさが記載されており、情報収集継続の価値あり。
triage.notes: 本記事は結核スクリーニング活動の実施を報じるもので、異常な疾病発生の警告信号ではない。ただし、インドネシアにおける結核の高い疾病負担（年間約100万人の患者、12.5万人の死亡）が記載されており、公衆衛生的な関心事項である。WPROスクリーニング基準では「長期曝露」（密集地域での継続的な結核患者の存在）と「流行しやすさ」（ヒト-ヒト感染可能な結核）に該当。追加情報による継続的なモニタリングを推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Kecamatan Cengkareng catat kasus DBD terbanyak di Jakarta Barat
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cengkareng District records the highest number of dengue fever cases in West Jakarta.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever cases in West Jakarta's Cengkareng district lead Jakarta Barat with 327 of 842 cases recorded from Jan 1–Apr 23, 2026. Other West Jakarta districts reported Kalideres 188, Kebon Jeruk 85, Kembangan 65, Tambora 47, Palmerah 46, Grogol Petamburan 57, Tamansari 27. Trend shows rising DBD activity: 134 cases in January, 203 in February, 315 in March, and 190 in April (as of Apr 23). High humidity and poor drainage cited as drivers. Vector-control measures include 3M Plus, community engagement via Gerakan 1 Rumah 1 Jumantik, selective larviciding, and focused fogging. No lab confirmation details provided; no mention of imported/exported cases. Situation underscores intensified prevention in Jakarta Barat.

triage.headline_ja: ジャカルタ西部チェンガレン地区、デング熱症例数が最多
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアにおけるデング熱の季節的流行の一部と考えられるが、情報不足（死亡例や重症化率の記載なし、確定診断の詳細不明）により、トレンドと社会的関心を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: デング熱はインドネシアにおいて年間を通じて流行する風土病であり、本件は季節的上昇の一部と考えられる。記事に死亡例の記載がなく、重症度情報が限定的である。ただし2026年1月から4月にかけて症例数が増加傾向（134→203→315→190）を示しており、地元自治体による積極的な対策が実施されている。確定診断の詳細と管理可能性に関する情報が不足しているため、WATCH評価とした。

article.articleHeadline: DPRD Kota Malang Godok Ranperda Penyakit Menular, Bakal Libatkan Pelaku Usaha Hiburan Malam
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Malang City DPRD Drafts Regional Regulation on Infectious Diseases, Will Involve Nightlife Industry Operators
article.articleSummary: Malang City DPRD is drafting a Regional Regulation on Infectious Diseases (Ranperda Penyakit Menular), currently in the academic draft stage as one of 2026’s 18 priority laws. The measure seeks to strengthen prevention and response to infectious diseases, with HIV/AIDS highlighted. The Malang Health Department (Dinas Kesehatan) records 355 people diagnosed with HIV in 2025, noting many cases likely undetected. The regulation would regulate high-risk social activities and address transmission at its sources, aiming to stimulate on-ground prevention and handling. The process will involve a broad range of stakeholders, including culture, health, social sectors, and nightlife industry operators, ensuring input from civil society and community advocates. The initiative reflects an integrated approach to curb infectious diseases in Malang City, Indonesia, through comprehensive regulation and collaboration.

triage.headline_ja: マラン市DPRD、感染症に関する地域規則を起案、夜間娯楽産業事業者の関与を計画
triage.triage_reason: 本イベントはHIV/エイズの予防・対策に向けた地域規制の起案であり、新たな感染症発生や流行ではなく、政策的対応です。IHR基準およびWPRO基準のいずれにも実質的に該当しません。
triage.notes: 本記事は既知のHIV/エイズ対策としての地域規制の立案プロセスについて報じたもので、感染症イベント（発生、流行、アウトブレイク）ではなく政策イニシアティブです。2025年のマラン市での診断数355件は報告済みの既知統計であり、新規発生ではありません。シグナルトリアージの対象外です。

article.articleHeadline: WHO sieht Fortschritte im Kampf gegen Malaria
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO sees progress in the fight against malaria.
article.articleSummary: As of 24 April 2026, the World Health Organization reports progress in the fight against malaria, a life-threatening disease transmitted to humans by Anopheles mosquitoes and caused by a parasite. Mild symptoms include fever, chills, and headache; severe cases can involve confusion, seizures, and breathing difficulties. Widespread use of insecticide-treated nets, reducing mosquito breeding sites in populated areas, and vaccinations have prevented about 2.3 billion illnesses and 14 million deaths since 2000. The number of countries where malaria is endemic dropped from 108 to 80. Ongoing challenges include growing drug resistance in the malaria parasite and the spread of the Anopheles stephensi mosquito from India into Africa.

triage.headline_ja: WHOはマラリア対策での進展を確認
triage.triage_reason: マラリアの地球規模での進展報告であり、異常性や予想外性は低い。ただし薬剤耐性の増加とAnopheles stephensiのインドからアフリカへの拡大という懸念が記載されており、継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はWHOによるマラリア対策の進展報告が主体であり、新規アウトブレイク事象ではない。ただしAnopheles stephensi蚊のインドからアフリカへの拡大は潜在的リスク要因として言及されている。インド発生地点が明記されているため verified_locations に含める。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue treatments in 2-3 years, but cases set to rise with climate change
article.articleSummary: Dengue in India could gain targeted treatments in 2–3 years if ongoing trials succeed, even as climate change is expected to drive a sharp rise in cases. With the monsoon approaching, dengue is no longer seasonal and is spreading across geographies due to urbanisation and shifting climate. No approved specific therapy exists; current care is supportive. In Delhi, a high-level meeting with WHO, ICMR, NITI Aayog and the Dengue Alliance (India, Brazil, Malaysia, Thailand) pushed to accelerate therapies and access. Antivirals and monoclonal antibodies are in advanced trials; Serum Institute is conducting a Phase 3 dengue monoclonal antibody study, while THSTI and ICMR support research. India logged over 280,000 dengue cases in 2023, with underreporting likely. Policy focus includes climate-resilient health systems, fever surveillance, early detection, upgraded facilities and vector control. Vaccines exist; Indian candidates face access and pricing concerns. If successful, care could shift from symptom-based to targeted treatment.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱の治療法は2～3年で実現予定だが、気候変動により症例数の急増が予想される
triage.triage_reason: インドでのデング熱の大規模流行（2023年28万件以上）、気候変動に伴う流行拡大の予測、複数国の協力体制構築により、IHR基準およびWPRO基準の複数項目に該当。国際的な対応強化の動きが示されている。
triage.notes: 記事はインドを主舞台としているが、Dengue Alliance（インド、ブラジル、マレーシア、タイ）の国際協力体制が強調されている。マレーシアは対象国に含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。気候変動による流行拡大の予測と現在進行中の治療法開発が重要なシグナル要素。

article.articleHeadline: WHO im Kampf gegen Malaria optimistisch
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO Optimistic in the Fight Against Malaria
article.articleSummary: As of 24 April 2026, the World Health Organization remains cautiously optimistic about eradicating malaria within our lifetimes but warns that funding shortfalls threaten progress. New vaccines, treatments, and technologies such as genetic modification of mosquitoes underpin a World Malaria Day campaign on 25 April 2026 to mobilize global action.
