Africa accounts for about 95% of malaria cases and deaths, with 2024 figures of roughly 265 million infections and 579,000 deaths; children under five represent about three-quarters of fatalities. Millions of young children now receive malaria vaccines or seasonal prophylaxis. Malaria is a life-threatening parasitic disease spread by Anopheles mosquitoes, causing fever, chills, and headaches, and sometimes confusion, seizures, or breathing problems. Since 2000, bed nets, breeding-site elimination, and vaccines have prevented about 2.3 billion cases and 14 million deaths; endemic countries fell from 108 to 80. Drug resistance and Anopheles stephensi spread from India into Africa pose new challenges.

triage.headline_ja: マラリア撲滅で WHO は楽観的
triage.triage_reason: マラリアの世界的課題と進捗状況に関する WHO の見解を報じた一般情報記事。現在のところ新規アウトブレイク報告や急速な情報変化を示す具体的なシグナルは含まれていないが、薬剤耐性と Anopheles stephensi のインド発アフリカへの拡大に言及されており、継続的な監視が適切。
triage.notes: 発生地域には『Africa』と『Republic of India』が含まれているが、記事サマリーの主題はアフリカでのマラリア負担の報告（全感染例の約95%）である。一方、 Anopheles stephensi の拡大はインドから記載されており、インドでは蚊の系統の異常拡大が記録されている。対象国リストに含まれるのはインドのみであるため verified_locations に登録。IHR基準は『公衆衛生影響の深刻度』（年間26500万感染、579,000死亡）と『国際的拡大リスク』（薬剤耐性、蚊種の拡大）で2基準該当。WPRO基準では重症度・長期曝露・流行リスクで3基準該当。ただし記事は予防進捗と楽観的見通しを中心としており、新規アウトブレイク報告や危機的状況ではなく、一般情報記事の特性を持つため WATCH 判定。

article.articleHeadline: Cegah DBD, Pemerintah Desa Margorejo Berikan Sosialisasi dan Fogging di Sekitar Rumah Warga yang Terdampak - Suara Merdeka Kendal
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Prevent Dengue Fever (DBD), Margorejo Village Government Conducts Awareness Campaign and Fogging Around the Homes of Affected Residents - Suara Merdeka Kendal
article.articleSummary: On 24 April 2026, Margorejo Village Government in Kendal, Indonesia, conducted a dengue fever (DBD) prevention campaign, pairing community outreach with vector control. Health teams and the Kendal Regency health department visited homes of residents affected by DBD to stress environmental cleanliness and remove potential mosquito breeding sites—such as buckets, bathtubs, flower pots, and other water containers. The aim is to reduce Aedes aegypti breeding and interrupt transmission. Following the awareness drive, Margorejo Village authorities carried out fogging around areas housing affected residents to kill live mosquitoes. Officials emphasized that fogging only targets live mosquitoes and that primary prevention relies on clean, healthy practices by the community.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱を予防するため、マゴレジョ村政府が啓発活動とフォギングを実施 - スアラメルデカケンダル
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアのマゴレジョ村での日常的なデング熱対策キャンペーンであり、深刻な流行や異常な状況を示す証拠がない。公衆衛生への重大な影響、国際的拡大リスク、政治的・社会的な高い関心も認められない。
triage.notes: 記事は地方自治体による定期的なデング熱予防・啓発活動であり、シグナル検知として適切ではない。既知の流行地での標準的な公衆衛生対応と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: Poland's bird flu outbreaks affect egg industry and exports
article.articleSummary: Avian influenza outbreaks in Poland in 2026 have hit the egg industry, triggering culling and strict biosecurity across key poultry regions, with dozens of outbreaks since the start of the year. Since autumn 2025, the laying-hen population has fallen by about 7.5 million birds, roughly 15% of the total. Losses are sharpest in high-density areas, and restocking could take months as producers delay due to ongoing risk. In March 2026, Poland's chief veterinary inspectorate restricted egg exports from affected regions to North Macedonia, Bosnia and Herzegovina, and Kyrgyzstan; these limits are not expected to materially disrupt overall export volumes. About 35%–45% of Poland's egg production is sold abroad, supporting pricing flexibility. Polish exporters face intensified competition in the EU from non-EU suppliers such as Ukraine, Turkey, and Brazil, raising concerns about a renewed downturn into 2027.

triage.headline_ja: ポーランドの鳥インフルエンザ流行が卵産業と輸出に影響
triage.triage_reason: 動物向けの鳥インフルエンザ流行であり、人的感染の直接的な証拠がない。ただし国際的な経済影響（輸出制限）と複数国への言及があるため、今後の人獣共通感染症リスク監視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はポーランドおよび東欧諸国の動物向けAIアウトブレイク。IHR基準で国際的な貿易制限が発生しており、複数国への言及がある（ウクライナ、トルコ、ブラジルなど）。しかし人への直接的な感染報告がなく、主に経済的・動物衛生上の関心である。対象国リストではブラジルのみが該当（他の発生地域は対象国外）。人獣共通感染症としてのリスク進展を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Dari gawai warga, Thailand pantau penyebaran penyakit hingga ke desa: Apa yang bisa dipelajari Indonesia?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: From citizens' devices, Thailand monitors the spread of disease down to the village level: What can Indonesia learn?
article.articleSummary: Thailand has built an integrated health system that monitors residents’ health down to village level, supported by more than 10,000 COVID-19 labs and a digital disease surveillance network. The Center for COVID-19 Situation Administration (CCSA) coordinates outbreak response and public communication, boosting trust and compliance with health protocols (Imperial College London, 2020: 89–98% of people wear masks and follow measures). Digital health monitoring links local and national levels via MorChana and Mohpromt, covering about 36 million people including migrant workers. MorChana uses GPS and Bluetooth to flag exposure in real time; Mohpromt tracks vaccination data and electronic health records. Thailand detected a mid-2025 COVID-19 wave with 374,000 cases and 84 deaths. Early in the pandemic, the first wave ended in under six months with 3,195 infections and 3,072 recoveries (96%). By contrast, Indonesia’s regional apps (Pikobar, Sawarna, PaPa Sulbar) lack integrated cross-district surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: 市民のデバイスから、タイは村レベルまで疾病の拡がりを監視：インドネシアが学べることは？
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19の既知の流行に関する政策・システム比較記事であり、新規アウトブレイクの報告ではない。IHR基準・WPROスクリーニング基準いずれも該当せず、緊急性なし。
triage.notes: 本記事はタイとインドネシアの健康監視システムの比較分析であり、新規感染症シグナルではない。2025年中盤のCOVID-19波（374,000例、84死亡）の言及は過去の統計情報として記載されており、現在進行中の危機ではない。シグナルトリアージの対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Title: CDC Issues Travel Alert for 14 Countries and Territories Over Zika Virus Risk - News Directory 3
article.articleSummary: CDC issued a Level 2-Practice Enhanced Precautions travel alert on January 15, 2016, for 14 countries and territories in the Americas with Zika transmission and potential pregnancy risks. As of 2026-04-24, affected areas include Brazil, Colombia, El Salvador, French Guiana, Guatemala, Haiti, Honduras, Martinique, Mexico, Panama, Paraguay, Suriname, Venezuela, and Puerto Rico. The guidance links Zika infection during pregnancy to adverse birth outcomes, such as microcephaly, prompting precautionary travel decisions for pregnant women. Recommendations emphasize mosquito bite prevention (repellent, long sleeves/pants, air-conditioned or screened settings) and that travelers returning from affected areas should limit exposure for three weeks. Zika can be transmitted sexually; men should use condoms or abstain when a partner is pregnant or planning pregnancy. Updates and details are available on the CDC Zika website.

triage.headline_ja: CDCがジカウイルスリスク対象の14カ国・地域に対し渡航警告を発令
triage.triage_reason: ジカウイルスの複数国での流行・国際的拡大、妊娠中の感染による重篤な胎児障害（小頭症）との関連性、渡航・貿易制限のリスク、公衆衛生への深刻な影響が認められ、IHR基準3つ以上該当。CDCによる正式な渡航警告発令により社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事は複数国のジカウイルス発生を報告しているが、対象国リスト（CEPR監視対象地域）に該当するのはブラジルのみ。CDCの2016年1月15日の渡航警告に基づく報告であり、現在の継続的流行状況の確認が必要。妊娠女性への健康影響（小頭症など）が強調されており、生殖衛生関連の公衆衛生上の懸念が高い。

article.articleHeadline: 永州市疾控中心开展疟疾与慢性病防治宣传活动_健康_永州站
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Yongzhou CDC launches malaria and chronic disease prevention and control publicity campaign.
article.articleSummary: On April 24, 2026, Yongzhou City Health Commission, with the CDC, hospitals, and community centers, held a malaria and chronic disease prevention campaign at Yinxiang Market in Lengshuitan District. The event supports Healthy China goals by raising awareness and preventing malaria reintroduction while promoting chronic disease management. For malaria, staff outlined transmission, typical symptoms, and prevention; travellers and workers returning from malaria-endemic areas were advised to seek pre-departure protection and post-return health monitoring, and to seek medical care promptly if chills, fever, or sweating occur, reporting overseas travel to prevent imported malaria from triggering local transmission. For chronic diseases, focus was on hypertension, diabetes, and cardiovascular diseases; attendees were guided on risks, early screening, treatment, and daily management, including low-salt, low-oil, low-sugar diets, regular activity, smoking cessation, adherence, and family-doctor follow-up. The campaign aims to strengthen prevention, participation, and long-term public health capacity.

triage.headline_ja: 永州市疾控中心がマラリアおよび慢性疾病予防・コントロール宣伝活動を展開
triage.triage_reason: マラリア予防啓発キャンペーンであり、新規患者報告や流行の兆候がない。既知のマラリア対策の標準的な公衆衛生活動であり、IHR基準またはWPRO基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事は中国・永州市での予防啓発キャンペーン実施の報告であり、マラリア患者の発生、流行の兆候、あるいは異常な疫学的状況の報告ではない。定期的な公衆衛生キャンペーン活動の一環として分類される。

article.articleHeadline: Tập trung mọi nguồn lực, quyết tâm khống chế dịch tả lợn Châu Phi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Concentrate all resources, determined to contain the African swine fever outbreak.
article.articleSummary: African swine fever (ASF) outbreak in Gia Hội commune, Lao Cai Province, Vietnam, began 31 March 2026 and spread to four villages: Chiềng Pằn 1 and 2, Nà Kè, Bản Đồn. By 22 April 2026, 66 pig-keeping households reported 382 pigs dead and culled, totaling over 16.2 tonnes. The virus persists in the environment, with risk amplified by smallholder farming near roads and inadequate biosafety, plus vectors such as rodents, flies, and mosquitoes. Local authorities declared a red alert, mobilized the entire political system, enforced the “5 no’s” in farming, intensified disinfection, and tightened movement and trade controls of pigs in affected zones. About 1,500 kg of lime powder and 48 litres of disinfectants were distributed to contain the outbreak. Restocking is planned only after 4–6 months post-eradication and requires strict biosafety; daily reporting and vigilant supervision continue under Lao Cai province guidance to protect livelihoods.

triage.headline_ja: すべてのリソースを集中させ、アフリカ豚熱の流行を封じ込めることに決意
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムでのアフリカ豚熱(ASF)の流行は、複数の村への拡大、大量の豚の死亡・殺処分、環境中のウイルス残存、不十分な生物安全対策により国内感染拡大リスクが高く、スクリーニング基準複数(異常性、重症度、長期曝露リスク、流行しやすさ)に該当するため、フルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: ベトナムのラオカイ省でASFが3月31日から発生し、4月22日までに66世帯で382頭の豚が死亡・殺処分。環境中のウイルス残存、不十分な生物安全対策、ネズミ・ハエ・蚊などの媒介動物の存在により、地域内拡大リスク高し。地方当局が赤色警報を発令し、厳格な移動・貿易統制を実施中。動物衛生上重要なシグナルであるが、人獣共通感染症ではないため国際的な人的パンデミックリスクは低い。

article.articleHeadline: Dinkes Kota Malang Butuh Perda Penyakit Menular untuk Hadapi Tantangan Kasus di Lapangan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Malang City Health Office Needs a Local Regulation on Infectious Diseases to Face Field Case Challenges.
article.articleSummary: As of 24 April 2026, Malang City faces ongoing infectious disease challenges, prompting the Health Office to seek a local regulation (Ranperda Penyakit Menular) to bolster prevention and case management. The DPRD Malang has prioritized this measure for 2026. Diseases highlighted include tuberculosis (TBC), HIV, and vaccine-preventable diseases such as measles (PD3I). While national Health Ministry regulations exist, a local legal framework is deemed necessary to strengthen program implementation. The regulation would be issued via a mayoral Regulation (Perwali) to provide a clear legal basis for field operations, enforcement, and public education on prevention, testing, treatment, and other public health actions. Puskesmas facilities are reportedly adequate for basic services, with equipment like ultrasound and ECG and access to basic labs; BLUD status offers staffing flexibility. The initiative involves the Bapemperda and broader stakeholder engagement.

triage.headline_ja: マラン市保健局が感染症対策のための地方規則（Perda）を必要とする
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア（ジャワ東部州マラン市）における結核、HIV、麻疹の複数疾患による感染症課題が報告されているが、記事は主に地方規則制定の必要性という政策・制度面の議論に焦点を当てており、具体的な流行規模や緊急性の明確な情報が不足している。
triage.notes: 記事はマラン市の複数の感染症（結核、HIV、麻疹）への対応として地方規則（Perda）制定の必要性を述べている。これはジャワ東部州マラン市における慢性的・継続的な感染症課題を反映しているが、具体的な症例数、死亡数、急激な増加の有無など定量的なエスカレーション情報が記載されていない。政府レベルでは関心が高いが、フルRRAに進むには詳細な流行状況データが必要。

article.articleHeadline: Pekerja Waspada! Kemenkes Ungkap Demam Berdarah Dengue Bisa Terjadi di Tempat Kerja : Okezone Women
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Workers, Be Vigilant! Ministry of Health Reveals Dengue Fever Can Occur in the Workplace: Okezone Women.
article.articleSummary: Workplaces in Indonesia—offices, factories, and project sites—can be dengue hotspots if vector control is neglected, due to Aedes aegypti breeding. As of April 14, 2026, Indonesia recorded 30,465 dengue infections (incidence 10.6/100,000) and 79 deaths (CFR 0.3%). Clinically, 10,138 are Dengue Fever (DD), 19,877 Dengue Hemorrhagic Fever (DHF; known as DHF/DBD in Indonesian), and 450 Dengue Shock Syndrome (DSS). Ministerial data underscore Indonesia’s share of global dengue burden, accounting for 17% of dengue deaths and ranking second in mortality after Brazil. Speaking at SIAP Lawan Dengue in South Jakarta, Prima Yosephine, Director of Communicable Diseases, Ministry of Health, highlighted hesitancy toward dengue vaccination among office workers, with cost cited as a key factor. The report urges integrated prevention—education, vector control, and cross‑sector collaboration—to protect workers and strengthen national preparedness against dengue.

triage.headline_ja: 労働者へ警告！保健省がデング熱が職場で発生する可能性を明かす：Okezone Women
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（異常/予想外性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準でも5項目全てに該当。インドネシアでの高い死亡率（全球デング死亡数の17%、ブラジルに次ぐ）と職場での感染リスク拡大が報告されており、フルRRA推奨。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIはBrazilを発生地域に含めているが、記事サマリーではBrazilはデング死亡数の比較対象（インドネシアがブラジルに次ぐ）として言及されているのみで、実際のイベント発生地はインドネシアのみ。インドネシアのデング感染者30,465人、死亡79人（CFR 0.3%）、DHF/DSSの報告あり。職場での蚊媒介感染リスク拡大が強調されており、予防接種躊躇の課題も指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: Cegah Rabies, KPKP Kepulauan Seribu Gencarkan Vaksinasi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Prevent Rabies, Thousand Islands KPKP Steps Up Vaccination
article.articleSummary: Rabies vaccination campaign in Jakarta's Thousand Islands (Kepulauan Seribu) targets 251 rabies-transmitting animals (HPR) on Pulau Sabira, Kepulauan Seribu Utara. The free vaccination effort by Suku Dinas Ketahanan Pangan, Kelautan, dan Pertanian (KPKP) Kepulauan Seribu is part of the provincial government’s ongoing drive to maintain a rabies-free status and enhance coastal animal welfare. Nurliati, head of Sudin KPKP Kepulauan Seribu, says vaccination is a key mitigation to protect residents. The department also conducts sterilization to prevent a surge in stray cats that could affect ecosystem balance and neighborhood aesthetics. The article centers on vaccination coverage and population management, with no disease outbreak or mortality figures provided. The associated statements were made on 20 April 2026, published 24 April 2026.

triage.headline_ja: 狂犬病を予防、千島地区KPKPがワクチン接種を強化
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は狂犬病の予防的ワクチン接種キャンペーンに関するもので、発生事例や患者数の報告がない。通常の公衆衛生予防活動であり、IHR基準およびWPRO基準のいずれも該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事は狂犬病の発生ではなく、ジャカルタの千島地区での予防的ワクチン接種キャンペーンを報じている。患者数、死亡、アウトブレイクの報告はなく、通常の動物衛生管理活動である。シグナルトリアージの対象とはならない。

article.articleHeadline: बंदर ने 6 महीने पहले काटा, अब युवक को हुआ रेबीज; हथेली में डालकर चाय-पानी पी रहा
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Monkey bit him six months ago; now the youth has rabies; placing it on his palm and drinking tea.
article.articleSummary: In Ghaziabad, Uttar Pradesh, a 28-year-old man developed rabies symptoms six months after being bitten by a monkey. He had not received anti-rabies vaccination at the time of the incident, and his condition deteriorated, with abnormal behavior. Family reported he started behaving like a monkey, scratching himself, and even placing tea and water in his palm to drink, and emitting monkey-like sounds. Emergency doctors suspected rabies and promptly referred him to GTB Hospital for specialized care. The hospital initiated treatment, and precautionary anti-rabies vaccinations were administered to his close contacts—the father, brother, wife, and their one-year-old child—to blunt further transmission. Authorities emphasize not to ignore animal bites, as rabies is fatal but can be prevented with timely vaccination. The patient is under close observation with some early signs of improvement.

triage.headline_ja: サルが6ヶ月前に咬んだ、今若い男性が狂犬病に；手のひらに置いてお茶と水を飲んでいる
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病は致死的疾患であり、インドで確定症例が報告されている。6ヶ月後の発症という異常な経過と、家族内への曝露リスク、予防接種の遅延が公衆衛生上の深刻な懸念となるため、フルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 動物咬傷後6ヶ月での狂犬病発症は異常（通常潜伏期は1-3ヶ月）。家族への接触曝露と複数人への予防接種実施が報告されている。当初の予防接種未実施がリスク管理の課題として強調されている。

article.articleHeadline: Casos de gripe disparam e reforçam alerta para a necessidade de se vacinar
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza cases surge and reinforce the warning about the need to be vaccinated.
article.articleSummary: Influenza season arrives early and stronger in Brazil in 2026. By April 17, 4,181 influenza-associated Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome (SRAG) cases and 259 deaths were reported, with Fiocruz forecasting continued high activity in about 14 of 27 states. The surge involves Influenza A(H3N2) and its subclade K (J.2.4.1). Globally, WHO estimates 500 million infections annually, with 3–5 million severe cases and up to 650,000 deaths, affecting the young, the elderly, pregnant people, and the immunocompromised. A 2025 meta-analysis of 165 studies found vaccination reduces hospitalizations by 42%, deaths by 36%, ICU admissions by 52%, ventilation by 55%, and pneumonia by 51%. Brazil’s National Immunization Program vaccinates year-round for children 6 months–under 6 years, pregnant individuals, and those 60+, with nationwide campaigns; some municipalities open to all, and private providers offer vaccines. Barriers include access, timing, clinician recommendations, and misinformation. The season’s vaccine may confer protection against subclade K even without it in the formula, per animal studies.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルでインフルエンザ患者が急増、ワクチン接種の必要性を強調
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で公衆衛生への深刻な影響（259死亡、4,181重症患者）と異常性（例年より早期かつ強力な流行）の2つ以上に該当。WPRO基準でも重症度（死亡・入院多数）、流行しやすさ（ヒト-ヒト感染、複数州への拡大）が確認され、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 2026年4月時点での記事で、ブラジルにおけるインフルエンザA(H3N2)の早期流行を報告。Fiocruzの予測では14/27州で高活動が継続予測。ワクチン接種率向上と公衆衛生対応が重要課題として認識されている。

article.articleHeadline: Novartis Secures WHO Nod For Infant Malaria Therapy Coartem Baby
article.articleSummary: WHO prequalifies Coartem Baby, the first and only malaria treatment designed for newborns and young infants weighing 2–5 kg. The prequalification enables procurement through public-sector and donor-funded programs, addressing a long-standing gap in protection for the most vulnerable—infants under 4.5 kg who previously had no approved options and were often treated with age-inappropriate medicines. Coartem Baby, also marketed as Riamet Baby in some countries, was developed with Medicines for Malaria Venture and is largely available on a not-for-profit basis in endemic regions. Clinicians such as Dr. Emmanuel Aidoo (Ghana) emphasize that an infant-specific option boosts safety and physician confidence; WHO officials call it a breakthrough to ensure the smallest patients are not left behind. Novartis has launched in Ghana and plans broader expansion; the company has delivered over 1.1 billion Coartem courses since 1999 and continues malaria research. NVS stock traded within $104.93–$170.46, closing at $147.48.

triage.headline_ja: ノバルティス、乳幼児向けマラリア治療薬コアルテムベビーでWHO承認を取得
triage.triage_reason: これは医薬品の規制承認に関するニュースであり、感染症の発生・アウトブレイクイベントではない。疾患が存在することは事実だが、新規の感染症危機や異常な流行を示す信号ではない。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はノバルティス社による新医薬品の WHO 事前適格化（prequalification）の発表である。ガーナでの製品展開に言及されているが、これはマラリアの発生・アウトブレイク報告ではなく、医薬品承認・製品ローンチのニュースである。EBS（Early Warning and Response System）のシグナルトリアージ対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Malaria: via libera OMS a primo farmaco per neonati, è di Novartis
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Malaria: WHO gives the green light to the first drug for neonates, from Novartis.
article.articleSummary: WHO prequalifies Coartem Baby, the first antimalarial designed for neonates 2–5 kg, developed by Novartis with Medicines for Malaria Venture (MMV). Also known as Riamet Baby in some markets, the drug will be supplied largely on a non-profit basis through public-sector channels in malaria-endemic regions, starting in Ghana. Global malaria burden remains high: 2024 data show about 282 million cases and 610,000 deaths, predominantly in Africa, with children under 5 accounting for ~75% of African deaths. triage.triage_reason: マラリア医薬品の承認（予防・治療イノベーション）は重要だが、新たな感染症の発生やアウトブレイクではなく、治療ツールの展開に関するニュースである。ガーナでの初期導入予定は社会的関心を呼ぶが、シグナルトリアージの対象外に近い。
triage.notes: 本イベントは感染症医薬品の規制承認・商用展開に関するニュースであり、感染症の発生やアウトブレイク検出ではない。ガーナでの導入が予定されているため location は確認されたが、シグナルトリアージの対象（新規発生・異常な疾病パターン）ではなく、WATCHに分類した。公開情報の継続監視により、ガーナでの導入状況や市場展開に関する追加情報を確認する価値があるが、現時点ではフルRRA対象外。

article.articleHeadline: 호르무즈 향하던 미 해군 병사, 태국서 원숭이 공격으로 이탈
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: U.S. Navy sailor bound for the Strait of Hormuz withdraws after a monkey attack in Thailand.
article.articleSummary: US Navy sailor with the USS Chief, part of a joint mine-countermeasures task with USS Pioneer bound for the Strait of Hormuz, was attacked by a macaque in Phuket, Thailand, and evacuated to Sasebo, Japan; he will not join the Hormuz operation. Phuket's crab-eating macaques are known to enter urban areas and sometimes assault people or steal items. The CDC warns macaques may carry Herpes B virus and recommends prompt treatment after exposure. The injury was a minor scrape, and the mission onward to the Hormuz Strait is reportedly unaffected; officials called the incident unusual.

triage.headline_ja: ホルムズ海峡に向かっていた米海軍兵士、タイの猿の攻撃により転出
triage.triage_reason: B型ウイルス（ヘルペスB）への曝露リスクがあり、稀な動物由来感染症事例として監視対象だが、現時点では感染確認なく情報不足。引き続き臨床転帰を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: B型ウイルス曝露事例は稀だが、現時点で感染確認がなく、受傷者は軽微な擦り傷のみ。発症がなければ感染症事象ではなく動物咬傷の労働衛生事案に留まる。今後の臨床転帰（特にB型ウイルス抗体検査・PCR結果）の報告待ちで、経過観察継続が適切。

article.articleHeadline: Tarakan Bebas Flu Burung, Ini Perbedaan dengan Penyakit Newcastle Disease pada Ayam - Tribunkaltim.co
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tarakan Free of Avian Influenza, Here's How It Differs From Newcastle Disease in Chickens - Tribunkaltim.co.
article.articleSummary: Tarakan, North Kalimantan, remains free of avian influenza, according to veterinary officials (Drh Richard, Tarakan’s Food Security and Animal Health Office). Active, community-based reporting engages farmers, traders, RT/RW, and security personnel to enable early detection of outbreaks. Newcastle Disease (ND) can resemble avian influenza, but ND is non-zoonotic and does not infect humans. Diagnosis relies on sampling from reports and testing at accredited laboratories, including the UPTD Provincial Laboratory of North Kalimantan and Banjarbaru’s Veterinary Center. Authorities complement lab work with rapid field inspections and stringent biosecurity, particularly monitoring poultry movements into Tarakan. Farm conditions are currently stable, with poultry mortality around 1–2% of the flock. Ongoing surveillance extends to areas such as Juata to maintain the region’s disease-free status.

triage.headline_ja: タラカン市は鳥インフルエンザが自由、ニューカッスル病との違いをここに示します - Tribunkaltim.co
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア（北カリマンタン州）で鳥インフルエンザが「発生していない」という報道であり、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響、異常な事態、国際的拡大リスクは認められない。これは疾病サーベイランスの通常報告に過ぎない。
triage.notes: 記事はタラカン市が鳥インフルエンザの自由状態を維持していることを確認する安定的な報道であり、現在のアウトブレイクを示唆していない。ニューカッスル病との鑑別は教育的内容である。動物への限定的な影響（ニューカッスル病）のみで、ヒト感染リスクは記載されていない。通常のサーベイランス活動の報告として分類される。

article.articleHeadline: 川渝两地发布传染病风险健康提示
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Sichuan and Chongqing issue health tips on infectious disease risk.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-04-24, Chongqing CDC and Sichuan CDC issued health tips warning that the spring–summer transition raises risks of enteric, mosquito-borne, and respiratory infections in Sichuan and Chongqing, with holidays and lambing season elevating brucellosis risk. Enteric infections feature hand, foot and mouth disease and other diarrheas; high-risk settings include schools, nurseries, and catering venues. Preventive measures: hand hygiene, food safety, EV71 vaccination before 12 months, and proper handling of vomiting in institutions. Mosquito-borne diseases include dengue and chikungunya; travelers from tropical/subtropical regions such as Southeast Asia and South America are a focus. Prevention: remove standing water, screens and nets, light clothing, repellents, and seek care promptly if fever with rash or joint pain, with travel history disclosed. Varicella remains high among children under five; vaccination, ventilation, avoiding crowds, and school screening are advised. Brucellosis risk persists for slaughterhouse and dairy workers; use PPE, avoid raw dairy and undercooked meat, and report exposure.

triage.headline_ja: 四川と重慶が感染症リスクに関する健康情報を発行
triage.triage_reason: 春夏季節転換期における複数の感染症（手足口病、デング熱、チクングンヤ、ブルセラ症など）のリスク警告が当局から発出された。異常または予想外の事象ではないが、複数の病原体に関する公衆衛生上の関心がある。情報の詳細度と確認事例の有無について不明な点が多い。
triage.notes: 本記事は健康警告・予防情報の発出であり、具体的な感染例や流行拡大の報告ではない。複数の季節性感染症に対する当局の予防啓発という性質のため、IHR基準には該当しない。ただしWPRO基準では長期曝露リスク（学校、保育施設などの高リスク施設）と流行しやすさ（蚊媒介感染症、人獣共通感染症）に該当。政府関心は高いが、確定患者数や異常な増加傾向の記述がないため、WATCH段階の経過観察が適切。

article.articleHeadline: बंदर ने 6 महीने पहले काटा, अब युवक को हुआ रेबीज; मंकी जैसा चिल्ला रहा
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Monkey bit him six months ago; now the youth has rabies and is screaming like a monkey.
article.articleSummary: In Ghaziabad, Uttar Pradesh, a 28-year-old man bitten by a monkey six months ago developed rabies symptoms after a delayed response, displaying abnormal behavior, monkey-like actions, and peculiar responses. He was brought to a hospital and referred to Guru Tegh Bahadur Hospital for specialized care. Authorities initiated precautionary anti-rabies vaccination for his close contacts—father, brother, wife, and a one-year-old child—to prevent transmission. The patient’s condition shows some improvement but remains under close monitoring. Nodal officer Dr. R.K. Gupta urged the public not to underestimate animal bites, stressing that rabies is fatal but preventable with timely vaccination. The incident underscores the importance of immediate post-bite vaccination for any dog, monkey, or other animal bite.

triage.headline_ja: 猿に6ヶ月前に咬まれ、今、青年は狂犬病を発症し、猿のように叫んでいる
triage.triage_reason: インドで狂犬病の確定患者が報告されており、公衆衛生への関心が高いが、単一事例報告で国際的拡大の直接的エビデンスに乏しい。情報の完全性が限定的であるため経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 狂犬病は致死的で予防可能な疾患であり、本事例は遅延した治療の重要性を示している。6ヶ月の感染潜伏期間後の発症は狂犬病の特徴的な特性を反映している。地域当局が濃厚接触者への予防接種を実施しており、公衆衛生対応が取られている。ただし、複数患者の集団発生の報告がなく、単一事例報告であるため、現段階ではフルRRA前のWATCH段階が適切。

article.articleHeadline: 这种病已在我国本土消除，但每年都有境外输入！
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: This disease has been eliminated domestically in our country, but there are imported cases from abroad every year!
article.articleSummary: China has eliminated malaria domestically with WHO certification in 2021, but imported malaria cases from abroad occur annually, keeping the risk of reintroduction and local transmission. Malaria is caused by Plasmodium parasites; five human-infecting species exist—P. falciparum, P. vivax, P. malariae, P. ovale, and P. knowlesi—with P. falciparum and P. vivax posing the greatest danger. Core prevention focuses on preventing importation, interrupting transmission, early detection, and rapid response. Returning travelers and migrant workers from malaria-endemic areas should monitor for fever, chills, and fatigue and report travel history promptly. Personal protection against mosquitoes—nets, screens, repellents, and protective clothing—is essential. Early diagnosis and standard treatment prevent spread. April 26 is National Malaria Day in China, underscoring ongoing risk from imported cases despite domestic elimination.

triage.headline_ja: この病気は私たちの国で本土から排除されていますが、毎年海外から輸入されています！
triage.triage_reason: マラリアは中国で国内発症が排除されている状況だが、毎年輸入症例が発生し続けており、再導入・局所伝播のリスクが存在する。ただし現時点では深刻な集団発生の報告ではなく、情報の進展を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事は中国でのマラリア排除認証（2021年WHO認定）と毎年の輸入症例の継続的リスクについて述べている。深刻な流行ではなく、予防啓発コンテンツと位置付けられる。4月26日は中国の全国マラリア日。輸入症例による再導入リスク、蚊媒介、海外流行地域からの渡航者・出稼ぎ労働者が該当している。

article.articleHeadline: Urgent Action Needed to Strengthen Dengue Diagnostics and Treatment Ahead of Monsoon Season - News Directory 3
article.articleSummary: Urgent action to strengthen dengue diagnostics and address the absence of specific therapeutics ahead of the monsoon season in South and Southeast Asia. A day-long dialogue hosted by DNDi with THSTI, WHO SE Asia Region, and Dengue Alliance partners highlighted gaps in diagnostic capacity and treatment. In India, 2023 dengue cases exceeded 2.89 lakh, with underreporting and surveillance limits implying a higher true burden. Taruna Madan Gupta (ICMR) stressed dengue as a national health priority, noting ongoing Phase III trials of an indigenous tetravalent dengue vaccine enrolling over 10,000 participants and expanded public-private partnerships. Despite vaccine and diagnostic progress, no antivirals or targeted therapeutics exist. Dr G Karthikeyan (THSTI) affirmed commitments to advance both diagnostics and therapeutics through collaborations. With the monsoon increasing Aedes aegypti breeding, experts call for sustained investment in research, manufacturing capacity, and equitable access to preventive and therapeutic tools.

triage.headline_ja: モンスーン時期に向けたデング診断と治療の強化が急務 - ニュースディレクトリー3
triage.triage_reason: インドのデング熱について診断と治療の強化の必要性を論じた記事で、2023年の症例数が多いものの、これは既知の季節的課題の政策提言型記事であり、新規の急性ピークやアウトブレイク報告ではない。ただし南・東南アジア全域での関心と継続的な病原体監視の観点から経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はインドのデング熱の既知の季節的課題と診断・治療ギャップの認識に焦点を当てており、新規または急性の流行警告ではない。しかし、2023年のケース数が多く、モンスーン期間中の媒介蚊増加による曝露継続が確実であり、WHO地域事務局やDNDiなどの国際機関の関与がある点で、継続的な監視価値がある。

article.articleHeadline: （乡村行·看振兴）内蒙古肉牛小镇：产业提档从春日防疫开始
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: (Rural Tour · Watching Revitalization) Inner Mongolia Beef Cattle Town: Industrial Upgrading Begins with Spring Epidemic Prevention
article.articleSummary: On 2026-04-24, Inner Mongolia’s Longchang Town in Balinzu Banner launched a spring animal-epidemic prevention program to upgrade its beef cattle industry. With 22,000 cattle and 2025 output of 443 million yuan, the town is part of an agriculture-industrial integration project aiming to strengthen the sector. A spring prevention leadership group coordinates 36 biosecurity workers across 32 villages under a 'no village, no household, no cattle left behind' pledge. Vaccination records follow 'one village file, one household record' and are logged via the Inner Mongolia MuYunTong app. The town operates 32 quarantine checkpoints; farmers file declarations online, and staff reach each site within two hours, checking immunization, ear-tags, and issuing an online Animal Quarantine Certificate after verification. Suspected cases are sampled and isolated. Long-standing issues—dispersed farms, vaccine cold-chain gaps, and scattered records—are addressed as authorities push environmental improvements and manure utilization, amid foot-and-mouth disease and brucellosis risks.

triage.headline_ja: （農村ツアー・振興を見る）内モンゴル牛肉の町：産業高度化は春の疫病予防から始まる
triage.triage_reason: 記事は内モンゴル地域における牛肉産業の発展と予防的な防疫プログラムについての産業ニュースであり、進行中の疾病アウトブレイク事例ではない。口蹄疫およびブルセラ症は潜在的リスク要因として言及されているのみで、実際の集団発生やクライシスイベントの報告ではない。
triage.notes: 記事は防疫プログラムの実施状況に関する肯定的なニュース報道であり、進行中のアウトブレイク事例ではない。口蹄疫・ブルセラ症は「リスク」として言及されているが、患者数、確定例、死亡例などの急性の公衆衛生上の危機は記載されていない。シグナル検出ではなく、ルーチンの産業・公衆衛生対策の報告と判断。

article.articleHeadline: Anjing Diduga Rabies Mengamuk dan Gigit 18 Warga di Buleleng Bali
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dog Suspected of Rabies Goes on a Rampage and Bites 18 Residents in Buleleng, Bali.
article.articleSummary: Rabies-suspected dog in Banyuning Village, Buleleng District, Bali, bit 18 residents on 23 April 2026, including two children aged 10 and 5. All bite victims received anti-rabies vaccine (VAR); none classified as high risk. Wounds were mainly on legs and arms; patients were treated at Buleleng Public Health Centers 1 and 3 and RSU Giri Emas Hospital. The dog, a small-to-medium cream-colored mixed-breed with a short tail, has not yet been found; searches planned for the afternoon to night with community involvement. The incident was identified from social media reports; authorities confirmed the case count and vaccination status, with no high-risk cases reported to date.

triage.headline_ja: バリ州ブレレンで狂犬病疑い犬が暴れ回り18人を咬傷
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア（対象国）での狂犬病疑い事案であり、WPRO基準の異常性・重症度・流行可能性が部分的に該当。ただし現時点では高リスク症例がなく、全員がワクチン接種済みであるため、情報収集と続報監視が必要。
triage.notes: 狂犬病は高い致死率を持つ人獣共通感染症だが、本事案では全員がVAR（抗狂犬病ワクチン）を接種済みで高リスク症例なし。犬の確保状況や地域での追加感染の可能性について続報を監視する必要がある。記事はインドネシア語地域メディアからの報道。

article.articleHeadline: Gefahr durch Malaria: Wie schütze ich mich auf Reisen?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Risk of malaria: How can I protect myself while traveling?
article.articleSummary: Malaria is transmitted to humans by the Anopheles mosquito and is deadly, with about half a million deaths in Africa annually. Travelers from Europe to malaria regions should consider prophylaxis. High-risk areas include sub-Saharan Africa down to Mozambique (excluding South Africa) and Southeast Asian islands east of Lombok to Papua New Guinea. In these regions the risk of death from malaria outweighs potential prophylaxis side effects. In large parts of South Asia and South America, carrying a standby treatment upon suspicion may suffice, India or Borneo. Two prophylactics are available: Malarone/Malanil (atovaquone-proguanil) and doxycycline. Both are prescription meds; Malarone must be continued seven days after return, doxycycline four weeks. Side effects: Malarone GI upset; doxycycline sun sensitivity and genital yeast infections; doxycycline not for pregnant women or children under eight. Costs vary; insurance rarely covers prophylaxis; some private plans reimburse. Consistent mosquito protection (nets, DEET sprays, clothing) remains defense.

triage.headline_ja: マラリアのリスク：旅行中に身を守る方法は？
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は旅行者向けのマラリア予防啓発記事であり、新規の感染症の流行イベントではない。過去の統計情報（アフリカでの年間約50万人の死亡）と予防方法の一般的な情報提供が主内容である。新たな異常な発生状況や公衆衛生上の緊急事態は報告されていない。
triage.notes: 本記事はマラリアの流行イベント報告ではなく、旅行者向けの予防情報記事である。Bluedot APIが複数国を抽出しているが、これは記事で言及される「マラリア流行地域」の一覧であり、現在の疾病発生の報告ではない。verified_locationsはサマリー内で具体的に名前が挙げられたIndonesiaとIndiaのみを含める。

article.articleHeadline: Foco de contaminación en Campo Verde tiene en alerta a Villa del Rosario | Noticias de Norte de Santander, Colombia y el mundo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Pollution hotspot in Campo Verde puts Villa del Rosario on alert | News from Norte de Santander, Colombia and the world
article.articleSummary: Pollution-driven standing water in Campo Verde, Villa del Rosario, Norte de Santander, Colombia, affects more than 200 families as a rainwater canal crossing the 20 de Julio and Lomitas neighborhoods carries domestic wastewater into the streets. Residents say years of informal settlements and irregular connections lacking drainage exacerbate overflows, prompting persistent odors and forcing households to keep doors and windows closed. The noxious smell is particularly troubling for pregnant women, children, and older adults, causing nausea, vomiting, and migraines. Stagnant water has become mosquito breeding sites, with dengue cases reported year-round, and some residents have required emergency care. The community notes humidity-related slips and negative impacts on local commerce. Despite repeated petitions to authorities, residents report little progress toward resolving the drainage and sanitation problems fueling the health risks.

triage.headline_ja: カンポベルデの汚染焦点がビジャデルロサリオに警戒をもたらす | コロンビア、ノルテデサンタンデル州および世界のニュース
triage.triage_reason: 本イベントは環境汚染による蚊の増殖と関連するデング熱の発生ですが、記事の主題は地方的な排水・衛生問題であり、国際的な拡大リスクは低い。対象国（ブラジル）での直接的な感染症イベント報告がなく、IHR基準およびスクリーニング基準の該当が限定的です。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はコロンビア（Norte de Santander州）の地方的な環境汚染・衛生問題であり、対象国リストに含まれていません。ブラジルは発生地域に列挙されていますが、記事サマリーではコロンビアのみが主題となっており、ブラジルでの実際のイベント発生の報告はありません。したがってverified_locationsは空配列です。デング熱の存在は記述されていますが、大規模流行の兆候や国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念を示す証拠がないため、DISMISSと判定します。

article.articleHeadline: [Kolom Pakar] Prof Tjandra Yoga Aditama: 8 Hal tentang Tuberkulosis dan Diabetes Melitus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: [Expert Column] Prof. Tjandra Yoga Aditama: 8 Things About Tuberculosis and Diabetes Mellitus.
article.articleSummary: TB and Diabetes Mellitus (DM) interact to increase risk and burden. In Jakarta, Indonesia, Prof. Tjandra Yoga Aditama outlined eight points during a TB-DM briefing at Puskesmas Tambora, West Jakarta, on April 23, 2026. Global trends from WHO indicate TB risk rises among people with DM. First, DM prevalence is projected to grow about 50% between 2019 and 2045, with a median increase up to 99% in countries with high TB burden. Second, 2023 data show roughly 380,000 new TB cases were DM-triggered worldwide. Third, a 2019 systematic review reports 15.3% of TB patients have DM, compared with 9.3% DM in the general population. Fourth, 2023 figures show about 1.65 million TB patients also require DM treatment. Fifth, DM increases TB risk by approximately 1.9×, with some studies indicating up to 4.2× for type 1 DM.

triage.headline_ja: [専門家コラム] ティジャンドラ・ヨガ・アディタマ教授：結核と糖尿病についての8つのポイント
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は結核と糖尿病の相互作用に関する専門家による教育的コラムであり、新規の感染症アウトブレイク、異常な患者数の報告、または公衆衛生上の緊急事態を報告していない。WHO統計の引用と医学的知見の提示に過ぎない。
triage.notes: 本記事はジャカルタで開催された結核-糖尿病に関する専門家ブリーフィングについての報道記事であるが、新規事例の報告、患者数の増加、アウトブレイク、または公衆衛生危機の兆候は含まれていない。一般的な疾病負荷に関する既知のWHO統計データと医学的知見の解説であり、シグナル検出の対象外。

article.articleHeadline: 五一出行防蚊虫，这份"防疟清单"提前看
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: May Day travel: Mosquito and insect prevention—check out this malaria-prevention checklist in advance.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-04-24, ahead of the 19th National Malaria Day on 2026-04-26, China emphasizes malaria prevention with the theme Prevent malaria, prevent importation, early detection, early treatment. Malaria results from Plasmodium parasites transmitted by Anopheles mosquitoes, including falciparum, vivax, malariae, ovale, and knowlesi. Typical symptoms are cycles of chills, high fever (often >40°C), and profuse sweating with fatigue. For travelers, check destination malaria risk with customs or international travel health centers; use DEET repellents, mosquito nets, and long-sleeved clothing; discuss chemoprophylaxis with a physician if needed. During travel, stay in screened rooms and avoid exposure at dusk to dawn. After return, monitor health for up to one year, report overseas travel to clinicians, and seek prompt care for fever or related symptoms; follow the prescribed full anti-malarial treatment to prevent relapse or resistance.

triage.headline_ja: ゴールデンウィークの旅行で蚊と虫を防ぐ—この マラリア予防チェックリストを事前に確認しましょう
triage.triage_reason: 記事は中国の国内公衆衛生キャンペーンであり、実際の感染症アウトブレイク・異常事象ではなく、予防啓発情報である。IHR基準、WPROスクリーニング基準いずれも該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事は中国の4月26日の全国マラリア予防キャンペーンに関する啓発情報であり、具体的な感染症アウトブレイク、異常事象、または公衆衛生上の危機を報告するものではない。定期的な公衆衛生教育活動のため、シグナルとしてのピックアップは不要。

article.articleHeadline: Com alta nas notificações, Batayporã intensifica combate à dengue e chikungunya - CSN1
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: With an uptick in notifications, Batayporã intensifies the fight against dengue and chikungunya
article.articleSummary: Batayporã, Brazil reports rising arboviral activity, with 212 suspected cases in the 16–23 April period, up from 125 (10–16 April), about a 70% increase. Dengue confirmed cases rose from 2 to 3; suspected dengue investigations climbed from 82 to 123. Chikungunya shows a larger uptick: confirmed cases from 22 to 43 and suspected-in-analysis from 80 to 123 (≈53.7%). Health officials warn that dengue, chikungunya, and Zika share symptoms (fever, body and joint pain, headache, fatigue) and urge medical evaluation for any signs. Dengue vaccination is available for priority groups (children/adolescents 10–14 and primary-care workers) at ESF Santo Antônio and ESF Santa Luzia (Mon–Fri, 7:30–10:30 and 13:00–16:30). Vector-control measures include house inspections, removal of standing water, focal/mechanical blocking, insecticide spraying, and ovitrapping for surveillance. Population participation is essential; remarks were given on 22 April by Letícia Sanches and Douglas Leite.

triage.headline_ja: 通知の増加に伴い、バタイポラン州はデング熱とチクングニア熱との戦いを強化
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルの特定地域におけるデング熱・チクングニア熱の急速な増加（70%の症例増加、チクングニア確定症例が22から43へ上昇）は異常・予想外であり、公衆衛生への影響が深刻と判断される。IHR基準2項目以上に該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準複数項目に合致するため、フルRRA実施の必要あり。
triage.notes: 記事はバタイポラン市（マット・グロッソ・ド・スル州）で発生している複合アルボウイルス流行を報告。16～23日の週で212件の疑似症例（前週125件から70%増加）が報告され、特にチクングニア熱が急増（確定症例22→43、疑似症例80→123）。デング熱も増加傾向（確定2→3、疑似82→123）。三種疾患は臨床症状が類似しており、医学的評価の重要性が強調されている。ベクトル制御と予防接種キャンペーンが実施中。

article.articleHeadline: Nord-Kivu : 174 771 enfants ciblés par la campagne anti-polio à Butembo - Journal de Kinshasa
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: North Kivu: 174,771 children targeted by the polio vaccination campaign in Butembo - Kinshasa Journal
article.articleSummary: Polio vaccination campaign launched in Butembo, North Kivu, Democratic Republic of Congo, on April 22, 2026, targeting 174,771 children aged 0–5 across 17 health zones, with vaccination teams operating April 23–25. Each child receives four drops of oral polio vaccine, free of charge, regardless of health status. The effort is part of nationwide Expanded Programme on Immunization to eliminate polio, despite the DRC being wild poliovirus-free since August 2020. Risk persists due to circulating vaccine-derived poliovirus type 2 (PVDVc2); campaigns are intensified amid population movement linked to insecurity. In Beni, about 2,000,000 children aged 0–59 months are targeted from April 23–26. The response leverages VPOn2 since 2021 and a national NVPO program paired with bivalent OPV since November 2025, with support from WHO, UNICEF, CDC, GAVI, and Rotary International. Government aims to eradicate polio in the DRC and contribute to global eradication by 2026.

triage.headline_ja: 北キブ州：ブテンボでのポリオワクチン接種キャンペーンで174,771人の子どもを対象 - キンシャサ・ジャーナル
triage.triage_reason: ワクチン由来ポリオウイルス型2の循環が報告されており、スクリーニング基準の複数項目に該当するが、本イベントは予防接種キャンペーン（対応措置）の実施報道であり、新規の感染症発生を示すものではない。情報確認と継続的な監視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はポリオワクチン接種キャンペーンの実施を報道しており、ワクチン由来ポリオウイルス型2（PVDVc2）の循環リスクが背景にある。DRCは2020年8月以降野生ポリオウイルスが検出されていないが、VPDVc2の継続的な循環が懸念事項。本件は対応措置の実施報道であり、新規感染事例の発生ではない。ただし、VPDV型2の流行状況を監視する必要があり、WATCH段階での継続観察が適切。

article.articleHeadline: Ученые обнаружили новый механизм проникновения коронавирусов в клетки
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Scientists have discovered a new mechanism by which coronaviruses enter cells.
article.articleSummary: Bat coronavirus strain CcCoV-KY43 uses its spike protein to bind CEACAM6, a receptor abundant in human lung tissue, enabling a novel entry mechanism for coronaviruses. The finding indicates alpha-coronaviruses may utilize receptors beyond ACE2 and APN, broadening potential infection routes. Researchers conducted experiments on synthetic viral models, with no live pathogens involved. In Kenya, blood analyses found no evidence of human infection among the population. Similar CEACAM6-interacting viruses have been identified in bats across Africa, China, and Russia, implying widespread geographic distribution and potential spillover risk. The study underscores the need for enhanced wildlife surveillance to detect cross-species transmission threats and monitor evolution of coronavirus-host interactions.

triage.headline_ja: 科学者がコロナウイルスが細胞に侵入する新たなメカニズムを発見
triage.triage_reason: コロナウイルスの新規感染メカニズムに関する研究報告であり、潜在的なリスク要因は存在するが、現在の実際の流行事例ではなく、ケニアでの調査では感染の証拠が見つかっていない。継続的な監視が必要だが、即座のピックアップ基準には達していない。
triage.notes: 記事は基礎研究報告であり、実際の感染者や流行事例ではない。ケニアでの血液検査では人間への感染証拠なし。蝙蝠由来コロナウイルスのスパイルオーバーリスクについての理論的警告であるため、現段階では実際の公衆衛生的脅威のピックアップには至らない。ただし、新規感染メカニズムとアフリカ・中国・ロシア地域での広範な分布報告により、野生動物監視強化の必要性が指摘されている点は注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Khởi động 'Ký ức COVID-19', sẵn sàng ứng phó dịch bệnh trong tương lai
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Launching 'COVID-19 Memory', ready to respond to future epidemics.
article.articleSummary: On April 24, 2026, Ho Chi Minh City launched the COVID-19 Memory program to document and learn from its COVID-19 response (2019–2023). Led by Dr. Le Truong Giang, Chair of the HCMC Public Health Association, the initiative notes that the city’s dense population and international links made it an early pandemic hotspot, yet it mobilized testing, contact tracing, lockdowns, social distancing, vaccination, treatment, and social welfare. After the crisis, HCMC established a COVID memory ecosystem—memorial park, data repositories, ward-level health facilities, a community-health volunteer network, and a strengthened Center for Disease Control—and compiled lessons for future epidemics. The program’s three core goals are Remember, Reflect, Act: build a data archive, analyze to derive lessons, and propose interventions to boost readiness. A French Institute of COVID-19 Memory signed cooperation; the plan includes 2026 events, material collection (2020–2023), research synthesis, and a tech platform with partners, plus immunization forums.

triage.headline_ja: 『COVID-19メモリー』を立ち上げ、将来の感染症流行対応に備える
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はCOVID-19パンデミック（2019-2023）の教訓をまとめるメモリアルプログラムの立ち上げについて報じたもので、現在進行中の感染症発生イベントではなく、過去の危機から学ぶための準備活動である。新規患者、重症化、死亡例の報告、国際的に急速に拡大する感染症のシグナルがない。
triage.notes: 本記事は教訓学習プログラムの立ち上げで、現在の感染症イベント（アウトブレイク）ではない。過去のCOVID-19パンデミックへの対応の振り返りと将来への準備活動であり、シグナルトリアージの対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Việt Nam tiến gần mục tiêu loại trừ sốt rét nhưng chưa thể chủ quan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Vietnam moves closer to the goal of malaria elimination but cannot afford to be complacent.
article.articleSummary: On 24 April 2026, the Ho Chi Minh City Institute of Malaria, Parasitology and Entomology (Ministry of Health) with local authorities launched World Malaria Day activities in Vung Tau ward, Ho Chi Minh City, under the theme 'No More Malaria: We Will, We Can.' A march, bike parade, and mobile outreach raised awareness and promoted prevention, aiming to eliminate Anopheles breeding sites. WHO notes malaria remains a challenge; 2024 estimates report roughly 282 million cases and 610,000 deaths, Africa about 95%. In Vietnam, since 2021 annual cases stay under 500 with virtually no deaths; the Southern region and Lam Dong are well controlled, with mostly imported cases and no domestic outbreaks. Risks persist from cross-border movement, climate-driven mosquito ecology, and economic volatility. Vietnam targets malaria elimination by 2030, relying on surveillance, diagnostics, treatment, and vector control with community involvement. WHO calls for stronger prevention amid drug- and insecticide-resistant malaria and vaccines.

triage.headline_ja: ベトナムはマラリア排除目標に近づきつつあるが自満してはいけない
triage.triage_reason: マラリア排除に向けた啓発活動と進捗報告であり、新規の急性危機イベントではない。ベトナムではマラリア症例数は制御下にあり（年間500件未満、死亡ほぼゼロ）、国際的な拡大リスクも報告されていない。
triage.notes: 本記事はWHO世界マラリアデー（4月25日）に関連する啓発キャンペーンの報道であり、疾病サーベイランスの成功事例の紹介である。ベトナムの状況は良好に管理されており、新規クラスター、死亡増加、異常な流行の報告はない。記事内のアフリカへの言及はWHOの全般的統計であり、発生イベントではない。

article.articleHeadline: From pet stores to pandemics -- how wildlife trade helps diseases jump to humans
article.articleSummary: Wildlife trade raises spillover risk by bringing humans into close contact with diverse species and co-mingling animals in transit, boosting cross-species viral sharing. In a global analysis, Carlson and colleagues catalog every wildlife species involved in trade and the viruses known to infect those species, then examine how travel, dense holding conditions, and new species mixes accelerate virus movement to humans. They note that wildlife trade is pervasive—roughly a quarter of terrestrial vertebrates are traded—and that risks extend beyond exotic markets to pets and common supply chains (e.g., geckos and Amazonian tetras sold in outlets like PetSmart). Historical examples underscore the stakes: SARS-CoV-2/COVID-19, mpox (2003 US outbreak), and HIV origins. Data gaps on both trade flows and animal viromes hinder precise risk quantification, but the study highlights a “turbocharged” evolution of pathogens in this global network.

triage.headline_ja: ペットストアからパンデミックへ——野生動物取引がどのように疾病を人間に感染させるか
triage.triage_reason: 野生動物取引による人獣共通感染症のスピルオーバーリスクに関する分析記事。COVID-19、mpox、HIVの歴史的事例を言及しているが、現在の具体的な発生イベントではなく、リスク因子の一般的な解説である。
triage.notes: 本記事は野生動物取引と感染症リスクに関する科学的分析記事であり、進行中の具体的なアウトブレイクイベント報告ではない。記事サマリーではブラジルのアマゾンテトラなどの貿易例が言及されており、ブラジルは対象国リストに該当するため verified_locations に含める。ただし、現在の具体的な発生例ではなく、歴史的な事例（SARS-CoV-2、2003年US mpox outbreak、HIV origin）を参考として引用しているのみ。新規シグナルとしてはpickupの要件を満たさないが、野生動物取引によるスピルオーバーリスクの継続的なモニタリング価値があり、WATCH判定とする。

article.articleHeadline: A forgotten disease returns: Why Diphtheria is resurfacing in 2026 and what you need to know about the new indigenous Td vaccine
article.articleSummary: Diphtheria resurfaces in Australia, with outbreaks across the Northern Territory and Western Australia (Kimberley region). The Melbourne Vaccine Education Centre reports 17 respiratory diphtheria cases since March 23, 2026, and 60 cutaneous cases since May 2025. Diphtheria, caused by Corynebacterium diphtheriae, spreads via respiratory droplets, close contact, contaminated objects, or skin lesions. After decades of low incidence since the 1950s, resurgence is linked to gaps in vaccination, waning adult immunity, and travel. Early symptoms include sore throat, mild fever, and fatigue; a thick grey throat membrane can obstruct breathing, with bull neck in some cases. Cutaneous diphtheria presents as non-healing skin ulcers with a grey membrane. Early treatment with diphtheria antitoxin and antibiotics is effective, though toxin damage may persist; vaccination remains the prevention cornerstone, with boosters in adolescence and adulthood. India has launched an indigenously manufactured Td vaccine to boost adult immunisation, and the Rajasthan Deeg outbreak in 2024 underscores risk in under-immunised communities.

triage.headline_ja: 忘れられた病気が戻る：ジフテリアがなぜ2026年に再浮上しているのか、そして新しい国産Tdワクチンについて知っておくべきこと
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航リスク）。オーストラリアとインドの両国で同時多発的なジフテリア再浮上は予想外であり、国際的な関心と支援の必要性が高い。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIの発生地域フィールドにはオーストラリア（Melbourne, Victoria, Western Australia, Tasmania, Kimberley）とインド（Rajasthan, Deeg）が含まれている。記事サマリーは両国でのジフテリア再浮上を明記しており、2025年5月からの発生と2026年3月からの呼吸器ジフテリア症例が報告されている。ワクチン接種ギャップと成人免疫の低下が背景にあり、WPRO地域（オーストラリア）での重要な感染症再出現イベントである。

article.articleHeadline: Chikungunya Outbreak in Dourados: 42% of Brazil's Deaths, Public Calamity Declared, Health Workers Trained, Civil Defense Mobilizes, 13th Fatality Reported in MS - News Directory 3
article.articleSummary: Chikungunya outbreak centers on Dourados, Mato Grosso do Sul, Brazil, accounting for 42% of Brazil’s chikungunya deaths in 2026. By 4 April 2026, Mato Grosso do Sul recorded 4,281 probable cases, 2,102 confirmed and 10 deaths, with fatalities in Dourados, Bonito, Jardim and Fátima do Sul. Local health authorities are training to administer the chikungunya vaccine, targeting children and adolescents aged 10 years, 11 months, 29 days. Civil Defense-supported mosquito-control efforts in indigenous villages aim to reduce Aedes aegypti breeding. By 13 April 2026, chikungunya deaths in MS rose to 10, including older adults, infants and Indigenous residents; five had comorbidities. On 23 April, an 87-year-old man from Bonito was the state’s 13th death. Genomic surveillance identified 422 chikungunya genomes from 12 states (2021–2022), with East-Central-South-African lineage expansion and the Northeast hub driving spread. No dengue deaths reported in MS by 24 April 2026.

triage.headline_ja: ドゥラードスでのチクングニア熱アウトブレイク：ブラジルの死亡の42％、公式災害宣言、保健労働者研修、市民防衛動員、MS州で13番目の死亡例報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響・予想外の死亡数・国際的拡大リスク）、WPRO基準4つ以上該当（異常・重症度・流行性・管理能力）、公式災害宣言による社会的関心が高い。フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: ブラジル国内の局所的なアウトブレイクであるが、MS州で公式災害宣言され、全国の死亡の42％を占める。12州でのゲノム監視により東中央南アフリカ系統の拡大が確認されており、国家レベルの対応が進行中。チクングニア熱はベクター媒介疾患で環境・蚊対策が重要。

article.articleHeadline: Over 10 million children protected against polio in coordinated cross-border campaigns across Angola, DRC and Namibia | WHO | Regional Office for Africa
article.articleSummary: Poliovirus, type 2, circulates across Angola and Namibia, with genetic sequencing confirming linked strains and a possible circulation in the DRC, underscoring how population movement drives transmission and why synchronized action is essential. In Angola, 39 confirmed type 2 poliovirus cases have been reported since 2025. Despite prior campaigns that reduced transmission, the detection of a genetically linked variant in Namibia’s Kavango East Region highlights cross-border outbreak connectivity and the need for coordinated interventions. Health authorities note that movement of people, trade routes, and family ties across borders facilitate virus spread when immunity gaps persist. More than 10 million children have been protected against polio through coordinated cross-border campaigns across Angola, DRC, and Namibia, signaling progress but a continued need for synchronized vaccination efforts and surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: アンゴラ、DRC、ナミビアの国境を越えた協調キャンペーンで1000万人以上の子どもがポリオから保護される
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（重大な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。ポリオウイルス2型の複数国での循環確認と遺伝学的連鎖の証拠があり、対象国DRCでの可能性のある流行も指摘されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは、アンゴラとナミビアでのポリオウイルス2型流行が確認され、DRCでの可能性のある流行が言及されている。対象国リストに該当するのはDRCのみ。アンゴラとナミビアは対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsにはDRCのみを列挙。ただし、複数国の関連流行であり、WHOアフロ地域事務局による公式アナウンスであることから、重大なシグナルと判定。

article.articleHeadline: Rabies case confirmed in Korat, control measures stepped up
article.articleSummary: Rabies confirmed in a dog in Mueang district, Nakhon Ratchasima (Korat), Nong Bua Sala subdistrict. Laboratory tests on brain tissue confirmed rabies after an incident on 21 April at 16:20 when a stray dog entered a home, bit another dog, and collapsed near a temple. Officials launched investigation and containment; vaccination of stray dogs in high-risk areas and planned sterilisation programs to curb long-term transmission. Residents warned that bites, scratches, or saliva entering open wounds can transmit rabies; untreated rabies is almost always fatal once symptoms appear. A recent fatal human case in February, a 54-year-old man who died after symptoms consistent with rabies following a dog bite, prompted heightened surveillance in neighboring areas. The response emphasizes surveillance, vaccination, and population control to reduce risk.

triage.headline_ja: タイのコラートで狂犬病ケースが確認、対策が強化される
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で2つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響：最近の人間死亡例、異常/予想外性：野犬による感染拡大リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数該当し、社会的・政治的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 狂犬病は未治療時の致死率がほぼ100%である重篤疾患。2月の人間死亡例に続く今回の確認により、当局の警戒が高まっている。野犬の管理と予防接種プログラムが展開中。動物および人間への影響が記事で明示されている。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H3N2
Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H1N1

article.articleHeadline: Casos de síndromes gripais disparam e ultrapassam 4 mil atendimentos em Boa Vista
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza-like illness cases surge and exceed 4,000 visits in Boa Vista.
article.articleSummary: Boa Vista, Brazil — Influenza-like illness surged during the rainy season, with over 4,000 respiratory-syndrome visits in the past month. At Hospital da Criança Santo Antônio (HCSA), respiratory diseases account for about 16% of total demand, and roughly half of current inpatients have respiratory conditions. A contingency plan was activated to reinforce care, with a 30% rise in emergency department staff; green-code (less urgent) cases are redirected to ambulatory services to reduce waits. Rhinovirus leads, responsible for more than 50% of detections; other circulating pathogens include adenovirus, Influenza A (H3N2 and H1N1), Respiratory Syncytial Virus (RSV), SARS-CoV-2, human metapneumovirus, and Influenza B in smaller proportions. The situation aligns with typical seasonal patterns, with ongoing monitoring. Influenza vaccination is available at all Basic Health Units for priority groups, including individuals with comorbidities, Indigenous populations, and other vulnerable groups, aiming to reduce severe cases, hospitalizations, and deaths.

triage.headline_ja: ボアビスタでインフルエンザ様疾患の症例が急増し、4,000件を超える受診者数
triage.triage_reason: 季節性呼吸器感染症の集中が報告されているが、異常性が限定的（季節パターンに沿う）で、深刻な死亡や国際拡大リスクの記載がない。情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 季節性呼吸器感染症集中であり、通常の季節パターン内の出来事と記事が明記している。複数病原体（ライノウイルス50%以上、アデノウイルス、インフルエンザA、RSV等）が検出されているが、個別の死亡数や重症化率の詳細記載がない。ブラジル北部ロライマ州での流行であるため、国際拡大リスクは限定的。ただし4,000件超の受診圧迫と警急部門人員30%増強という対応措置から、地域的な保健サービス負荷増加は認められる。

article.articleHeadline: Cegah Penyebaran Malaria di Rohil, Petugas Semprot Rumah Warga dan Edukasi Pelajar
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Prevent Malaria Transmission in Rokan Hilir, Officers Spray Residents' Homes and Educate Students.
article.articleSummary: Malaria control efforts are intensified in Sinaboi District, Rokan Hilir Regency, Riau Province, Indonesia. The integrated program combines indoor residual spraying (IRS) to kill malaria-carrying mosquitoes, mass blood screening to enable early case detection, and health education for residents and students, including at Sinaboi Vocational High School (SMK Sinaboi). The initiative involves the district government, Puskesmas Sinaboi, and the Rokan Hilir Health Office, led by Zulkifli, Head of the Riau Provincial Health Office. Officials emphasize that malaria control requires a combined approach rather than partial measures, with IRS targeting vectors resting on walls and early-detection blood testing to treat cases promptly, even when symptoms are not severe. Community members are urged to maintain clean environments and participate in regular gotong royong to create mosquito-free villages. The effort underlines ongoing malaria containment in the region.

triage.headline_ja: ロカン・ヒリル県のマラリア伝播を防止、職員が住民宅に殺虫剤を散布し学生を教育
triage.triage_reason: 記事はインドネシアのマラリア制御キャンペーンの実施について述べており、新たなアウトブレイクや異常な事象の報告ではなく、ルーチンの公衆衛生対策である。IHR基準とWPRO基準のいずれも該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事はマラリアの予防・制御活動についての地域的な公衆衛生キャンペーンであり、新規クラスターや異常な流行の報告ではない。内的消毒散布（IRS）、血液スクリーニング、健康教育などの確立された制御対策の実施を述べている。シグナルとしてピックアップする根拠がない。

article.articleHeadline: กทม. เตรียมพร้อมมาตรการเฝ้าระวังป้องกัน 'โรคไข้ดิน' เร่งให้ความรู้วิธีป้องกันตนเอง -
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bangkok is preparing surveillance and prevention measures for 'soil fever'; stepping up education on how to protect oneself.
article.articleSummary: Bangkok authorities are stepping up surveillance and prevention of melioidosis (soil fever) in response to rising reported cases, with the Bangkok Metropolitan Administration coordinating hospital readiness, laboratory diagnosis, and drug stock to reduce septicemia fatalities. From 2023–2026 (as of 18 April 2026), Bangkok recorded 9, 23, 13, and 5 cumulative cases respectively; from 1 January–19 April 2026 there were 3 cases with no deaths. High-risk groups include farmers, construction workers, those with soil/water exposure, diabetics, chronic kidney disease, thalassemia, and immunocompromised individuals. Preventive measures emphasize wearing boots and gloves when handling soil, covering wounds, drinking boiled water, hand/foot hygiene, and avoiding soil/water contact when unnecessary; seek prompt medical care for fever, headache, body aches, or skin abscesses. Telemedicine app 'Bangkok Doctor' and 1646 hotline are available. Public education and community screening through 69 health centers and rapid mobile teams are prioritized, especially during monsoon and post-flood periods.

triage.headline_ja: バンコクが『土壌熱（メリオイドーシス）』の監視・予防措置を準備、自己防御法の啓発を強化
triage.triage_reason: メリオイドーシスはエンデミック疾患であり、バンコク内での事例数は限定的（2026年4月時点で5例、死亡なし）。異常・予想外の発生ではなく、予防的対応の段階であるため。情報が部分的であり、続報の注視が必要。
triage.notes: メリオイドーシスはタイではエンデミック疾患であり、バンコク当局による監視・予防強化は通常の対応の範囲内。報告事例数が少なく、死亡例もないため深刻度は低い。ただしWPRO基準の『長期曝露』（土壌・水への継続的な曝露リスク）と『流行しやすさ』（危険群が多い、対策不十分の可能性）の2基準に該当し、政府・公共の関心があるため、WATCH段階での継続監視が適切。

article.articleHeadline: 'Stay vigilant': Kerala minister warns of seasonal rise in amoebic infections
article.articleSummary: Kerala Health Minister Veena George warned of a likely seasonal rise in amoebic brain infections during the summer in Kerala. Amoebic meningoencephalitis is caused by Naegleria fowleri and Acanthamoeba in contaminated water bodies. Public measures include avoiding unclean water for bathing or facial washing; regular cleaning and chlorination of wells and water tanks; proper maintenance of swimming pools. Surveillance has been intensified and encephalitis patients are tested for amoebic infection. Transmission occurs through the nose and can reach the brain; in immunocompromised individuals, wounds can spread. Symptoms include high fever, sudden headache, vomiting, neck pain, loss of consciousness, and photophobia, requiring urgent care. Kerala reports mortality reduced to ~24% from global figures of ~99% (Naegleria fowleri) and 70–90% (Acanthamoeba) due to early diagnosis and specialized care. Diagnostic facilities exist in all medical college microbiology departments; advanced confirmation at Public Health Lab Thiruvananthapuram, IAV Thonnakkal, and Kozhikode Medical College.

triage.headline_ja: 「警戒を継続すべき」：ケララ州保健相がアメーバ感染症の季節的増加を警告
triage.triage_reason: アメーバ性髄膜脳炎は高い致死率を持つ稀な感染症であり、ケララ州で季節的増加の警告がされている。しかし現在報告される具体的な症例数が記事に示されておらず、現在のリスク段階が不明確であるため、情報の更新を待つ必要がある。
triage.notes: ケララ州における季節的なアメーバ性髄膜脳炎の警告であり、予防啓発と監視体制の強化が述べられている。現在進行中のアウトブレイク状況が不明確であるため、続報が重要。Naegleria fowleriとAcanthamoeba両種が関与し、致死率は99%と70-90%であるが、ケララでは早期診断により24%に低下していると報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: Tingginya temuan kasus Tb bukti efektivitas skrining massal
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: High TB case detections are evidence of the effectiveness of mass screening
article.articleSummary: Indonesia reports high TB detections through active screening, signaling effective early-detection in the community. In Cilincing, North Jakarta, during a free health check and TB screening, experts say finding up to a million TB cases nationwide isn’t alarming but essential to ensure treatment and curb transmission. PDPI chair Arief Riadi Arifin likens the surge to an iceberg, arguing tracing reveals cases previously hidden and reachable by care. Eka Ginanjar of PP PAPDI adds that higher case numbers enable more precise public health interventions. Together they emphasize that knowing the true burden allows strategies to prevent spread within families and workplaces and to tailor prevention and treatment efforts, highlighting the value of active case finding and contact tracing in Indonesia.

triage.headline_ja: 結核症例の多数検出は集団検診の有効性の証拠
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアにおける結核の能動的検査による検出件数増加を報告しているが、これは公衆衛生対応の強化を示すポジティブなシグナルであり、直近の危機的悪化を示すものではない。ただし結核は重要な公衆衛生課題であり、今後の発生動向は注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 本記事は結核検出件数の増加を報告しているが、その原因は検査体制の強化と能動的検査による早期発見の進展であり、流行の悪化ではなく公衆衛生対応の改善を示すものである。ただし結核は長期的曝露と流行性の高い疾患であり、WPROスクリーニング基準の2項目に該当するため経過観察の対象とした。

article.articleHeadline: TBC bagai fenomena gunung es, PDPI ingatkan urgensi deteksi dini - ANTARA News
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tuberculosis, like an iceberg phenomenon, PDPI reminds of the urgency of early detection.
article.articleSummary: As of 24 April 2026, Indonesia ranks second globally in tuberculosis cases according to the Global TB Report 2024. In Jakarta, Arif Riadi Arifin, president of the Indonesian Pulmonology Doctors Association (PDPI), stated that the high number of detected TB cases reflects ongoing screening efforts rather than a shrinking outbreak. TB is framed as an 'iceberg phenomenon,' highlighting that many infections may remain undiagnosed beneath the surface while increased case finding surfaces those detected. The message calls for sustained emphasis on early detection to curb transmission and improve outcomes, underscoring Indonesia's continued status as a major global TB burden. The brief notice does not provide detailed outbreak counts, laboratory confirmations, or infection sources.

triage.headline_ja: 結核、氷山現象のようなもの。PDPI（インドネシア呼吸器医学会）は早期発見の緊急性を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアにおける結核の疾病負担が確認されるが、記事は公衆衛生警報というより啓発メッセージであり、新規アウトブレイクや急激な変化の報告がない。情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事はインドネシアの結核の継続的な疾病負担を述べているが、新規アウトブレイクの報告ではなく、早期発見の重要性に関する保健機関からのメッセージである。具体的な症例数、確定診断数、感染源の詳細は記載されていない。IHR基準では1つのみ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響）し、WPROスクリーニング基準では3つ該当（重症度、長期曝露、流行しやすさ）するが、緊急性が低い。続報により状況が変わる可能性があるため、要経過観察。

article.articleHeadline: Lubero : plus de 48 000 enfants ciblés par une vaste campagne anti polio
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Lubero: more than 48,000 children targeted by a broad polio vaccination campaign.
article.articleSummary: Polio vaccination campaign in Lubero, North Kivu (DRC) targets 48,292 children aged 0-5 starting 23 April 2026, as part of ongoing national polio eradication efforts. Health teams traverse quarters and villages; each child receives four drops in total: two drops of nVPO and two drops of bVPO to strengthen protection against poliomyelitis, a highly contagious viral disease that can cause irreversible paralysis or death. The campaign runs during the 16th Africa Vaccination Week. Nationally, about 23 million children are expected to participate in the integrated campaign against polio, measles, and rubella from 22-26 April across 515 health zones; in Nord-Kivu only polio vaccination activities are organized. Dr. Charles Kaviri, chief medical officer for Lubero health zone, underscores the double-drops approach to immunize young children.

triage.headline_ja: ルベロ：ポリオ対策の広範なキャンペーンで48,000人以上の子どもを対象
triage.triage_reason: 本イベントはポリオ、麻疹、風疹に対する予防接種キャンペーンであり、疾病の発生・アウトブレイク報告ではなく、公衆衛生対応活動（ルーチン免疫化キャンペーン）の報道である。IHR基準、WPROスクリーニング基準ともに該当せず、シグナルとしてピックアップする必要がない。
triage.notes: 本記事は2026年4月23日〜26日にかけてDRC（Nord-KivuのLubero保健地区含む）で実施されるポリオ、麻疹、風疹の予防接種キャンペーンの案内・実施報告である。これはアフリカ予防接種週間（Africa Vaccination Week）に合わせた定期的な免疫化活動であり、疾病の新規発生やアウトブレイク現象ではない。したがって感染症シグナルトリアージの対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Casos de influenza mais que dobram em Piracicaba e acendem alerta
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza cases more than double in Piracicaba, triggering an alert.
article.articleSummary: Influenza has triggered a local alert in Piracicaba, Brazil, where 15 influenza hospitalizations were recorded from January 1 to April 20, 2026, more than double the 7 cases in the same period last year. The rise aligns with national trends and threatens vulnerable groups—the elderly, young children, pregnant women, and people with chronic conditions. In response, the city expanded its influenza vaccination campaign through May 30 at all health units, with free vaccination for priority groups defined by the Ministry of Health: people over 60, children 6 months to under 6 years, pregnant women, teachers, and patients with comorbidities. Five units now offer extended hours (5 pm–8 pm); others operate Monday–Friday, 8 am–3 pm. Authorities also stress hand hygiene, covering coughs or sneezes, and avoiding contact when symptomatic to curb transmission.

triage.headline_ja: ピラシカバにおけるインフルエンザ患者数が2倍以上に増加し、警戒が高まる
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル国内の限定的な地域（ピラシカバ）でのインフルエンザ患者数の増加は検出されたが、国際的拡大の具体的な兆候がなく、情報が限定的であるため。
triage.notes: ピラシカバ市において2026年1月1日～4月20日の期間でインフルエンザ入院患者が前年同期比2倍超（15例 vs 7例）に増加。高齢者、小児、妊婦、基礎疾患患者が脆弱集団として特定されている。当局は予防接種キャンペーンと感染対策を実施中。ただし現時点では国際的拡大の具体的証拠がなく、地域レベルの対応で管理されているため、WATCHとして経過観察を推奨。

article.articleHeadline: โคราช แจ้งเตือนสุนัขจรติดเชื้อบ้าพื้นที่รอยต่อเขต ชาย 54 ปี ติดเชื้อตาย
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nakhon Ratchasima warns of rabies-infected stray dogs in inter-district border areas; a 54-year-old man contracted rabies and died.
article.articleSummary: Rabies alert in Nakhon Ratchasima after a stray dog in the inter-district border area between Nongbu Sala and Pho Klang Subdistricts (Mueang District) tested positive for rabies. On April 21, the stray dog entered a home, bit another dog, and died after seizures; brain tissue testing at Surin Province’s Lower Northeastern Veterinary Research and Development Center confirmed rabies in the area. In response, authorities vaccinated high‑risk stray dogs and planned neutering to curb transmission. Public guidance stresses immediate post‑exposure vaccination after bites, scratches, or saliva contact, and avoiding handling stray or unvaccinated animals due to fatal risk if untreated. A 54-year-old man bitten on both legs in the border area developed fever, fatigue, dysphagia, and hypersensitivity to stimuli and died on February 15; rabies was laboratory-confirmed. Containment measures have been intensified in the border zone. Keywords: vaccination, outbreak, public health measures.

triage.headline_ja: ナコーンラーチャシマ県が境界地域の狂犬病感染野犬に警告、54歳男性が狂犬病で死亡
triage.triage_reason: タイで狂犬病の人獣共通感染症アウトブレイクが確認され、確定死亡例が報告されている。IHR基準は3項目以上該当し、異常性、重症度（死亡例）、感染易性（ヒト-動物接触）を満たしている。
triage.notes: 狂犬病は致命率がほぼ100%の人獣共通感染症である。タイでの野犬による感染事例とヒト死亡例が確認されており、公衆衛生上の重大な懸念。地域的なワクチン接種と不妊手術による制御対策が既に実施されている。

article.articleHeadline: টিকা সংকটে হামের উচ্চ ঝুঁকিতে দেশ, বিশ্ব স্বাস্থ্য সংস্থার উদ্বেগ | বাংলাদেশ প্রতিদিন
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Countries at high risk of measles amid vaccine shortages, WHO expresses concern
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreak in Bangladesh is labeled 'high risk' by the WHO as nationwide transmission accelerates. From March 15 to April 14, about 19,161 suspected cases were recorded, with 79% under five and 66% under two. By April, 166 child deaths were reported, largely among the unvaccinated. The Dhaka division is hardest hit, with slums in Demra, Jatrabari, Kamrangirchar, and Karail driving transmission; 58 of 64 districts are affected, signaling a national health emergency. The crisis follows 2024–2025 MR vaccine shortages and gaps in routine immunization since 2020. The National Immunization Technical Advisory Committee approved a measles-rubella campaign on March 30; rollout started April 5 and expanded nationwide from April 20, with vitamin A and district rapid-response teams. Cross-border risk with India and Myanmar; border towns Jessore and Chapainawabganj highlighted. WHO urges at least 95% coverage in all municipalities and stronger border surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: ワクチン不足によるはしか危機下で、WHOが懸念を表明―バングラデシュが高リスク
triage.triage_reason: バングラデシュにおけるはしかの大規模流行（3月15日～4月14日で約19,161疑い例、166人の死亡）が報告され、IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。WHO からも正式に高リスク判定を受けており、国際的な懸念が存在する。
triage.notes: バングラデシュが主要な流行地（58/64県が影響）。インドとミャンマーとの国境地域での越境リスク明記。2024-2025年のワクチン不足と予防接種の一貫性欠如が背景。WHO から95%以上のカバレッジと国境監視強化を要求されている。フルRRA実施推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Tuberculose exige atenção aos sintomas e tem tratamento completo pelo SUS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tuberculosis Requires Attention to Symptoms and Has Complete Treatment Through the SUS
article.articleSummary: Tuberculosis (Mycobacterium tuberculosis) remains one of the most impactful infectious diseases worldwide, with Brazil reporting approximately 84,000 new cases and about 6,000 deaths annually. The infection primarily attacks the lungs but may affect other body sites. Key warning sign is a productive cough lasting more than three weeks, prompting diagnostic workup with sputum analysis and rapid molecular testing. Treatment is provided free through the Brazilian Unified Health System (SUS) for at least six months. The physician emphasizes strict adherence to the full regimen, even as symptoms improve, to prevent relapses and the emergence of drug-resistant TB. Early diagnosis and proper follow-up are essential given TB’s public health burden in Brazil.

triage.headline_ja: 結核は症状への注意が必要であり、SUSを通じた完全な治療がある
triage.triage_reason: 結核は既知の公衆衛生課題であり、ブラジルでの新規症例報告は異常ではない。記事は予防啓発・治療情報の提供が主体で、新規クラスター、新規病原体、または急速な拡大の兆候がない。
triage.notes: 記事は年間84,000件の新規患者と6,000人の死亡という既知の統計情報に基づいた啓発記事。新しいアウトブレイク、クラスター、または予期しない増加の報告ではなく、SUSを通じた標準治療の可用性に関する医療情報提供である。

article.articleHeadline: Nagpur News: विदेश जाने वालों का एम्स में होगा येलो फीवर का टीकाकरण | Those going abroad will be vaccinated against yellow fever at AIIMS.
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nagpur News: Those going abroad will be vaccinated against yellow fever at AIIMS.
article.articleSummary: AIIMS Nagpur inaugurates a yellow fever vaccination clinic on the ground floor of the IPD block, approved by the Directorate General of Health Services, MoHFW. The center targets travelers to Africa and some South American countries where yellow fever is present. Yellow fever is a vector-borne flavivirus transmitted by Aedes mosquitoes; India is not endemic, but international travel poses a risk. The adult vaccination clinic is in Room 24; registration via Google form with eligibility checks leads to a vaccination date. On vaccination day, travelers must bring their passport and a signed consent form. Registration runs 9:00–12:00; vaccination sessions every Thursday (excluding holidays) 9:00–12:30. A nominal vaccination fee applies at OPD registration. Recipients are observed for 30 minutes post-vaccination, then issued an internationally valid certificate, effective after 10 days and lifelong. Dr. Prashant Joshi notes this strengthens health services and protects travelers from central India, including Maharashtra, Madhya Pradesh, and Chhattisgarh.

triage.headline_ja: ナグプール: AIIMSで海外渡航者向けの黄熱病ワクチン接種を開始
triage.triage_reason: 黄熱病ワクチン接種クリニックの開設というヘルスケア施設のニュースであり、インド国内での新規感染症アウトブレイクや公衆衛生危機を示すものではない。IHR基準・WPROスクリーニング基準いずれも該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事は黄熱病のワクチン接種施設開設のニュースであり、インドでの黄熱病流行またはアウトブレイクを示していない。黄熱病自体はアフリカおよび南米の風土病であり、インドは非流行地域である。この記事は感染症危機・シグナル検出対象ではなく、単なるヘルスケア施設のお知らせである。

article.articleHeadline: CDC Issues Interim Travel Guidance for Areas with Ongoing Zika Virus Transmission - News Directory 3
article.articleSummary: Zika virus travel guidance from the CDC issued January 15, 2016 targets areas with ongoing transmission in Central and South America and the Caribbean. Pregnant women and those planning pregnancy are advised to postpone travel to affected regions and consult a healthcare provider before traveling. A Level 2 Travel Alert (Practice Enhanced Precautions) is in effect for Brazil, Colombia, El Salvador, French Guiana, Guatemala, Haiti, Honduras, Martinique, Mexico, Panama, Paraguay, Suriname, Venezuela, and Puerto Rico. The advisory follows reports of microcephaly and other adverse pregnancy outcomes in Brazil linked to maternal Zika infection; while full causality remains under study, precautions are urged. Mosquito bite prevention is key; Zika can also be transmitted sexually, and the virus can persist in semen. Returning travelers should avoid mosquito bites for three weeks. As of Feb 6, 2026, no area has an active Zika Travel Health Notice, though risk persists.

triage.headline_ja: CDCが持続的なジカウイルス伝播地域への暫定渡航ガイダンスを発表
triage.triage_reason: 記事は2016年1月15日のCDCガイダンスの過去情報であり、2026年2月6日時点でアクティブなジカウイルス渡航勧告がないと明記されている。現在進行中の感染症イベント（ongoing transmission）ではなく、歴史的な公衆衛生対応の報告であるため、シグナルレベルのリスクを示さない。
triage.notes: 記事は過去の2016年ガイダンスの説明であり、現在進行中の流行を報告するものではない。2026年2月6日時点で「no area has an active Zika Travel Health Notice」と明記されている。対象国リストに含まれるのはBrazilのみであるが、現在のアクティブなイベントではないため、トリアージ対象外と判定。

article.articleHeadline: São Carlos vira o jogo contra a dengue: casos despencam 97%
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: São Carlos turns the tide against dengue fever: cases plummet 97%
article.articleSummary: São Carlos, Brazil reports a dramatic turn against dengue in early 2026, with 294 confirmed dengue cases, 3 under investigation, and 61 deemed inconclusive this week, and no deaths. The city also found no new cases of chikungunya or zika among 29 and 20 notifications respectively; all were discarded, and there are no yellow fever records. Through the first 15 weeks of 2026, preventive work and community engagement kept the situation under control. Compared with the same period in 2025, dengue cases fell 97%, from 10,786 to 294, while total notifications dropped 86%, from 15,138 to 2,096. The report underscores the impact of public health measures and population participation in moving toward dengue control; the fight continues but progress is evident.

triage.headline_ja: サンカルロス市、デング熱対策で逆転勝利：症例が97%減少
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルのサンカルロス市における好ましい公衆衛生成果の報告であり、緊急のシグナルではない。症例は大幅に減少し、死亡者もなく、他の蚊媒介感染症（チクングニア、ジカ、黄熱病）の新規症例も報告されていない。IHR基準およびWPRO基準の該当なし。
triage.notes: 本記事はデング熱の制御成功と症例の著しい減少を報告するポジティブなシグナルである。公衆衛生対策と地域参加の効果を示すもので、感染症危機ではなく管理成功の事例。監視対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Campinas emite alerta para dengue e aponta 27 bairros com alto risco de transmissão
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Campinas issues dengue alert and identifies 27 neighborhoods with high transmission risk.
article.articleSummary: Campinas, Brazil issues the 17th Arbovirus Alert of 2026, identifying 27 neighborhoods with high dengue transmission risk and reinforcing Aedes aegypti control as cases rise across the city. Dengue, transmitted by Aedes aegypti, is the focus, with the vector also capable of spreading Zika and chikungunya. Regions highlighted include the East (Jardim Novo Flamboyant, Nova Campinas, Vila Brandina), Northwest (Jardim Campos Elíseos, Jardim Ipiranga), and the North (Jardim Aurélia, Parque Shalon) along with areas in the Southwest, South, and Southeast. The alert uses incidence, new transmission signals, population density, and access challenges to map risk. Authorities note ~80% of breeding sites are inside homes, urging residents to allow health inspectors in and eliminate standing water, seal water tanks, refresh plant water, and keep toilets closed. The response combines enforcement, public guidance, and ongoing risk-area monitoring amid rising arbovirus activity.

triage.headline_ja: カンピーナスがデング熱アラートを発令し、高い伝播リスクのある27の地域を特定
triage.triage_reason: デング熱を主とした蚊媒介感染症（Zika、Chikungunya同時検出）の地域アラートであり、WPROスクリーニング基準の「異常/予想外」「流行しやすさ」に該当する可能性があるが、記事から死亡事例や入院数などの重症度を示す具体的データが不明であり、情報不足により確定的なシグナル判定ができない。続報による重症度・死亡数の情報待ち。
triage.notes: ブラジル・カンピーナス市が2026年の17番目のアルボウイルスアラートを発令。デング熱が主体だがZikaおよびChikungunyaも同時検出。27地域で高いリスク判定。ただしIHR基準では国際的拡大リスクなし、渡航制限リスクもなし。スクリーニング基準では「異常性」「流行易動性」「長期曝露」が認められるが、「重症度」（死亡率、入院数など）と「管理可能性」は記事から判定不可。Bluedot発出地域はブラジルで正確。

article.articleHeadline: Malaria in Pregnancy: Early Detection and Prevention Can Save Two Lives - Newspatrolling.com
article.articleSummary: As of 24 April 2026, malaria in pregnancy is highlighted in Hyderabad, where seasonal transmission poses ongoing risk. Plasmodium falciparum, transmitted by Anopheles mosquitoes, can severely affect pregnancy by compromising placental function and fetal growth; pregnancy increases vulnerability due to reduced immunity. Symptoms include fever, chills, headache, nausea, vomiting, and body aches; severe cases may involve seizures, confusion, or breathing difficulties. Diagnosis relies on blood tests, including microscopy and rapid diagnostic tests, with repeat testing if initial results are negative but symptoms persist. Treatment during pregnancy is safe when guided by a clinician. Prevention remains the most effective strategy, with measures to reduce exposure and, in high-risk settings after the first trimester, preventive treatment per WHO guidance. Emphasizes regular antenatal care for early detection and timely intervention; Fernandez Hospital advocates awareness and evidence-based care to safeguard mothers and babies.

triage.headline_ja: 妊娠中のマラリア：早期発見と予防により2つの命が救われることができる
triage.triage_reason: ハイデラバードにおけるマラリア妊娠症例の季節的伝播リスク報道だが、IHR基準での深刻な新規の公衆衛生インパクト、国際的拡大リスク、あるいは渡航・貿易制限リスクは示唆されていない。また記事は一般的な予防啓発および医学情報が主であり、流行規模や重症度、管理可能性の危機を示す具体的なデータがない。
triage.notes: 記事は季節的マラリア伝播に関する予防啓発・医学教育的内容であり、新規の疫学的インシデントとしてのシグナルではない。長期曝露・流行しやすさの基準は季節的背景として該当するが、社会的・政治的関心の具体的証拠がなく、管理可能性の危機を示唆しないため、フルRRA対象とはしない。

article.articleHeadline: الصين تحظر دخول منتجات الدواجن التشيلية بسبب أنفلوانزا الطيور - اليوم السابع
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: China Bans Chilean Poultry Products Due to Avian Influenza.
article.articleSummary: China’s General Administration of Customs has imposed an immediate ban on importing poultry and poultry products from Chile after an avian influenza outbreak in Chile, aimed at protecting biosafety and stabilizing China’s livestock sector. The measure is expected to disrupt Chile’s export flows, reconfigure trade routes, raise logistics costs, and increase pressure on health and veterinary authorities. Shipments already en route or at ports may be refused or destroyed, risking losses and contract disruptions. This follows prior Chinese suspensions of Chilean poultry imports (18 months, ending late 2024), underscoring the sensitivity of this trade channel.
