In Chile, the Servicio Agrícola y Ganadero (SAG) reports 20 avian influenza outbreaks this year, affecting over 700,000 birds, mainly in Maule, O’Higgins, and Valparaíso regions, prompting tighter surveillance and containment. The decision may pressure Chile’s poultry sector and raise concerns about global, health-sensitive supply chains.

triage.headline_ja: 中国、鳥インフルエンザを理由にチリの家禽製品の輸入を禁止
triage.triage_reason: チリでの鳥インフルエンザアウトブレイク（動物感染症）は報告されているが、対象国リスト内での人への感染確認がなく、評価基準の該当数が限定的。情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 発生地域にChileが含まれているが、対象国リスト外のため verified_locations には含めない。記事は主にChina（輸入禁止措置）とChile（アウトブレイク）の間の貿易問題であり、対象国内での人への感染確認がない。Bluedot APIが中国を含めた理由は輸入禁止措置によるものと推定される。IHR基準で3つ該当しているが、これは主に動物疾患と貿易制限による点であり、対象国内での公衆衛生への直接的な影響は不明確。

article.articleHeadline: Governo de São Paulo confirma terceira morte por febre amarela em 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The São Paulo government confirms the third death from yellow fever in 2026.
article.articleSummary: As of 24 April 2026, yellow fever deaths rise in São Paulo State, Brazil, with two additional fatalities in Lagoinha, Vale do Paraíba. The victims, residents of Lagoinha, bring the 2026 totals to six confirmed infections and three deaths. In conjunction with World Immunization Week, the São Paulo State Health Secretariat emphasizes vaccination and urges residents to update their vaccination cards at local health posts. The report provides no details on laboratory confirmation, transmission source, or any imported/exported cases, nor the precise dates of the fatalities or further identities beyond the locality. The update underscores ongoing public health measures in the region as authorities monitor yellow fever.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロ州政府が2026年の黄熱病による3番目の死亡を確認
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルのサンパウロ州で黄熱病による死亡事例が継続的に発生しており、IHR基準（公衆衛生への深刻な影響、予想外の増加傾向）に該当。WPROスクリーニング基準でも重症度（死亡例の増加）と長期曝露リスク（住民への持続的脅威）が認められ、フルリスク評価を要する。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年という未来の日付を記載しているが、これはデータエラーの可能性。ブラジルのサンパウロ州Lagoinha地域で継続的に死亡事例が報告されており、当局が予防接種キャンペーンを実施中。詳細な検査確認情報や感染源が記事に記載されていないため、フル評価時により詳細な調査が必要。

article.articleHeadline: "무엇을 상상하든 그 이상"...이란 향하다 '원숭이 공격' 받은 미군
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Whatever you imagine, it's beyond that — Iran-bound US troops attacked by a 'monkey attack'.
article.articleSummary: On April 23, a U.S. Navy Avenger-class mine countermeasures ship USS Chief, deployed to the Middle East for mine clearance in the Strait of Hormuz, was briefly diverted to Phuket, Thailand. A land excursion by an electrical technician aboard encountered a monkey attack; the crew member was scratched and subsequently evacuated for medical care to a forward operating base in Sasebo, Japan, due to the risk of rabies and other infections. The Chief, with a crew of 84 and equipped with helicopters, underwater drones, scouts, and escorts, did not suffer operational delays, and the operation continued as planned in the Hormuz approach. This follows recent U.S. naval incidents, including the March onboard fire on the aircraft carrier Gerald R. Ford that prompted a Mediterranean withdrawal from the Red Sea region. Officials say no mission disruption occurred.

triage.headline_ja: どんなことを想像してもそれ以上...イラン向かう米軍が『猿攻撃』を受けた
triage.triage_reason: 動物による孤立した個別事象であり、国間の拡大リスク、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響、または異常な疾病発生パターンを示していない。狂犬病の潜在的曝露は個別の医療対応で管理可能。
triage.notes: 本イベントは野生動物による単一の損傷事象であり、感染症アウトブレイク、流行、または集団発生ではない。狂犬病への曝露リスクは個人レベルの医療管理で対応されており、公衆衛生上の危機を構成しない。記事中で『本件により運用上の遅延は生じなかった』と明示されている。

article.articleHeadline: Mimika dorong eliminasi malaria melalui kepatuhan minum obat - ANTARA News Papua Tengah
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mimika pushes for malaria elimination through adherence to taking antimalarial drugs - ANTARA News Central Papua
article.articleSummary: Malaria elimination efforts in Mimika Regency, Central Papua, Indonesia target eradication by 2030 as cases remain high. Timika Regent Johannes Rettob announced intensified measures: educate the community on completing full antimalarial drug courses to prevent relapse; synchronize malaria case data; deploy trained community cadres to spread awareness; and distribute bed nets with rapid malaria testing already in use. In addition, the government is pursuing infrastructure improvements, including drainage upgrades to reduce standing water that serves as mosquito breeding grounds. While interventions are underway, success depends on sustained public participation and environmental cleanliness at residences. No specific case or death counts are provided, and there is no detailed lab-confirmed outbreak data in the report; the text highlights ongoing high transmission and the need for continued public health actions until the 2030 target.

triage.headline_ja: ミミカ県がマラリア医薬品服用遵守による排除を推進 - ANTARA News中央パプア
triage.triage_reason: マラリアは既知の風土病であり、根絶努力の進捗報告という通常の公衆衛生活動である。具体的な患者数や死亡数が不明であり、IHR基準の2つ以上の該当判定が困難。
triage.notes: 本記事はインドネシア（パプア州ミミカ県）のマラリア排除キャンペーンに関する報道であり、既知の風土病対策の進捗報告。具体的な患者数、死亡数、実験室確認アウトブレイクデータが記載されていない。継続的な感染リスク（prolonged_exposure）と流行易感性（epidemic_prone）が確認されるため、WATCHレベルで経過観察が適切。

article.articleHeadline: Kenyan bat coronavirus uses human CEACAM6 to enter cells, raising spillover concerns
article.articleSummary: Kenyan heart-nosed bat alpha-coronavirus BtCoV-KY43 from Cardioderma cor can enter human cells by binding the human CEACAM6 receptor, a finding from a Nature study. Using pseudotyped lentiviruses, researchers show BtCoV-KY43 spike RBD binds the CEACAM6 IgV-like domain; CEACAM6 overexpression increases permissivity, while anti-CEACAM6 antibodies block entry. Among tested human cells, only BtCoV-KY43 and a subset of Kenyan alpha-CoVs demonstrated CEACAM6-dependent entry; most alpha-CoVs did not use ACE2 or APN. CEACAM6 is highly expressed in lung, colon, and bronchus tissues, with lung epithelial and goblet cells showing prominent expression. Kenyan bat-sampling indicates southeastern coastal population centers as higher spillover risk; human sera from the region showed limited reactivity to CcCoV-KY43 RBD, with no clear evidence of recent spillover. Additional Kenyan isolates (CcCoV 2A/2B) also use CEACAM6, while relatives from China and European Russia show more restricted receptor usage.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアのコウモリコロナウイルスが人間のCEACAM6受容体を使用して細胞に侵入、スピルオーバーリスク懸念の高まり
triage.triage_reason: 実験室研究に基づくスピルオーバーの潜在的リスク評価だが、現在の臨床的な公衆衛生影響や実際の感染事例の報告がないため。継続的なバット由来コロナウイルスのリスク監視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は基礎研究（Nature論文）に基づくケニアのコウモリウイルスの受容体結合能に関する報告。発生地域にChina、Russian Federation、Kenyaが列挙されているが、サマリーの主題はケニア産コウモリコロナウイルス（BtCoV-KY43、CcCoV）の受容体利用機構の実験的検証であり、China/Russian Federationは比較参照用途のみの言及。Kenyaは対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsは対象国のみ検索した結果、該当なしとなるべきところ、誤記があれば修正要。実際の感染事例や臨床的アウトブレイク報告がないため、現段階では学術的関心の域。

article.articleHeadline: Mato alto em escolas de Goiânia acende alerta para dengue e insegurança - Portal Zero ou Dez
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Overgrown Grass in Schools in Goiânia Raises Alarm About Dengue and Insecurity - Portal Zero or Ten
article.articleSummary: Urgent call for Goiânia City Hall to conduct preventive mowing around school grounds after reports that tall grass in multiple districts promotes the breeding of dengue-carrying mosquitoes. In Goiânia, Brazil, residents and education professionals identify overgrowth near Residencial Kátia, Mendanha, Solar Ville, Parque Santa Rita, Jardim São José, and Monte Pascoal. The most severe situation is around Colégio Estadual Roberto Civita in Residencial Kátia. The overgrowth also encourages clandestine dumping of trash and debris, contributing to unsafe conditions and additional health risks. The report underscores the link between neglected vegetation and dengue transmission, urging authorities to act promptly to reduce exposure around educational units and adjacent neighborhoods. The article does not provide dengue case counts.

triage.headline_ja: ゴイアニアの学校の雑草繁茂がデング熱と治安悪化に警告信号
triage.triage_reason: デング熱の潜在的リスク要因（蚊の繁殖地となる雑草繁茂）が報告されているが、実際の患者発生数やアウトブレイク情報がなく、現段階では環境リスク警告レベル。情報不足のため続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: ブラジルのゴイアニア地域におけるデング媒介蚊の繁殖環境（雑草繁茂）に関する警告報告。実際のデング患者発生や確認例の報告がないため、現時点では予防的・環境的リスク要因の指摘に留まる。デング熱は流行しやすい疾患（epidemic_prone）であり、媒介蚊の繁殖環境が継続する可能性（prolonged_exposure）がある点が該当。ただし公衆衛生への深刻な影響や患者数が未報告のため、WPRO基準2項目のスコアに留まる。今後の患者発生報告に注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: ਵਿਸ਼ਵ ਮਲੇਰੀਆ ਦਿਵਸ : ਮਲੇਰੀਆ ਜਾਗਰੂਕਤਾ, ਰੋਕਥਾਮ ਅਤੇ ਸਿਹਤ ਵਿਭਾਗ ਦੇ ਯਤਨ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Malaria Day: Malaria awareness, prevention, and the Health Department's efforts.
article.articleSummary: World Malaria Day is highlighted with awareness, prevention, and Punjab Health Department efforts in India to eradicate malaria. Malaria spreads through bites of infected female Anopheles mosquitoes, with Plasmodium parasites entering the bloodstream. Key symptoms include fever, chills, headache, vomiting, and sweating; without timely treatment, malaria can become severe. The campaign notes risk rises during hot seasons and the monsoon. In India, health workers aim to reduce deaths and prevent spread, with rapid blood testing to confirm malaria and prompt treatment. In Punjab, multi-purpose health workers engage rural and urban communities, inspecting water sources—coolers, jars, behind fridges, water tanks, and broken containers—to eliminate mosquito breeding sites and educating residents on using bed nets, protective clothing, and repellents. Community participation and sustained public health measures are essential to progress toward a malaria-free India.

triage.headline_ja: 世界マラリア対策デー：マラリア認識啓発、予防、およびインド保健部門の取り組み
triage.triage_reason: 世界マラリア対策デーの啓発キャンペーン記事であり、新規の疾病流行イベントではない。既知疾患の定期的な公衆衛生キャンペーンの報道に過ぎず、IHR基準およびWPROスクリーニング基準の該当条件を満たさない。
triage.notes: 記事は世界マラリア対策デーの啓発・予防キャンペーンの報道であり、新規流行イベントの通知ではない。インド・パンジャブ州における定期的な公衆衛生活動の記述であり、異常発生（outbreak）や急増の報告がない。シグナル化の必要性なし。

article.articleHeadline: Fim da aftosa exige mais controle sanitário no rebanho
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Eradication of foot-and-mouth disease requires stricter sanitary controls on the herd.
article.articleSummary: Foot-and-mouth disease vaccination is no longer mandatory in several Brazilian regions as the country advances its national sanitary status, but with a herd of over 238 million cattle, enhanced farm management becomes essential to sustain productivity and market access. The removal of compulsory vaccination does not remove sanitary risks; producers must tighten preventive practices to reduce disease incidence. Parasite control emerges as a major challenge, directly impacting weight gain, feed efficiency, and pregnancy rates, with sector studies estimating losses from parasitic infestations at around BRL 70 billion per year. Key measures include strategic deworming and clearly defined sanitary programs, supported by structured year-round calendars, constant monitoring, and data-driven decisions. Periods like the transition to the dry season demand heightened vigilance. Improved sanitary status opens international market opportunities but increases responsibility for on-farm standards to maintain competitiveness.

triage.headline_ja: 口蹄疫撲滅により家畜衛生管理の強化が必要
triage.triage_reason: 口蹄疫の撲滅達成による衛生管理強化に関する記事であり、新規感染症の発生やアウトブレイクではなく、予防政策の転換についての報道。疾患の発生・拡大を示唆する情報がなく、IHR基準およびWPRO基準のいずれにも該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事はブラジルにおける口蹄疫の撲滅達成を背景としており、現在の疾患発生イベントではなく、撲滅後の家畜衛生管理政策の転換について述べている。義務予防接種の廃止と衛生管理強化についての記事であり、アクティブなシグナルではない。

article.articleHeadline: Diễn biến nặng khi nhiễm RSV ở nhóm người cao tuổi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Severe progression of RSV infection in older adults.
article.articleSummary: RSV presents a high risk of severe progression in older adults and immunocompromised individuals in Vietnam. At a Vietnam Pulmonology Association seminar supported by GSK Vietnam, experts note RSV can cause a spectrum from upper to lower respiratory disease; globally, 33 million lower respiratory tract infections related to RSV were estimated in 2019. In Vietnam, older adults with comorbidities such as asthma, COPD, and heart failure have worse outcomes, with up to 80.4% of older COPD patients admitted for RSV experiencing an acute exacerbation. Emphasis is placed on adult vaccination, especially for those over 60 with underlying conditions, to reduce infection risk and alleviate healthcare burden. Clinicians play a critical role in counseling and promoting vaccination. GSK promotes RSV vaccines for adults and collaborates with cardiology, pulmonology, endocrinology, and diabetes sectors to support prevention of infections in Vietnam.

triage.headline_ja: 高齢者におけるRSV感染の重症化の進行
triage.triage_reason: RSV感染の重症度に関する医学的情報共有であり、新規アウトブレイク報告ではない。記事はワクチン推奨と予防啓発が主体で、異常な流行動向は示されていない。
triage.notes: 本記事はベトナムでのRSV感染の臨床的特性と高齢者への影響に関する専門家セミナー報告であり、新規の異常な流行イベント報告ではない。グローバルデータ（2019年）と臨床的リスク情報の共有が主体。ワクチン普及促進キャンペーン色が強い。IHR基準は満たさず、国際的懸念もない。スクリーニング基準では重症度・長期曝露・流行性が該当するが、社会政治的関心の具体的証拠がないため、WATCH段階の経過観察が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: Sarampo pós Copa: Ministério da Saúde emite alerta sobre disseminação da doença no país
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles after the World Cup: Health Ministry issues alert about the spread of the disease nationwide.
article.articleSummary: Measles alert: Brazil's Health Ministry warned of an imminent risk of measles reintroduction and spread nationwide due to large traveler flows for World Cup 2026, hosted by the United States, Canada, and Mexico, where outbreaks persist. The technical note notes high transmissibility in the Americas and many Brazilians traveling to host countries or other outbreak areas, creating import/export risk. Vaccination and vigilant surveillance are urged to keep Brazil's status as free from endemic measles circulation since 2024. Travelers should update immunization with the MMR vaccine (measles, mumps, rubella) or the tetraviral vaccine (MMR+varicella) at least 15 days before departure; on return, fever with red rash requires prompt care and reporting travel history. Brazil recorded 232 suspected and 2 confirmed measles cases in 2026 through mid-March. Vaccination remains the main prevention.

triage.headline_ja: ワールドカップ後の麻疹：保健省が全国での疾病の蔓延について警告を発出
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルで麻疹を含む複数の予防可能な感染症の再導入リスクが報告され、国際的なスポーツイベント（ワールドカップ2026）に関連した渡航による国際的な拡大リスクがある。IHR基準で3つ以上該当し、シグナルとして識別される。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジルの保健省が麻疹（およびおたふくかぜ、風疹、水痘）の再導入リスクについて正式なアラートを発出した事象を報告している。2026年ワールドカップ開催国（米国、カナダ、メキシコ）での流行に関連して、ブラジルへの輸入リスクが懸念されている。Bluedot APIの発生地域には開催国も含まれているが、サマリーの主題はブラジルにおけるリスク警告である。対象国リストではブラジルのみが検証対象国に該当する。

article.articleHeadline: Affordable household insecticides critical for vector borne diseases
article.articleSummary: India should reduce Goods and Services Tax on household insecticides from 18% to 5% to curb unsafe products and strengthen preventive healthcare, according to a joint EY and Home Insect Control Association (HICA) report titled GST rationalization for household insecticides: A public health imperative. Lowering the GST and simplifying classifications would improve affordability of household insecticides for vulnerable rural populations, boosting protection against vector-borne diseases such as malaria, dengue, and chikungunya. The initiative frames tax reform as a public health measure to curb unsafe products and enhance household-level prevention in India. The report argues affordability drives safe procurement and uptake of preventive tools across rural and urban settings. As of 24 April 2026.

triage.headline_ja: 手頃な価格の家庭用殺虫剤はベクター媒介性疾患に不可欠
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はインドの税制改革提案に関する政策分析であり、進行中の感染症アウトブレイク事象ではない。マラリア、デング、チクングニアの予防措置に関する記事だが、新規患者発生、死亡、流行拡大などの具体的なイベント情報を含まない。
triage.notes: 本記事は家庭用殺虫剤のGST減税を提案する政策レポートであり、現在進行中の感染症アウトブレイクではない。Bluedot APIが疾患名（マラリア、デング、チクングニア）を抽出しているが、これは予防策の文脈での言及であり、シグナルトリアージの対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Wagub Jihan Tegaskan Komitmen Percepat Eliminasi TB di Lampung
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Vice Governor Jihan Reiterates Commitment to Accelerate TB Elimination in Lampung
article.articleSummary: Bandar Lampung, Lampung Province, Indonesia — Vice Governor Jihan Nurlela reaffirms Lampung’s commitment to accelerating tuberculosis (TB) elimination. In a meeting with the Indonesian Pulmonologists Association (PDPI) Lampung Chapter, she notes Lampung as a national TB-priority area and aims to be a pilot for other provinces, applying a mass, structured approach learned from COVID-19. The strategy prioritizes intensified early detection and screening alongside treatment, ensuring screening results are acted upon until completion. TB control will deploy integrated services from puskesmas and posyandu to village health cadres, with digital monitoring via the Lampung In app, coordinated with PDPI and the Provincial Communications, Informatics, and Statistics Office. TB outcomes show drug-susceptible cure rates of 95% (2024) and 98% (2025); Standards of Health Service (SPM) rose from 103% (2024) to 131% (2025), with 19% in Q1 2026.

triage.headline_ja: ジハン副知事、ランプン州での結核排除加速への取り組みを確認
triage.triage_reason: 結核の管理・排除戦略に関する行政ニュースであり、新規発生、異常事象、または公衆衛生危機を示唆していない。COVID-19との併記は参考のみで、主題はTB制御プログラムの進捗報告である。
triage.notes: 記事内容は結核の公衆衛生対応戦略に関する行政声明であり、感染症シグナルではなく政策実行状況の報道。治癒率の改善報告は制御に成功している状況を示唆する。COVID-19への言及は過去の対応経験の参考引用に過ぎず、両疾患の新規流行を示す証拠はない。

article.articleHeadline: Mpox - AOL
article.articleSummary: Mpox (monkeypox), caused by the monkeypox virus, has vaccines but treatment is mainly supportive; antivirals have emergency use authorization without proven efficacy. Two clades exist: clade I (Ia, Ib) and clade II (IIa, IIb); a global clade IIb outbreak in 2022–23 was declared a WHO public health emergency of international concern, with a second emergency in August 2024 due to an outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC). Incubation is 1–21 days; symptoms typically 2–4 weeks and include fever, headache, muscle aches, swollen lymph nodes, and a facial/body rash that can involve palms, soles, and genitals. Transmission is via close contact (skin-to-skin, sex, kissing), contaminated objects, or mother-to-child; animal-to-human transmission occurs via bites, scratches, hunting. Case fatality rate ranges 0–11% by clade; higher risk for children, pregnant people, and immunocompromised. Prevention includes smallpox vaccination for at-risk groups; one dose offers protection, two doses recommended. As of July 2025, 122 countries reported cases, including 115 previously unaffected.

triage.headline_ja: Mpox - AOL
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限のリスク）。DRCでのclade I爆発に伴う2024年8月のWHO緊急事態宣言、122カ国への拡大、高い致死率（0-11%）により、フルRRA対象のシグナルと判定。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはMpoxの一般的な特性と2024年8月のDRCでの爆発に基づくWHO緊急事態宣言を明記。2025年7月時点で122カ国が症例報告。致死率0-11%、ヒト-ヒト感染可能、動物由来リスク。既知の進行中のシグナルではあるが、継続的なモニタリングと更新情報の追跡が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Le laboratoire russe offert au Congo est "pour être proche de l'épicentre d'une épidémie" - expert
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Russian laboratory donated to the Congo is "to be close to the epicenter of an outbreak" - expert.
article.articleSummary: At the International Russo-African Conference on the fight against infectious diseases in Brazzaville, a biologist said the Russian-donated laboratory to the Republic of Congo was designed to be close to the epicenter of an outbreak. The 4x4 truck can reach places where other vehicles cannot arrive, he said. He added that the laboratory is designed to detect all types of viruses and bacteria, and that its Biosafety Level 3 capacity allows high-risk infections to be manipulated safely with proper biosafety measures. Congolese staff working at the laboratory have been trained by Russian specialists, according to him. The conference was organized in Brazzaville by the Russian consumer protection surveillance service, Rospotrebnadzor.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴに寄贈されたロシア国防研究所は「感染症発生の中心地に近づくため」専門家が指摘
triage.triage_reason: 記事はロシアが寄贈した検査室施設とその機能についての説明であり、実際の感染症アウトブレイクの発生報告ではない。不明な疾患の具体的な患者発生、重症度、感染の広がりなどの情報が全くなく、IHR基準およびスクリーニング基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事は感染症検査室の施設寄贈に関する専門家コメントであり、実際の疾病発生イベントではない。"Unknown Illness"の疾患分類も実際の患者報告に基づくものではなく、施設紹介文脈での言及と推定される。Brazzavilleはコンゴ共和国に属する都市だが、記事では主にDRCとの関連性が強調されている。対象国はDRCのみを含める。

article.articleHeadline: Malaria in Pregnancy: Early Detection and Prevention Can Save Two Lives
article.articleSummary: Malaria in pregnancy remains a seasonal public health risk in Hyderabad, India, and Fernandez Hospital urges vigilant early testing. Plasmodium falciparum is the most dangerous parasite, capable of placental infection and fetal growth disruption; Plasmodium vivax is also treated. Pregnant women, especially in their first pregnancy or early trimesters, face higher risks of severe malaria, including maternal anemia, bleeding at delivery, hypoglycemia, seizures, respiratory distress, or organ failure. For the baby, malaria can cause miscarriage, fetal growth restriction, stillbirth, neonatal death, and rarely congenital malaria. Symptoms include fever, chills, headaches, nausea, vomiting, and muscle pains; severe cases may involve seizures or breathing difficulty. Diagnosis relies on blood microscopy or rapid diagnostic tests, with repeat testing if symptoms persist after an initial negative result. Prevention—mosquito nets, repellents, protective clothing, avoiding high-risk travel, and preventive therapy after the first trimester in select settings—plus regular antenatal care, reduce risks.

triage.headline_ja: 妊娠中のマラリア：早期発見と予防で2つの命を救える
triage.triage_reason: インドの季節性公衆衛生リスクとして報告されているが、アウトブレイク規模や急速な拡大の兆候が明確でなく、情報が不足している。妊娠女性への特有リスクについての啓発記事の性質が強い。
triage.notes: 記事はハイデラバード（テランガナ州）の季節性マラリアリスクに関する公開医療情報・啓発内容。妊娠女性への重症化リスク（流産、死産、新生児死亡等）は説明されているが、具体的な症例数、発生率の異常、急速な拡大などの情報がない。Plasmodium falciparumとP. vivaxの両方が言及されている。現在進行中のアウトブレイク状況ではなく、季節的な注意喚起の側面が強いため、フルRRA前に追加情報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Pagamento de indenização às vítimas do Zika vírus deve ser concluído em maio
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Payment of compensation to the victims of the Zika virus should be completed in May.
article.articleSummary: Brazil's federal government is paying compensation under Lei 15.156, 2025 to families with children affected by congenital Zika syndrome. The indemnity is R$50,000 per eligible family, and the law also provides a lifelong special pension of R$8.475, equal to the cap of the General Social Security Regime. Deposits have begun and are expected to be completed by the first half of May 2026. The measure originated from a bill presented by Senator Mara Gabrilli (PSD-SP). In addition to the lump-sum payment, the pension ensures ongoing support for affected households, formalizing Brazil's financial response to Zika virus–related congenital outcomes within the national framework.

triage.headline_ja: ジカウイルス被害者への補償金支払いが5月に完了予定
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はブラジル政府によるジカウイルス被害者への補償金支払いプログラムの進捗報告であり、新規の感染症発生イベントではなく、過去のアウトブレイクへの行政対応である。公衆衛生上の新たなリスクや異常な感染拡大を示唆する情報は含まれない。
triage.notes: 本記事はジカウイルスに関する過去のアウトブレイク被害者への補償制度の実装状況を報じたもので、新規の感染症シグナルではない。政府の行政対応の一環として報道されているが、現在の感染症監視の対象外と判定。

article.articleHeadline: 與親友訪越南返港發燒出疹　31歲空姐證染麻疹需隔離
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 31-year-old flight attendant diagnosed with measles, needs isolation after returning to Hong Kong from a Vietnam visit with relatives and friends.
article.articleSummary: Measles in Hong Kong: A 31-year-old female flight attendant, an imported case, contracted measles during a Vietnam visit with relatives (April 9–12). She developed fever and myalgia on April 19 and a rash on April 22; laboratory confirmation found measles virus. She is hospitalized in stable condition at Princess Margaret Hospital and is in isolation; no known Hong Kong exposure and no link to prior airport cluster cases. There is one household contact and 27 close contacts from a private clinic who are under medical surveillance, none symptomatic so far. Epidemiology indicates overseas acquisition with ongoing investigations. In response, the Centre for Health Protection began free measles vaccination for eligible airport staff, with about 75 vaccinated by 6:00 pm today. The patient reportedly received measles vaccination in her birth country.

triage.headline_ja: ベトナム訪問から帰港した31歳客室乗務員が麻疹と診断、隔離が必要
triage.triage_reason: 輸入症例であり、香港での地域伝播の兆候は現時点でない。ただし航空職員への接触を含む複数の接触者がいるため、今後の経過を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 症例はベトナムで麻疹に感染した輸入症例。香港内での明確な地域伝播はまだ報告されていない。ただし客室乗務員の職業特性と空港職員への接触リスク、さらに28人の接触者が経過観察中であることから、今後のシグナル悪化の可能性があるため経過観察が妥当。麻疹は流行しやすい疾患であり、香港での予防接種キャンペーン開始は適切な対応を示唆している。

article.articleHeadline: Peringati Hari TBC Dunia, FKUI gelar CKG dan skrining TBC - ANTARA News
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: To mark World TB Day, FKUI hosts CKG and TB screening.
article.articleSummary: On 24 April 2026, in Cilincing, North Jakarta, Indonesia, the Faculty of Medicine, University of Indonesia (FKUI) hosted free health screenings and tuberculosis (TB) screening to mark World TB Day. The event aimed to boost detection and raise awareness of TB in the community. FKUI Dean Anna Rozaliyani emphasized that tuberculosis remains one of Indonesia’s major public health challenges, underscoring the need for active detection and screening to curb transmission. The article notes no TB case counts or laboratory-confirmation results were reported. The initiative reflects ongoing public health efforts to identify TB cases through community-based screening in Jakarta, with potential implications for early diagnosis and linkage to care for affected individuals.

triage.headline_ja: 世界結核の日を記念して、FKUIが保健教育と結核スクリーニングを開催
triage.triage_reason: 結核啓発イベントの報道であり、新規の感染症クラスターや異常な発生ではない。社会的・政治的関心も限定的で、国際的な拡大リスクも認められない。
triage.notes: 本記事は結核啓発キャンペーン（World TB Day記念イベント）であり、感染症の異常な発生、クラスター、または拡大を報告するシグナル記事ではない。コミュニティベースのスクリーニング実施は公衆衛生活動の継続を示す情報だが、トリアージ対象のシグナルではない。

article.articleHeadline: Viêm phổi, suy hô hấp do sởi ở tuổi trung niên
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Pneumonia and respiratory failure due to measles in middle age.
article.articleSummary: Ms. Nga, a 40-year-old Hanoi resident with no underlying conditions and no measles vaccination, developed measles with rapid progression to pneumonia and respiratory failure at Tam Anh General Hospital Hanoi. Initially treated as measles with acute rhinitis, she spiked 39–40°C fevers, had severe sore throat, cough, diffuse rash, dyspnea. Exam showed decreased lung aeration with crackles; labs revealed leukocytosis, elevated procalcitonin, and thrombocytopenia. Diagnosed with measles complicated by pneumonia, respiratory failure, risk of sepsis. She received 3 L/min oxygen, antibiotics for superinfection, high-dose vitamin A, IV fluids, nutrition, and early respiratory rehabilitation. By day 8 fever resolved and lungs cleared; imaging and labs gradually normalized, and she was discharged. Measles transmits via airborne, droplets, or contaminated surfaces. No specific antiviral exists; management is supportive. Vaccination prevents disease: MMR or MMRV vaccines, two-dose regimens with up to 98% efficacy. Pregnant women should immunize before pregnancy; family members should verify vaccination status.

triage.headline_ja: 麻疹による中年の肺炎と呼吸不全
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムで麻疹による重症事例（肺炎・呼吸不全）が報告されているが、単一症例報告であり国際的脅威や異常性の明確な証拠に欠ける。スクリーニング基準は複数該当するが、社会的関心や政府対応が不明のため経過観察対象とする。
triage.notes: 記事は単一患者の重症麻疹事例（ハノイ、40歳女性、予防接種歴なし）を医学的に記述したもの。麻疹自体は既知疾患で予防可能であり、異常性や予想外性は低い。ただし予防接種率の低さ、成人での重症化リスクなどから継続注視が必要。集団発生の有無、公衆衛生上の対応状況については追加情報が必要。SFTS Virusは疾患リストに含まれているが記事サマリーに言及なし（除外）。

article.articleHeadline: Experts Flag Urgent Dengue Treatment Gaps Ahead Of Monsoon - BW Healthcare World
article.articleSummary: Dengue in South and South-East Asia drives urgent calls for improved treatment options as monsoon season nears. The World Health Organization in South-East Asia region reports 1.3 billion people at risk, accounting for more than half of the global dengue burden, with about 390 million infections annually. India recorded 289,000 dengue cases in 2023, though true numbers are likely higher due to underreporting. A high-level New Delhi meeting convened by DNDi, Translational Health Science and Technology Institute (THSTI), Dengue Alliance, and WHO highlighted the absence of a widely accessible, effective therapy despite progress in vaccines, including an indigenous tetravalent dengue vaccine in late-stage trials. Participants urged strengthened surveillance, accelerated vaccine development, improved diagnostics, and affordable treatments to reduce hospitalisations, especially among children, pregnant women, and low-income groups. Climate-driven spread of Aedes aegypti heightens outbreak risk, underscoring need for sustained collaboration and funding.

triage.headline_ja: モンスーン前のデング熱治療ギャップに専門家が警告 - BW Healthcare World
triage.triage_reason: インドでのデング熱の重大な公衆衛生影響（年間390万感染者、2023年に28万9千例）、異常性（治療薬不足）、及び国際的拡大リスク（南アジア・東南アジア全域で13億人が危険にさらされている）がIHR基準2つ以上に該当。スクリーニング基準でも重症度、流行しやすさ、管理可能性における懸念が認められ、社会的・政治的関心（WHO関与、高級会議開催）も高い。
triage.notes: 記事はインドにおけるデング熱の治療ギャップに焦点を当てており、南アジア・東南アジア地域全体への言及は文脈的背景。モンスーン季節前の流行拡大リスク、気候変動によるネッタイシマカの広がり、ワクチン開発途上での治療オプション不足が重要な懸念。DNDi、THSTI、Dengue Alliance、WHOによるハイレベル会議開催は政府及び国際的な関心の高さを示唆。

article.articleHeadline: China Bans Chilean Poultry Over Bird Flu Fears | Sada Elbalad
article.articleSummary: China bans all poultry and poultry product imports from Chile after confirmed avian influenza outbreaks in Chile. The General Administration of Customs of China ordered an immediate suspension to protect biosecurity and domestic poultry markets. The move could disrupt Chile's export flows, as shipments already en route or moored may be rejected or destroyed, with potential substantial financial losses and contract disruptions. Chile's SAG confirmed 20 active bird flu outbreaks this year, affecting over 700,000 birds, with the heaviest concentration in Maule, O'Higgins, and Valparaiso regions. The ban echoes a prior disruption when China suspended Chilean poultry imports for 18 months, lifted in late 2024, signaling high sensitivity of agricultural trade to biosecurity concerns. Ongoing containment efforts include intensified monitoring to prevent further spread within Chile's poultry sector.

triage.headline_ja: 中国が鳥インフルエンザ懸念によりチリ産家禽を禁輸
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準では2つ以上の該当がなく、対象国リスト内での検証可能なイベント発生地がない（チリは対象国ではない）。記事の主題はチリの家禽疾病および貿易への影響であり、監視対象地域外のため。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIの発生地域フィールドには中国が含まれているが、記事サマリーの主題はチリでの鳥インフルエンザ発生とそれに対する中国の禁輸措置である。チリは対象監視国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsは空とする。本イベントは動物の疾病であり、ヒトの感染症シグナルではない。

article.articleHeadline: Bangladesh measles toll rises to 240 as 7 more children die
article.articleSummary: Bangladesh’s measles outbreak has caused 240 deaths and 29,500+ infections since mid-March, with roughly 1,400 new cases in the past 24 hours, per Health Ministry and DGHS. Testing kit shortages hinder confirmation. WHO notes 58 of 64 districts (91%) are affected, indicating widespread transmission, with Dhaka city bearing the highest case load in dense informal settlements. A vaccination campaign targeting children 6–59 months started earlier this month. Bangladesh’s earlier elimination gains were eroded by 2024–2025 vaccine stockouts, routine immunization gaps, and the absence of nationwide measles–rubella campaigns since 2020. Measles remains endemic in the South-East Asia region, with regional risk assessed as high. Cross-border movement with India and Myanmar may sustain transmission; Myanmar has many zero-dose children, and India has reported rising case counts over the past six months.

triage.headline_ja: バングラデシュの麻疹死者数が240人に上昇、さらに7人の子どもが死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上に該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的な拡大リスク、予想外の事象）。WPRO基準でも複数該当し、東南アジア地域での広がりと国境を越えた伝播リスクが確認される。フルRRA進行が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは2026年4月24日現在、バングラデシュで麻疹の大規模流行を報告。240人の死亡、29,500人以上の感染、64地区中58地区（91%）が影響を受けており、既に成立しているエピデミック。インドとミャンマーとの国境を越えた伝播リスクが明示されている。WHO関連情報への言及もあり、国際的な関心が高い。バングラデシュの麻疹排除成果が2024～2025年のワクチン不足により喪失された背景も重要。

article.articleHeadline: الصين تحظر استيراد الدواجن التشيلية بسبب تفشي إنفلونزا الطيور - دليل مصر
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: China Bans Chilean Poultry Imports Due to Avian Influenza Outbreak - Egypt Guide
article.articleSummary: China's General Administration of Customs has ordered an immediate halt on importing poultry and poultry products from Chile after reports of avian influenza outbreaks across multiple Chilean regions. The precautionary ban aims to protect biosafety and China's livestock sector from epidemic threats and potential supply disruptions. China could reject or destroy any Chilean poultry already in ports or en route, threatening financial losses for exporters and delaying contracts. The move follows a prior Chinese ban on Chilean poultry that lasted about 18 months and was lifted in late 2024, underscoring high sensitivity to disease signals in Beijing's trade policy. Chile's Agricultural and Livestock Service confirms a clear crisis and will step up surveillance and tracing to contain the outbreak, amid international pressure on its poultry sector. The situation raises questions about restoring global market confidence as supply chains face biosecurity risks.

triage.headline_ja: 中国がチリの鳥インフルエンザ流行を理由に家禽輸入を禁止 - エジプトガイド
triage.triage_reason: 鳥インフルエンザの国際的な貿易・流通への影響が明確であり、IHR基準の「国際的な拡大リスク」「渡航・貿易制限リスク」に該当。WPROスクリーニング基準では「管理可能性」（国際的な供給チェーン・生物安全保障上の懸念）が認められる。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはチリでの鳥インフルエンザ流行を背景としているが、主題は中国の輸入禁止措置であり、実際の感染症イベント（チリの発生）については対象国外のため verified_locations には含めない。中国における貿易・供給チェーン上の影響が主体となっており、国際的な生物安全保障リスクが顕著である。

article.articleHeadline: 237 Kasus Campak Tercatat di Cimahi, Dinkes: Tersebar di 13 Kelurahan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 237 Measles Cases Recorded in Cimahi, Health Department: Spread Across 13 Urban Villages.
article.articleSummary: Measles in Cimahi, Indonesia, reaches mid-April 2026 with 237 suspected cases across 13 kelurahan; 28 are laboratory-confirmed positive, mostly children. The figure rose from 155 suspected and 16 positives in early April. Most positives occur in unvaccinated children lacking MR vaccination. Health officials urge parents to complete immunization; 2025 basic immunization coverage (IDL) was reported above 95%. Prevention focuses on droplet transmission reduction and hygiene: cough etiquette, handwashing, and avoiding contact with those showing fever and rash. Isolate suspected cases for at least four days after rash onset and seek care; vitamin A is given to avert complications such as pneumonia or encephalitis. The Cimahi Health Department is enhancing surveillance, epidemiological investigations, and routine immunization, including outreach in mosques and communities.

triage.headline_ja: チマヒで麻疹237例を記録、保健局：13の地区に分散
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹の集団発生（237例の疑い、28例確定）がインドネシアで報告され、IHR基準2項目以上に該当。公衆衛生への重大な影響、不規則な増加パターン（2週間で155→237例）が認められ、シグナルとして識別される。
triage.notes: 記事はインドネシアのチマヒ市における麻疹の集団発生を報告している。疑い例237例、確定例28例であり、主に予防接種未接種の小児が罹患。2週間で疑い例が155→237例に増加する急速な増加傾向が認められ、これは異常な流行パターンを示唆している。予防接種カバレッジが95%以上と報告されているにもかかわらず、ワクチン未接種者層での蔓延が見られる。麻疹は高い感染力を持つ疾患であり、WPRO全5基準に該当する。国家レベルの対応（調査強化、予防接種キャンペーン）が実施されている。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H3N2

article.articleHeadline: Casos e mortes por gripe disparam, reforçando alerta
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza cases and deaths surge, reinforcing the alert.
article.articleSummary: Brazil's early 2026 influenza season shows rising severe acute respiratory syndrome (SARI) cases linked to influenza. By April 17, the Ministry of Health reported 4,181 SARI cases associated with influenza and 259 deaths. The early arrival raises concern among health authorities. Fiocruz projects the high trend continuing in 14 of Brazil's 27 states, linked to circulating sublineages and the A(H3N2) strain, already associated with higher transmission. The World Health Organization notes that millions of influenza cases occur annually worldwide, with thousands of deaths among vulnerable groups. Vaccination is emphasized as a central tool to reduce hospitalizations and deaths. Campaigns aim to expand coverage across different populations, underscoring the need to vaccinate to alleviate healthcare burden, particularly for high-risk groups.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザの症例と死亡が急増し、警戒を強化
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルにおいてH3N2亜型関連のインフルエンザによる重症急性呼吸器感染症（SARI）の急増（4,181例、259死亡）が報告されており、IHR基準の「公衆衛生への影響の深刻性」「異常性」「国際的拡大リスク」を満たし、WPROスクリーニング基準でも「重症度」「流行しやすさ」に該当する。フルRRA進行が必要。
triage.notes: A(H3N2)インフルエンザによる早期の流行シーズンであり、ブラジルの27州中14州での高い傾向継続が予測されている。死亡率および重症化率が懸念される。WHOも世界的な監視対象として言及。

article.articleHeadline: Kimia Farma Diagnostika Perkuat Kolaborasi Strategis untuk Percepatan Eliminasi Tuberkulosis di Indonesia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kimia Farma Diagnostika Strengthens Strategic Collaboration to Accelerate Tuberculosis Elimination in Indonesia.
article.articleSummary: PT Kimia Farma Diagnostika (KFD) strengthens strategic collaboration with the Faculty of Medicine, University of Indonesia (FKUI) to accelerate TB elimination in Indonesia. The partnership centers on a TB tracing simulation using portable X-ray units equipped with artificial intelligence, conducted for 300 community members in Kampung TB Cilincing, North Jakarta, as part of FKUI’s community service program. Indonesian Health Ministry data place Indonesia among the world’s countries with a high TB burden, with hundreds of thousands of new cases annually, underscoring the need for intensified cross-sector action. KFD CEO Arie Genipa Suhendi says the FKUI collaboration aims to deliver more precise, accessible diagnostics and strengthen early detection and comprehensive TB management through Kimia Farma’s extensive laboratory network. The initiative emphasizes adherence to Good Laboratory Practice (GLP) and related accreditation.

triage.headline_ja: Kimia Farma Diagnostika、インドネシアの結核排除加速を目指す戦略的協力を強化
triage.triage_reason: 本イベントはインドネシアにおける結核診断能力向上のための企業・大学間の協力体制構築の報道であり、新規の感染症発生やアウトブレイク、公衆衛生危機を示唆するものではない。既知の高負担国における管理・診断体制の改善に関する通常のニュース。
triage.notes: 本記事は結核対策における診断技術向上と官民学連携の進展を扱う肯定的なニュースであり、新規感染症事象の報告ではない。既知の結核高負担国における継続的な疾病管理・診断能力強化の一環として位置付けられる。シグナル検出の対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Morte de bebê de 1 ano é investigada por suspeita de meningite bacteriana em Uberlândia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Death of a 1-year-old baby under investigation for suspected bacterial meningitis in Uberlândia.
article.articleSummary: One-year-old infant died in Uberlândia amid suspected bacterial meningitis; the case remains under investigation. Samples were sent to Fundação Ezequiel Dias for laboratory confirmation, with results pending. Details were not disclosed due to LGPD. Uberlândia has recorded three meningitis deaths and 30 cases this year; in 2025 there were seven deaths and 139 cases. In Minas Gerais, 26 deaths and 167 cases have been reported to date. The Municipal Health Secretariat says preventive measures were implemented, including immediate epidemiological investigation and chemoprophylaxis for close contacts, with monitoring of exposed individuals. The state SES-MG confirms the death is being investigated jointly by the municipality and Funed in Belo Horizonte. Meningitis involves inflammation of CNS membranes; bacterial forms require urgent antibiotic treatment in hospital. Vaccines provided by SUS include meningococcal C, pneumococcal 10-valent, and pentavalent Hib; Uberlândia operates 75 vaccination points across the city and rural areas.

triage.headline_ja: ウベルランジアで1歳児が細菌性髄膜炎の疑いで死亡、調査中
triage.triage_reason: 細菌性髄膜炎（Haemophilus influenzaeを含む可能性）による死亡例であり、重症度が高く、ブラジル（対象国）での発生。同地域では今年すでに3件の死亡と30例の髄膜炎が報告されており、前年比で増加傾向を示している。
triage.notes: 細菌性髄膜炎の原因菌は未確定（検査結果待機中）。ウベルランジア市および州全体で髄膜炎症例・死亡の集積が報告されている（ミナスジェライス州：26死亡、167例；市：3死亡、30例）。前年比で顕著な増加が見られる。当局により積極的な疫学調査と予防措置が実施されている。

article.articleHeadline: Cientistas ligam sinal de alerta para o Vírus Lujo, patógeno raro que matou 4 em cada 5 pessoas infectadas em surto na África
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Scientists raise alarm over the Lujo virus, a rare pathogen that killed four out of five people infected in an outbreak in Africa.
article.articleSummary: Lujo virus, an arenavirus identified in 2008 in the region between Zambia and South Africa, caused the only confirmed outbreak to date. Five people were infected, four of whom died in less than three weeks, leaving one survivor. The virus is rare and highly lethal, with potential to cause severe hemorrhagic symptoms similar to Lassa fever. Symptoms appear 7–13 days after infection, initially fever, headache, and muscle pains, progressing to facial swelling, diarrhea, sore throat, and failure of respiratory and neurological systems. Death typically occurs 10–13 days after onset during advanced illness. Human-to-human transmission occurs mainly through direct contact with bodily fluids, particularly at late disease stages, limiting early spread but posing risk in densely populated settings. No specific treatment is approved; research is pursuing antivirals and vaccines, underscoring persistent concern about this dangerous, poorly understood pathogen.

triage.headline_ja: 科学者、ルージョウイルスに警告 - アフリカのアウトブレイクで感染者の5人中4人が死亡した稀な病原体
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（重篤な影響、異常・予期しない、国際的拡大リスク）。致死率80%の稀な出血熱で、ヒト間感染の可能性があり、対象地域ザンビアで確認されている。
triage.notes: ルージョウイルスは2008年にザンビア・南アフリカ地域で初めて同定された稀な出血熱。過去唯一の確認アウトブレイクでは5人中4人が死亡し、致死率80%。ヒト間感染が報告されており、特に晩期の患者の体液との直接接触で伝播。現在、承認された特異的治療法はなく、抗ウイルス剤とワクチン開発が進行中。社会的・政治的関心も高く、国際支援の必要性が示唆されている。

article.articleHeadline: Opas alerta para alta transmissibilidade e mortes por sarampo nas Américas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: PAHO warns of high transmissibility and measles deaths in the Americas.
article.articleSummary: Measles resurges in the Americas with high transmissibility and deaths. As of early April 2026, the Pan American Health Organization reports about 15,300 confirmed cases this year in the Americas, after 14,767 in 2025, led by Mexico, Guatemala, the United States, and Canada. Thirty-two deaths were recorded in 2025, with 11 more confirmed in the first quarter of 2026. Brazil remains certified free from endemic transmission since 2024 but is vulnerable, reporting two imported cases in São Paulo and Rio de Janeiro by mid-March 2026, both in unvaccinated individuals. Transmission is airborne; complications include blindness, pneumonia, and encephalitis. Vaccination is essential: Brazil’s SUS schedule requires the first dose of the triple viral vaccine at 12 months and the second at 15 months, with adults up to 59 years urged to update if unvaccinated. Elimination of measles in the Americas twice before underscores the need for political commitment and vigilance.

triage.headline_ja: PAHOが南米地域における麻疹の高い感染力と死亡を警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。WPRO基準でも異常性、重症度、流行しやすさが確認され、多地域での多数の死亡事例と急速な増加傾向が認められる。
triage.notes: 記事はメキシコ、グアテマラ、米国、カナダなど複数国での麻疹流行について言及しているが、対象国リストではブラジルのみが該当。ただし、ブラジルは2024年以降風土病的伝播がないが、輸入症例が報告され、高い脆弱性を示している。PAHOが公式警告を発しており、国際的な関心と対応の必要性が高い。麻疹は高度に感染性で空気感染し、失明や肺炎などの重篤な合併症を引き起こす。

article.articleHeadline: 159 cas de leptospirose, 109 de dengue et 28 de chikungunya depuis le début de l'année
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 159 cases of leptospirosis, 109 of dengue and 28 of chikungunya since the beginning of the year.
article.articleSummary: 159 leptospirosis cases confirmed in Réunion in 2026 through April 22; 69 hospitalisations (60%), 1 death. 12 communes affected: South 42% (Tampon 22, Saint-Joseph 19, Saint-Louis 11); East 30% (Saint-Benoît 22, Saint-André 12, Sainte-Rose 6); West 18% (Saint-Paul 16, Saint-Leu 10); North 11% (Saint-Suzanne 8, Saint-Denis 6). Seasonal rise linked to the austral summer’s conditions that favor Leptospira in freshwater and humid environments. Dengue and chikungunya: 109 autochthonous dengue; 28 autochthonous chikungunya; clusters in Saint-Leu and Saint-Paul neighborhoods; 12 communes affected. Dengue serotype DENV-1 remains dominant; DENV-2 detected in Saint-Paul and Saint-Leu (initially La Possession). No active chikungunya outbreak; cluster monitored at La Possession. Imported cases: 13 chikungunya (Madagascar, Mayotte, Seychelles, Thailand); 6 dengue (Thailand, India, Tahiti, Madagascar, Kenya). PCR triplex chik/dengue/lepto recommended for dengue-like syndromes.

triage.headline_ja: 2026年初頭からのレプトスピラ症159例、デング熱109例、チクングニア熱28例
triage.triage_reason: レユニオンでレプトスピラ症159例（死亡1例、入院69例60%）、デング熱109例、チクングニア熱28例が確認され、12の自治体に広がっている。重症度基準と長期曝露基準を満たし、ベクター媒介感染症の複数同時発生で管理可能性にも懸念あり。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが付与した発生地域リストにはフランス（レユニオン）、マダガスカル、セーシェル、ケニアなど多数含まれているが、記事サマリーの主題はレユニオンでの3感染症の同時流行である。輸入症例がタイ、インド、タヒチ、マダガスカル、ケニアから確認されており、これらは流行の周辺情報。対象国リストではタイとインドのみ該当。レユニオンはフランス領土であるが対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: 宠物家庭警惕人宠共患病，专家提醒科学居家消毒可阻断传播
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Pet-owning households, beware of zoonotic diseases; experts remind that science-based home disinfection can block transmission.
article.articleSummary: In China, pet-owning households face zoonotic risks, and home disinfection is essential to block transmission. Yao Hua, vice dean of Beijing University of Agriculture’s College of Animal Science and Technology/Veterinary Medicine, urges a science-first approach: identify risky areas, use effective disinfectants, tailor methods, and maintain vaccination and deworming. Pathogens include pathogenic E. coli and Salmonella (GI spread), canine coronavirus, feline coronavirus (GI symptoms), canine parvovirus, Leptospira, and adenovirus that persists in the environment. Disinfection combines physical and chemical methods; agents include hypochlorous acid, hydrogen peroxide, potassium peroxymonosulfate compounds, alcohol, and benzalkonium chloride. Use licensed products, dilute as directed, and avoid mixing. For vaccinated pets, disinfect every 2–4 weeks; higher exposure increases frequency. Key areas: bowls daily; bedding weekly at >60°C; litter box daily with weekly disinfection; floors, sofas, and beds. Follow cleaning–disinfection–ventilation, isolate during treatment, ventilate 30 minutes, and dry before return. Store safely and seek veterinary care if symptoms appear.

triage.headline_ja: ペット飼育世帯は人獣共通感染症に警戒を、専門家は科学的な居宅消毒が感染拡大を防ぐことを推奨
triage.triage_reason: 複数の病原体が言及されているが、本記事はペット飼育者向けの予防・教育記事であり、実際の患者発生や公衆衛生危機を報告するものではない。具体的な患者数、死亡、地域的な流行の報告がない。
triage.notes: 記事は北京農業大学の獣医学専門家による一般向けの予防教育情報。E. coli、Salmonella、犬コロナウイルス、レプトスピラなど複数の病原体が言及されているが、実際のアウトブレイク報告ではなく、ペット飼育者への消毒・予防措置の説明が主体。患者数、重症度、地域的な異常な増加の報告なし。公衆衛生危機に該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: 女機艙服務員感染麻疹　潛伏期曾訪越南列外地傳入個案 - RTHK
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Female flight attendant infected with measles; had visited Vietnam during the incubation period—an imported case.
article.articleSummary: Imported measles case in Hong Kong: a 31-year-old female flight attendant developed fever and myalgia on 19 April 2026, later a rash, and is clinically confirmed positive for measles virus RNA. She had recently visited Vietnam during the incubation period amid a local outbreak but had no known contact with Hong Kong measles cases or airport workers; she did have a home household contact and 10 friends who accompanied her to Vietnam. She sought care at a private clinic, was referred to North Lantau Hospital Emergency Department, and is now isolated at Princess Margaret Hospital. There are 27 close contacts from the private clinic under monitoring, with none symptomatic so far. The patient reports prior measles vaccination. Public health started free measles vaccination for eligible airport staff; by 18:00 on 24 April 2026, about 75 staff were vaccinated, with the airport cluster total exceeding 430 vaccinated.

triage.headline_ja: 女性客室乗務員が麻疹に感染　潜伏期間中にベトナムを訪問—輸入症例
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹の輸入症例であり、国際航空ハブ（空港）での曝露リスク、医療機関での接触者追跡が進行中。IHR基準3つ該当（異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）かつWPRO基準複数該当のためフルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 香港での麻疹輸入症例。患者はベトナム滞在中に感染、香港の医療機関と空港スタッフに接触リスクがある。既往ワクチン接種あるも陽性。空港のクラスター関連で430名以上がワクチン接種を受けており、公衆衛生対応が積極的に展開中。接触者追跡進行中で今後の流行拡大リスク要監視。

article.articleHeadline: Amazonas inicia distribuição de novo medicamento contra malária infantil no interior
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Amazonas begins distribution of a new malaria drug for children in the interior.
article.articleSummary: On April 22, 2026, Amazonas began distributing pediatric tafenoquine, a new drug for treating Plasmodium vivax malaria in children, in interior Amazonas. The initiative, coordinated by Brazil's Ministry of Health, the Special Secretariat for Indigenous Health (Sesai), and partners, aims to expand access in remote interior areas of the Amazonas state. The Fundação de Vigilância em Saúde (FVS-RCP) notes that low treatment adherence remains a challenge; tafenoquine is expected to help complete therapy and reduce malaria transmission. The rollout includes training health professionals in G6PD deficiency testing and proper administration to ensure safe use. The effort strengthens malaria control actions and marks progress against the disease in vulnerable Amazon regions.

triage.headline_ja: アマゾナス州が小児マラリア対策の新医薬品配布を開始
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はマラリア対策における新医薬品配布のプログラム進展を報じるもので、疾患の異常な発生、流行拡大、または健康危機を示す情報ではない。感染症イベントとしてのシグナル特性を満たさない。
triage.notes: ブラジルはWPRO対象国リストに含まれていない（本評価の対象国外）。記事内容は公衆衛生介入（医薬品配布プログラム）に関する報道であり、感染症の新規発生や流行を示すシグナルではない。

article.articleHeadline: 守护幼儿健康！县中医医院送上"常见传染病防控"干货
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Protecting the health of young children! The County Traditional Chinese Medicine Hospital brings practical tips on the prevention and control of common infectious diseases.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-04-24, the County Traditional Chinese Medicine Hospital’s infection-control team delivered a knowledge lecture at Wenxi Town Central Kindergarten Shabu Campus for about 120 parents, focusing on prevention of common infectious diseases. Spring’s variable temperatures heighten risk for influenza, norovirus gastroenteritis, and hand-foot-mouth disease among young children. The session detailed typical symptoms, transmission routes, and how to distinguish influenza from a common cold, plus recognizing danger signs of hand-foot-mouth disease for early intervention. Emphasis was placed on practical prevention, including a seven-step handwashing method demonstrated and practiced, from palms to fingertips. Given norovirus’ high contagion and environmental persistence, running water with soap is recommended, as alcohol-based sanitizer is ineffective. The trainers also covered safe vomitus disposal and advised against sweeping with a mop to prevent aerosol spread, aiming to cut transmission and strengthen home–school collaboration.

triage.headline_ja: 幼児の健康を守る！県中医医院が「一般的な感染症対策」の実践的なアドバイスを提供
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は幼稚園での感染症予防啓発講座の報告であり、新規発生事例や異常な流行ではなく、日常的な公衆衛生教育活動。感染症が発生した具体的なイベント情報ではなく、IHR基準およびWPRO基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事は実際の感染症流行イベントではなく、春季の季節的なリスク（インフルエンザ、ノロウイルス、手足口病）に対する予防啓発講座の実施報告。120名の保護者向けの教育活動であり、新規患者発生や異常な流行の報告ではない。このため、感染症の危機信号としては扱わない。

article.articleHeadline: Kasus Dengue Masih Tinggi, Pencegahan Penting Dilakukan Termasuk di Lingkungan Kerja
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue cases remain high; prevention is important, including in the workplace.
article.articleSummary: Indonesia reports 30,465 dengue cases (IR 10.6/100,000) and 79 deaths (CFR 0.3%) as of 14 April 2026. Clinical breakdown: 10,138 Dengue Fever, 19,877 Dengue Hemorrhagic Fever, 450 Dengue Shock Syndrome. Dengue remains a public health and productivity risk, necessitating vaccination and sanitation across all sectors, including workplaces. In Jakarta’s Kuningan, 23 April 2026, Dr. Prima Yosephine of the Ministry of Health urged integrated prevention—education, vector control, cross-sector collaboration—and framed dengue prevention as part of workplace safety (K3). The Ministry of Manpower emphasizes workplaces as potential transmission sites without proper management, advocating hygiene and sanitation. Challenges include worker reluctance toward vaccination, with cost as a key factor. In response, KADIN, Takeda, Bio Farma, with Kemenkes, Kemnaker, and PERDOKI, launched SIAP Lawan Dengue, a one-stop platform linking firms to health partners to strengthen prevention.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱の事例が依然高い状況：職場を含む予防が重要
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアにおいてデング熱の大規模な流行が報告されており（30,465例、死亡79例、CFR 0.3%）、IHR基準で「深刻な公衆衛生への影響」と「異常/予想外」に該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも「重症度」「流行しやすさ」「管理可能性」の複数基準に合致するため、フルRRA対象のシグナルとして判定。
triage.notes: デング熱の大規模流行は確実にシグナル基準を満たす。記事サマリーではインドネシアのジャカルタを主焦点としており、複数の政府機関（保健省、労働省）が積極的に対応中。ワクチン接種躊躇（予防費用の負担）が課題として明記されている。国際的な拡大リスクについては情報不足だが、現地での管理体制構築が進行中（SIAP Lawan Denguプラットフォーム）。

article.articleHeadline: Malafaia apresenta projetos de lei para fortalecer combate à malária e quer criar dia nacional contra doença - Diário do Amapá
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Malafaia presents bills to strengthen the fight against malaria and seeks to create a national day against malaria - Diário do Amapá
article.articleSummary: Four bills by Amapá deputy Dorinaldo Malafaia aim to intensify malaria elimination in the Amazon, including: PL 1959/26 creating the National Day of Malaria Combat on April 25 (aligned with WHO); PL 1956/2026 establishing the National Prevention, Control and Elimination of Malaria (PNCEM) as a health policy, targeting transmission interruption and morbimortality reduction in high-incidence areas. PL 1958/26 would guarantee resources in the Social Fund to back campaigns in the Amazon Legal region; PL 1957/26 would amend Complementary Law 140/2011 to ensure intergovernmental cooperation for malaria control with budgetary and institutional alignment. Malafaia notes over R$2 million already allocated to Amapá actions, supplying materials and equipment. Malaria cases in Amapá fell up to 60% in 2020 under SVS leadership. The package also supports frontier surveillance via a Binational Health Emergency Center in Oiapoque, linked to Suriname and French Guiana, and advances for ACS/ACE salaries and retirement (PEC 18/22, PEC 14/23).

triage.headline_ja: マラファイア議員がマラリア対策強化法案を提示し、国家マラリア対策の日の創設を要望 - アマパ州日報
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はブラジル下院議員による法案提出に関する政策ニュースであり、マラリアの新規発生・流行を報告するものではなく、既存対策の立法化・予算強化に関する内容です。疾病流行のシグナルとしての医学的・疫学的インパクトは認められません。
triage.notes: 本記事はマラリア対策に関する立法動向（法案提出）の政策ニュースです。記事サマリーは過去の成果（2020年の60%削減）を述べており、新しい疾病流行や異常なアウトブレイクを報告していません。政府関心は高いが、感染症危機シグナルとしての医学的価値は低いため見送り判定とします。

article.articleHeadline: How Vaccinations Play A Crucial Role In Malaria Prevention
article.articleSummary: As of 2026, the World Health Organization reports 282 million malaria cases and 610,000 deaths across 80 countries, underscoring a rising global burden. India currently lacks malaria vaccines in its Universal Immunisation Programme, relying on vector control, surveillance, early diagnosis, and treatment. Malaria vaccines RTS-S (Mosquirix) and R21/Matrix-M show partial immunity and reduce clinical malaria in endemic regions, with immune responses yielding about 30–55% efficacy in the first year after vaccination. WHO-approved vaccines for children in moderate-to-high transmission areas include RTS-S/AS01 (recommended 2021) and R21/Matrix-M (recommended 2023); rollout is mainly in sub-Saharan Africa and not yet in India’s public system. Vaccines do not offer complete protection but can significantly reduce disease severity and deaths when used alongside nets, indoor spraying, and antimalarial drugs. The approach targets vulnerable groups, especially children under five and pregnant women.

triage.headline_ja: 予防接種がマラリア予防において重要な役割を果たす方法
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はマラリアワクチンの予防効果に関する教育的な解説記事であり、インドでの新規感染事例の報告ではない。公衆衛生上の緊急性や異常事象の報告がなく、いずれのトリアージ基準も該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事はNDTVのヘルスセクションにおけるマラリアワクチンの教育コンテンツであり、具体的な感染症イベント（ケースクラスター、流行、アウトブレイク）の報告ではない。インドでのワクチン導入の遅れについて言及があるが、これは政策的な課題であり、シグナルトリアージの対象となる突発的な感染症イベントではない。

article.articleHeadline: Over 10 million children protected against polio in coordinated cross-border campaigns across Angola, DRC and Namibia
article.articleSummary: Over 10 million children were vaccinated against polio last month across Angola, Namibia and the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) in a synchronized cross-border campaign to halt transmission. Recent laboratory sequencing shows genetically linked poliovirus strains circulating in Angola and Namibia and potentially in the DRC, underscoring how cross-border movement drives spread and why synchronized action is essential. Since 2025 Angola has reported 39 confirmed type 2 poliovirus cases. In Namibia, a genetically linked variant has been detected in the northern Kavango East Region, highlighting border-linked outbreaks. In 2026, two poliovirus variants were confirmed in the DRC, including an orphan strain with no close link to known viruses, suggesting undetected transmission. Angola vaccinated communities in 13 municipalities; Namibia has achieved over 90% coverage in prior rounds. Door-to-door strategies helped reach hard-to-reach and mobile populations. Lab sequencing and surveillance guided rapid responses; donors like KSRelief and GPEI support the effort.

triage.headline_ja: アンゴラ、DRC、ナミビア全域での調整された国境横断キャンペーンで1000万人以上の子どもがポリオから保護される
triage.triage_reason: ポリオウイルス（野生型および由来型）の複数国での確認報告であり、IHR基準の国際的拡大リスク、異常性が明確に該当。ワクチン接種キャンペーンの規模と遺伝子配列の関連性は公衆衛生への深刻な影響を示唆している。
triage.notes: ナミビアとアンゴラは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。DRCのみが対象国に該当する。記事は複数国での遺伝子関連性のあるポリオウイルス株の検出と大規模なワクチン接種キャンペーンを報告しており、公衆衛生への影響が深刻である。2026年のDRCでの新規確認例（孤立株を含む）は未検知の伝播を示唆しており、警戒が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Eight-Year Phase 3 Results: Tenofovir for Hepatitis B in China
article.articleSummary: China-based eight-year Phase 3 analysis of Tenofovir alafenamide (TAF) vs tenofovir disoproxil fumarate (TDF) in Chinese patients with chronic hepatitis B shows durable efficacy and improved safety. In 334 Chinese participants, 212 of 227 on TAF-TAF and 99 of 107 on TDF-TAF switched to open-label TAF after three years, for up to eight years total. By Year 8, virologic suppression (HBV DNA <29 IU/mL) was 79.3% (180/227) in TAF-TAF and 78.5% (84/107) in TDF-TAF (missing=failure); excluding missing data, 95.2% and 95.5%. ALT normalization remained high and serologic responses continued to rise, with higher serologic gains in TAF-TAF. Renal safety and bone health were favorable with TAF: estimated glomerular filtration rate (Cockcroft-Gault) and hip/spine bone mineral density stayed stable through eight years; declines during TDF were largely reversible after switching to TAF. No TAF resistance detected. Concludes TAF is effective and safer long-term option for aging CHB patients in China.

triage.headline_ja: 8年間の第3相試験結果：中国における慢性B型肝炎に対するテノホビルの使用
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は臨床試験結果の学術報告であり、新規の感染症アウトブレイク、疾病集積、または公衆衛生上の危機に該当しない。B型肝炎は既知の慢性感染症であり、治療薬の臨床試験成績は疫学的なシグナルではない。
triage.notes: 本記事は医薬品の臨床試験データを報告した学術コンテンツであり、感染症危機管理・バイオセキュリティの観点からのシグナルではない。Bluedot APIが「Hepatitis B」と「China」を検出したが、これは既存の治療法の有効性検証に関するもので、新規アウトブレイク、疾病集積、または予期しない公衆衛生事象を示すものではない。

article.articleHeadline: 幼儿园14名儿童呕吐腹泻 园方回应 疑似诺如病毒感染
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fourteen children at a kindergarten suffer from vomiting and diarrhea; the school responds to suspected norovirus infection.
article.articleSummary: 14 Class One students at Xi'an Chang'an Smart LEGO Kindergarten in Chang'an District, Xi'an, China, reported with vomiting and diarrhea as of the morning of April 24, 2026; fever observed in some cases. Symptoms appeared from Tuesday or Wednesday of the prior week; initially over 10 children affected. School principal suspects norovirus, noting a pooled, large-pot meal service and shared food; if it were food-safety only, fewer cases would be affected. Spring is a peak season for norovirus. Immediate isolation of symptomatic students started on day one; two teachers have also fallen ill and were hospitalized. Authorities have been notified, including health, education, and food-safety departments; investigation underway with results to be communicated. The kindergarten asserts safe procurement, preparation, and food sampling with complete records; 24-hour CCTV footage is available for review. No lab-confirmed status reported yet.

triage.headline_ja: 幼儿园14名儿童呕吐腹泻 园方回应 疑似诺如病毒感染（幼稚園の14名の児童が嘔吐・下痢を報告、園側が疑似ノロウイルス感染について回応）
triage.triage_reason: ノロウイルスの集団感染疑い例で複数基準に該当し、社会的関心も生じているが、ラボ確認前の段階であり、地理的・規模的影響が限定的なため。続報での検査結果確認を要する。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは西安市（Xi'an）陝西省（Shaanxi）での幼稚園での集団感染疑い例を報告。ラボ確認（norovirus PCR等）はまだされておらず、臨床診断段階。幼稚園という共有食事環境でのヒト-ヒト感染の可能性があり、春季はノロウイルス流行季である旨が述べられている。教職員2名も罹患し入院している。複数の当局（保健・教育・食品安全部門）が既に関与している。情報が限定的で、確認されるまではWATCHレベルが妥当。

article.articleHeadline: Targetkan Eliminasi TBC, Pemprov Lampung Perkuat Deteksi Dini dan Integrasi Data Digital
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Aiming for TB Elimination, Lampung Provincial Government Strengthens Early Detection and Digital Data Integration.
article.articleSummary: TB elimination efforts in Lampung Province, Indonesia, advance through cross-sector COVID-19–era collaboration and digital data integration. Deputy Governor Jihan Nurlela announced adapting this coordination to accelerate early TB detection and treatment completion via mass screening conducted by community health centers (Puskesmas), integrated health posts (Posyandu), and village cadres. The plan includes integrating TB control into the Lampung In app, enabling real-time patient monitoring and more precise policy interventions, with Diskominfotik coordinating data bridging with the Indonesian Pulmonology Doctors Association (PDPI). Health indicators show progress: Standard Service Minimal (SPM) rose from 103% in 2024 to 131% in 2025; in Q1 2026 it stood at 19%. Cure rates for drug-susceptible TB rose from 95% (2024) to 98% (2025), with treatment achievement reaching 81% by early 2026. Strong central-local collaboration supports sustainable TB elimination.

triage.headline_ja: TBC排除を目指し、ランプン州政府が早期発見とデジタルデータ統合を強化
triage.triage_reason: 結核に関する予防・制御プログラムの進捗報告であり、新規の感染症危機や異常事象ではない。IHR基準、WPROスクリーニング基準いずれにも該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事はインドネシア・ランプン州の結核排除プログラムの進捗状況を報告するもの。COVID-19と結核が記事に言及されているが、実質的な新規感染事例の報告ではなく、行政的な対策強化と治療成果の好転を伝える管理報告である。シグナルトリアージの対象外と判定。

article.articleHeadline: Dunia Usaha Diajak Aktif dalam Pencegahan Penyakit Demam Dengue
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Private sector invited to actively participate in dengue fever prevention.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever, a zoonosis transmitted by mosquitoes, continues to pose a year-round risk to productivity and business in Indonesia. Transmission occurs from animals to humans via direct contact or contaminated food or water, and through vectors such as mosquitoes. At the SIAP Lawan Dengue event in Jakarta on 23 April 2026, authorities urged sector involvement to prevent workplace transmission, stressing that offices can become risk hotspots without systematic hygiene and environmental controls. The guidance urges awareness, reinforced environmental management, and integrating employee health protection into company policy, with vaccination considered to reduce severe dengue and hospitalisation. PERDOKI estimates dengue care costs at around Rp 10–60 million and notes mortality; Disability-Adjusted Life Years indicate substantial productivity losses. Given no cure, prevention is vital. Vaccination and the 3M Plus approach are recommended for workers in agriculture, plantations, forestry, and endemic areas; executives from Takeda underscored the workplace as a key protection point.

triage.headline_ja: 民間企業によるデング熱予防への積極的参画が呼びかけられている
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアでのデング熱対策の啓発記事であり、異常事象や新規発生ではなく、既知の風土病に対する予防活動の報道と判断される。IHR基準およびWPRO基準での該当が限定的で、情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事はインドネシアでのデング熱の既知のリスクに対する民間企業への予防啓発であり、新規の感染症クラスターや異常事象の報告ではない。年間通じてのリスク継続と職場での曝露継続が述べられているが、急性の危機的状況を示す情報はない。ワクチンと3Mプラスアプローチの推奨など管理可能な対策が既に実施されている。

article.articleHeadline: Imported measles case involving 31-year-old flight attendant confirmed as airport vaccinations begin
article.articleSummary: Imported measles case confirmed in Hong Kong: a 31-year-old flight attendant developed fever on 19 April and rash on 22 April; laboratory confirmation led to isolation at Princess Margaret Hospital; patient stable with mild symptoms. Travel history includes Vietnam (9–12 April) during incubation, with Vietnam experiencing a measles outbreak; infection classified as imported as no local contact identified. The patient did not attend work during the infectious period (from 18 April) and had no passenger or colleague contact; household one contact; 10 relatives/friends are being followed. CHP identified 27 people at the same private clinic; none symptomatic so far. A vaccination drive at Hong Kong International Airport provides free measles vaccines to eligible staff; by 24 April 6 pm around 75 vaccinated that day and over 430 total, including earlier cluster. No secondary transmission detected; HK maintains >95% two-dose coverage, but imported cases remain a risk.

triage.headline_ja: 31歳のフライトアテンダントが関与する輸入麻疹症例が確認、空港でのワクチン接種が開始
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹の輸入症例であり、ベトナムでの流行背景と地域への潜在的な伝播リスクが存在するが、現時点で二次感染は検出されていない。香港の高いワクチン接種率（>95%）と対応体制が明確であり、情報は十分だが、動向監視が必要。
triage.notes: 香港での確認症例はベトナム渡航中に感染した輸入症例。ベトナムで麻疹流行が発生している背景情報あり。香港の公衆衛生対応は迅速かつ適切（空港でのワクチン接種キャンペーン、濃厚接触者追跡）。現在のところ二次感染なし、重症度低い。IHR基準2つ以上該当しWPRO基準2つ以上該当するが、社会的関心と管理可能性により「WATCH」判定。ベトナムでの流行拡大状況の続報を注視すべき。

article.articleHeadline: Dourados concentra 42% das mortes por chikungunya no país
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dourados accounts for 42% of chikungunya deaths nationwide.
article.articleSummary: Dourados, Mato Grosso do Sul, accounts for 42% of chikungunya deaths in Brazil in 2026, eight of 19 nationwide as of April 17. In MS, 13 deaths are recorded, most in Dourados, which faces a surge stressing public health. On April 20, the mayor declared a public health emergency to accelerate responses. Dourados reports 4,959 probable chikungunya cases and 2,204 confirmed; incidence is 2,037.6 per 100,000, well above the epidemic threshold of 300. Indigenous populations bear a heavy burden: seven of eight deaths in Dourados are Indigenous, including two infants under three months. At least 41 patients are hospitalized; a Center of Emergency Operations was established. The state added 15 beds at the Hospital Regional de Dourados and instituted urgent-care flows for severe cases. Vector-control efforts visited over 4,000 residences and located more than 1,000 breeding sites, mostly in water tanks and litter. Brazil exceeds 31,000 probable cases; a vaccination pilot including Dourados begins in April.

triage.headline_ja: ドゥアドスがブラジル全国のチクングニア死亡者の42%を占める
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルで蔓延しているチクングニア熱について、特定地域での死亡集中（42%）、高い罹患率、先住民への不均等な影響、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響が認められ、IHR基準2つ以上に該当するとともに、WPROスクリーニング基準の複数項目に該当する。国家レベルの公衆衛生対応（ワクチン接種パイロット、緊急センター設置）が進行中である。
triage.notes: チクングニア熱の蔓延地域はドゥアドス（マット・グロッソ・ド・スル州）に集中。罹患率が疫学的閾値（300/10万人）を大きく上回る（2,037.6/10万人）。先住民を含む脆弱層への不均等な健康負担が顕著。公衆衛生上の対応が強化されており、医療システムへの負荷が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Ada Warga RW 02 Kelurahan Mappala Terjangkit DBD, Horas Community Langsung Fogging
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Residents of RW 02 in Mappala Urban Village Infected with Dengue Fever, Horas Community Immediately Conducts Fogging.
article.articleSummary: One confirmed dengue fever case in RT 04/RW 02, Mappala Urban Village, Rappocini district, Makassar, South Sulawesi (Vino, 15) reportedly contracted the disease from Aedes aegypti bites. On 24 April 2026, Horas Community, led by Hamdan Cikal, mobilized fogging of homes and key areas, in collaboration with RW 02 chair Baso Muktar, RT leaders, and Gerindra branch head Abd Rivai, to curb transmission. The intervention targets adult Aedes aegypti and aims to interrupt virus spread and reduce mosquito density in built-up and hard-to-reach spaces. Dengue fever can cause severe complications such as hemorrhage, organ failure, and Dengue Shock Syndrome if not diagnosed promptly. Fogging is presented as a rapid vector-control measure following the reported case to protect the community in Makassar.

triage.headline_ja: マピラ地区RW 02の住民がデング熱に感染、ホラスコミュニティが即座に燻蒸を実施
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア（南スラウェシ州マカッサル市）での単一の確認症例報告であり、即座な地域対応が取られている。ただし現在のところ、国家規模の公衆衛生的影響は不明であり、国際的拡大リスクの詳細情報も不足している。
triage.notes: 記事は南スラウェシ州マカッサル市マピラ地区の15歳児1名のデング熱確定症例を報告。地域コミュニティ（ホラスコミュニティ）が即座に蚊の燻蒸対策を実施。デング熱はWPRO地域で流行しやすい感染症であり、ヒト-ヒト伝播（蚊媒介）の可能性がある。ただし単一症例であり、流行規模や国家的な管理困難性は明確ではない。継続的な症例報告の動向に注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: MS registra 13ª morte por chikungunya e casos disparam em uma semana -- AconteceuMS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Health records the 13th chikungunya death as cases surge in one week -- AconteceuMS.
article.articleSummary: Chikungunya death toll in Mato Grosso do Sul reaches 13 in 2026, including an 87-year-old Bonito resident with hypertension. The 15th epidemiological week bulletin reports 7,599 probable chikungunya cases and 3,490 confirmed in SINAN, up from 5,352 notifications and 2,639 confirmations the prior week. Deaths by municipality: Dourados (8), Bonito (2), Jardim (2), Fátima do Sul (1). In Dourados: ages 69, 73, a 3‑month‑old, 60, a 1‑month‑old, 55, 77, and 63 years (Feb–Apr 2026). Bonito: 72-year-old man and 87-year-old woman (Mar 19; Apr 19). Jardim: 82-year-old woman and 94-year-old man; Fátima do Sul: 82-year-old man (Apr 8). Eight victims had comorbidities (hypertension, diabetes, cancer); two deaths still under investigation. Pregnancy cases: 52 chikungunya confirmations, +6. Dourados leads with >2,500 probable cases; dengue totals: 4,187 probable, 597 confirmed, no deaths. Public health guidance urges medical evaluation, not self-medication, for vulnerable groups.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省がチクングニア熱による13番目の死亡を記録、1週間で症例が急増
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルのマットグロッソドスル州でチクングニア熱による死亡が13例に達し、1週間で確認症例が2,639から3,490に増加。重症度と異常な発生パターンがあり、IHR基準およびスクリーニング基準を満たす。
triage.notes: ブラジル国内での急速な流行拡大を示す。妊娠症例52例含む。複数の併存疾患を有する犠牲者が確認されており、脆弱な集団への影響が懸念される。デング熱の同時流行も報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: Delhi's Battle Against Dengue: Task Force To The Rescue | Health
article.articleSummary: Delhi plans a special task force to combat dengue, following a Delhi High Court order from December 2021, to reduce vector-borne diseases across the city. The task force will coordinate inter-departmental efforts, boost public awareness, and implement preventive measures district-wide. Spearheaded by the Municipal Corporation of Delhi’s commissioner, it will involve health departments and civic bodies. Its primary objectives are prevention and control of dengue with a focus on mosquito breeding hotspots, timely fogging, and sustained public campaigns. The initiative aims to strengthen disease surveillance and ensure prompt action in complaint scenarios, especially as monsoon-season mosquito activity rises. Dengue cases in Delhi have fluctuated in recent years, highlighting the need for rapid, coordinated action to curb transmission.

triage.headline_ja: デリーのデング熱対策：タスクフォースが救援へ
triage.triage_reason: デング熱の既知の流行地における予防・管理戦略の発表であり、急性的な危機状況ではない。ただし、継続的な監視の対象として、今後の発症数推移と対策効果を追跡する価値あり。
triage.notes: 記事はデリーにおけるデング熱対策の組織的体制整備（タスクフォース設置）に関するもので、急性的な患者数増加や新規感染症の出現ではない。デング熱はインドの風土病であり、予防的取り組みとしては重要だが、シグナルレベルでのピックアップは不要。WPRO基準では「長期的曝露」と「流行しやすさ」で該当するが、社会的・政治的関心が既存対策の範囲内であるため、WATCH判定とした。

article.articleHeadline: Drauzio Varella faz alerta sobre riscos graves da gripe
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Drauzio Varella warns about the serious risks of influenza.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-04-24, Brazilian physician Drauzio Varella cautions that influenza should not be treated as routine. In an interview with IstoÉ Saúde, he explains that influenza typically causes high fever, severe body aches, and prostration unlike a common cold, and can disrupt normal activities. Observational studies show periods of greater influenza circulation are associated with a higher incidence of cardiovascular events, including heart attacks and strokes, driven by systemic inflammation in individuals with preexisting conditions. With Brazil’s aging population and rising prevalence of hypertension and diabetes, the burden of flu complications grows. Vaccination reduces disease severity and hospitalizations—even when infection occurs—thereby easing health system strain, though uptake remains below ideal amid misinformation. The message emphasizes vaccination as a key public-health strategy to protect vulnerable groups and an aging society.

triage.headline_ja: ドラウジオ・バレーラが流感の深刻なリスクについて警告
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルの医師による流感の一般的な健康啓発・ワクチン接種推奨に関する意見記事であり、新規感染症イベント、異常な集団発生、または新規流行の報告ではない。IHR基準およびWPRO基準に該当するシグナルなし。
triage.notes: 本記事は感染症イベント（集団発生、新規流行、異常な状況）の報告ではなく、医学専門家による流感の一般的な健康教育および公衆衛生啓発である。具体的な患者数、発生件数、新規患者の増加、または異常な流行パターンの報告がないため、シグナルトリアージとしてはピックアップ対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Ribeirão Claro zera casos de dengue em 2026 - NPDiário
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ribeirão Claro records zero dengue cases in 2026 - NPDiário
article.articleSummary: Ribeirão Claro, Brazil, reports zero dengue cases from January 2026 to date, according to the Municipal Health Secretariat. Dengue fever, transmitted by Aedes aegypti, is being contained through sustained prevention and strong community participation. The positive result reflects intensified vector-control actions by endemic teams, including door-to-door visits to identify and eliminate mosquito breeding sites and to educate residents. Key measures involve removing water-holding containers, cleaning gutters and yards, and maintaining water-storage tanks. Community engagement is a critical factor, with residents adopting preventive habits and following health guidance. Officials warn dengue is seasonal, with higher incidence in hot and rainy periods, so ongoing vigilance and preventive practices remain essential to sustain this achievement.

triage.headline_ja: リベイラン・クラロ、2026年のデング熱患者数がゼロに - NPDiário
triage.triage_reason: デング熱の患者数がゼロという良好な公衆衛生成果を報告する記事であり、新規発生や危機的状況ではない。IHR基準およびスクリーニング基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事はブラジルの一自治体（リベイラン・クラロ）がデング熱の患者数がゼロという積極的な公衆衛生成果を報告するもの。感染症危機の発生を示すシグナルではなく、対策の成功例であるため、シグナルトリアージの対象外と判定。

article.articleHeadline: Cotia registra mortes por síndrome respiratória e baixa vacinação acende alerta
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cotia records deaths from a respiratory syndrome, and low vaccination rates raise alarm.
article.articleSummary: Three influenza cases confirmed among monitored SRAG (Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome) cases in Cotia, Brazil, with no deaths directly attributed to the virus to date. Influenza is assessed within SRAG, alongside COVID-19 and Respiratory Syncytial Virus (RSV); specific tests are performed to identify the causative virus in some instances. Vaccination uptake for influenza remains very low, with under 10% of the target population immunized so far; the elderly show the highest coverage at about 16%. Health authorities reiterate vaccination as the primary measure to prevent severe illness and deaths and continue awareness campaigns to boost coverage. Officials urge the population to seek vaccination at posts, emphasizing priority groups—elderly, children, and people with comorbidities—to reduce the burden of respiratory diseases.

triage.headline_ja: Cotia registra mortes por síndrome respiratória e baixa vacinação acende alerta（コティアが呼吸器症候群による死亡を記録、低いワクチン接種率が警報を発する）
triage.triage_reason: 複数の呼吸器感染症（インフルエンザ、COVID-19、RSV）が同時検出されており、ワクチン接種率の低さが懸念されるが、現時点でウイルス直接による死亡確認がなく、情報が限定的。続報の注視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年4月配信と未来日付となっており、データの検証が必要。現在報告では死亡がウイルス直接によるものではなく、低ワクチン接種率の警告が主眼。複数の呼吸器病原体の並行監視体制が確立されている点に注目。

article.articleHeadline: Delhi govt mulls special task force for concerted efforts to eradicate dengue
article.articleSummary: New Delhi, India: Delhi government plans a special task force, chaired by the Municipal Corporation of Delhi commissioner, with representation from the health department, civic bodies, and the Delhi government, to coordinate dengue eradication within a defined timeframe per a Delhi High Court order (Dec 24, 2021). The panel will oversee vector-borne disease prevention citywide, monitor mosquito breeding hotspots, ensure timely fogging and sanitation drives, address water stagnation and unhygienic conditions, strengthen surveillance, and boost public awareness and inter-department coordination ahead of the monsoon. Dengue cases: 2020—1,072; 2021—9,613; 2022—4,469; 2023—9,266; 2024—6,391; by March 29, 2025—98. Malaria: 2020—228; 2021—167; 2022—263; 2023—426; 2024—792; by March 29, 2025—23. Chikungunya: 2020—111; 2021—89; 2022—48; 2023—65; 2024—267; by March 29, 2025—4.

triage.headline_ja: デリー政府、デング熱撲滅に向けた調整の取組を目的とした特別タスクフォースを検討
triage.triage_reason: デング熱、マラリア、チクングニアの複数のベクター媒介感染症が報告されており、特にデング熱は2021年・2023年に大規模発生（9,000件以上）の実績がある。政府レベルの対応が進行中だが、現在は積極的な流行期ではなく、サマリーは予防的な体制整備が主題であるため、情報収集を継続する必要がある。
triage.notes: デリーは過去にデング熱の大規模発生地域（2021年9,613件、2023年9,266件）。2025年3月末時点で98件と抑制されているが、政府が正式なタスクフォース体制を整備しており、モンスーン時期の流行リスク管理が重要。ベクター媒介感染症複数同時発生の管理可能性を注視すべき。

article.articleHeadline: Tubarão registra alta de focos de dengue e entra em estado de alerta
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tubarão records an increase in dengue hotspots and enters a state of alert.
article.articleSummary: Dengue hotspots in Tubarão have increased by more than 15% from the previous year, reaching approximately 422 records in the municipality. The central region is currently the most critical area, concentrating the majority of identified hotspots. Municipal health authorities have declared a state of alert in response to the rise in dengue vector sites. The report, based on a recent survey, notes the uptick in breeding sites but provides no data on confirmed dengue cases, fatalities, laboratory confirmations, infection sources, or details about imported or exported cases. The information underscores ongoing monitoring of transmission risk, with data current as of 2026-04-24.

triage.headline_ja: トゥバラォン市、デング熱媒介蚊増加記録し警報発令
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれていない。また記事は媒介蚊の繁殖地増加の報告であり、確定デング症例、死亡、ヒト感染者データがなく、現時点での公衆衛生的影響の深刻性が確認できない。
triage.notes: ブラジル（GeoNames ID: 3469034）は対象国リスト（Zambia, Philippines, Thailand, Ghana, DRC, Brazil, Indonesia, China, Myanmar, Vietnam, India）に含まれているが、本トリアージシステムの検索対象は限定的。発生地域フィールドにはブラジルが表示されているものの、本評価では対象国外として扱う指示に基づき、verified_locationsを空配列とした。記事は媒介蚊対策段階の警報であり、ヒト感染症例データがないため、感染症イベント本体としての重大性は現段階では判断できない。

article.articleHeadline: 麻疹│潛伏期訪越南 女機艙服務員確診 27人被列密切接觸者 - 香港文匯網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles | Female flight attendant diagnosed; 27 people identified as close contacts after visiting Vietnam during the incubation period - Hong Kong Wen Hui Net
article.articleSummary: Measles case imported into Hong Kong: a 31-year-old female flight attendant presented with fever, myalgia, and a rash; RT-PCR positive for measles. Onset 19 April; rash 22 April; hospitalized for isolation at Princess Margaret Hospital; epidemiology shows infection during incubation period 9–12 April after traveling to Vietnam, where measles is outbreaking; patient had no HK contact with measles cases; designated imported. She is not HK-born; vaccinated in her birth country; no contact with airport maintenance staff; not working during infectious period; has one household contact and 10 friends who accompanied her to Vietnam. Center identified 27 close contacts from a private clinic; none symptomatic at present; they will be medically monitored. Public Health Laboratory Centre also started free measles vaccination for eligible airport staff; about 75 staff vaccinated by 6pm. Investigation ongoing; 27 close contacts being monitored.

triage.headline_ja: 麻疹│潛伏期訪越南 女機艙服務員確診 27人被列密切接觸者（麻疹 | 潜伏期中のベトナム訪問後、女性客室乗務員が確診、27人が濃厚接触者に指定）
triage.triage_reason: 香港へ輸入された麻疹確定症例で、ベトナムでの感染が確認され、27人の濃厚接触者が同定されている。国際渡航に関連した感染症イベントであり、複数の対象国に関連し、公衆衛生上の対応が進行中。
triage.notes: 香港への輸入麻疹症例で、ベトナムでの潜伏期感染が確認されている。患者は航空乗務員であり、接触者追跡が進行中。香港とベトナムの両国で対応が取られており、国際的な感染症監視の観点から重要。

article.articleHeadline: 腸病毒疫情升溫破3500人　成人無症狀恐成傳染源、嬰幼兒重症風險高-台視新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Enterovirus outbreak on the rise, surpassing 3,500 cases; asymptomatic adults may become transmission sources, and infants and young children face a high risk of severe illness - TTV News Network
article.articleSummary: Taiwan faces rising enterovirus activity. In week 15 (April 12–18), clinic/ED visits reached 3,526, up 16.5% from the prior week. Coxsackievirus A6 is predominant, with Coxsackie A4 and A16 also common; four lab-confirmed severe enterovirus infections this year include two EV-D68 and one each of Coxsackie A4 and A16.
