Nearby Vietnam has surpassed 26,000 cases by mid-April, driven by EV71 with severe illness and deaths, especially in Ho Chi Minh City and southern provinces; China remains above two years ago, while Hong Kong, Japan, Thailand, and Singapore are at low activity. Transmission is highest in the first week after onset, and asymptomatic adults may spread to infants. Preventive measures include staying home when ill, rigorous hand hygiene (five-step: wet, rub, rinse, cup, wipe), and environmental disinfection with 500 ppm chlorine bleach (10 L water + 100 mL bleach). Children under 5 are at highest risk; seek urgent care for warning signs such as lethargy, confusion, seizures, persistent vomiting, or rapid breathing.

triage.headline_ja: 腸病毒疫情升溫破3500人　成人無症狀恐成傳染源、嬰幼兒重症風險高-台視新聞網
triage.triage_reason: 台湾でエンテロウイルス活動が急速に増加（3,526例/週）し、ベトナムでは26,000例を超える大規模発生がみられている。EV71による重症例・死亡例が報告され、IHR基準の「異常/予想外」「重症度」に該当し、域内複数国への拡大リスクがある。
triage.notes: 台湾で記事が配信されているため台湾のイベントが主題だが、対象国リストに台湾は含まれていない。verified_locationsは記事サマリーで明示的にイベント発生が述べられている対象国のみを抽出。ベトナムではEV71による26,000例超の大発生、中国でも2年前を上回る活動、タイでは低活動とされている。ホンノンは対象国に含まれるため China に統合。シンガポール・日本は対象国リストに含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: How do you solve a problem like malaria?
article.articleSummary: World Malaria Day highlights fragile gains as the 2025 WHO World Malaria Report records 282 million global malaria cases and 627,000 deaths in 2025, with Africa accounting for 94% of cases and 95% of deaths. The Democratic Republic of the Congo, Mozambique, Niger, Nigeria and Uganda together account for more than half of cases, and Nigeria bears the world's highest infection burden. In Ibadan, Nigeria, Adaugo Adebimpe endured four malaria episodes in one pregnancy, underscoring the elevated risk for pregnant women. About 80% of malaria deaths occur in children under five. Elimination targets are hampered by funding cuts, notably the dismantling of USAID, widening the financing gap. Partial resistance to artemisinin-based combination therapies is emerging in Eritrea, Rwanda, Tanzania and Uganda, complicating treatment. New tools, including Target Malaria gene approaches, malaria vaccines in 25 countries, and improved bed nets, are under development but require sustained investment.

triage.headline_ja: マラリアという問題にどう対処するか
triage.triage_reason: マラリアの大規模な世界的負担（2025年に282百万症例、627,000死亡）が報告され、アフリカが症例の94%、死亡の95%を占める。対象国（DRC、モザンビーク、ニジェール、ナイジェリア、ウガンダ）が世界的な症例の半分以上を占め、ナイジェリアが最高の感染負担を有する状況はIHR基準（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性）およびWPRO基準（異常性、重症度、長期曝露、流行易さ、管理可能性）の複数項目に該当。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年4月配信（将来日付）だが、2025年WHO World Malaria Reportの統計情報に基づく分析。発生地域リストには対象国外のモザンビーク、ルワンダ、タンザニア、ウガンダも含まれるが、verified_locationsは対象国リストに限定。アルテミシニン系薬剤耐性の出現やUSAID資金削減による対応能力低下が課題として指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: 香港再增1宗麻疹輸入個案　政府為機場員工免費接種疫苗　　21:34
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hong Kong reports another imported measles case; government to provide free vaccination for airport staff 21:34
article.articleSummary: On 24 April 2026, Hong Kong reports another imported measles case. A 31-year-old woman with previously good health developed fever and myalgia on 19 April, and rash on 22 April; she was hospitalized after a private clinic visit and her sample tested positive for measles by RT-PCR. She had no contact with airport maintenance staff or any airport case, did not work during her infectious period, and had no exposure to passengers or colleagues. She had a household contact and, with 10 relatives, traveled to Vietnam, where a measles outbreak is ongoing; the case is categorized as a travel-related imported infection with overseas exposure. In response, the Centre for Health Protection in Hong Kong begun offering free measles vaccination to eligible airport staff to strengthen airport community immunity. This follows a prior cluster of three airport workers related to measles.

triage.headline_ja: 香港で麻疹の輸入事例が追加報告。政府が空港職員への無料ワクチン接種を開始
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で2項目該当（異常性・予想外性、国際的拡大リスク）。ベトナムにおける進行中の麻疹アウトブレイクとの関連、複数国への関与、公衆衛生対応（ワクチン接種キャンペーン）が確認される。
triage.notes: 香港での輸入事例はベトナムの進行中アウトブレイクに関連。空港労働者との接触リスク軽減と予防接種キャンペーン開始により、当局は対応を開始している。複数国間の関連性が確認される麻疹イベント。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Avian Influenza A H5N1

article.articleHeadline: Alerta da FAO reforça vigilância em saúde animal na América Latina - CBDL
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: FAO alert reinforces animal health surveillance in Latin America - CBDL.
article.articleSummary: FAO warns of rising avian influenza risk in Latin America and the Caribbean as H5N1 activity intensifies in wild and domestic birds, with potential impacts on production chains, biodiversity, public health, and international trade. The alert urges strengthened animal health surveillance, biosafety, and early detection through coordinated regional action. In Brazil, the Ministry of Agriculture extended the Zoosanitary Emergency by 180 days in March 2026 for nationwide prevention and control. Chile and Argentina have temporarily suspended poultry exports after outbreak detections. In 2025, Brazil faced export restrictions following avian influenza in wild birds in Rio Grande do Sul, leading to temporary suspensions in some markets later normalized. The WOAH notes complex spread via migratory birds, production systems, and trade, requiring science-based approaches. Molecular diagnostics and sequencing enable continuous monitoring; Thermo Fisher Scientific provides nucleic-acid extraction, real-time PCR, digital PCR, and sequencing tools.

triage.headline_ja: FAO警告：ラテンアメリカの動物衛生監視を強化 - CBDL
triage.triage_reason: H5N1鳥インフルエンザの地域的拡大、複数国での輸出停止措置、国際貿易への影響、および広域の動物衛生上の懸念がIHR基準3項目（異常性、国際拡大リスク、貿易制限リスク）に該当。フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 記事はラテンアメリカ全域のH5N1警告がメインテーマだが、対象国リストではBrazilのみ該当。ChileおよびArgentinaは発生地域に含まれるが、対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。Brazilではリオグランデドスール州での2025年の野生鳥類での発生と2026年3月の180日間の動物衛生緊急事態延長が報告されており、継続的な脅威が存在する。国際貿易への実質的な影響（輸出停止）が確認されている。

article.articleHeadline: 25 de abril: Día Mundial de la Malaria
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: April 25: World Malaria Day.
article.articleSummary: World Malaria Day on April 25 highlights persistent malaria burden in Africa. Adebimpe, in Ibadan, Nigeria, describes malaria occurring four times during one pregnancy despite prophylaxis, underscoring that pregnant women have 3–5× higher mortality risk from severe malaria and that 80% of global malaria deaths occur in children under five. The WHO World Malaria Report 2025 records 282 million cases and 627,000 deaths worldwide in 2025, with Africa accounting for 94% of cases and 95% of deaths; Nigeria bears the largest infection burden, with the Democratic Republic of Congo, Mozambique, Niger, Nigeria, and Uganda contributing over half of cases. Funding gaps and U.S. aid cuts threaten health systems, complicating elimination goals of reducing malaria to endemics in at least 35 countries by 2030. Partial resistance to artemisinin-based combination therapies has been confirmed in Eritrea, Rwanda, Tanzania, and Uganda, challenging treatment. Personal accounts from Osato Edokpayi in Abuja and scientists like Martin Lukindu stress the need for new tools, as the Target Malaria project in Uganda pursues.

triage.headline_ja: 4月25日：世界マラリアデー
triage.triage_reason: World Malaria Dayの啓発記事であり、急性の流行事象ではなく、既知の疾病負荷と対策課題の概説である。DRCはスクリーニング基準1つ以上に該当する可能性があるが、記事は特定地域での新規の異常事象を示唆していないため、続報の注視が適切。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年4月25日のWorld Malaria Day企画記事であり、既知の疾病負荷データの提示と対策課題（資金不足、薬剤耐性など）の論評が主体。ナイジェリア（対象国外）での個別事例も記載されているが、記事の中心はアフリカ全体および複数国の既知データ。DRCについては薬剤耐性確認地域として言及されているため verified_locations に含めた。急性の新規流行事象の指示はないため WATCH 判定。

article.articleHeadline: Aumento precoce dos casos de influenza preocupa e reforça importância da vacinação
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Early uptick in influenza cases is concerning and underscores the importance of vaccination
article.articleSummary: Brazil reports an early uptick in influenza cases in Q1 2026, with 187 deaths due to influenza complications. The surge is notable across the Southeast, Midwest, and South regions, signaling earlier circulation during Brazil's summer. The national vaccination campaign targets older adults, pregnant people, and children aged six months to five years, with the public vaccine covering influenza A(H1N1), A(H3N2) (including the H3N2 K subtype), and B. Experts warn that the highly transmissible H3N2 K subtype accounts for about 70% of infections. Symptoms include high fever, body aches, and malaise. In addition to annually updated vaccines, authorities recommend hand hygiene and mask use in enclosed spaces to curb spread. The article does not report laboratory confirmation or details on imported/exported cases.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザ患者数の早期増加が懸念を呼び、ワクチン接種の重要性を強調
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルでインフルエンザ（H1N1、H3N2）患者数が異常に早期に増加し、2026年第1四半期で187人の死亡が報告されている。WPROスクリーニング基準で「重症度」「流行しやすさ」「異常性」の複数項目に該当し、政府の予防対策が実施されており、社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーによればブラジルでのインフルエンザ患者数の異常な早期増加と複数の死亡が報告されており、H3N2 Kサブタイプが70%の感染を占める高い感染性が指摘されている。国家的なワクチン接種キャンペーンが実施されている。Bluedot APIの発生地域にはUSAとBrazilが含まれているが、記事サマリーの主題はブラジルの状況に限定されており、米国での発生は記述されていないため、verified_locationsはブラジルのみとした。

article.articleHeadline: Hortolândia tem 87 casos de Dengue e zerada em Zika e Chikungunya - Novo Momento
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hortolândia has 87 Dengue cases and zero Zika and Chikungunya cases - Novo Momento.
article.articleSummary: Hortolândia, Brazil, reports 1,445 dengue cases notified this year, with zero Zika and zero Chikungunya cases to date. The municipality maintains active vector control via UVZ (Unit of Zoonoses Surveillance) under the Health Secretariat, conducting house-to-house inspections in the Chácara Recreio Alvorada and Condomínio Grota Azul areas to detect and eliminate Aedes aegypti breeding sites. Residents are urged to permit entry; UVZ agents are identified by badges and uniforms. If larvae are found, some are collected for laboratory identification. UVZ notes that about 80% of breeding sites are inside homes. Dengue vaccination is available at Basic Health Units (UBSs) from 7:30 to 15:30, with seven UBSs operating extended hours this week to boost immunization.

triage.headline_ja: ホルトランディアはデング熱87例を報告し、ジカとチクングニアはゼロ - Novo Momento
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルでのデング熱の通知例数が増加しており（1,445例）、異常性と継続的な曝露リスクが認められるが、死亡や重症化の具体的報告がなく、現時点では自治体レベルで対応可能と判断される。情報不足のため経過観察を継続する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事はホルトランディア市のデング熱1,445例報告に焦点を当てており、積極的なベクター制御と予防接種対策が実施されている。重症度や死亡率の具体的データが記事に含まれていないため、IHR基準の『serious_impact』は不明と評価した。WPROスクリーニングでは異常性（年間の急速な増加）、長期曝露リスク（家屋内の繁殖地約80%）、流行性（Aedes aegyptiの活動）が認められ、自治体による管理可能性も示唆されている。

article.articleHeadline: MS confirma 3,4 mil casos de chikungunya - Boca do Povo News
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Health confirms 3,400 Chikungunya cases - Boca do Povo News.
article.articleSummary: Chikungunya outbreak intensifies in Mato Grosso do Sul, Brazil, with 7,599 probable chikungunya cases in 2026 and 3,490 confirmed in the official notification system. The 15th epidemiological week bulletin from the State Health Secretariat reports 13 chikungunya deaths across Dourados, Bonito, Jardim, and Fátima do Sul, some with comorbidities, and 52 confirmed cases in pregnant women. Two chikungunya deaths remain under investigation. Dengue totals stand at 4,187 probable and 597 confirmed cases in the state, with no dengue deaths reported or under investigation. In the prior 14 days, several municipalities showed low confirmed dengue incidence. A vaccination campaign has administered over 223,000 doses to the target population. The State Health Secretariat urges avoidance of self-medication and to seek care for suspected symptoms.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省がチクングニア3,400例を確認 - ボカ・ド・ポーボ・ニュース
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・マトグロッソ・ド・スル州でのチクングニア集団発生。確認症例3,490例、死亡13例と重症度が高く、妊婦感染52例を含む。異常・予想外であり、複数のスクリーニング基準に該当。
triage.notes: チクングニアの公式確認症例数3,490例、死亡13例（調査中2例）。妊婦感染が確認されており、重症度が懸念される。同時期にデング熱の症例も報告。予防接種キャンペーン実施中。地域的には限定的（マトグロッソ・ド・スル州）だが、国内で重点対象地域として対応中。

article.articleHeadline: A Tribuna MT - Conscientização: Malária segue como desafio no Brasil e exige diagnóstico rápido, alerta especialista do HDT-UFNT
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A Tribuna MT - Awareness: Malaria continues to be a challenge in Brazil and requires rapid diagnosis, says an HDT-UFNT specialist.
article.articleSummary: Malaria remains a significant public health challenge in Brazil, especially in the Amazon region. Ahead of World Malaria Day (April 25), the Tropical Diseases Hospital of the Federal University of North Tocantins (HDT-UFNT) urges intensified prevention, early diagnosis, and treatment for vulnerable populations. Health Ministry data show a 16% reduction in cases in Q1 2026 versus Q1 2025, but more than 90% of occurrences are still in the Amazon. Plasmodium vivax is the most common cause in Brazil, though Plasmodium falciparum can lead to severe complications; vivax can relapse if treatment is incomplete. Symptoms include high fever, chills, sweating, headache, body pains, and malaise, with fever cycles possible. Diagnosis relies on thick blood smear, with rapid tests used in some settings. Treatment follows SUS protocols and is free; mild cases are outpatient, severe cases may require hospitalization. Tocantins has few autochthonous cases, but HDT-UFNT treats patients from Pará, Rondônia, and Roraima. Prevention and traveler guidance remain essential.

triage.headline_ja: 認識啓発：マラリアはブラジルにおける継続的な課題であり、迅速な診断が必要とHDT-UFNTの専門家が警告
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルのアマゾン地域におけるマラリアは継続的な公衆衛生課題であり、複数の基準に該当するが、Q1 2026で前年同期比16%減少という肯定的な指標があり、また本記事はWorld Malaria Day前の啓発キャンペーン的性質が強いため、新規アウトブレイクを示唆する明確な根拠に欠ける。
triage.notes: 記事はWorld Malaria Day（4月25日）前の啓発・予防啓蒙キャンペーン的な内容。ブラジル保健省データで16%の減少が報告されており、新規アウトブレイク状況ではなく、既知の地域流行の管理と啓蒙に重点。ただしアマゾン地域での継続的な高い患者発生（全体の90%以上）、重症化リスクがある点、長期的な曝露リスクがあるため、経過観察対象として重要。対象国リストに該当する国はBrazilのみ確認。

article.articleHeadline: Febre amarela: governo de SP convoca população para se vacinar após seis casos confirmados no estado
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Yellow fever: São Paulo state government calls on residents to get vaccinated after six confirmed cases in the state
article.articleSummary: Yellow fever cases in São Paulo state rise to six in 2026, with three new confirmations reported on April 22 by the State Center for Epidemiological Surveillance. In Lagoinha, Vale do Paraíba, two men aged 56 and 53 died; in Araçariguama (Sorocaba region), a 43-year-old man recovered. Earlier cases in Cunha (38-year-old man died) and Cruzeiro (two cases recovered) were also reported this year. All six patients were unvaccinated. The São Paulo State Health Secretariat has begun a vaccination campaign, offering free yellow fever vaccine at Basic Health Units and urging residents to verify vaccination status, especially before travel to risk areas. Vaccination is routine nationwide since 2019; travelers should receive the vaccine at least 10 days before travel. On April 24, an online seminar for health professionals addressed yellow fever and differential diagnosis with dengue.

triage.headline_ja: 黄熱病：サンパウロ州政府が州内で確認された6例の後、住民にワクチン接種を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 黄熱病とデング熱の同時報告。6例の確認患者（うち2例死亡）、未接種者が全員、複数地域での発生、州政府による積極的なワクチン接種キャンペーン開始。IHR基準の「異常/予想外」「重症度」に該当し、ワクチン予防可能疾患の増加傾向を示しており、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 2026年の記事（未来日付）だが、イベント情報として受信されたため評価対象とした。黄熱病とデング熱の並行感染リスク。全患者が未接種であることが特徴。複数の地域で同時多発的に確認されており、未検出症例の存在可能性あり。

article.articleHeadline: Surto de chikungunya: o que é, como se proteger e quando procurar atendimento
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chikungunya Outbreak: What It Is, How to Protect Yourself, and When to Seek Medical Attention.
article.articleSummary: Chikungunya outbreak in Dourados, Brazil, spurred guidance from Hospital Universitário da Universidade Federal da Grande Dourados on transmission, symptoms, and prevention. Chikungunya is a viral infection transmitted by Aedes aegypti and Aedes albopictus; there is no person-to-person spread. Symptoms appear 3–7 days after a bite and include high fever, severe joint pain, muscle pain, headache, and skin rash; joint pain can be disabling and may persist for months. High-risk groups include the elderly, children under 1 year, pregnant women, and people with chronic diseases, with deaths reported in some periods. Infection confers lasting immunity, making re-infection unlikely. A vaccine approved by ANVISA in 2025 is being deployed cautiously; in Dourados, a vaccination campaign begins 27 April 2026 for 18–60-year-olds after health screening. Prevention emphasizes eliminating standing water, keeping water tanks closed, waste disposal, cleaning drains, and using screens. Chikungunya is similar to dengue but causes more intense, disabling joint pain.

triage.headline_ja: チクングニアアウトブレイク：それが何であるか、自分を守る方法、いつ医療に相談するか
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル（ドゥラードス市）におけるチクングニアの集団発生が報告されており、IHR基準では少なくとも「異常/予想外」と「重症度」に該当。WPRO基準では「異常/予想外」「重症度」「流行しやすさ」の複数基準に該当し、シグナルとして識別される。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジルのドゥラードス市におけるチクングニアアウトブレイクに焦点を当てている。報告された症状は重篤で、関節痛が数ヶ月間続く可能性がある。2025年にANVISA承認のワクチンが導入されており、4月27日から予防接種キャンペーンが開始予定。蚊媒介感染症であり、人-人感染なし。高リスク群（高齢者、1歳未満の子ども、妊婦、慢性疾患患者）で死亡例が報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: Puducherry to focus on eradication of malaria
article.articleSummary: On the eve of World Malaria Day, April 25, 2026, Puducherry's Health Department urged stakeholders to sustain malaria eradication efforts. The Union Territory reports its last malaria case in 2020; the Ministry of Health has categorized Puducherry in the '0' category, signaling elimination status. Puducherry is eligible to submit the dossier for Subnational Malaria Elimination Verification Certification. The release by Director of Health S. Sevvel underscores continued vigilance and actions needed to achieve complete malaria eradication in the UT. No ongoing outbreak is reported; emphasis is on building on the historic last case in 2020 and pursuing official verification for subnational elimination.

triage.headline_ja: プドゥチェリがマラリア根絶に注力
triage.triage_reason: マラリアの最後の患者が2020年で、現在は根絶状態にあり、進行中のアウトブレイクはない。公衆衛生上の緊急リスクは認められず、いずれのIHR基準も該当しない。
triage.notes: プドゥチェリはマラリア根絶状況にあり、世界マラリアデー（4月25日）を前にした公衆衛生上の啓発活動である。進行中の感染症危機ではなく、根絶成功の定着と国際検証取得に向けた取り組み段階。感染症危機管理の対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Crusty Residue Of Roman-Era Chamber Pots Reveals Parasite Once Believed To Originate In Central America
article.articleSummary: Cryptosporidium parvum identified in mineralized residues from Roman chamber pots at Novae and Marcianopolis on the Lower Danube (2nd–4th centuries CE) represents the earliest known evidence of the parasite in Europe, challenging the prior view of its Central American origin. The study also detected tapeworm eggs and Entamoeba histolytica. Researchers applied ancient DNA analysis, microscopy, and, for the first time in archaeology, enzyme-linked immunosorbent assays (ELISAs) to rehydrate, sieve, and test the crusts and solid residues from the pots. Infections were likely transmitted via contaminated drinking water from the castella aquae reservoir near Novae or through close contact with animals. Conducted in 2022, the work highlights sanitation conditions in these towns and demonstrates chamber pots as highly informative time capsules for paleoparasitology and ancient disease presence.

triage.headline_ja: ローマ時代の便器の硬い堆積物がかつて中米起源と考えられていた寄生虫を明らかに
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は2nd～4th世紀のローマ時代の古代遺物から検出された寄生虫の考古学的研究であり、現在進行中の感染症アウトブレイクではなく、歴史的な古病理学の知見である。現在の公衆衛生上の脅威ではない。
triage.notes: 記事は古代ローマ帝国時代（2nd～4th世紀CE）の考古学的遺物分析であり、現在のBrazil、Bulgaria、Germanyでの現在進行中のアウトブレイクではない。Bluedot APIが付与した発生地域（Marcianópolis、Goiás、Baden-Württemberg等）は、記事の主題である古代遺跡または現在の論文発表地を示すものであり、現在の感染症イベントを示す対象地域ではない。したがって verified_locations は空配列とする。

article.articleHeadline: 南京栖霞龙潭村开展血吸虫病防治宣传
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Longtan Village, Qixia District, Nanjing Launches Schistosomiasis Prevention and Control Publicity Campaign
article.articleSummary: On April 24, 2026, Longtan Village, Longtan Street, Qixia District, Nanjing launched a schistosomiasis prevention and control publicity campaign. The event, organized by the village Women’s Federation with the New Era Civilization Practice Station and Community Health Service Center, took place along the riverbank and featured banners, distribution of science manuals, a consultation desk, and on-site lectures. Key messages covered schistosomiasis transmission, high-risk areas, health impacts, and daily protective practices, including avoiding contact with contaminated water, not playing in riverbanks or ditches, and taking protective measures during farming. Attendees were coached to identify Oncomelania snails and understand snail-control basics. For seniors and migrant workers, staff provided one-on-one guidance. Participants were urged to seek medical care promptly if symptoms appear, promoting early prevention, detection, and treatment. The campaign aims to sustain routine health education and strengthen local schistosomiasis prevention.

triage.headline_ja: 南京栖霞龍潭村が血吸虫病防治啓発キャンペーンを展開
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は公衆衛生啓発・教育キャンペーンの実施報告であり、新規患者の発生報告や疾病の異常増加を示す証拠がない。血吸虫病は中国で既知の風土病であり、予防・啓発活動自体は異常ではない。
triage.notes: 本イベントは南京市における既知の風土病（血吸虫病）に対する定期的な予防啓発活動の実施であり、新規の疾病クラスター発生や異常な患者増加の報告ではない。中国における血吸虫病の地域的対策は日常的に実施されている。シグナルとしてのピックアップ対象ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Spillover: entenda como a ação humana na Amazônia facilita a transmissão de novos vírus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Spillover: Understand how human activity in the Amazon facilitates the transmission of emerging viruses.
article.articleSummary: Human activity in the Amazon accelerates spillover risk by increasing contact among people, vectors, and wildlife harboring diverse viruses. The Amazon hosts a vast virosphere, with arboviruses capable of infecting warm-blooded hosts and broad host ranges. Researchers along BR-319, the highway between Porto Velho, Rondônia, and Manaus, Amazonas, study known viruses and newly described ones, noting that road openings and habitat fragmentation push wild animals and vectors toward human settlements. Antibody profiles in nearby communities record exposure to viruses circulating in forests, indicating transmission potential. The focus includes arboviruses with established human impact—Dengue, Zika, chikungunya, yellow fever—as well as less characterized agents like Oropouche and Mayaro, which may cause dengue-like illness and sometimes neurological complications. Metagenomic surveillance identifies viral genetic material in environmental and biological samples to support early warning of emerging threats.

triage.headline_ja: スピルオーバー：アマゾンにおける人間活動が新興ウイルスの伝播を促進する仕組みを理解する
triage.triage_reason: 複数の既知アルボウイルス（デング、ジカ、チクングニア）と新興病原体（オロポウシ、マヤロ）の同時サーベイランスが実施されており、人口増加地域での環境変化に伴う動物媒介性感染症のスピルオーバーリスクが具体的に報告されている。ブラジル北部アマゾン地域での複合的な媒介性感染症の急速な拡大リスクはIHR基準およびWPRO基準の複数項目に合致する。
triage.notes: アマゾン地域（ロンドニア州とアマゾナス州）での複数のアルボウイルスの同時流行の可能性。新興ウイルスであるオロポウシとマヤロは神経学的合併症の可能性あり。BR-319道路の開通に伴う生息地分断化と野生動物のスピルオーバー加速が論点。ジカ、デング、チクングニア、黄熱病といった既知ウイルスに加え、特性化されていない病原体の出現が指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: Em 2026 Chikungunya já acumula mais da metade das mortes da década
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In 2026, Chikungunya already accounts for more than half of the decade's deaths.
article.articleSummary: Chikungunya deaths in Mato Grosso do Sul, Brazil, reached 13 in four months of 2026, over half of the decade’s total fatalities. The SES bulletin for epidemiological week 15 reports an 87-year-old Bonito woman who began symptoms April 8 and died 11 days later; chikungunya was confirmed April 20. Dourados is the MS epicenter with eight deaths and has declared a three-month public calamity to escalate Aedes aegypti control, the vector for dengue and Zika. In 2025 MS had the highest annual toll with 17 deaths; by early March 2025 the state had about 2,122 probable chikungunya cases. Through Sinan, MS accounted for 25 of the nation’s chikungunya deaths from 2015–2025. By March 2026 MS reported roughly 7,600 probable cases, eight of 13 deaths with comorbidities, and two more deaths under investigation; MS accounted for about 65% of Brazil’s chikungunya lethality.

triage.headline_ja: 2026年、チクングニアはすでに過去10年間の死亡の半分以上を占めている
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルのマトグロッソドスル州でチクングニアによる死亡が急増し、過去10年間の死亡の半分以上を2026年4ヶ月で記録。重症度が高く、公衆衛生への深刻な影響を示している。
triage.notes: チクングニアの死亡数が過去10年間の累計を4ヶ月で半分以上達成するという異常な状況。ブラジル全国のチクングニア致死率の約65%をマトグロッソドスル州が占めており、地域的な公衆衛生危機が明確。Aedes aegypti媒介蚊の制御強化が宣言されている。

article.articleHeadline: Coopération sanitaire : la Russie entend soutenir le Congo dans la lutte contre les épidémies
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health cooperation: Russia intends to support the Congo in the fight against epidemics.
article.articleSummary: Russia intends to bolster the Republic of Congo's epidemic response through health cooperation, knowledge exchange, and technology transfer. Rospotrebnadzor chief Anna Popova praised Congo’s leadership for understanding infectious disease challenges as a foundation for durable collaboration. Russia has already delivered a mobile laboratory mounted on a vehicle chassis capable of up to 300 analyses, enabling faster, autonomous outbreak response, and a memorandum was signed in Brazzaville to create a modern, fully equipped laboratory to reinforce epidemic containment. The initiative continues efforts launched at the second Russo-African conference on infectious diseases. Moscow reiterated its COVID-19 assistance, including medical equipment and vaccines, underscoring a broader collaboration to strengthen the Congo’s health system.

triage.headline_ja: 保健協力：ロシアがコンゴの感染症対策支援を意図
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は既存のCOVID-19パンデミック下における二国間保健協力協定の発表であり、新規の感染症イベント・アウトブレイクではない。IHR基準およびWPRO基準のいずれにも該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事はロシアとコンゴ共和国（Republic of the Congo）間の保健協力の枠組み構築に関する公開発表であり、新規のヘルスシグナル（新規アウトブレイク、異常な発症報告、未知の病原体など）を含まない。DRCおよびRepublic of Congoの両国が言及されているが、いずれも具体的な感染症イベントの発生報告ではなく、対象国内で検証されるべき感染症イベント自体が存在しない。

article.articleHeadline: चंडीगढ़ PGI में सेकंडों में आएगी मलेरिया टेस्ट रिपोर्ट, AI आधारित सॉफ्टवेयर देगा सटीक जानकारी - pgi chandigarh to use ai for rapid malaria detection
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Malaria test report will arrive within seconds at PGI Chandigarh; AI-based software will provide accurate information - PGI Chandigarh to use AI for rapid malaria detection.
article.articleSummary: Malaria detection at PGI Chandigarh will be accelerated by an AI-based software developed by the Medical Parasitology Department and funded by the Ministry of Science and Technology. The system is being trained on more than 1,000 parasite-cell images from malaria patients, with plans to extend data further. It aims to identify malaria within seconds, reducing the risk of errors from untrained lab technicians. The project is currently in the research stage but targeted for practical deployment within three years. Samples are being collected in Punjab's malaria-prone areas. While rapid diagnostic tests and PCR are commonly used today, the AI approach aspires to deliver rapid, accurate reports via computer-model training. Image acquisition remains a key challenge, with engineers assisting to enhance accuracy and accessibility.

triage.headline_ja: チャンディーガル PGI でマラリア検査レポートが数秒で出現、AI ベースのソフトウェアが正確な情報を提供 - PGI チャンディーガルが急速なマラリア検出に AI を使用
triage.triage_reason: マラリア検出の AI ツール開発に関するニュースであり、新規患者アウトブレイク、異常な発生パターン、または公衆衛生上の重大な影響の報告ではない。技術開発段階の研究プロジェクトの進捗報告に過ぎない。
triage.notes: 本記事はマラリア診断技術の開発・研究進捗に関する情報であり、感染症アウトブレイクやシグナルではない。患者の感染例、患者数増加、流行兆候、異常な疾患パターンの報告を含んでいない。シグナルトリアージの対象外として見送る。

article.articleHeadline: Sem testes específicos, entenda como são diagnosticados casos de influenza em Cotia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: No Specific Tests, Understand How Influenza Cases Are Diagnosed in Cotia.
article.articleSummary: Cotia, São Paulo, Brazil — Influenza testing is not routinely performed in urgent care; such tests are limited by Brazil’s Unified Health System (SUS) to specific or severe cases. Municipal testing prioritizes COVID-19, with influenza monitored within Severe Acute Respiratory Infection (SARI) surveillance alongside COVID-19 and Respiratory Syncytial Virus (RSV). Diagnosis is primarily clinical and epidemiological, with laboratory influenza tests reserved for severe cases requiring hospitalization. As of 2026, Cotia has 3 confirmed influenza cases, with no influenza-related deaths reported. Vaccination coverage against influenza remains below 10% of the target population, though the elderly show the highest uptake at about 16%. Vaccination is available at 26 Basic Health Units (UBSs) from Monday to Friday. At-risk individuals are urged to vaccinate promptly to reduce complications from respiratory illnesses.

triage.headline_ja: 特定検査なし、コティアのインフルエンザ症例がどのように診断されているかを理解する
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルのコティア市におけるインフルエンザの診断方法に関する情報記事であり、新規の感染症アウトブレイクを示す疫学的シグナルを含まない。確認症例数3例は限定的で、死亡例なく、IHR基準およびWPRO基準に該当せず、社会的・政治的緊急性も低い。
triage.notes: 本記事は季節性インフルエンザの診断プロトコルと予防接種キャンペーンに関する予防衛生情報であり、アウトブレイク警報ではない。確認症例3例、死亡例0、ワクチン接種率が低いという状況は既知の公衆衛生課題の記述であり、新規シグナルを構成しない。

article.articleHeadline: Nipah Virus - AOL
article.articleSummary: Nipah virus is a zoonotic disease carried by fruit bats (Pteropus) in southeast Asia, with outbreaks in Bangladesh and India and historical incidents in Malaysia (1998) and elsewhere. Transmission occurs from animals (bats, pigs) or contaminated foods, and via close person-to-person contact; potential sexual transmission noted. Incubation is about four to 14 days, up to 45 days. The clinical spectrum ranges from asymptomatic infection to acute respiratory illness and fatal encephalitis; case fatality is estimated at 40–75%, and about 20% of patients develop neurological sequelae, with possible relapse or delayed encephalitis. There is no licensed treatment or vaccine; care is supportive, including intensive management for severe respiratory or neurologic disease. Experimental therapies (monoclonal antibodies, novel antivirals) are in development; a vaccine trial is planned in Bangladesh in January 2026. Outbreaks are seasonal (December–April) linked to date palm sap harvesting; Pteropus bats are widespread across Asia and Australia, implying broader risk.

triage.headline_ja: ニパールウイルス - AOL
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当。対象国（インド）での実際の発生を記事が述べており、高い致死率と神経学的合併症を伴う重症感染症として識別される。
triage.notes: 記事はニパールウイルスの流行疫学、バングラデシュとインドでの既知の発生、マレーシア（1998年）での歴史的事例を述べている。対象国リストに該当するのはインド（1269750）のみ。バングラデシュは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。オーストラリアはコウモリ宿主の存在を述べているが、実際の発生地ではなく理論的リスク言及のため除外。致死率40-75%、長期神経学的後遺症の可能性、治療法・ワクチン不在、2026年1月バングラデシュでのワクチン試験計画など、深刻性と管理困難性を示す複数の要素がある。

article.articleHeadline: WHO warns Bangladesh at high risk of measles outbreak
article.articleSummary: Measles risk in Bangladesh has been labeled high by WHO as of 24 April 2026, with ongoing outbreaks feared. Between March 15 and 24 April, 39 people died from confirmed measles, mostly children under five, Dhaka division recording 25 deaths. Additionally, 194 people died with measles-like symptoms, including 90 in Dhaka and 66 in Rajshahi. The disease has reached 58 of 64 districts across eight divisions. A widening immunity gap stems from irregular supplementary immunization for five to six years and MR vaccine shortages in the prior fiscal year. Bangladesh’s porous borders with India and Myanmar heighten cross-border transmission risk; Jashore and Chapainawabganj are hotspots. WHO calls for at least 95% nationwide vaccination, strengthened border surveillance for imported cases, improved hospital isolation, and prioritizing vaccination for healthcare workers and workers in tourism and transport sectors.

triage.headline_ja: WHOがバングラデシュの麻しん流行リスク高と警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常・予想外、国際的拡大リスク）。WPRO基準も複数該当し、WHOの正式警告と国境越え感染のリスクがあるため、フルRRA進行が必要。
triage.notes: バングラデシュの麻しん流行警告が主要トピックだが、バングラデシュはBluedot対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。記事で明記された国境を越えた感染リスク（インド・ミャンマーとの国境）に基づき、これら2国を該当国として列挙。WHOの正式警告、死亡事例233人（確認39人＋疑い194人）、58/64地区への拡大、ワクチン供給不足による免疫ギャップなどが全WPRO基準に該当。

article.articleHeadline: Kasaï Central: l'implication de la population sollicitée pendant la campagne contre la poliomyélite - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kasaï-Central: the involvement of the population solicited during the polio vaccination campaign - ACP
article.articleSummary: A polio vaccination campaign in Kasaï Central province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, targets more than one million children aged 0-5 and runs for three days. In Kananga, Dr. Urbain Mekanda, head of the provincial health division, urged broad community involvement—parents, political actors, community leaders, religious leaders, and civil society—to ensure the campaign’s success. The strategy is door-to-door, with vaccinators visiting households parcel by parcel, as well as schools, places of worship, and other public venues to vaccinate children. Parents were urged to make their children available; Mekanda warned that even a single unvaccinated child risks contracting poliomyelitis and potentially spreading it to others. The first phase will operate across 26 health zones in Kasaï Central.

triage.headline_ja: カサイ・セントラル：ポリオ根絶キャンペーン中の住民参加の推進 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: ポリオ予防接種キャンペーンの実施報道であり、イベント自体は公衆衛生対策の一環。ただしポリオウイルスの流行兆候の報告ではなく、情報不足のため WATCH 段階で継続監視が適切。
triage.notes: 本記事はポリオウイルスの流行報告ではなく、DRC当局による予防接種キャンペーンの実施状況報道。カサイ・セントラル州で100万人以上の5歳以下児童を対象とした予防接種活動が進行中。ポリオ根絶が流行しやすい疾患として基準に該当するが、イベント自体は対策活動であり緊急性は低い。ただしDRCにおけるポリオ流行の存在背景を示唆しており、今後の流行報告の続報を注視すべき。

article.articleHeadline: Pemkot Kediri investigasi adanya laporan keracunan makanan MBG
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Kediri City Government investigates reports of MBG food poisoning.
article.articleSummary: Escherichia coli contamination linked to Kediri City’s Free Nutritious Meal (MBG) program in East Java, Indonesia, prompted investigation after 69 students from SDN Ketami 1, SDN Ketami 2, and SDN Tempurejo 1 in Pesantren reported nausea, vomiting, dizziness, and fever on 22 April. Health authorities collected samples; laboratory results indicated E. coli, signaling food unfit for consumption. No hospitalizations; conditions are stable and under monitoring by puskesmas. The City Government and MBG task force are coordinating with Badan Gizi Nasional for a comprehensive evaluation. Investigations identified SOP violations, particularly in food processing, with organoleptic testing not completed at all stages. Temporarily, SPPG Tempurejo was closed and distributions redirected to other service points to maintain operations. Police are investigating; if legal violations are confirmed, further action will follow.

triage.headline_ja: ケディリ市政府がMBG食中毒報告の調査を実施
triage.triage_reason: E.coli感染による食中毒イベントであり異常・予想外（WPRO基準1つ以上該当）だが、症例数限定（69名の学生）で重症化なし・入院なしのため重症度は低い。情報不足により慎重な判定。
triage.notes: 学校給食プログラム（MBG）に関連するE.coli食中毒で、ケディリ市東ジャワ州で確認。69名の学生が症状を呈したが重症化なく、当局による調査・改善措置が進行中。食品衛生SOP違反が特定され、対応が取られている。引き続き経過を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: EARA | News - Disease-carrying mosquitoes now feed mostly on humans
article.articleSummary: Brazil’s Atlantic Forest, where only about a third of the original habitat remains intact, faces a shift: disease-carrying mosquitoes are now more likely to feed on humans rather than a variety of wildlife hosts. This predator-prey shift, linked to biodiversity loss, increases human exposure to arboviruses such as yellow fever, dengue, Zika fever, Mayaro, Brazilian haemorrhagic fever, and chikungunya. The finding highlights elevated outbreak risk in the Brazilian Atlantic Forest as habitat degradation reduces non-human hosts and drives vectors toward people. The article notes no outbreak counts or laboratory confirmation details and emphasizes ecological drivers behind vector-host contact. No local case figures are provided. Published 2026-04-24.

triage.headline_ja: EARA | ニュース - 病原体を媒介する蚊が現在、主に人間から血液を吸血するようになった
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルの生態学的変化に伴う蚊の吸血行動の変化が報告されており、アルボウイルス（黄熱病、デング熱、ジカ熱など）の人への曝露リスク増加が予測されている。ただし、現在の実発症例やアウトブレイク報告がないため、確認済みの健康影響は不明で、現時点での即座のピックアップは保留し続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事は生態学的リスク要因（生物多様性喪失に伴う蚊の吸血行動の変化）を論じており、現在のアウトブレイク報告や確認された症例数はない。将来的なリスク増加の予測であり、現在の公衆衛生への深刻な影響は未確認。United Statesは蚊の生態学的変化の発生地ではなく、参考資料の所在地と考えられるため検証対象地から除外。

article.articleHeadline: Taubaté decreta epidemia de dengue e amplia medidas de prevenção
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Taubaté declares a dengue epidemic and expands preventive measures.
article.articleSummary: Taubaté, Brazil, declares a dengue epidemic and activates emergency and epidemiological alert to intensify mosquito control. The decree, published on 23 April 2026, directs all municipal sectors to support the Health Secretariat’s efforts and enables procurement of supplies and contracted services to curb Aedes aegypti, the vector for dengue, chikungunya, and Zika. Ongoing virus circulation monitoring accompanies the measures. As of 2026, the city has 630 confirmed dengue cases; the comparable figures were 1,799 in 2025 and 22,686 in 2024, signaling a multi-year fluctuation. Control strategies include eliminating breeding sites, prioritizing high-risk areas, and expanding diagnosis and patient assistance to reduce transmission and prevent severe dengue. No details on laboratory confirmation timing or imported/exported cases are provided. The move underscores regional public health efforts in the Vale do Paraíba region of São Paulo state.

triage.headline_ja: タウバテ市がデング熱の流行を宣言し、予防対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルにおけるデング熱流行の地方宣言であり、複数の蚊媒介感染症（デング熱、チクングニア、ジカ）に関連。ただし、過去3年の症例数減少傾向（2024年22,686件→2025年1,799件→2026年630件確定）があり、国際的拡大リスクや重症度の詳細が不明なため、継続経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル・サンパウロ州タウバテ市の地方レベルのデング熱流行宣言。過去3年で症例数が大幅に減少していることが注目点。蚊媒介感染症であり流行しやすい環境が存在するが、国際的な拡大リスクや重症例の詳細情報が欠如。引き続き地域の流行動向を注視し、国家レベルでの対応拡大があれば再評価の対象。

article.articleHeadline: Puducherry qualifies for subnational malaria elimination verification certification
article.articleSummary: As of 24 April 2026, Puducherry (Union Territory, India) has been recognised as a Category 0 region for malaria, enabling submission of dossiers for subnational malaria elimination verification certification. The Union government confirmed the designation after zero indigenous malaria cases were reported, the last being in 2020. The verification process involves a comprehensive review of health records and vector-control measures by national authorities to officially confirm elimination status. This achievement underscores sustained health department efforts in monitoring migrant populations, implementing larval-control measures, and ensuring rapid diagnosis. India aims to achieve zero indigenous malaria cases by 2027 and malaria elimination certification by 2030.

triage.headline_ja: プドゥチェリーがマラリア排除に関する準国家的認証資格を取得
triage.triage_reason: マラリア排除達成の肯定的なニュースであり、公衆衛生上の危機要素がない。IHR基準およびWPRO基準のいずれにも該当せず、社会的・政治的関心は限定的。
triage.notes: 本記事はマラリア排除達成の肯定的なニュースであり、感染症危機・アウトブレイク検知のシグナルではない。プドゥチェリー地域が2020年以降のマラリア本土感染ケースゼロを達成したことの報告であり、疾病の増加・拡大を示す情報は含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: WHO schickt Fachleute: Mysteriöse Krankheit in Burundi tötet fünf Menschen
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO sends experts: Mysterious disease in Burundi kills five people.
article.articleSummary: An unknown illness in Burundi’s Mpanda District, near Bujumbura on Lake Tanganyika, has killed five people and sickened 35 recently. Symptoms include fever, vomiting, diarrhea, blood in urine, fatigue and abdominal pain. The government says immediate measures were taken: patients treated and isolated, contacts closely monitored. Lab testing ruled out Ebola, Marburg, Yellow fever and Rift Valley fever; samples have been sent abroad for further analysis. The World Health Organization is assisting with surveillance, field investigations, clinical care, laboratory work, infection prevention and control, and logistics; samples are being sent to the Democratic Republic of Congo’s National Institute for Biomedical Research for analysis. CDC Africa is also involved; a high-level team is due next week. A January outbreak nearby had a similar rash but mpox tests were negative. Refugees from DRC may pose importation risk; a previous DRC outbreak (late 2024–early 2025) was later identified as a rare malaria variant.

triage.headline_ja: WHO が専門家を派遣：ブルンジの謎の病気で5人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: 未確定の感染症による死亡例（5人）と複数症例（35人）が報告され、公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性、国際的な実験室支援の必要性、複数の重症ウイルス感染症（エボラ、マールブルグ、黄熱、RVF）の除外検査が進行中。IHR基準を3つ以上満たし、WPRO基準も複数該当。WHO、CDC、DRCの国立生物医学研究所による国際的対応が既に開始されている。
triage.notes: ブルンジで発生しているイベントではあるが、対象国リストに Burundi が含まれていないため、地域検証のルールに従い verified_locations には含めない。ただし、サマリーに『DRC の国立生物医学研究所にサンプル送付』『難民から DRC への導入リスク』『DRC の前回アウトブレイク（2024年末〜2025年初）は稀な マラリア亜型と特定』と記載されているため、DRC (203312) を verified_locations に含める。なお、California（米国）も発生地域に含まれているが、サマリーに米国での発症に関する記述がないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: El aumento de Sarampión y Tos Ferina: ¿Qué medidas deben tomar los dominicanos ahora?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The increase in measles and whooping cough: What measures should Dominicans take now?
article.articleSummary: During the 24th Pan American Vaccination Week, health experts in the Dominican Republic warn of rising measles and pertussis across the Americas, urging full immunization amid travel-associated importation risk as 2026 approaches. Measles outbreaks prompted OPS/WHO alerts after 14,891 cases and 29 deaths across 13 countries; the Dominican Republic has contained measles entry and remains free, but maintains vigilant surveillance. Pertussis surged from 11,202 cases in 2023 to 66,184 in 2024 across the region, with Argentina, Brazil, Chile, Colombia, Ecuador, United States, Mexico, Panama, Paraguay and Peru identified; in the Dominican Republic, cases rose with at least two infant deaths by mid-2024. Vaccination remains the pillar of protection: aim for >90% coverage; acellular pertussis vaccines (aP) reduce adverse events versus whole-cell (wP), with hexavalent aP vaccines showing 95–97% efficacy; Chile’s switch to aP cut adverse events by 67%. RSV remains a concern as autumn approaches in the southern hemisphere.

triage.headline_ja: 麻疹と百日咳の増加：ドミニカ共和国国民が今採取すべき措置は何か？
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ該当（深刻な影響：複数国で死亡例、異常：急増傾向、国際的拡大リスク：米州全域での流行）。スクリーニング基準でも重症度・流行可能性・管理可能性で複数該当し、パンアメリカン予防接種週間における公式アラートの背景がある。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは米州地域（ラテンアメリカ・カリブ海地域）の麻疹および百日咳の流行について述べており、複数国での死亡例（麻疹29例、百日咳少なくとも2例）を報告。対象国リストの中ではブラジルのみが記事の主題的な流行国として明示されている。米国も言及されているが対象国リストに含まれていない。パンアメリカン保健機構（OPS/WHO）によるアラートが発令されており、予防接種週間の文脈でも関心が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Chikungunya chega a 95% dos municípios de Mato Grosso do Sul
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chikungunya reaches 95% of the municipalities of Mato Grosso do Sul
article.articleSummary: Chikungunya in Mato Grosso do Sul, Brazil, as of 24 April 2026, with 7,599 probable cases across 75 of 79 municipalities (94.9%). Dourados leads with 2,517 cases; Corumbá 1,002; Fatima do Sul 575; Amambai 415; Jardim 348. Incidence hotspots include Sete Quedas, Fatima do Sul, Paraíso das Águas and Douradina. Four municipalities have no records: Alcinópolis, Aparecida do Taboado, Japorã, Tacuru. Thirteen deaths are confirmed (eight in Dourados, two in Bonito, two in Jardim, one in Fatima do Sul); Dourados accounts for about 40% of Brazil’s chikungunya fatalities (nationwide 20). Vaccination using IXCHIQ has begun, with 20,000 doses shipped of a 46,500 total; target group 18–59 years at high exposure; single-dose, with restrictions for pregnant, puerperal, immunocompromised. Emergency funds of R$28.4 million support care, vector control, and joint federal/military actions, including thousands of visits and food distribution.

triage.headline_ja: チクングニア熱がマット・グロッソ・ド・スル州の95%の市町村に到達
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルのマット・グロッソ・ド・スル州でチクングニア熱が急速に拡大し、7,599件の患者と13件の死亡が確認されている。IHR基準で深刻な公衆衛生影響と異常性が該当し、国内の他地域への拡大リスクがある。
triage.notes: ブラジルは対象国（CEPR EBS対象国）として含める。マット・グロッソ・ド・スル州での急速な感染拡大（75/79市町村、94.9%）、13件の死亡、ワクチン接種キャンペーン開始、および大規模な政府・軍による対応が実施されている点が重要。国内流行の段階であり、国際的拡大リスクは現在「No」と評価したが、ブラジルの他地域への拡大可能性は高い。

article.articleHeadline: Prefeitura contrata médicos e enfermeiros para enfrentar chikungunya
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: City Hall hires doctors and nurses to tackle chikungunya.
article.articleSummary: Chikungunya outbreak in Dourados, Mato Grosso do Sul, Brazil, 251 km from Campo Grande, prompts emergency hiring of doctors and nurses. The city hall issued a temporary measure to reinforce health units and urgent care, and hospitals as a state of calamity persists. Hiring is simplified and immediate, prioritizing applicants with more years of professional experience; age serves as tie-breaker. Positions are with the Secretaria de Saúde de Dourados; the number of hires is not disclosed. The epidemiological report shows 5,136 probable chikungunya cases, including 2,337 confirmed and 2,799 under investigation; 1,609 discarded. Positivity rates remain high (59–72% over 15 days), indicating intense transmission. Since February, eight deaths attributed to chikungunya (seven Indigenous, one urban resident), with two more under investigation. About 48 people with confirmed disease or symptoms are hospitalized in the municipality. Measure signed by Health Secretary Márcio Figueiredo, aims to prevent collapse of the system during the epidemic.

triage.headline_ja: チクングニア熱に対抗するため市役所が医師と看護師を雇用
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルのマト・グロッソ・ド・スル州ドゥラードスで深刻なチクングニア熱アウトブレイクが発生。確認症例2,337例、死亡8例、高い陽性率（59-72%）と継続的な医療逼迫状況が報告されており、IHR基準2項目以上該当とWPRO基準複数項目該当。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーが明確に特定のブラジル市（ドゥラードス）での深刻なチクングニア熱アウトブレイクを記述。確認症例数、死亡例、高い陽性率、医療体制の逼迫、非常雇用実施など、複数の重症度指標が存在。対象国リストではブラジルは含まれていないが（3469034はリストに明記されていない）、本システムの設計上、対象国外のイベントについても医学的重要性が高い場合はシグナルとして検出される可能性がある。ただし厳密には対象国確認ルール適用時にブラジルは非対象国。

article.articleHeadline: T7News | Taubaté decreta epidemia de dengue
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: T7News | Taubaté declares a dengue epidemic.
article.articleSummary: Taubaté, Brazil, declares dengue epidemic as of 24 April 2026, with 630 laboratory-confirmed dengue cases in 2026, down from 1,799 in 2025 and 22,686 in 2024. The decree declares a state of emergency and epidemiological alert, expanding actions to curb Aedes aegypti, the vector of dengue, chikungunya and Zika. Surveillance emphasizes reducing breeding sites and integrated vector management in homes and neighborhoods. The CAS vector-control unit visited 11,768 properties, carried out 6,597 nebulization operations and 8,816 breeding-site control actions. Educational activities in 16 municipal schools reached about 800 students who serve as information multipliers. Cleanup operations removed 4 tons of waste in flood-prone areas and 66 tons elsewhere. Teams are training under the BR Aedes program for targeted insecticide application. Eliminating indoor breeding sites remains the primary prevention, with public cooperation urged.

triage.headline_ja: タウバテ市、デング熱流行を宣言
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルのタウバテ市でデング熱流行が宣言されたが、2026年の確定症例は630例で前年（1,799例）・前々年（22,686例）よりも減少傾向。国際的な急速な拡大リスクは現時点では限定的と判断される。
triage.notes: ブラジルはWPRO対象国ではなく米州地域であるため、本システムの主要な監視対象外。記事では3つの蚊媒介感染症（デング、チクングニア、ジカ熱）に言及されており、Aedes aegypti対策の強化が示されている。症例数が減少傾向にあることから、現時点でのフル評価（RRA）進行は不要と判断。今後症例が急増する場合は再評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Tratamento com até 90% de resposta clínica muda cenário da peritonite infecciosa felina no Brasil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Treatment with up to 90% clinical response changes the landscape of feline infectious peritonitis in Brazil.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-04-24 in Brazil, molnupiravir is being manipulated by DrogaVET to expand therapeutic access for feline infectious peritonitis (PIF). Reported remission rates reach 80-90% in non-neural cases, approaching those seen with GS-441524. A 2023 study in the Journal of Veterinary Internal Medicine found 14 of 18 treated cats achieved stable remission, with fever and appetite improving within days. PIF results from mutation of feline enteric coronavirus (FCoV) in multi-cat environments, transmitted fecal-oral; about 5-12% of infected cats develop PIF. Wet (effusive) PIF features ascites/pleural effusion; dry forms affect liver, kidneys, eyes, CNS. Diagnosis combines history, labs, imaging, and effusion analysis; RT-PCR for viral RNA in effusions or tissues with immunocytochemistry increases specificity. Molnupiravir, a prodrug, impairs viral replication; treatment is weight-based, ~84 days, with monitoring for reversible hematologic changes. Administration can be flavored biscuits, paste, or oil suspension to aid owners.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルで猫伝染性腹膜炎の治療状況が変わる：モルヌピラビルで90%の臨床的反応率を達成
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19とラベル付けされているが、記事の実質はブラジルの猫伝染性腹膜炎（PIF）治療に関する獣医学的トピックであり、公衆衛生上の感染症アウトブレイクではない。動物疾患であり、ヒト対ヒト伝染はなく、IHR基準およびWPRO基準を満たさない。
triage.notes: 本記事はBluedotによるメタデータエラーの可能性が高い。疾患名がCOVID-19と分類されているが、記事の内容は猫伝染性腹膜炎（Feline Infectious Peritonitis: FCoV由来）に関する獣医医学情報であり、ヒト感染症ではない。公衆衛生監視の対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Queixas sobre imóveis abandonados no Centro disparam 135% em Campinas; moradores relatam insegurança e risco de dengue
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Complaints about abandoned properties in downtown Campinas spike 135%; residents report insecurity and risk of dengue.
article.articleSummary: Downtown Campinas, Brazil, faces rising health concerns linked to abandoned buildings as a potential dengue risk. The municipal service 156 reports a 135.48% jump in abandonment complaints from 62 in 2024 to 146 in 2025. Dengue-risk inspection requests rose from 128 to 136 in the same period (6.25%). January–March 2026 saw 66 general abandonment complaints and 31 dengue-risk inspections. Residents in Botafogo and Cambuí describe vandalized, unoccupied lots with trash, overgrown vegetation, and homeless occupancy, creating mosquito breeding sites and health hazards. One resident cites two dengue infections, including a hemorrhagic case. The city says complaints are routed to the responsible secretaries; water accumulation issues go to Health, tall grass and dirt to Public Services. Owners identified are notified to act within 15 days; unresolved cases trigger fines or forced cleanup.

triage.headline_ja: カンピーナスのダウンタウンで廃墟物件の苦情が135%急増。住民が不安と高い感染リスクを報告
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルのカンピーナスでデング熱のリスク要因（蚊の繁殖地となる廃墟物件の増加）が報告されているが、現在のところ実際のアウトブレイク・患者数の急増は記事に明記されていない。環境的リスクと個別症例の言及に留まるため、情報収集段階での継続監視が適切。
triage.notes: 記事の主眼は廃墟物件による公共の不安と環境的なデング熱リスク要因の報告。確認された患者数の急増やアウトブレイクの進行中という記載は見当たらない。蚊媒介疾患の流行リスクが潜在的に高い環境状況が存在するため、今後の確認症例数報告を待つ必要がある。ブラジルは非WPRO地域だが、リスク評価の観点から監視継続を推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Sintomas da malária podem ser confundidos e atrasar diagnóstico
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Malaria symptoms can be confused and delay diagnosis.
article.articleSummary: Malaria, caused by Plasmodium vivax and Plasmodium falciparum, transmitted by Anopheles mosquitoes, remains endemic in tropical regions. In Brazil, P. vivax is most common while P. falciparum poses greater risk of severe disease. Common symptoms include fever, chills, headache, malaise, myalgia, sweating, nausea, and fatigue. Early, accurate diagnosis is critical to initiate appropriate treatment and prevent complications, especially with P. falciparum, delays are more likely in non-endemic areas. World Malaria Day (Apr 25) raises awareness. In the Americas, PAHO reported 536,700 cases and 136 deaths in 2024. Brazil saw a 26.8% drop in January–March 2025 versus 2024, totaling 25,473 cases, with SUS protocols guiding testing and treatment. Prevention emphasizes mosquito bite avoidance, nets, repellents, and clothing; RTS,S and R21 exist but do not replace core measures. The Amazon region accounts for over 99% of Brazilian cases; Minas Gerais non-endemic but health professionals must be trained to suspect malaria.

triage.headline_ja: マラリア症状は混同される可能性があり、診断を遅延させる
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルでのマラリア流行は継続中であり、診断遅延の問題は重要だが、記事は啓発・教育的性質が強く、新規な急性イベントではなく、現在の流行状況についての一般情報である。スクリーニング基準は複数該当するが、社会的関心が高いとも判定しにくく、情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事はポルトガル語で、ブラジルのマラリア流行に関する啓発記事。アマゾン地域が症例の99%以上を占め、クロロキンに耐性のあるP. vivaxが主流。2025年1-3月の症例数は2024年同期比で26.8%減少している。スペイン（カナリア諸島）は地理的に列挙されているが、記事の主題はブラジルのマラリアであり、スペインでの発生は記述されていない。したがってverified_locationsはBrazilのみ。

article.articleHeadline: Rotary Club dan Pemkab Rote Ndao Bersinergi, Wujudkan Zero Malaria - Suara Merdeka NTT
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rotary Club and the Rote Ndao Regency Government Join Forces to Realize Zero Malaria
article.articleSummary: As of 24 April 2026, Rotary Club Kupang Victory led Rotarian Against Malaria (RAM) activities in Rote Ndao Regency, East Nusa Tenggara, Indonesia, to mark World Malaria Day. The event targeted endemic villages Faifua-Oesosole and Daiama, with participation from Rotary President Maxi Rihi, Deputy Regent Apremoi Dudelusy Dethan, and Acting Head of Health Maria Isabela, S.KM., M.PH. Health workers from Puskesmas Oehun and community members joined in malaria screening, health education, prevention campaigns, and relief distributions. International support included microscopes from Australia to aid malaria examinations. Maxi Rihi emphasized the effort is a genuine, not ceremonial, part of a global movement across 34 sites, aiming to eliminate malaria in Rote Ndao by 2029 under the theme 'End Malaria, Now We Can.' Deputy Regent expressed appreciation for Rotary’s collaboration toward zero malaria.

triage.headline_ja: ロータリークラブとロテ・ンダオ県政府が協力し、マラリア根絶を実現
triage.triage_reason: マラリア対策・スクリーニング活動の報道であり、新規の流行や異常な感染症事象ではない。IHR基準・スクリーニング基準に該当せず、社会的関心も限定的。
triage.notes: 本記事はWorld Malaria Day（世界マラリアデー）を記念したルーチン的な対策・スクリーニング活動の報道であり、新規の感染症流行事象ではない。ロテ・ンダオ地域のエンデミック村での予防活動であり、異常性や国際的拡大リスクはない。Australia言及は顕微鏡供与の文脈であり、流行地は印インドネシアのみ。

article.articleHeadline: Kent computational approach takes the guesswork out of drug development for Chagas disease
article.articleSummary: Chagas disease (Trypanosoma cruzi) infection affects ~8 million people, mostly in Latin America, with ~100 million at risk. Early infection can be cured; untreated infections become chronic, causing complications in the heart, digestive system, and nervous system. Due to weak commercial incentives for neglected tropical diseases, new drug development is slow. University of Kent researchers established a physics-based computational protocol to accelerate discovery for naphthoquinone-based drug candidates, using a ruthenium-catalyzed modification strategy to tune potency, stability, and selectivity. They benchmarked nine quantum-chemical methods against a high-accuracy reference, identifying a protocol that closely reproduces high-level results while enabling a cheaper, faster screening workflow. This approach reduces trial-and-error in the lab, prioritizes promising compounds earlier, and supports faster, cheaper drug discovery. The work is part of the NUBIAN Project (UK, Brazil, Sierra Leone) with Royal Society support; lead author Dr Felipe Fantuzzi.

triage.headline_ja: ケント大学の計算化学的アプローチがシャーガス病の医薬品開発の試行錯誤を解消
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は医薬品開発の計算化学手法に関する学術的ニュースであり、疾病の発生・流行イベントではない。シャーガス病の感染症危機管理上の急性リスクを示す情報がない。
triage.notes: 本記事は研究成果の発表であり、シャーガス病の新規発生・流行情報ではない。NUBIAN Project（英国・ブラジル・シエラレオネ）における医薬品開発の進展を報告するプレスリリースである。EBS対象外の学術ニュース。

article.articleHeadline: Mumbai Emerges As Worst Malaria Hotspot In Maharashtra With 28 Daily Cases, 39% Rise In 3 Years: Official Data
article.articleSummary: Malaria, a mosquito-borne disease, remains a major public health concern in Maharashtra, with Mumbai as the worst-affected hotspot. From January to March 7, 2026, the state logged 2,392 malaria cases, of which Mumbai accounted for 918. The statewide average is about 74–75 daily malaria cases, with Mumbai contributing about 28 per day. Economic Survey data show a year-on-year rise since 2020-21: 12,909; 2021-22: 19,303; 2022-23: 15,451; 2023-24: 16,760; 2024-25: 20,640; 2025-26 (to Dec): 20,735. Malaria deaths increased from 23 (2023-24) to 26 (2024-25) and 27 (2025-26). Mumbai saw cases climb 7,319 (2023) to 8,710 (2024) to 10,162 (2025)—a 39% rise. Officials cite climate change, early monsoon, intermittent rainfall, and construction-driven water stagnation as drivers. The data were released around World Malaria Day.

triage.headline_ja: ムンバイがマハーラシュトラ州最悪のマラリアホットスポットに浮上、1日28件の患者数、3年間で39%増加：公式データ
triage.triage_reason: インドのマラリア患者数が3年間で39%増加し、死亡数も増加している異常なトレンドが確認されている。公衆衛生への深刻な影響と異常性が認められ、IHR基準2つ以上に該当する。
triage.notes: マラリアは蚊媒介性疾患であり、インドは既知の風土病地域である。記事はWorld Malaria Dayの時期に公表されており、気候変動と環境要因がドライバーとして挙げられている。患者数と死亡数の双方で増加トレンドが確認されており、管理可能性の情報不足があるが、フルRRA実施の優先度は高い。

article.articleHeadline: Monkey carcass, illegal meat seized at US airports as officials warn of disease threats
article.articleSummary: April 24, 2026 report: U.S. Customs and Border Protection uncovered a monkey carcass from Cameroon and illegal meat at Chicago O’Hare International Airport, with the primate remains detained and destroyed per agency directives. In a separate incident, a traveler from Liberia concealed beef, meat, bones and hair within eight boxes of dried seafood; 125 pounds of prohibited meat were seized, along with a pound of prohibited fresh leaves and four types of prohibited seeds for planting. Meat is restricted due to disease risks such as bovine spongiform encephalopathy (mad cow disease) and foot-and-mouth disease. Earlier this week, CBP announced at Miami International Airport interception of over 44 pounds of prohibited meat from Brazil, including hot dogs labeled “salsicha.” These seizures illustrate ongoing efforts to prevent animal diseases from entering the United States.

triage.headline_ja: 米国の空港でサル死骸と違法肉が押収、当局が疾病リスクを警告
triage.triage_reason: 口蹄疫とBSEという国際的に重要な動物疾病に関連する検疫事例であるが、実際の疾病発生ではなく水際での違法肉製品の押収であり、IHR基準の該当性が限定的。情報不足のため経過観察対象。
triage.notes: 記事の主体は米国での検疫・押収活動であり、実際の疾病発生ではない。言及されている3カ国（カメルーン、リベリア、ブラジル）のうち、対象国リストに該当するのはブラジルのみ。IHR基準は2つ該当するが、これは水際対策での違法肉押収であり、その意味でのトリアージ価値は相対的に低い。ただし口蹄疫とBSEの国際的リスク、および複数国からの違法肉押収という背景から、WATCH対象とした。

article.articleHeadline: Fever, Cough And Stomach Issues: What's Causing The Sudden Spike In Illness Around You?
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-04-24, a cluster of fever, cough, fatigue and stomach issues is spreading across households in Gurugram, India. This is not a single illness or just seasonal flu, but a mix of factors hitting the body simultaneously. Environmental and behavioral triggers—temperature fluctuations, dehydration, heat exposure, and rapid viral spread within families—plus summer risks of food-borne illnesses and compromised hygiene contribute to many people becoming sick at once. Seasonal transitions can temporarily lower immunity, while dry air, dust, pollution and pollen worsen throat irritation and respiratory symptoms, especially for individuals with asthma or sinus problems. Prevention emphasizes hydration, food hygiene, hand hygiene, good ventilation, and reducing dust exposure; seek medical care if symptoms persist. Insights from Dr. Shailesh Sahay, Max Hospital, Gurugram.

triage.headline_ja: 発熱、咳、胃腸症状：あなたの周囲で病気の急増を引き起こしている原因は？
triage.triage_reason: インフルエンザではなく、複数の環境・行動因子が引き起こす季節的な症候群の報告であり、単一の新興感染症イベントではない。IHR基準およびWPRO基準いずれも該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは季節的な症状集積（環境要因、脱水、食中毒リスク、衛生管理）についての一般的な健康啓発記事であり、公式な感染症アウトブレイク報告ではない。単一病原体の異常なクラスタではなく、複数因子による一時的な健康問題の説明であるため、シグナルのピックアップは不適切。

article.articleHeadline: 18 Warga Buleleng Digigit Anjing Ngamuk Diduga Rabies
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 18 Buleleng Residents Bitten by a Rabid Dog, Suspected Rabies
article.articleSummary: Rabies-suspected incident in Bali: 18 residents of Kelurahan Banyuning, Buleleng Regency, were bitten by a rampaging mixed-breed dog on 23 April 2026. Victims were immediately taken to nearby health facilities; all have received anti-rabies vaccination (VAR), with none categorized as high risk. Two bite victims are children aged 10 and 5. Most wounds are on the legs and hands. The dog, described as a small-to-medium mixed breed likely kept as a pet, remains at large as authorities conduct an ongoing search of locations including Jalan Pulau Samosir, Jalan Pulau Komodo, and surrounding residential areas; the search was to continue into the afternoon and evening of 24 April. Treatments occurred at Puskesmas Buleleng 1, Puskesmas Buleleng 3, and RSU Giri Emas. No laboratory confirmation was reported; rabies is suspected.

triage.headline_ja: 18人のブレレン住民が狂犬病の疑いのある犬に咬まれた
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア（バリ州）で狂犬病疑い事例の集団発生がサーベイランスに上がりました。18名の被害者が予防接種を受け重症例はないと報告されていますが、犬が未確保で病原体確認がなく情報不足のため、経過観察が適切です。
triage.notes: 被害者全員が予防接種を受けており、高リスク例がないと報告されている。ただし犬が未確保であり、病原体の実験室確認がなされていない。狂犬病は疑い段階。追加情報として、被害者数が18名と比較的多数かつ短期間での複数被害であることが異常性を高めている。インドネシアは対象国リストに含まれている。

article.articleHeadline: Tuberculose no Ceará: estado registra o maior número de mortes desde 2015
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tuberculosis in Ceará: the state records the highest number of deaths since 2015.
article.articleSummary: Tuberculosis remains a public health challenge in Ceará, Brazil, with free treatment via the SUS. The 2025 epidemiological bulletin records 4,094 TB cases and 259 deaths in Ceará—the highest mortality since 2015—driven by Mycobacterium tuberculosis infection, comorbidities (notably HIV/AIDS), aging, and late diagnosis. The COVID-19 pandemic disrupted diagnoses in 2020, contributing to delayed care. Fortaleza's Hospital São José is a reference for complex TB cases. Cure rates average 60.7% (2015–2024), below the 85% target, while treatment abandonment runs about 12.3% annually. Public health actions include active case finding, health-worker training, and stronger integration between surveillance and primary care. TB in Ceará concentrates among vulnerable groups—prison inmates, people with HIV/AIDS, and the homeless—amid stigma that hinders care. Authorities have expanded rapid molecular testing via Lacen-CE to shorten detection and initiate treatment sooner.

triage.headline_ja: セアラ州の結核：2015年以来の最高死亡数を記録
triage.triage_reason: 結核の死亡数増加は重症度の高さを示しているが、これは既知の地域的課題の悪化であり、異常または予想外の新興感染症ではない。ただし死亡数の増加傾向と対策の効果測定上、継続的な監視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はセアラ州における結核の既知課題（2015年以来の高い死亡数）を報告しており、新興感染症シグナルではなく、地域的な公衆衛生課題の継続監視に該当。HIV/AIDSの合併症率が高いこと、治癒率が目標の85%を下回る60.7%であることが注視点。COVID-19の診断遅延への言及があるが、主題は結核。

article.articleHeadline: Governo alerta para risco de sarampo após Copa do Mundo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Government warns of measles risk after the World Cup.
article.articleSummary: Measles poses risk of reintroduction to Brazil after the 2026 FIFA World Cup, according to the Brazilian Health Ministry, due to reported measles cases in the event’s three host nations—United States, Mexico and Canada. The warning underscores cross-border exposure during the tournament. Brazil has been considered measles-free since 2024, a status noted by Senator Marcelo Castro (MDB-PI), a physician and former Health Minister. Authorities stress vigilance in vaccination coverage and surveillance to prevent importation and transmission, especially among travelers and communities with lower immunization. The alert reflects ongoing global measles threats and the importance of maintaining high vaccination uptake to sustain elimination status in Brazil.

triage.headline_ja: 政府、ワールドカップ後の麻しんリスクを警告
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルでの麻しん再導入リスクは国際的な拡大懸念があり、IHR基準2項目以上に該当。対象国ブラジルが直接該当し、公衆衛生への具体的な警告が発表されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーの主題はブラジルへの麻しん再導入リスク。ブラジルが2024年以来麻しんフリーとされている中での警告であり、ワールドカップ開催国（米国・メキシコ・カナダ）での事例が再導入の直接的なきっかけとなっている。対象国リストではブラジルのみ該当。

article.articleHeadline: Près de 29 millions de cas de paludisme détectés en 2024 en RDC (Programme national de lutte contre le paludisme) - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nearly 29 million malaria cases detected in 2024 in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (National Malaria Control Programme) - ACP
article.articleSummary: Kinshasa, 24 April 2026 — The Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) recorded about 29 million malaria cases in 2024, per the National Malaria Control Programme (PNLP). Malaria remains endemic; approximately 49% of cases were in children under five, with 21,000 deaths, or 69%. The PNLP outlined two core strategies: prevention, case management, and strengthened surveillance, plus a major strategy integrating communication, research, and program management (human resources, funding, resource mobilization). Key challenges include vector resistance to insecticides, parasite drug resistance, climate, logistics, financing, and security. Sanru, a major operational partner, reported intensified 2025 efforts across prevention, treatment, and surveillance: nearly 14 million insecticide-treated nets distributed (9 million in campaigns, ~4 million to pregnant women and infants under one year), and over 2.2 million patients treated, with drug-resistance surveillance in 9 provinces. The goal remains malaria elimination by 2030, aligned with World Malaria Day theme: “Motivated to eliminate: now we can, now we must.”

triage.headline_ja: 2024年にコンゴ民主共和国で約2,900万件のマラリア症例を検出（国家マラリア対策プログラム）
triage.triage_reason: DRCにおけるマラリアの継続的な高い感染率と児童死亡率（69%）が報告されており、スクリーニング基準の複数項目に該当する。ただし、これは既知の風土病の定期的な報告であり、新規の異常事象ではないため、続報の経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: マラリアはDRCの風土病であり、2024年の約2,900万症例は深刻な公衆衛生課題であることは明白だが、新規または異常な発生ではない。児童死亡率69%（21,000死亡）、5歳未満児が約49%と高率な重症度から、WPROスクリーニング基準の「重症度」「長期曝露」「流行しやすさ」「管理可能性」に該当。IHR基準では「公衆衛生への影響は深刻」に該当するが、「異常」「国際的拡大」「渡航・貿易制限」には該当しないため、IHR基準は1つのみ。フルRRA前段階としてはWATCHが適切。

article.articleHeadline: 'উচ্চ ঝুঁকিপূর্ণ' বাংলাদেশে হামের পরিস্থিতি :বিশ্ব স্বাস্থ্য সংস্থা
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: High-risk measles situation in Bangladesh: World Health Organization
article.articleSummary: WHO labels Bangladesh’s measles situation as high risk, with transmission across 58 of 64 districts. From March 15 to April 14, suspected cases total 19,161; laboratory-confirmed 2,973; deaths 166 among symptomatic cases, including 30 lab-confirmed deaths (roughly 1.1% case fatality). Currently 12,318 patients are hospitalized. Dhaka division is hardest hit (8,263 suspected), followed by Rajshahi (3,747), Chittagong (2,514), and Khulna (1,568). About 91% of districts are affected; under-5 children account for 79% of cases, with 66% under 2 years and 33% under 9 months. Most dead children were unvaccinated or had only one MR dose. The crisis follows declines in MR vaccination coverage (2024-25) and no supplementary immunization activities since 2020, compounded by vitamin A deficiencies. Cross-border transmission risk with India and Myanmar is noted. WHO urges 95% vaccine coverage, vitamin A capsules, hospital isolation, rapid vaccination of contacts within 72 hours, and protection of health workers and travelers.

triage.headline_ja: 「高リスク」のバングラデシュの麻疹状況：世界保健機関
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべて該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準も全5項目該当。国際機関（WHO）が警告し、社会的・政治的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーより、バングラデシュで64地区中58地区に拡大した麻疹流行が確認されている。3月15日～4月14日に疑似症例19,161件、確定症例2,973件、死亡166件（確定症例のうち30件死亡、CFR約1.1%）。5歳未満児が症例の79%を占める深刻な児童感染。インド・ミャンマーとの国境越境感染リスクがWHOにより指摘されており、対象国3カ国すべてが該当。WHOが95%のワクチン接種率達成を緊急提言している。

article.articleHeadline: Cicada Varian Covid-19 Terbaru, Ini Gejala dan Cara Pencegahannya
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Latest Cicada COVID-19 Variant: Symptoms and How to Prevent It.
article.articleSummary: BA.3.2, nicknamed Cicada, is a SARS-CoV-2 variant first detected in South Africa in November 2024. As of February 2026 it has been reported in at least 23 countries, including Europe and the United States, but its global spread remains low and it is not yet dominant. Indonesian experts note no detected Cicada cases in Indonesia and no evidence that this lineage is more virulent than prior strains. CDC reports this variant carries roughly 70–75 mutations in the spike protein, raising concerns about immune evasion, though WHO states there is no proof of more severe disease. Symptoms align with typical COVID-19: fever, cough, sore throat, runny nose, fatigue, with potential progression to severe illness in vulnerable groups. Preventive measures mirror standard COVID-19 guidance: vaccination, healthy living, hygiene, avoiding crowds when unwell, and seeking medical care promptly.

triage.headline_ja: 最新のシカダCOVID-19変異株：症状と予防方法
triage.triage_reason: BA.3.2変異株（Cicada）は南アフリカで初検出され23ヶ国以上で報告されているが、インドネシアでは未検出で、より重篤化の証拠がなく、現段階では国際的な優勢株ではない。情報の進展を注視する価値がある。
triage.notes: 記事はインドネシアのメディア（Bisnis Indonesia）で配信されており、インドネシア専門家がインドネシア国内でCicada症例が未検出であることを指摘している。発生地域リストにはUS、南アフリカ、インドネシアが含まれているが、サマリーから実際の発生がインドネシアで確認されていないため、verified_locationsにはインドネシアのみを含める。IHR基準は2つ以上該当するがWPRO基準も複数該当するため、PICKUP基準を満たす可能性があるが、重篤性や感染性の懸念がない点、インドネシアでの検出がない点、および情報が不足している点（政府の関心度、長期曝露の詳細など）を考慮し、WATCH判定とした。

article.articleHeadline: As Chennai reports cases of measles, doctors stress timely vaccination
article.articleSummary: As of 24 April 2026, Chennai has reported measles cases over the past few months, but officials say there is no upturn or clustering versus the previous year. Most affected children were not fully vaccinated against measles. Tamil Nadu state immunisation coverage stands at 99%. The Measles-Rubella vaccine, administered at nine and 18 months, has about 85% efficacy and provides adequate protection, according to A. Somasundaram, Director of Public Health and Preventive Medicine. Health authorities emphasize timely vaccination to prevent sporadic cases and maintain protection, noting that vaccination status is a key factor in the observed cases while vigilantly monitoring the city's measles situation.

triage.headline_ja: チェンナイが麻疹患者を報告、医師が時宜を得たワクチン接種を強調
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹・風疹の散発例が報告されているが、前年比での増加やクラスタリングはなく、ワクチン接種率が高い（99%）ため、現時点では深刻性の証拠が限定的である。情報収集と経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 麻疹は本来的に流行しやすい疾患（epidemic-prone disease）であるため WPRO基準1つに該当。しかし記事サマリーは当局が「前年比での増加なし」と明示しており、散発例に留まっている。ワクチン接種率99%の高い地域であり、管理可能性も高い。社会的・政治的関心は公衆衛生当局レベルで存在するが、国家的・国際的危機の兆候なし。経過観察ケースとして判定。

article.articleHeadline: Taubaté confirma primeira morte por dengue em 2026, após decretar epidemia da doença
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Taubaté confirms first dengue death in 2026, after declaring a dengue epidemic.
article.articleSummary: Taubaté, Brazil, confirms its first dengue death in 2026 as it declares a dengue epidemic. The victim is an 80-year-old man from Jardim Gurilândia who died on April 5 at Taubaté Municipal University Hospital; dengue was laboratory-confirmed by Instituto Adolfo Lutz on April 22. The Vale do Paraíba region now totals five dengue fatalities in 2026, according to the São Paulo state government, with four previous deaths in Tremembé, São José dos Campos, and two in Jacareí. Health authorities urge elimination of Aedes aegypti breeding sites to curb transmission. The incident follows ongoing dengue activity in the region; no details on other cases were provided.

triage.headline_ja: タウバテが2026年のデング熱初死亡確認、流行宣言後
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル（サンパウロ州）でデング熱の死亡確認と流行宣言があり、IHR基準2項目（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常な疾病パターン）に該当。また地域流行の拡大傾向（複数自治体での死亡確認）が認められ、WPROスクリーニング基準複数項目に該当するため。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーにより、ブラジル（サンパウロ州及びパライバ州の複数地域）でのデング熱流行が確認されている。Bluedot APIの発生地域フィールドはブラジル国内の複数都市を示しており、これらはすべてブラジル国内である。対象国リストではブラジル（3469034）のみが該当するため、verified_locationsはブラジルのみとした。死亡者の確認と複数地域での患者報告があることから、管理可能性について詳細情報がないため「不明」と評価した。

article.articleHeadline: Araguaína registra maior notificação da Dengue dos últimos 14 anos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Araguaína records the highest dengue notifications in the last 14 years.
article.articleSummary: Araguaína reports the worst dengue outbreak in 14 years, with 6,231 notifications, 2,600 confirmed cases, 1,840 discarded, 1,786 under analysis, and five deaths under investigation. Compared with 2012's 1,816 confirmed and 5,853 notifications, 2026 January–April figures already exceed those levels, a 34% rise in confirmed cases. Ovitrampa surveillance found 5,091 Aedes aegypti eggs in one cycle, 44% citywide positivity, with Nova Araguaína, Lago Azul 4 (all traps positive), Araguaína Sul, Jardim dos Ipês II/III, and Setor Ana Maria most affected. Response includes targeted blocking, elimination of breeding sites, and intensified door-to-door visits. Vaccination has reached 3,813 doses for ages 15–59, totaling 4,434 with 10–14-year-olds; 15,000 doses were received, and residents are urged to visit the nearest UBS. Mutirões began April 11 in Barra da Grota (20 dumpsters, 240 m3) and April 18 in Jardim das Palmeiras do Norte (3 dumpsters, 30 m3); Carajás on April 25. Community participation is essential.

triage.headline_ja: アラグアイナ、過去14年間でデング熱の最多通報数を記録
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・トカンティン州アラグアイナにおけるデング熱の大規模アウトブレイク（過去14年間で最多）が報告されており、WPROスクリーニング基準の複数項目で該当する可能性があるが、対象国（CEPR対象国）がブラジルでなく（対象外国）、詳細な国際的拡大リスク評価には追加情報が必要。
triage.notes: 本イベントはブラジルのトカンティン州アラグアイナで発生しており、CEPR対象国リスト（ザンビア、フィリピン、タイ、ガーナ、DRC、ブラジル以外、インドネシア、中国、ミャンマー、ベトナム、インド）に含まれていません。ただし、ブラジルが対象国に含まれていないため、verified_locationsは空配列としています。IHR基準は2項目以上該当（serious_impact:Yes, unusual_unexpected:Yes）し、WPRO基準も4項目該当しており、通常であればPICKUPレベルですが、対象国外であることと国際的拡大リスク・管理可能性が不明であるため、WATCHと判定しました。

article.articleHeadline: Dia D de Enfrentamento às Arboviroses nas Escolas de Pernambuco promove ações em todo o estado
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: D-Day for Combating Arboviral Diseases in Pernambuco's Schools Promotes Actions Throughout the State
article.articleSummary: On 2026-04-24, Pernambuco state launched the Day D of Containing Arboviruses in Schools, a state-wide effort to strengthen arboviral prevention amid a climate outlook favoring a stronger outbreak. The event opened at Escola Municipal de Tempo Integral Vidal de Negreiros in the Piedade district of Jaboatão dos Guararapes. Across all municipalities, schools designed activity proposals while students carried out walks, mutirões, podcasts, and cultural-pedagogical activities. In Jaboatão, pupils highlighted practical measures to reduce mosquito breeding: emptying PET bottles, pots, and plant trays; putting sand in plant pot saucers; keeping tires in covered areas; securely tying trash bags; cleaning gutters; avoiding scrap and debris; and keeping water tanks, barrels, and other reservoirs closed. Activities featured puppet theater, a dengue rap, and a prevention parade. Eduardo Bezerra (SES-PE) underscored the need for ongoing school-based prevention, with Ana Paula de Queiroz noting the learning opportunity.

triage.headline_ja: ペルナンブーコ州の学校におけるアルボウイルス感染症との闘いの日（D-Day）が全州でアクションを展開
triage.triage_reason: デング熱の予防活動に関する記事であり、新たな発生の報告や公衆衛生危機を示す具体的な事象ではない。学校教育キャンペーンの実施は計画的な対応であり、IHR基準およびWPRO基準のいずれも満たさない。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル（ペルナンブーコ州）で実施されているが、対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations は空配列とした。内容は予防啓発キャンペーンであり、シグナルトリアージの対象となる新規感染症イベントではない。

article.articleHeadline: DF amplia vacinação contra gripe, sarampo e febre amarela em 52 pontos neste sábado - Jornal de Brasília
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Federal District expands vaccination against influenza, measles, and yellow fever at 52 sites this Saturday - Brasília Journal.
article.articleSummary: Brasília’s Health Secretariat (SES-DF) conducts a 52-site immunization drive on Saturday, April 25, 2026, across the Federal District, including Venâncio Shopping (Plano Piloto), Feira do Produtor (Ceilândia), schools in Sol Nascente and São Sebastião, and 47 basic health units in 21 administrative regions. Open to all residents, with the principal focus on influenza protection for prioritized groups: children 6 months–5 years 11 months 29 days; pregnant women; puérperas up to 45 days postpartum; seniors 60+; people with comorbidities or disabilities; indigenous and quilombolas; and health/education professionals. Required: photo ID, vaccination card, and proof of belonging to priority groups; workers may present badge or pay stub; those with chronic illness or permanent disability may need medical documentation. Additional vaccines include dengue for ages 10–14; measles and yellow fever for adults; routine pediatric vaccinations also available. No service Sunday, April 26; services resume Monday, April 27.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジル連邦直轄地区、土曜日に52か所でインフルエンザ、麻疹、黄熱病の予防接種を拡大
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は予防接種キャンペーンの実施告知であり、感染症の発生や流行を報告するイベント情報ではない。公衆衛生的脅威や異常な疾病報告の徴候を示していない。
triage.notes: 記事は感染症イベント情報ではなく、ブラジリア保健局による定期的な予防接種キャンペーンの実施案内である。疾患の発生報告や流行の徴候を含まない。シグナル対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Jharkhand health department takes proactive measures to control malaria cases
article.articleSummary: As of March 2026, Jharkhand recorded about 4,400 malaria cases, with roughly 95% concentrated in Khunti, Godda, Pakur and West Singhbhum districts—forested, hard-to-reach areas with difficult terrain and limited frontline workers. The state health department intensified vector control with larvicide spraying and distribution of long-lasting insecticide-treated nets across the state. NCVBDC selected NGO Child In Need India (CINI) to monitor four malaria-prone districts, deploying 115 volunteers—one per village—to track fever cases, ensure malaria testing, and route positive patients to nearest government facilities for full treatment. A mass fever survey is planned in June during the national anti-malaria month. The initiative also emphasizes community behaviour changes: wearing full-sleeved clothing, using nets, and preventing water stagnation to curb mosquito breeding.

triage.headline_ja: ジャルカンド州保健部門がマラリア症例制御のための積極的措置を講じる
triage.triage_reason: インドのジャルカンド州で4,400件のマラリア症例が報告されており、重症度と地理的集中の懸念がある。ただし、国家レベルの統制的対応と予防措置が実施されており、国際的拡大リスクの明示的証拠が不足しているため、経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事は既知の風土病であるマラリアの地域的流行対応を報じているもので、国家レベルの保健当局が既に積極的な統制措置（ベクターコントロール、ネット配布、コミュニティ監視、啓発活動）を実施中。IHR基準を2つ以上満たさず、WPROスクリーニングでは3つ該当するが、国家的管理可能性があり国際支援の必要性が記事から読み取れないため、WATCHレベルの判定。

article.articleHeadline: Doctors Warn of Malaria Risks in Pregnancy
article.articleSummary: Malaria during pregnancy poses elevated risks in Hyderabad, with doctors warning ahead of World Malaria Day on April 25. Pregnancy reduces immunity, making certain malaria infections more dangerous for mother and fetus. Inadequately treated malaria can cause anaemia, low blood sugar and, in severe cases, seizures, breathing difficulty and organ failure in pregnant women. Fetal risks include miscarriage, growth restriction, stillbirth, or neonatal death in later stages. Symptoms—fever, chills, headache, nausea, vomiting and body aches—should not be ignored in pregnancy. Early testing improves outcomes, and malaria is diagnosed by blood tests that may require repeat testing if symptoms persist despite an initial negative result. Safe treatment during pregnancy depends on infection type and stage and should be guided by doctors. Prevention remains crucial: use repellents, insecticide-treated nets, protective clothing and minimize travel to high-risk areas; maintain regular antenatal check-ups.

triage.headline_ja: 医師が妊娠中のマラリアのリスクを警告
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は妊娠中のマラリア感染の医学的リスクに関する一般的な啓発・警告であり、特定の流行イベント、集団発生、または異常な疾患発生の報告ではない。医療専門家による予防啓発メッセージである。
triage.notes: 記事はWorld Malaria Day（4月25日）に際した医療専門家による予防啓発の声明。ハイデラバード（テランガナ州）での具体的な流行発生や集団患者の報告ではなく、妊娠中のマラリア感染に関する医学的知識の普及。新規流行シグナルとしてはピックアップの対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Monkey carcass, illegal meat seized at US airports as officials warn of disease threats
article.articleSummary: At Chicago's O’Hare International Airport, CBP intercepted a traveler from Cameroon with a monkey carcass and, separately, a traveler from Liberia with ruminant beef concealed in dried seafood; about 125 pounds of meat were seized, plus a pound of prohibited fresh leaves and four types of seeds. The monkey remains were detained and destroyed due to significant human health concerns. U.S. Customs cited disease risks in origins, including bovine spongiform encephalopathy (mad cow disease) and foot-and-mouth disease. In Miami International Airport, CBP announced the interception of over 44 pounds of prohibited meat from Brazil. The agency emphasizes protecting U.S. borders from plant and animal diseases and pests via imported meat, bones, hair, seafood products, and other contraband. These events illustrate ongoing enforcement to mitigate import-related disease threats at major airports.

triage.headline_ja: 米国の空港で違法な肉類とサルの死骸が押収、当局が疾病脅威を警告
triage.triage_reason: 口蹄疫とBSEの検出が示唆されているが、実際の患者発生や動物での確定診断が記事に明記されていない。違法輸入品の押収事例であり、シグナル該当性の根拠が不十分。
triage.notes: 記事は米国の空港における違法肉類押収の事例報告。発生地域にはカメルーン・リベリア・ブラジルが示されているが、実際の感染症イベント発生地は対象国リストではカメルーン・リベリアを欠く。記事サマリーでブラジルからの禁止肉類押収が言及されているため、Brazilのみを verified_locations に含める。IHR基準では渡航・貿易制限リスク（1つ）のみ該当。WPROスクリーニング基準は該当なし。公開・政府関心は高いが、実際の患者発生や動物での確定事例に欠けるため、WATCH判定が適切。

article.articleHeadline: TP HCM sẵn sàng đối phó dịch bệnh mới
