article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ho Chi Minh City ready to tackle a new disease outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Ho Chi Minh City launches the Covid-19 Memory Program to learn from the pandemic and strengthen readiness for future health crises. At the 24 April kickoff, Dr. Le Truong Giang, chair of the Ho Chi Minh City Public Health Association, notes that Covid-19 receded, but WHO and epidemiologists warn of new, more dangerous pandemics. The initiative treats the past outbreak as a rehearsal to prevent past blind spots and enable proactive defense. Its three pillars—Remember, Reflect, Act—start with building a data repository on prevention and response from 2019–2023, then analytic workshops to propose actionable solutions and intervention projects to bolster the health system. Supported by France’s Ad Memoriam Institute, led by President Laetitia Atlani-Duault, the program aims to share tools and methods and develop a web platform and seminars in 2026, keeping the city ready for health emergencies.

triage.headline_ja: ホーチミン市、新たな感染症アウトブレイクに対応する準備態勢を整備
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19パンデミムの教訓を学ぶプログラムの開始についての記事。実際の新規発生や患者事例ではなく、将来の危機に備えるための準備活動である。情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 本記事は新規感染症の発生報告ではなく、ホーチミン市がCOVID-19の経験から学び将来の健康危機に備えるための『COVID-19メモリープログラム』の開始についての報道である。フランスとの国際協力が含まれているが、これは対象国に該当しないため verified_locations には含めない。現在の患者発生や異常な疾病頻度の報告がないため IHR/WPRO 基準は満たされない。

article.articleHeadline: Parasite Believed to Originate in the Americas Found in Roman Bulgaria - GreekReporter.com
article.articleSummary: Cryptosporidium parvum, Taenia, and Entamoeba histolytica were detected in mineralized deposits inside Roman chamber pots from Novae in Moesia Inferior, northern Bulgaria, dating to about 2,000 years ago. The study, led by Elena Klenina and published in npj Heritage Science, used microscopy, ancient DNA, and immunoassays on crusts formed by urine and feces to reveal human infection evidence. Cryptosporidium parvum—long linked to the Americas—also appears in this Old World context, suggesting broader ancient distribution and waterborne exposure among villa residents near the Legio I Italica camp, with Danube-derived drinking water and nearby sewers as plausible sources. Contaminated water could have infected residents; food practices and use of human waste as fertilizer might also have played a role. A chamber pot from Marcianopolis showed no parasite evidence, possibly due to cleaner water, predominantly urine deposits, or dietary differences. This Bulgarian finding advances understanding of ancient disease in the eastern Balkans.

triage.headline_ja: ローマ時代のブルガリアで発見された寄生虫はアメリカ大陸由来と考えられている - GreekReporter.com
triage.triage_reason: 本イベントは2,000年前の古代ローマ時代の歴史的な遺物から検出された古代寄生虫に関する考古学研究であり、現在の感染症危機には該当しません。現在の公衆衛生上の脅威や国際的拡大リスクはありません。
triage.notes: 本記事は古代遺跡（ローマ時代の便器から採集した鉱物化堆積物）における古代寄生虫のDNA分析に関する考古学研究です。ブルガリアおよびブラジルが地理的に言及されていますが、これは2,000年前の歴史的パターンの分析であり、現在の感染症イベントではありません。WPROスクリーニング対象国（Brazil）についても、歴史的な遺物分析が主題であるため、現在の感染症危機管理の対象外です。

article.articleHeadline: Riedel aposta em vacinação para frear chikungunya em MS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Riedel bets on vaccination to curb chikungunya in Mato Grosso do Sul.
article.articleSummary: Chikungunya vaccination is being rolled out in Mato Grosso do Sul, Brazil, to curb the outbreak. Governor Eduardo Riedel said the state joined a Ministry of Health pilot, with 20,000 doses allocated to Dourados and Itaporã. MS, a national leader in vaccination coverage at 98.3% for primary vaccines, cites dengue immunization as a successful model. Dengue vaccination data show 223,322 doses administered to the target group; MS has received 241,030 from the federal government, with 147,123 first doses and 88,420 second doses. The chikungunya schedule comprises two doses, three months apart, for children and adolescents aged 10 to 14 years, 11 months and 29 days—the group most affected by dengue hospitalizations. The outbreak has reached 63 of 79 municipalities. Actions include health care, surveillance, lab diagnosis, vector control, and interinstitutional coordination, with strong community participation to eliminate mosquito breeding sites.

triage.headline_ja: リーデルはマット・グロッソ・ド・スル州でチクングニアを抑制するためにワクチン接種に賭ける
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルでのチクングニアおよびデング熱の急速な流行拡大（63/79自治体に到達）と、政府主導のワクチン接種キャンペーンの展開が進行中であり、IHR基準およびWPRO基準を複数満たす。公衆衛生への深刻な影響と国際的広がりのリスクが存在する。
triage.notes: ブラジルはWPRO対象国ではないが、チクングニア・デング熱の流行は国際的な懸念事項。マット・グロッソ・ド・スル州での大規模ワクチン接種展開と、63自治体への急速な拡大が報告されている。デングの重症化と関連する10-14歳層への集中的な対策が実施中。

article.articleHeadline: Carcass disposal crisis puts Goa's 'rabies-controlled' status in jeopardy
article.articleSummary: Goa's status as India's first 'rabies-controlled' state is threatened by a carcass disposal crisis. Mission Rabies warns AHVS that without an approved disposal facility, rabies testing and rescue operations may be suspended, jeopardising public health and Goa's rabies-control status. The organisation has requested temporary land for scientific burial until an incinerator becomes operational. Earlier disposal occurred on government land in Curca panchayat but objections led to its discontinuation; disposal on private properties with supporters' consent has also ceased. A proposed veterinary centre at Usgao, Ponda includes plans for an in-house incinerator but is not established yet, leaving no authorised disposal option. Bengaluru's government animal funeral centre is cited as a model of dignified cremation. Over 50 animal carcasses are reported monthly due to disease, neglect or injury, hindering rabies surveillance and control.

triage.headline_ja: 犬の遺体処理危機がゴアの「狂犬病制御」ステータスを危機に瀕させている
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病は重要な人獣共通感染症であり、ゴアの公式な狂犬病制御ステータスが脅かされている点で異常・予想外である。しかし現在のところ人間への新規感染事例の報告はなく、主に行政上の遺体処理インフラの問題であるため、PICKUP前の情報確認が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はゴア州（インド）の狂犬病制御体制における遺体処理インフラの危機を報じている。現時点で人間の新規感染事例は記載されていないが、狂犬病監視と制御業務の停止可能性は公衆衛生上の懸念。続報で実際の感染事例の増加が報告される場合はPICKUPに昇格させるべき。

article.articleHeadline: ParnaÃ­ba realiza capacitaÃ§Ã£o sobre manejo clÃ­nico da dengue
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Parnaíba conducts training on the clinical management of dengue.
article.articleSummary: Parnaíba City Hall, via the Municipal Health Secretariat, conducted training for professionals in the municipal health network on clinical management of dengue. The program aims to strengthen frontline teams in dengue prevention, early recognition of warning signs, and appropriate patient care, following updated protocols from the Ministry of Health to ensure safer, more efficient, and humane services. In the face of the current epidemiological context, the administration under Mayor Francisco Emanuel reiterates a commitment to continuous professional qualification, delivering increasingly prepared and decisive care. Parnaíba reinforces integrated dengue prevention and control actions to protect the health and well-being of residents. It also emphasizes ongoing professional development and integration with broader prevention strategies.

triage.headline_ja: パルナイバはデング熱の臨床管理に関する研修を実施
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はパルナイバ市がデング熱の臨床管理に関する研修を実施したというニュースであり、新たな感染症クラスタ・アウトブレイク・確認患者の報告ではない。既知の流行への公衆衛生対応の強化に関する一般的な情報であり、IHR基準およびWPRO基準のいずれにも該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事は予防・対応強化の行政措置に関するニュースであり、新規のシグナル情報ではない。既知のデング熱流行に対する公衆衛生対応の一環としての研修実施の報道。

article.articleHeadline: Communicable Disease Control Campaign intensifies, 35 Homes Surveyed
article.articleSummary: Kanpur, 24 April 2026, conducted the Special Communicable Disease Control Campaign and Dastak Abhiyan in urban areas including Babu Lal Ka Hata and mohallas under DTC Harjender. 35 homes surveyed; 171 water containers checked with no larvae found. The team distributed pamphlets and informed residents about symptoms and preventive measures for 12 major diseases, urging prompt testing at government hospitals if symptoms appear. Asha and Anganwadi workers distributed materials; meetings with public representatives and citizens encouraged active participation. Entomological surveys identified larval breeding sites; interventions included source reduction, bleaching powder spraying in rural areas, indoor space spray, and larvicidal spraying in drains. Scrub Typhus awareness was raised. Animal Husbandry advised keeping livestock enclosures away from homes; pig farmers instructed accordingly. Helplines: 0512-2333810, 9335301096 (UHM Hospital) and 0512-2526004/2526005 (Nagar Nigam) remain active for information and complaints.

triage.headline_ja: 伝染病対策キャンペーンが強化、35軒が調査対象に
triage.triage_reason: ツツガムシ病の認識向上キャンペーンであり、制御措置と啓発活動が実施されている。ただし、具体的な患者数や重症度の報告がなく、シグナルの確実性が不足している。
triage.notes: 記事はツツガムシ病（Scrub Typhus）を含む12の主要疾患に対する予防的な伝染病対策キャンペーンの実施を報告している。患者発生や流行の具体的なデータがないため、これは制御措置と啓発活動に焦点を当てた定期的な公衆衛生活動と考えられる。ただし、ツツガムシ病は蔓延性が高く、長期的な曝露リスクがあるため、WATCH段階で継続監視が推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: Combate à dengue começa dentro de casa; veja como se prevenir
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fight against dengue begins at home; see how to protect yourself.
article.articleSummary: Inside homes, about 80% of Aedes aegypti breeding sites are found, making household prevention crucial to curb dengue, chikungunya and Zika transmission. In Pernambuco, Brazil, dengue notifications average 17 cases per day this year. From January 4 to April 18, 2026, the state recorded 1,854 dengue cases; 145 were severe (7.8%), with a daily average of 1.3 severe cases; no deaths from arboviral diseases were recorded in 2026 so far. In the same period, 60 chikungunya cases were reported, bringing total arboviroses to 1,914 in 2026. Preventive actions include keeping water tanks closed, covering tires, cleaning gutters, securing waste, adding sand to plant pots, and emptying bottles and other containers. In Recife, residents can report suspected breeding sites via SUS Ombudsman (0800-281-1520), the Conecta Recife app (Denunciar Foco de Dengue), or the city website; Asaces are authorized to identify and eliminate foci.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱対策は家の中から始まる；予防方法を確認しよう
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・ペルナンブーコ州でデング熱、チクングニア、ジカの既知の流行が報告されているが、情報が公衆衛生キャンペーン中心であり、流行増加や新興事態を示す明確な証拠がない。記事は予防啓発であり、IHR基準での異常性や国際的脅威は限定的。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル・ペルナンブーコ州でのデング熱、チクングニア、ジカの既知流行に対する予防キャンペーンを扱っている。2026年1月4日から4月18日の期間で1,854デング症例（重症145例、死亡0例）、チクングニア60例が報告されている。WPRO基準で重症度、長期曝露、流行しやすさが該当するが、本記事は新興事態というより既知流行への対応であるため、フルRRAではなく経過観察段階が適切。社会的関心（政府・住民双方の予防対応）は認められるが、国際支援必要性や異常性は限定的。

article.articleHeadline: MUNICÍPIO CONSTATA AUMENTO NOS CASOS DE DENGUE
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Municipality records an increase in dengue cases.
article.articleSummary: On 24 April 2026, the Municipal Health Secretariat reported a dengue surge in the municipality. For the period January 4–March 21, 37 cases notified and 3 confirmed. In the latest update (January 4–April 18), 119 cases notified and 17 confirmed. This corresponds to increases of about 221.6% in notified cases and 466.7% in confirmed cases, with local transmission (locally acquired). No deaths were recorded to date. Authorities warn that transmission is ongoing and urge the public to cooperate in vector control, keep properties clean, and eliminate standing water to curb Aedes aegypti breeding. Prevention is presented as a collective responsibility to contain the outbreak in the municipality.

triage.headline_ja: 市が登録したデング熱症例の増加
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルの単一自治体内でのデング熱サージ（確認症例が466.7%増加）が報告され、地域伝播が継続している。IHR基準では異常性と国際拡大リスクが該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準では異常性、流行しやすさ、管理可能性の複数基準に該当する。
triage.notes: 自治体レベルでの報告であるため影響の範囲は限定的だが、短期間での急速な症例増加（221.6〜466.7%）と継続的な地域伝播は注視が必要。デング熱は西半球での重要な公衆衛生課題であり、国際的な関心が高い。死亡報告がないことは重症度を低下させるが、蚊媒介感染症の性質上、流行しやすさ基準には該当する。

article.articleHeadline: Cientistas brasileiros desenvolvem molécula com rutênio que acelera combate à malária
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Brazilian scientists develop a ruthenium-containing molecule that speeds up the fight against malaria.
article.articleSummary: Brazilian researchers developed a ruthenium-containing molecule derived from atovaquone to fight malaria, aiming for faster action and transmission-blocking. The study, published in the Journal of Medicinal Chemistry, involved six Brazilian institutions with international collaboration from the University of Milan. The ruthenium modification produced compounds active against multiple stages of the Plasmodium life cycle, including the blood stage and human-to-mosquito transmission. In laboratory tests, the compounds rapidly reduced parasite load; experiments with infected human blood confirmed transmission blockade, and mouse studies showed significant parasitemia reduction. Drug resistance remains a major hurdle, reinforcing the need for new therapies. The work included 14 researchers (10 women) from Fiocruz Bahia, Fiocruz Amazônia, and Fundação de Medicina Tropical Heitor Vieira Dourado in Manaus. Still in early stages, further testing is required before human use, with implications for Amazon-region malaria control.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルの科学者がマラリア対策を加速させるルテニウム含有分子を開発
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は新規抗マラリア薬開発の研究成果報告であり、現在進行中の感染症アウトブレイクの報告ではない。公衆衛生上の直接的な影響や異常な疾患発生パターンは記述されていない。
triage.notes: 本記事はマラリア患者の急増や疾病発生の異常さを報告するイベント情報ではなく、ブラジルの研究機関によるin vitro・動物実験段階の新規医薬品開発研究の学術発表である。シグナルトリアージの対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Pelotas confirma primeiro caso de febre Chikungunya de 2026 | Zona Sul
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Pelotas confirms first chikungunya fever case in 2026 | South Zone
article.articleSummary: Pelotas, Brazil, in the South Zone, confirmed its first chikungunya fever case of 2026 on 24 April. The case is imported; the resident contracted the disease in another city, with identity and infection site not disclosed. The municipality records 22 chikungunya notifications under analysis, out of 98 total, with 75 discarded. In 2025 Pelotas had one confirmed chikungunya case (March). Chikungunya is an arbovirus transmitted by Aedes aegypti and resembles dengue, but often causes joint pain and swelling. Reported symptoms include high fever, intense joint pain (feet, hands, wrists), edema, rash, headache, eye pain, nausea, and gastrointestinal symptoms; the illness unfolds in three phases: acute (5–14 days), post-acute (15–90 days), chronic (>90 days), with chronic joint pain in more than 50% of cases. Regarding dengue, there are 1,754 breeding sites recorded this year; 148 notifications by residents, 100 discarded, 40 under investigation. Health teams continue house visits to control vectors.

triage.headline_ja: ペロタス市、2026年初のチクングニア熱の症例を確認
triage.triage_reason: チクングニア熱は輸入症例（他都市で感染）であり、局所的な流行の兆候は限定的。ただしデング熱との同時発生、蚊媒介感染症対策の継続報告により、今後の推移を観察する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事ではチクングニア熱は輸入症例として報告されており、ブラジル国内での活発な伝播チェーンは報告されていない。ただしアエデス属蚊による媒介ベクターが存在し、同地域でのデング熱通知数が多い（98件中、破棄75件、調査中22件）ことから、蚊媒介感染症全体の動向として継続的な監視が必要。情報不足のため「WATCH」と判定。

article.articleHeadline: Divinópolis realiza ação neste sábado para encerrar mês de combate à Doença de Chagas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Divinópolis holds an event this Saturday to conclude the month-long campaign against Chagas disease.
article.articleSummary: Divinópolis marks the end of a month-long Chagas disease campaign with a public outreach event on Saturday, 25 April 2026, from 8:00 to 13:00 at Praça da Igreja Matriz de Santo Antônio. Organized by the Municipal Health Secretariat (Semusa), the activity provides prevention-focused programming, informational materials, and an educational exhibit on Trypanosoma cruzi transmission and prevention. The Vaccination Mobile Unit (Vacimóvel) will update vaccination records. The campaign notes that Chagas is transmitted mainly via feces of the triatomine bug (“barbeiro”) and can be asymptomatic in early stages; chronic disease can cause serious heart and digestive complications. From 2025–2026, Divinópolis reported 16 confirmed chronic cases. Residents should report suspected insects to a Posto de Informação de Triatomíneos (PIT) for laboratory analysis to map risk. Treatment is available via SUS, with referrals to SAE for free medication. For questions, contact Vigilância em Saúde Ambiental at (37) 3229-6823.

triage.headline_ja: ジノポリスはシャーガス病との闘いの月を締めくくるため土曜日にイベントを開催
triage.triage_reason: シャーガス病の予防啓発キャンペーンイベントの報道であり、新規感染例の多発や異常なクラスターの報告ではない。既知の公衆衛生活動の進行状況報告に過ぎず、IHR基準・スクリーニング基準のいずれにも該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事はシャーガス病の既知の疾病対策活動（啓発キャンペーンと予防接種活動）の実施報告であり、新たな感染症危機を示さない。過去の数字（2025-2026年の16例）は既知の流行状況内である。医療システムが既に対応中であり、外部支援の必要がない。トリアージレベルは対象外。

article.articleHeadline: UP logs seven-fold drop in malaria cases since 2019
article.articleSummary: UP (Uttar Pradesh), Lucknow, reports a seven-fold drop in malaria cases since 2019, from 92,000 to 14,500 in 2025, ahead of World Malaria Day. Officials credit the National Strategic Plan for Malaria Control (2023-27) with rapid case reporting (within one day), investigation (within three days), and targeted response (within seven days). The 'test, treat and track' model underpins the effort, with frontline workers—ASHAs, ANMs, and community health officers—driving last-mile delivery. Key metrics: annual blood examination rate rose from 2.51% (2019) to 7.8%, and test positivity remained below 0.25%, signaling sensitive surveillance and early detection. Vector control targets breeding sites and larval management; public participation—preventing water stagnation, using nets, and maintaining hygiene—remains essential to interrupt transmission and sustain gains.

triage.headline_ja: インドの北部州（UP州）がマラリア症例を2019年以降で7分の1に減少
triage.triage_reason: マラリア症例の大幅な減少を報告する好ましいニュース。新規発生や急速な拡大ではなく、既存の感染症制御の成功事例であり、IHR基準やWPRO基準を満たさない。
triage.notes: 本記事はマラリア症例の減少を報告する肯定的なニュースであり、新興感染症シグナルではない。World Malaria Dayに合わせた成功事例の公表と判断される。シグナルトリアージの対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Internações por gripe crescem 92,9% no Brasil - 24/04/2026 - Equilíbrio e Saúde - Folha
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hospitalizations for influenza rose by 92.9% in Brazil.
article.articleSummary: Brazil reports 4,658 influenza hospitalizations and 259 deaths through April 18, 2026, up from 2,414 hospitalizations with 259 deaths in the same period of 2025 (roughly 92.9% more hospitalizations; deaths unchanged). A 13-year-old died in Sorocaba, São Paulo; the patient had no comorbidities and was unvaccinated, underscoring the protective role of vaccination now that immunization covers everyone over six months. High‑risk groups—older adults, children, people with chronic illnesses, and immunosuppressed individuals—remain most susceptible to Severe Acute Respiratory Infection (SARI) linked to influenza. Fiocruz Infogripe notes sustained influenza A activity across Central-West and Southeast states, with spread to parts of the Northeast and North, and declines in several states. The Health Ministry prioritizes vaccination for these groups; campaigns run through May 30, with North vaccination beginning mid‑November due to the Amazon climate. Early symptoms include fever, cough, myalgia; severe cases may progress to dyspnea, pneumonia, dehydration.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルでインフルエンザによる入院が92.9%増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で「深刻な公衆衛生への影響」「異常性」の2基準を満たし、WPROスクリーニング基準では「重症度」「流行可能性」「長期曝露」に該当。ブラジル全域での持続的なインフルエンザA活動と死亡報告があり、シグナルとして識別される。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年4月24日配信という未来日付を含んでいるが、シミュレーションデータと判断。ブラジル国内で持続的なインフルエンザA活動が報告されており、前年比で入院患者が92.9%増加。複数州（中西部、南東部、北東部、北部）での地理的な拡大が確認されている。死亡例も報告されているが、予防接種の有効性が強調されている点から管理可能性は高い。

article.articleHeadline: Cidades vacinam contra gripe, sarampo e febre amarela neste fim de semana
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cities vaccinate against influenza, measles, and yellow fever this weekend.
article.articleSummary: Weekend vaccination campaigns in the ABC region of São Paulo target influenza, yellow fever, and measles during World Immunization Week, amid rising respiratory viruses. São Bernardo do Campo hosts vaccination points at Praça da Matriz (9–13) and Praça Giovanni Breda (9–16) for flu and yellow fever, with drive-thru shifting to a post. The city’s target population is 325,000; about 73,000 flu doses have been given (≈22% coverage). São Caetano do Sul reports 11,279 flu doses; sites include UBS Maria Corbeta Segato and Centro Municipal de Imunização. Rio Grande da Serra maintains weekday vaccination with no weekend action. Santo André, Diadema, Ribeirão Pires, Mauá have no weekend drives. Vaccines remain through May 30 for influenza (60+, pregnant, health workers, comorbidities) and measles (two doses to ≤29, one to ≤59); yellow fever from 9 months. Six yellow fever cases in Vale do Paraíba and Sorocaba, three deaths, all unvaccinated.

triage.headline_ja: 都市がインフルエンザ、麻疹、黄熱病の予防接種を実施 今週末
triage.triage_reason: 黄熱病の確認症例（6例、死亡3例）と麻疹・インフルエンザの同時流行の可能性があるため注視が必要だが、現時点では予防接種キャンペーンの報道が主体であり、詳細な疫学情報が不足している。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーにおいて、Vale do ParaíbaおよびSorocaba地域での黄熱病確認症例（6例、死亡3例、全員未接種）が報告されている。これはWPRO基準の異常性・重症度・流行性・長期曝露リスクを満たすが、記事全体は予防接種キャンペーンの告知が主体であり、症例の詳細な疫学情報（発症日、感染源、接触者情報など）が不足している。フルRRA実施までには続報の収集が必要と判断し、WATCHレベルのトリアージとした。

article.articleHeadline: Caso de raiva animal é registrado em morcego na Grande BH - BH 24 Horas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rabies case recorded in a bat in Greater Belo Horizonte - BH 24 Horas.
article.articleSummary: Rabies confirmed in a bat in Betim, part of Greater Belo Horizonte (BH), Brazil. A bat found dead in the Capelinha neighborhood tested positive for the rabies virus at a reference laboratory. In response, the Center for Zoonoses and Endemias (CCZE) launched containment and preventive actions within a 500-meter radius, deploying 16 agents for home visits, public guidance, and sanitary controls. The municipality also began preventive vaccination of dogs and cats in the area to interrupt transmission and protect residents. Authorities urge pet owners to keep rabies vaccinations up to date and contact CCZE with questions. Watch for signs such as unusual aggression, excessive salivation, or apathy in animals; if bats are dead or behave abnormally in homes or public spaces, do not touch them and call CCZE for safe collection.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルのベロオリゾンテ大都市圏でコウモリから狂犬病が確認
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルの都市部でコウモリからの狂犬病確認は異常・予想外であり、人間と動物の両方に影響するが、現段階では限定的な局所対応（500m圏内）が実施されており、死亡例や大規模流行の報告がないため。
triage.notes: 記事は都市部での動物由来狂犬病確認報告。死亡例なし、対象となる対象国（WPRO地域外）。局所的な予防対応（ワクチン接種、啓発活動）が既に開始されている。コウモリからの狂犬病はブラジルで既知のリスクだが、都市部での確認は注意が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Hepatite A: Juiz de Fora chega a 600 casos em 2026 e amplia vacinação
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hepatitis A: Juiz de Fora reaches 600 cases in 2026 and expands vaccination coverage.
article.articleSummary: Juiz de Fora, Brazil, reports a Hepatitis A outbreak with 615 confirmed cases in 2026 as of April 22, the highest in a decade. In the first 15 days of April, 245 new cases (≈16/day) were recorded. The year-to-date total already surpasses all cases from 2016–2025 combined (36 in 2025; no cases in 2021–2022). Distribution spans all city regions, with the center (Centro) 189 and the south zone (Sul) 120 the most affected. Transmission is fecal-oral, linked to poor sanitation or sexual contact. Vaccination is expanded beyond the routine calendar to: children 15 months to under 5 years unvaccinated; people with liver disease, pregnant women, immunocompromised individuals; PrEP users; and contacts of confirmed cases unvaccinated. Symptoms include jaundice, dark urine, pale stools, malaise, abdominal pain, and fever; incubation 15–50 days. Prevention includes water disinfection with sodium hypochlorite, case testing, sanitary inspections, and hygiene guidance.

triage.headline_ja: A型肝炎：フレイ・ジョゼ市が2026年に600例に達し、予防接種を拡大
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準では公衆衛生への深刻な影響（615例、過去10年最高）と異常性が該当（2基準以上）。WPRO基準でも重症度・流行性・管理可能性が懸念される。国内での拡大ペース（4月中旬までに245例）が急速であり、フルRRA進行が必要。
triage.notes: ブラジル・フレイ・ジョゼ市での局地的なA型肝炎流行。2026年4月時点で615例確認され、過去10年で最高数。4月中旬だけで245例の急速な増加。糞口感染および性的接触による伝播の可能性。衛生環境の改善と予防接種拡大が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: Tuberculose cresce entre populações vulneráveis e desafia rede pública no Estado
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tuberculosis on the rise among vulnerable populations and challenges the public health system in the state.
article.articleSummary: Tuberculosis remains a rising emergency in Ceará, Brazil. In 2025, the state reported 259 TB deaths—the highest since 2015—and 4,094 confirmed cases. The epidemiological bulletin links the surge to late diagnoses, poor treatment adherence, and social vulnerability, with cases concentrated among people experiencing homelessness, incarcerated individuals, and people living with HIV. After a pandemic-related dip in 2020, later years saw patients presenting in more advanced disease, contributing to mortality. Ceará expanded diagnostic capacity, with rapid molecular testing at Lacen and higher daily testing in Fortaleza, yet post-mortem confirmations increased. Cure rate averages 60.7%, well below Brazil’s 85% target, and about 12% abandon therapy, risking ongoing transmission and resistance. Economic barriers impede care, and contact tracing remains below target. In prisons, notably Itaitinga, overcrowding compounds transmission. Measures include active case finding, primary care integration, prison screening, and expanded testing. Classic symptoms: persistent cough, fever, weight loss, chills.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルの脆弱な人口集団に広がる結核、同州の公的保健システムに課題をもたらす
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準4項目該当（異常性、重症度、長期曝露、流行しやすさ）。ブラジル内で重大な感染症アウトブレイク。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはブラジルのセアラ州におけるTB/HIV共感染アウトブレイクを報告。2025年の死亡数259件（2015年以来最高）、確定患者4,094件。ホームレス、獄中者、HIV陽性者など脆弱層に集中。治癒率60.7%は全国目標85%を大きく下回る。獄中での過密収容（Itaitinga刑務所）が伝播リスク増加。経済的障壁と治療アクセスが課題。国対象国はブラジルのみ。

article.articleHeadline: Governo de MS mobiliza estrutura e amplia ações para conter avanço da chikungunya - Perfil News
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Government of Mato Grosso do Sul mobilizes its resources and expands actions to contain the spread of Chikungunya - Perfil News
article.articleSummary: Mato Grosso do Sul, Brazil, intensifies the response to chikungunya as cases and deaths rise, with Dourados—where the disease accounts for the country’s highest case/death burden—as the epicenter. The SES-led integrated strategy strengthens care, surveillance, diagnosis, vector control, and interagency coordination across Dourados and surrounding areas. Actions include opening 15 exclusive beds for chikungunya at the Hospital Regional de Dourados and an emergency regulation flow for severe cases to shorten response times. Daily epidemiological monitoring, the State Emergency Operations Center, and Lacen-MS ensure ongoing surveillance and timely lab confirmation. Vector control covers urban and Indigenous territories, with home visits, breeding-site elimination, insecticides, and public guidance, aided by trained endemic agents and Army support, plus Defense Civil logistics. Vaccination is piloted with initial doses for Dourados and Itaporã. Citizens are advised to eliminate standing water, cover water tanks, use repellents, and seek care for fever and joint pains.

triage.headline_ja: マットグロッソドスル州政府がチクングニア熱の拡大抑制へ構造を動員し対策を拡充 - Perfil News
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル国内でチクングニア熱の症例・死亡数が増加し、国が対応を強化している異常事態。公衆衛生への深刻な影響が確認されており、IHR基準2項目以上該当、WPRO基準も複数該当のため、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: Douradosは「ブラジル国内で最高の症例/死亡負担」とされており、地域内の流行の中核。ワクチン接種パイロット、陸軍支援を含む包括的な対応が展開中。チクングニア熱は蚊媒介感染症で流行性が高く、死亡報告がある重症事例の存在が確認されている。

article.articleHeadline: Post-rain heat fuels dengue spread
article.articleSummary: As of 24 April 2026, post-rain heat heightens dengue risk in Rawalpindi and Islamabad, prompting an accelerated anti-dengue drive. About 900 female and 110 male workers have been deployed to dengue hotspot union councils, with 1,000 additional female workers recruitment underway. The Dengue Prevention Act is enforced through November 15, including case registration and property sealing. Joint health operations are planned for border areas, with teams from Rawalpindi and Islamabad targeting zones from Faizabad to Tarnol and both sides of the Islamabad Expressway. Insecticide sprays and equipment have arrived in Rawalpindi from Lahore’s Director General Health Office. Responsibilities are divided across departments: Education for schools, Civil Defence for multi-storey buildings and basements, Environment for tyre shops and open areas, PHA for parks and green belts, and municipal corporations for graveyards and vacant plots, with daily reports to the Deputy Commissioner.

triage.headline_ja: 雨後の熱がデング熱の蔓延を加速させる
triage.triage_reason: パキスタンのラワルピンディ・イスラマバッド地域でデング熱の増加が報告されており、スクリーニング基準（異常/予想外、流行しやすさ）に該当する可能性があるが、死亡者や重症例に関する記載がなく、公衆衛生への深刻な影響の程度が不明であるため、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 発生地域にインドのUttar Pradesh州が含まれており、サマリーでも記載されているため、Indiaをverified_locationsに含める。パキスタン（GeoNames ID 1168579）は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。雨後の気象変化がデング媒介蚊の繁殖を促進している点は環境的に異常であり、大規模な防除活動が展開されていることから流行しやすい状況と判断される。ただし、症例数や重症度に関する具体的な数値がなく、情報不足のためWATCH判定とした。

article.articleHeadline: Leprosy in India: An unfinished challenge needing urgent partnerships
article.articleSummary: On 24 April 2026, No Leprosy Remains (NLR) India commemorated 27 years of work to eliminate leprosy and its stigma, urging intensified last-mile interventions and stronger partnerships, including corporate involvement. The event united policymakers, public health experts, development partners and community members to emphasize that although medical treatment for leprosy is widely available, reaching underserved communities remains a critical barrier. Dutch ambassador Marisa Gerards highlighted inclusive collaboration and the goal that no one is left behind. Organisers noted ongoing collaboration with national programmes to boost eradication efforts and outreach to vulnerable groups. A resident of Jeevan Deep Kushth Ashram in Delhi, Bhimwati, shared experiences of stigma post-treatment, underscoring social barriers to education, employment and mental health. NLR India urged expanded CSR and public-private partnerships to accelerate early detection, access to care and social inclusion.

triage.headline_ja: インドのハンセン病：早急なパートナーシップが必要な未完の課題
triage.triage_reason: ハンセン病は慢性感染症で、インドで継続的な公衆衛生課題として認識されているが、記事は27年間の根絶活動の節目イベント報道であり、急性的な新規発生・拡大のシグナルではない。社会的・政治的関心は存在するが、IHR基準やWPRO基準の該当は限定的。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はハンセン病根絶イベントの記念報道であり、新規発生やアウトブレイクの報告ではない。ハンセン病は対象国（インド）で継続的な公衆衛生課題として認識されており、長期曝露（prolonged_exposure）と管理可能性（manageability）の観点からスクリーニング基準に該当するが、社会的関心は存在するものの緊急性は低い。続報で急性的な流行拡大の報告があれば判定を上げることが必要。

article.articleHeadline: El cólera retrocede en África, pero la guerra amenaza con reavivarlo: "Hay áreas aisladas a donde no llegan los recursos por falta de seguridad"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cholera recedes in Africa, but war threatens to rekindle it: "There are isolated areas where resources do not reach due to lack of security."
article.articleSummary: Cholera in Africa shows a misleading decline in early 2026, with 30,940 diagnoses—less than half of 77,861 in early 2025 and well below 2024–2023 figures. A 2025 emergency strategy, driven by global vaccine shortages, deployed a single-dose regimen and distributed 51 million doses, providing 1–2 years of immunity versus about five years for full schedules; the approach aimed to stretch limited supplies while investments in water and sanitation continue. The Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Mozambique together account for ~80% of African infections, with the DRC responsible for 84% of deaths. Ongoing conflict, notably the M23 rebel presence in the DRC and attacks on health facilities in Goma and Bukavu, has triggered massive displacement (over 1 million in Ituri and North/South Kivu in 2025). UNHCR notes >84,000 Congolese fled to Burundi, with camps overwhelmed and water shortages heightening outbreak risk; reported cholera symptoms include stomach pain, vomiting and diarrhea.

triage.headline_ja: コレラはアフリカで減少するも、戦争が再燃の脅威：「安全性の欠如により資源が到達しない孤立地域がある」
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。スクリーニング基準4項目該当（重症度、長期曝露、流行しやすさ、管理可能性）。紛争による医療施設崩壊と大規模難民移動により、感染再拡大が懸念される。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCとモザンビークを主要な感染地として述べているが、対象国リストではDRCのみが該当。DRC内の紛争（M23反乱勢力）、医療施設への攻撃、大規模難民流出（ブルンジへ84,000人以上）により、感染制御の管理可能性が著しく低下している。2026年初頭の診断数減少は、ワクチン戦略と低用量レジメン導入の結果だが、紛争による医療へのアクセス制限が根本的課題として指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: Mais dois morcegos com raiva são identificados em Campo Grande e total chega a 8 casos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Two more rabid bats identified in Campo Grande, bringing the total to eight cases.
article.articleSummary: Two more rabid bats identified in Campo Grande, Brazil, bringing the 2026 total to eight rabies-positive specimens. Urban detection occurred in the Centro and São Francisco districts, as part of the 502 bats collected up to 23 April 2026 by the Centro de Controle de Zoonoses (CCZ). Veterinary epidemiologist Maria Aparecida Conche Cunha said CCZ surveillance targets suspected cases and does not perform urban bat population control, noting that not all bats are infected. She indicated no sharp rise in infected bats, but higher submission of animals by residents. Advice: isolate any bat found on the ground, living or dead, avoid touching it, prevent contact with dogs and cats, and call CCZ for collection. Prevention emphasizes annual rabies vaccination of dogs and cats. Sesau notes no large-scale bat-control in natural habitats; killing bats is illegal and ecologically detrimental.

triage.headline_ja: カンポグランデで狂犬病の2羽のコウモリが新たに確認され、総数が8例に達する
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルで動物由来感染症（狂犬病）の継続的な検出が報告されており、公衆衛生監視対象事象だが、人間への感染事例は報告されておらず、流行の加速傾向も示唆されていない。情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 狂犬病は動物由来感染症であり、コウモリからの検出が主。人間への感染リスクはあるが、現段階では人間患者の報告なし。公衆衛生当局(CCZ、Sesau)が積極的に監視・予防対策を実施しており、管理可能と評価。都市部でのコウモリ検出が継続しているため、人間への曝露リスクは存在（prolonged exposure, epidemic prone基準該当）。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue: confirman reaparición del serotipo DENV-3, importado de Brasil - Nacionales - ABC Color
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue: Reappearance of the DENV-3 serotype confirmed, imported from Brazil - National - ABC Color.
article.articleSummary: Dengue virus serotype DENV-3 has reappeared in Paraguay, detected in Asunción in a traveler from Brazil, marking the first confirmed DENV-3 case in nearly a decade. Reintroduction raises concern due to a large susceptible population, since most Paraguayans born after 2007 and those not infected in 2016 lack immunity; the last major epidemic was 2006–2007. The case is confirmed and linked to international travel. In the past three weeks, 29 confirmed dengue cases have been reported across Asunción, Central, Concepción and Presidente Hayes; year-to-date total 157. Two hospitalizations (Villa Hayes and Villa Elisa) with discharge; no deaths. Chikungunya has 10 confirmed cases, including three imported from Bolivia. Nine regions show rising notifications; Limpio outbreak is in decline. Vaccination is urged for ages 6–39, and early medical consultation is advised for fever or headache.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱：ブラジルからの輸入DENV-3型の再出現が確認される
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で2項目該当（異常性・国際的拡大リスク）。新しい病原体血清型の再導入と大規模感染感受性人口の存在により、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域リストにはパラグアイが含まれていないが、記事サマリーから主要な発生地はパラグアイ（アスンシオン）である。ただし対象国リストにはパラグアイが含まれていないため、verified_locationsにはブラジルのみを記載。事例がブラジルからの輸入症例として明示されているためブラジルは該当。チクングニアも同時発生しており、複数の感染症流行の兆候。

article.articleHeadline: Amoebic Brain Infections on the Rise: Health Alerts Across Kerala and the U.S. As Summer Heat Increases Risk - News Directory 3
article.articleSummary: Amoebic brain infections are rising in Kerala, with public health advisories issued as warmer months raise waterborne exposure risk. The infections are caused by Naegleria fowleri and Acanthamoeba, with Acanthamoeba and Balamuthia capable of causing granulomatous amoebic encephalitis under subacute–chronic courses. Authorities warn that untreated water from wells, tanks, and other sources, plus swimming pools and water storage systems, heighten transmission during summer. Public guidance emphasizes avoiding bathing or washing the face with untreated water and maintaining rigorous hygiene, including chlorination of water storage and pools. Symptoms to monitor after freshwater exposure include headache, fever, nausea, and neurological changes; seek immediate medical attention if they occur. The surge is being monitored in Kerala, with broader alerts referenced for the U.S.; no case counts or fatalities are provided in the report.

triage.headline_ja: アメーバ性脳感染症が増加：ケーララ州と米国での保健警告、夏の気温上昇がリスクを増加
triage.triage_reason: ケーララ州（インド）における未知の脳脊髄炎（アメーバ性脳炎）の増加報告。神経学的重症度が高く、IHR基準の異常性・予想外性、重症度基準を満たし、シグナルとしてピックアップ対象。
triage.notes: 記事はケーララ州（インド）でのアメーバ性脳炎（Naegleria fowleri、Acanthamoeba）の増加と公衆衛生警告に焦点。米国への言及は存在するが、記事サマリーではインドでの発生が主題。具体的な症例数や死亡者数が報告されていないため、重症度の詳細は不明だが、神経学的症状と対症療法の重要性から中等度以上の重症性が示唆される。季節的要因（夏の気温上昇による水系感染リスク）により、今後の発生増加が予測される。

article.articleHeadline: Antônio Dias realiza ação de controle e prevenção de zoonoses na comunidade de São José da Barrinha
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Antônio Dias carries out a zoonoses control and prevention action in the São José da Barrinha community.
article.articleSummary: On 24 April 2026, Antônio Dias' municipal zoonoses team carried out an awareness, prevention and control action in the São José da Barrinha community to address diseases transmitted from animals to humans, including Rocky Mountain spotted fever, Leishmaniasis, Rabies, Dengue and other arboviruses. In rural settings, zoonoses remain a major public health challenge due to frequent human-animal contact. Rocky Mountain spotted fever (tick-borne) and Leishmaniasis (sandfly-borne) can become severe if not diagnosed and treated early. Rabies remains vaccine-preventable but requires ongoing vigilance; Dengue and other arboviruses require sustained vector control. The outreach emphasizes risk communication, transmission routes, and protective measures, highlighting the essential role of health surveillance in protecting vulnerable communities.

triage.headline_ja: アントニオ・ディアスがサンジョゼ・ダ・バリーニャコミュニティでズーノーシス（人獣共通感染症）の制御と予防活動を実施
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルにおけるズーノーシス予防活動の報道であり、複数の疾患（狂犬病、ロッキー山紅斑熱、リーシュマニア症、デング）が言及されているが、具体的な患者数、重症度、流行拡大の証拠が明記されていない。啓発・予防活動の実施報告であり、進行中の疫学的危機ではなく、継続的な経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事は自治体による定期的なズーノーシス対策プログラムの実施報告であり、新規の流行事例ではない。農村地域での人動物接触が継続的なリスク要因として指摘されており、長期曝露と流行傾向性の基準は該当するが、具体的患者情報や異常事態の発生が記述されていないため、シグナルとしてはWATCHレベルが適切。

article.articleHeadline: Nový virus z moře může napadat oči. Odborníci připouštějí, že může unikat diagnóze
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A new virus from the sea could attack the eyes. Experts acknowledge that it could go undiagnosed.
article.articleSummary: CMNV (covert mortality nodavirus), previously linked to aquatic animals, has been reported in humans and may cause persistent ocular hypertensive viral uveitis (POH-VAU), an inflammatory eye disease with elevated intraocular pressure that can threaten vision. As of 2026-04-24, no confirmed cases in the Czech Republic or Europe. China has described several cases; however, the Czech Republic reports none. Experts warn POH-VAU can resemble other uveitis forms, risking underdiagnosis. The Czech SZÚ notes limited data on CMNV’s human impact and that risk to the general population remains uncertain but nonzero. Transmission appears to occur mainly via contact with aquatic animals and consumption of raw or inadequately cooked seafood, especially during handling of fish or crustaceans without protection or with skin injuries. Freezing may not inactivate the virus; adequate heat treatment is required. EU surveillance has not flagged the issue; clinicians should consider POH-VAU in chronic anterior uveitis with high IOP.

triage.headline_ja: 海から新たなウイルスが眼を攻撃する可能性。専門家は診断を逃れる可能性があることを認める
triage.triage_reason: 新規病原体（CMNV）の人間への感染報告があり、眼疾患を引き起こす可能性があるため注視が必要。ただし対象国での確定症例がなく、情報が限定的で、国際的な公開文献での確認が不明確なため、フルRRA前段階の経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事はチェコのメディアであるが、主題は海洋動物由来のCMNVとその人間への感染可能性。チェコでの確定症例なし、中国で症例報告あり。対象国はChinaのみ。疾患が『Unknown Illness』と分類されており、病原体や臨床像の詳細が限定的。EUレベルでの監視警報なし。海産物消費を通じた長期曝露のリスク指摘があるため、WPRO基準の『prolonged_exposure』でYes。ただし国際的な拡大リスク、深刻な影響、管理可能性について情報不足のため、WATCHレベルとしました。

article.articleHeadline: Kerala health minister calls for caution over amoebic meningoencephalitis
article.articleSummary: Kerala braces for a possible rise in amoebic meningoencephalitis this summer, says Health Minister Veena George. Citizens are urged to avoid bathing or face washing in contaminated water; chlorinate wells, tanks, swimming pools, spas and water parks; avoid swimming in stagnant water; use a nose clip; never rinse the nose with unboiled water; keep water sources clean and tanks cleaned every three months. Public-water quality should be monitored, and those with meningitis symptoms should seek medical attention promptly. Amoebic meningoencephalitis is caused by Acanthamoeba and Naegleria fowleri found in warm lakes, ponds and polluted pools, entering via the nose; weakened immune systems and wounds increase risk. Kerala’s labs—Thiruvananthapuram public health lab, Thonnakkal IAV, and Kozhikode medical college microbiology—can detect amoebas with species identification and molecular diagnosis. Global mortality is high (Naegleria fowleri ~99%, Acanthamoeba 70–90%), but Kerala reduced to about 24% via early detection, a special protocol, and ICMR collaboration; ongoing surveillance and public-health measures as of 2026-04-24.

triage.headline_ja: ケララ保健大臣、アメーバ性髄膜脳炎に注意を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: アメーバ性髄膜脳炎は高い致死率（グローバル99%程度）を持つ重篤な感染症であり、ケララ州での夏季流行増加の可能性が指摘されている。保健大臣による公式警告と複数地域での検査能力の整備は、公衆衛生上の影響が深刻で異常な事態である可能性を示唆している。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはケララ州（インド）での夏季流行リスク増加に焦点を当てており、保健大臣による公式警告と具体的な予防措置の通達が記載されている。Naegleria fowleriおよびAcanthamoeba属による感染症であり、グローバル致死率は非常に高い（99%程度）が、ケララでは24%程度に低下している点は地域の検査能力と対応体制の向上を示唆している。水環境（温かい湖沼、汚染されたプール）が暖候期に増殖条件を満たす可能性が高く、環境監視と公衆衛生対策が重要課題となっている。

article.articleHeadline: COE publica Plano de Ação Incidente para enfrentar epidemia de Chikungunya
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Emergency Operations Center publishes Incident Action Plan to address the Chikungunya outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Chikungunya outbreak response plan by the City of Dourados establishes a Public Health Emergency Operations Center (COE-Chikungunya) to coordinate interventions in the Indigenous Reserve and urban area. The 36-page Incident Action Plan lays out strategic axes for planning, operation, monitoring, and evaluation, prioritizing expanded access, improved diagnosis, and reduced morbidity and mortality, with Primary Health Care as the organizing axis. It mandates permanent coordination between municipal management and the Mato Grosso do Sul Special Indigenous District (DSEI-MS) to respect sociocultural particularities and ensure equitable access. The plan prioritizes organizing the health network, enhancing diagnostic capacity, standardizing workflows, and risk-stratified clinical management with rapid case referrals. It also emphasizes intersectoral integration, ongoing workforce development, and robust information management to inform decision-making. Key challenges include governance, inter-institutional coordination, resource planning, transparency, and logistics.

triage.headline_ja: チクングニヤ流行に対処するための緊急対応計画を公開 - ドゥラードス市
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルのチクングニヤアウトブレイク対応計画の公表であり、異常・予想外な疾患発生の新規報告ではなく、既知の流行への対応策の策定段階。IHR基準2つ以上に該当する明確な証拠がない一方、社会的関心と政府の積極対応が確認できるため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 本記事は既知のチクングニヤ流行（ブラジル・マットグロッソ・ド・スル州ドゥラードス市）への対応計画の公表であり、新規アウトブレイクの報告ではない。政府による公式な対応体制整備が示されているが、IHR基準では2つ以上の該当が必要であり、現段階では「unusual/unexpected」の基準に該当しない。WPROスクリーニング基準では重症度・持続的曝露・流行傾向・管理対応で複数該当し、社会政治的関心も高いため、WATCH判定が妥当。引き続き流行規模・死亡数・地理的拡大の動向を監視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Ministério da Saúde alerta para risco de sarampo com a Copa de 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Health Warns of Measles Risk Ahead of the 2026 World Cup
article.articleSummary: Measles risk ahead of the 2026 World Cup: As of 24 April 2026, the Ministry of Health issued a technical note warning about the potential spread of measles within the country, due to World Cup games to be held in regions with significant measles activity. The notice stresses vigilance to prevent transmission during the tournament and underscores the importance of maintaining vaccination coverage. The article does not provide case counts, laboratory confirmation details, or identification of specific regions. No specific dates for outbreaks or vaccination campaigns are given. Officials emphasize preparedness across health systems to manage possible cases during the World Cup, while the note signals proactive public health measures to prevent measles amplification during the global event.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省、2026年ワールドカップに向けた麻疹リスクについて警告
triage.triage_reason: 2026年ワールドカップ開催に伴う麻疹の国際的拡大リスクが示唆されており、WPROスクリーニング基準（異常性・流行しやすさ）に該当する可能性があるが、具体的な症例数、確定診断、発生地域の詳細が記事に記載されていないため、情報不足の段階にとどまる。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年ワールドカップ開催に伴う麻疹リスクについての保健省警告であり、IHR基準2つ以上該当・WPROスクリーニング基準3つ以上該当している。しかし、具体的な症例数、確定診断例、具体的な発生地域の特定、現在の流行状況の詳細が記載されていない。将来的な大規模イベント開催に伴う予防的警告の性質が強い。続報により具体的な患者情報が追加される場合はPICKUPへの昇格を推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Students take lead in Gautam Budh Nagar malaria awareness campaign
article.articleSummary: Malaria awareness campaign launched in Gautam Budh Nagar district (Noida, Greater Noida, and Yamuna Expressway area) ahead of the monsoon. Government and private schools will hold malaria awareness sessions during morning assemblies; students will take a 'Malaria Warriors' pledge to identify and eliminate mosquito breeding spots in homes and neighborhoods. The 2026 global theme is 'Driven to End Malaria: Now We Can, Now We Must.' The district-wide effort is coordinated by health, education and panchayati raj departments, with Noida, Greater Noida, and Yamuna Expressway Industrial Development Authority involvement. Activities include street plays, rallies, and rangoli to promote cleanliness and prevent waterlogging; civic bodies will conduct public pledge ceremonies and outreach in slum clusters. Emphasis is on preventing stagnant water and sanitation to curb mosquito-borne diseases before the monsoon.

triage.headline_ja: 学生たちがガウタム・ブッダ・ナガル地区のマラリア啓発キャンペーンを主導
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はマラリア啓発キャンペーンの報道であり、感染症の発生・増加を報告するものではない。予防活動や公衆衛生教育の実施についての報道であり、新規患者の増加、深刻な健康被害、または異常な感染症事象は報告されていない。
triage.notes: 本記事はマラリア啓発キャンペーンの実施についての報道であり、感染症イベント（患者増加、アウトブレイク、異常な疾患発生）ではない。政府部門による予防教育活動の実施報告であり、シグナルトリアージの対象外。

article.articleHeadline: São Roque reforça vacinação contra febre amarela após novos casos no Estado | TVS+
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: São Roque steps up yellow fever vaccination after new cases in the state | TVS+
article.articleSummary: Yellow fever cases confirmed in São Paulo state prompt intensified vaccination in São Roque. A confirmed case in Araçariguama, about 16 km from São Roque, raises alert; some cases have progressed to death, and all deceased patients were unvaccinated. São Roque’s vaccination coverage is above 88%, with no recorded yellow fever cases in 2025 or 2026. In 2026, the municipality administered 736 vaccine doses; in 2025, 3,217 doses were given. Yellow fever is transmitted by the bite of infected mosquitoes, and vaccination remains the principal prevention to limit virus circulation. The report emphasizes maintaining high vaccination coverage to protect residents as new cases appear in the state.

triage.headline_ja: サンロッケ州内の新規感染事例に続き黄熱病ワクチン接種を強化
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・サンパウロ州での黄熱病の確認症例、死亡例の報告があり、IHR基準（重大な公衆衛生影響・予想外の事例）を満たす。スクリーニング基準でも重症度（死亡例あり）・流行可能性（蚊媒介感染）で複数該当し、地域での予防対応が進行中であることから、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル・サンパウロ州内での黄熱病確認事例に基づき、サンロッケ市でワクチン接種強化が進行中と明記。Araçariguamaで確認症例あり、未接種者を含む死亡報告あり。蚊媒介感染の特性上、流行継続のリスクあり。2026年の新規ワクチン接種は限定的（736件）であり、カバレッジ維持が課題。

article.articleHeadline: อันตรายอาหารดิบ อร่อยแต่เสี่ยงดับไม่รู้ตัว ต้องระวังทั้งภัยจากเชื้อโรคและพยาธิ   | เดลินิวส์
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The danger of raw foods: tasty but risky, you could drop dead without warning; beware of threats from pathogens and parasites.
article.articleSummary: Raw shrimp soaked in fish sauce can transmit Vibrio parahaemolyticus, causing severe gastroenteritis and potentially septicemic illness. In October 2025, a Thai online seller was hospitalized after consuming homemade shrimp-in-fish-sauce, requiring surgery for a parasitic infection that extended to the eye. Separately, a child developed eye swelling, dizziness, vomiting, fever, jaundice, and memory problems linked to raw shrimp, culminating in death. The article warns that raw or undercooked foods, including shrimp and oysters, can harbor parasites and bacteria. Vibrio infections typically appear 1–3 days after ingestion, with diarrhea, cramps, vomiting, and fever; vulnerable groups—elderly, diabetes, liver or kidney disease, and immunocompromised—are at higher risk of bloodstream spread and severe outcomes. Preventive advice includes eating hot foods, using clean utensils, washing hands, selecting fresh shrimp, thoroughly cleaning/deveining, and proper storage. Some foods are frozen to -35°C to kill parasites, but not all raw items are safe.

triage.headline_ja: 生食の危険性：美味しいが危険、気づかないうちに死ぬ可能性も；病原体と寄生虫の脅威に注意
triage.triage_reason: Vibrio parahaemolyticus感染による死亡事例と複数の重症患者が報告されており、スクリーニング基準で重症度と流行しやすさに該当する。しかし、これは食品安全に関する啓発記事であり、アクティブな大規模流行イベントの報告ではない点から、続報を注視して初期スクリーニングに留める。
triage.notes: 記事は個別の死亡事例および重症患者を報告しており、Vibrio parahaemolyticus感染による重症度の高いケースが複数存在することを示唆している。食品安全の啓発記事としての性質が強いが、生食を介した病原体感染のリスクが組織的に存在する可能性がある。今後、類似事例の集積報告やアウトブレイク兆候の有無を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Ministério da Saúde alerta sobre o risco de sarampo na Copa do Mundo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Health warns about the risk of measles during the World Cup.
article.articleSummary: Measles risk tied to the 2026 World Cup (June 11–July 19) across the United States, Canada and Mexico. Brazil’s Health Ministry warns that large events increase cross-border transmission risk; the Americas region is rated very high, though Brazil remains free of endemic transmission. In 2025 Canada reported 5,062 cases; 2026: 124. Mexico recorded 6,152 cases in 2025 and 1,190 in January 2026; the United States had 2,144 cases in 2025 and 721 in January 2026. Brazil logged 3,952 suspected cases in 2025 (3,841 discarded, 38 confirmed; 10 imported, 25 travel-related, 3 unknown; nearly all unvaccinated). In 2026, 232 suspected cases with 2 confirmed: a São Paulo child who traveled to Bolivia and a 22-year-old in Rio de Janeiro; neither vaccinated. Vaccination is the main prevention; travelers should verify status before departure. Schedules: 6–11 months one dose before travel; 1–29 years two doses; 30–59 years at least one dose 15 days prior. Transmitted by respiratory droplets; symptoms start flu-like, then a red rash; complications include pneumonia, otitis, encephalitis, and death in children.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省、ワールドカップ中の麻疹リスクについて警告
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹の国際的拡大リスク（2026年ワールドカップ関連）が明確で、IHR基準3つ以上該当。ブラジルで確認症例があり、米国・カナダ・メキシコでの感染者が増加中。社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは米国、カナダ、メキシコでの麻疹流行を述べているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。ブラジルのみ対象国リストに該当し、2026年に確認症例（サンパウロとリオデジャネイロ）がある。2026年ワールドカップ開催（米国）に関連した国際的な麻疹伝播リスクが主要な懸念。

article.articleHeadline: Ancient "Syphilis-Like" Disease in Vietnam Challenges Key Scientific Assumptions
article.articleSummary: Three of 309 individuals from 16 Vietnamese sites, dating 10,000–1,000 years before present, show clear markers of congenital treponematosis (treponemal diseases including syphilis, yaws, endemic syphilis). Two cases come from Man Bac in northern Vietnam, with infections predominantly affecting children and adolescents, patterns typical of non-venereal disease spread via skin contact. The remains date to about 3,500 years ago. The findings challenge the assumption that congenital infection is a reliable indicator of venereal syphilis and suggest congenital transmission occurred in non-venereal treponematoses as well. This has implications for the origin debate of syphilis, arguing that congenital infection alone cannot distinguish venereal syphilis from related diseases. Yaws remains a key example of a non-venereal treponemal disease—affecting more than 150,000 people worldwide. The study also notes challenges in ancient DNA recovery in tropical Southeast Asia and ethical considerations for biomolecular work.

triage.headline_ja: ベトナムの古代梅毒様疾患が科学的仮説に異議を唱える
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は10,000～1,000年前の古代遺跡から発見された過去の感染症に関する考古学的研究報告であり、現在進行形の感染症アウトブレイク・パブリックヘルス危機ではない。IHR基準およびWPRO基準のいずれにも該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事は考古学的研究（古代骨格遺跡の分析）であり、現在のウイルスサーベイランス・感染症危機管理の対象外。現在進行形の患者発生・流行は記載されていない。よって対象国の検証は不要。

article.articleHeadline: Cuộc chiến chống bệnh sốt rét: Đích đến trong tầm tay
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Battle Against Malaria: A Goal Within Reach
article.articleSummary: Malaria remains a threat in Kyamuyimbwa, Uganda (pop ~22,000), where Imelda’s story underscores the toll on mothers; preventive treatment and bed nets helped protect her next pregnancy. Since 2000, global malaria programs have averted about 2.3 billion cases and 14 million deaths, with 48 countries/territories eliminating malaria and three new eliminations in 2025. In the Greater Mekong subregion, cases fell nearly 90% despite drug resistance. Endemic countries declined from 108 in 2000 to ~80 in 2024; those reporting under 10,000 cases rose from 27 to 46. Progress is driven by vaccines, better medicines, vector control, and innovations like gene-modified mosquitoes and long-acting injectables, enabling proactive, sustainable control. Yet 2024 recorded 282 million cases and 610,000 deaths; challenges include artemisinin and pyrethroid resistance, urban Anopheles stephensi, and diagnostic mutations. Global malaria funding in 2024 was $3.9B vs $9.3B needed for 2025, a $5.4B gap. World Malaria Day 2026 theme calls for resolve; examples include Mauritius and China; Vietnam reports 2025: 246 cases, early 2026: 25, near elimination by 2030.

triage.headline_ja: マラリアとの戦い：手の届くところにある目標
triage.triage_reason: マラリアは継続的な世界的脅威であり、複数の対象国で言及されているが、記事は主にグローバルな進捗レポートと成功事例の報告であり、アウトブレイクや急速な拡大の兆候は明記されていない。情報不足の中での経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事はマラリア対策の進捗を報道する社説的内容であり、新規アウトブレイク警告ではない。ウガンダのKyamuyimbwaでの事例言及があるが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため検証位置に除外。IHR基準2以上該当しWPRO基準も複数該当するが、記事の性質が進捗報告であり緊急性の高いシグナルではない点を考慮しWATCH判定とした。資金ギャップ（$5.4B）と薬剤耐性の課題は管理可能性への懸念を示す。

article.articleHeadline: Palminópolis reforça vacinação contra Influenza após Goiás decretar situação de emergência
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Palminópolis reinforces influenza vaccination after Goiás declared a state of emergency.
article.articleSummary: Influenza vaccination drive intensified in Palminópolis after Goiás state declared a public health emergency due to rising influenza cases. The Municipal Health Secretariat announced vaccine availability for priority groups and urged residents in these groups to visit the municipal Basic Health Unit (UBS) to get vaccinated, carrying their vaccination card to update records. The campaign aims to increase vaccination coverage and reduce risk of complications, particularly for the elderly, children, pregnant women, and people with comorbidities. Influenza is a viral respiratory infection with potential to cause severe illness. With the surge in Goiás, health authorities emphasize prevention and vaccination. The Secretariat states staff are ready to serve and residents should check at the UBS for vaccination hours and eligibility criteria.

triage.headline_ja: ゴイアス州が緊急事態を宣言した後、パルミノーポリスがインフルエンザワクチン接種を強化
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルのゴイアス州でインフルエンザ症例の増加に伴い公衆衛生上の緊急事態が宣言されたが、具体的な症例数、重症度、死亡数などの詳細情報が不足しており、国際的拡大リスクについても不明。追加情報の収集が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はポルトガル語で、ゴイアス州パルミノーポリス市でのインフルエンザワクチン接種強化キャンペーンについて述べている。公衆衛生上の緊急事態宣言がなされており、政府・公的機関の関心は高いが、具体的な患者数、入院数、死亡数などの重症度に関する情報が記事に明記されていない。インフルエンザは流行しやすい呼吸器感染症で、ヒト-ヒト感染が容易である。ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に記載した。

article.articleHeadline: 'Vaca louca' e a doação de sangue no Brasil - 24/04/2026 - Tv Folha - Folha
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 'Mad cow disease' and blood donation in Brazil - April 24, 2026 - Tv Folha - Folha
article.articleSummary: Brazil restricts blood donation for people who lived in Europe due to concerns about Bovine Spongiform Encephalopathy (BSE, mad cow disease) and the risk of transmitting the human form, variant Creutzfeldt-Jakob disease (vCJD). BSE affects cattle and is caused by prions that damage neurons; vCJD is fatal in humans. Europe’s BSE outbreak began in the United Kingdom in 1986; the 1993 peak exceeded 100,000 cattle cases, with spread to other European countries. Worldwide, 233 people have contracted vCJD, with the last case recorded about a decade ago. There is no blood test to detect prions, underpinning precautionary measures in Brazil: donors who spent more than five years in Europe after 1980, or more than three months in the United Kingdom or Ireland between 1980-1996, are barred. Brazil has never reported a human vCJD case and the Health Ministry is reviewing these rules against international practices.

triage.headline_ja: 「狂牛病」とブラジルでの献血 - 2026年4月24日
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルが欧州滞在歴のある献血者の制限を実施している予防措置であり、実際の症例発生ではなく政策対応である。WPROスクリーニング基準の該当は限定的で、情報不足が多い。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジルの献血制限政策に関するもので、実際のvCJD症例発生やBSEの新規確認ではない。ブラジルは人間のvCJD症例を報告していない。欧州（英国・アイルランド）での歴史的なBSE流行への対応として理解される。国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念を反映しているが、現在の発生シグナルではないため、WATCH段階の継続観察が適切である。

article.articleHeadline: Ministério da Saúde alerta sobre o risco de sarampo na Copa do Mundo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Health Warns About the Risk of Measles at the World Cup.
article.articleSummary: Measles risk at the FIFA World Cup across the United States, Mexico, and Canada (June 11–July 19, 2026) prompts Brazil’s Health Ministry to warn about transmission during mass gatherings. The Americas risk is rated very high. Canada: 5,062 measles cases in 2025; 124 in 2026 so far. Mexico: 7 cases in 2024; 6,152 in 2025; 1,190 in January 2026 (preliminary). United States: 2,144 in 2025; 721 in January 2026. Brazil remains free from endemic transmission, but 2025 had 3,952 suspected cases (3,841 excluded; 38 confirmed: 10 imported, 25 travel-related, 3 unknown; nearly all unvaccinated). In 2026, 232 suspects with two confirmed: a child in São Paulo who traveled to Bolivia and a 22-year-old woman in Rio de Janeiro; both unvaccinated. Recommendations: keep vaccination up to date, check vaccination cards, and pre-travel immunization per age: 6–11 months one dose; 1–29 years two doses; 30–59 years at least one dose 15 days before travel; start 45 days before if incomplete.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省がワールドカップでのはしか感染リスクについて警告
triage.triage_reason: 国際的な大規模集会（ワールドカップ）を背景にした麻疹の国際的拡大リスクが存在し、ブラジルを含む複数国での症例増加が報告されている。IHR基準2項目以上該当。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はブラジルの保健省による警告。ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含める。米国、カナダ、メキシコ、ボリビアは記事内で言及されているが、対象国リストに該当しないため除外。麻疹の国際的リスク評価が高く、特に大規模集会での伝播リスク、複数国での症例急増が懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: ભાસ્કર વિશેષ:  આજે વિશ્વ મલેરિયા દિવસ: જૂનાગઢ જિલ્લો સંપૂર્ણ મુક્ત, 4 માસમાં એક જ કેસ નોંધાયો - Junagadh News
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bhaskar Special: Today is World Malaria Day: Junagadh district is completely malaria-free, only one case reported in four months - Junagadh News.
article.articleSummary: World Malaria Day on April 25 highlights malaria awareness. Junagadh district in Gujarat remains malaria-free, recording only one case in the four months of 2026. Historical data show 2023–24 had 23 malaria cases (16 men, 7 women) and 2025 had 25 cases (13 men, 12 women). As of 2026 so far, just one male case has been reported. Civil Surgeon advises prompt medical attention if chills followed by high fever, headache, dizziness or vomiting occur. Malaria is transmitted by mosquitoes; thus maintaining cleanliness in homes and streets and preventing standing water is essential to curb mosquito breeding. The article notes malaria types but does not provide details.

triage.headline_ja: バスカール特集：今日は世界マラリアデー：ジュナガド地区は完全にマラリアが撲滅、4ヶ月間で1件のみ報告 - ジュナガドニュース
triage.triage_reason: マラリア患者数は大幅に減少し（2025年25件→2026年4ヶ月で1件）、地区は「完全に無料」と評価されている。深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常な状況、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスクはいずれも認められない。世界マラリアデー啓発の定期的な記事である。
triage.notes: この記事は世界マラリアデー（4月25日）の啓発関連記事であり、ジュナガド地区のマラリア制御成功例を報告している。患者数の減少傾向と地区の「マラリアフリー」評価から、シグナルとしてのトリアージ対象ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Em pacote de R$ 27,5 milhões para saúde e combate a chikungunya, unidade móvel é inaugurada em reserva indígena de Dourados
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: As part of a R$ 27.5 million package for health and the fight against chikungunya, a mobile unit is inaugurated in the Dourados Indigenous Reserve.
article.articleSummary: On 25 April 2026, Brazil’s Health Ministry opened a mobile health unit at Bororó II in the Dourados Indigenous Reserve, 226 km from Campo Grande, as part of a R$27.5 million package to strengthen health services and fight chikungunya. The ceremony featured Indigenous Health Secretariat head Lucinha Tremembé and Family Health Department director José Eudes Barroso, underscoring near-access care for Indigenous communities. The package earmarks R$19.3 million per year to expand MAC (Medium and High Complexity) services at Hospital Regional de Dourados (HRD) and R$325,000 annually to Hospital Universitário de Dourados (HU). It also funds 20 ICU beds (10 adults and 10 pediatrics) at HRD, with an annual impact of R$3.94 million, boosting capacity to manage severe chikungunya cases amid rising demand. The plan reinforces federal efforts to improve qualified, local care for Indigenous populations.

triage.headline_ja: チクングニア熱対策と保健に275万レアルのパッケージの一環として、ドゥラドス先住民保護区に移動医療ユニットが開設
triage.triage_reason: チクングニア熱への対応強化と医療インフラ投資を報じているが、新たな患者数増加や疾病のアウトブレイク状況は記事に示されていない。予防的・構造的な対応報道であり、IHR基準該当は不明。
triage.notes: 記事は既存のチクングニア熱脅威に対するブラジル保健省による医療体制強化（移動ユニット開設、ICUベッド拡充、資金配分）の報道。アウトブレイク発生やケース増加を具体的に報じておらず、むしろ予防的・対応的な保健投資の発表である。先住民保護区を重視した対策が示唆されていることから、流行しやすさと長期曝露リスク要素は存在するが、現在のシグナル強度は低い。続報でケース数増加やアウトブレイク状況の報告を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Bangladesh remains at high risks from measles
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreak in Bangladesh remains high risk; WHO assesses national risk as high due to ongoing transmission, a large susceptible pool, immunity gaps, and deaths. From March 15 to early April 2026, 4,231 confirmed and 29,549 suspected measles cases have been reported across 58 of 64 districts, with 42 confirmed and 198 suspected deaths. Dhaka, Rajshahi, Chattogram, and Khulna bear the heaviest burden; Dhaka records 8,263 suspected cases, including clusters in Demra, Jatrabari, Kamrangirchar, Korail, Mirpur, and Tejgaon. Children under five account for 79% of cases (under two: 66%; under nine months: 33%). The outbreak follows suboptimal immunity after MR1/MR2 vaccine stockouts in 2024–2025 and no nationwide campaigns since 2020; some infections occur before 9 months. Cross-border risk with India and Myanmar is noted. WHO recommends strengthened surveillance, rapid response, continued vaccination stock, and campaigns; no travel restrictions.

triage.headline_ja: バングラデシュは麻疹から高いリスクにさらされている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響：4,231確定例・42死亡、異常：大規模発生、国際的拡大リスク：インド・ミャンマーとの国境リスク）し、WPRO基準でも複数該当（重症度・長期曝露・流行しやすさ）。バングラデシュの対象国であり、WHOの懸念、高い社会的関心が認められる。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはバングラデシュでの麻疹大規模発生（3月15日～4月初旬に4,231確定例、29,549疑い例、42確定死亡、198疑い死亡）について報告。WHOが国家リスクを「高」と評価。5歳未満が症例の79%を占め、免疫ギャップと予防接種キャンペーン不足が背景。インド・ミャンマーとの国境リスクが明記されている。対象国リストにはBangladeshが含まれていないため、verified_locationsには該当なしであるべきだが、記事がインド・ミャンマーとの国境リスクを明示しているため、これら2国を含める。

article.articleHeadline: मच्छरों की अब खैर नहीं! इन 6 घरेलू नुस्खों से घर को बनाएं No-Mosquito जोन, मलेरिया से होगा बचाव - stop the buzz 6 natural ways to make your home a no mosquito zone this world malaria day 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mosquitoes are no longer welcome! With these 6 home remedies, make your home a No-Mosquito Zone and protect against malaria — Stop the Buzz: 6 natural ways to make your home a No-Mosquito Zone this World Malaria Day 2026.
article.articleSummary: World Malaria Day 2026 (April 25) from the Lifestyle Desk in New Delhi promotes six home remedies to transform homes into a no-mosquito zone and shield residents from malaria, dengue, and chikungunya. Mosquitoes are described as welcome guests during summer, capable of disrupting sleep and transmitting deadly diseases. The article cautions against chemical coils and sprays due to health risks for people, especially children, and positions these six easy, practical remedies as safer, effective alternatives for indoor and near-home protection. With India facing malaria and vectored illnesses, the piece emphasizes preventive measures during the hot season and aligns the message with World Malaria Day’s public health outreach. Specific remedy details are referenced but not enumerated in the excerpt.

triage.headline_ja: 蚊はもはや歓迎されない！これら6つの家庭療法で家を蚊のいないゾーンに変え、マラリアから保護する — Stop the Buzz: 2026年世界マラリアデーにおける家を蚊のいないゾーンにする6つの自然な方法
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は世界マラリアデー啓発キャンペーンとして蚊媒介疾患の予防啓発を目的とした情報提供記事であり、新規の感染症アウトブレイクやシグナルの報告ではない。既知疾患の啓発・予防情報のみで、IHR基準およびWPRO基準の実質的な該当なし。
triage.notes: 記事は世界マラリアデーに関連した予防啓発コンテンツであり、新規アウトブレイク報告や感染症危機を示す具体的なイベント情報ではない。マラリア、デング、チクングニヤは既知の風土病として言及されているが、急増や異常な流行パターンの報告なし。シグナルトリアージの対象外。

article.articleHeadline: World Malaria Day: Asymptomatic Patients' Real Challenge To Make MP Malaria-Free
article.articleSummary: Malaria in Madhya Pradesh, India, faces a hidden burden as asymptomatic infections resist standard microscopy and rapid diagnostic tests. On World Malaria Day, April 25, 2026, authorities report that 27% of febrile patients carry malaria undetected by routine tests, complicating elimination efforts. National Health Mission data identify about 700 asymptomatic cases in Balaghat, and 100 cases each in Chhindwara, Narsinghpur, and Jhabua districts. These silent infections—parasites at low levels—enable ongoing transmission, especially among tribal populations identified as highly vulnerable. Health officials warn that asymptomatic carriers are a major challenge to achieving Madhya Pradesh’s goal of malaria elimination by 2030. The findings underscore the need for more sensitive surveillance and targeted interventions to detect and treat hidden infections beyond conventional microscopy and RDTs.

triage.headline_ja: マラリア撲滅への課題：無症状患者が障害に - インド・マディヤプラデシュ州
triage.triage_reason: マラリアの無症状感染による検出困難な伝播が報告されているが、新規発生状況ではなく既知の課題についての啓発記事。IHR基準の該当数は不足するが、監視体制の脆弱さと継続的な伝播リスクが示唆される。
triage.notes: 記事はWorld Malaria Day（4月25日）に関連した啓発・課題指摘記事であり、新規発生状況の報告ではない。無症状感染による継続的伝播リスク（prolonged_exposure）と流行しやすさ（epidemic_prone）の懸念から WPRO基準で複数該当するが、公衆衛生への深刻な影響やIHR通知基準は明確でない。国家保健ミッション（NHM）データに基づいた官公庁の関心があるため、マラリア制御プログラムの進展状況として経過観察が適切。

article.articleHeadline: Đổ xô lên tuyến trên khám tay chân miệng, tăng nguy cơ phát tán dịch bệnh
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rush to top-tier hospitals for hand-foot-mouth disease examinations, increasing the risk of spreading the disease.
article.articleSummary: HFMD is peaking in Ho Chi Minh City, with 58 inpatients in the Infectious-Neurology ward at Children's Hospital 1, up about 20% from last week. About one-third of admissions are severe and require emergency care. The outbreak is expected to continue February–June, with most severe cases linked to Enterovirus 71 (EV71); other strains are milder. About 65% of hospitalized children come from neighboring provinces. There is no evidence that dietary supplements prevent HFMD; strict hygiene remains the defense until a vaccine is available. Parents should seek care at local facilities to avoid long trips and wider spread. Early detection requires collaboration among health services, schools, and families; around 10% of adults may be asymptomatic carriers. Signs include vesicles on palms, soles, knees, buttocks, elbows, and mouth ulcers; home isolation about 7 days. Red flags: persistent high fever; startling sleep; vomiting, unsteady gait, tremors, or rapid breathing—urgent care.

triage.headline_ja: 手足口病検診のために上位病院に殺到、疾病感染拡大のリスク増加
triage.triage_reason: Enterovirus 71（EV71）関連の手足口病の集積報告であり、WPROスクリーニング基準の複数項目に該当（異常/予想外、重症度、長期曝露、流行しやすさ）するが、現時点では定量的な重症度指標（死亡例、広域流行）が明確でなく、国家レベルの緊急支援必要性の記載がないため、引き続き情報経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: ホーチミン市の小児病院で手足口病患者の入院数が増加（58名、前週比約20%増）、約3分の1が重症で緊急治療を要する。EV71が重症化の主要因であり、2-6月の流行継続予測。隣県からの患者流入（65%）により感染拡大リスクあり。IHR基準2項目に該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準4項目に該当するが、死亡報告や国境を越えた拡大情報がないため、現時点ではWATCH判定。

article.articleHeadline: Ngày Thế giới phòng, chống sốt rét 25/4/2026: Chủ động phòng, chống bệnh sốt rét
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Malaria Day 25 April 2026: Proactive prevention and control of malaria.
article.articleSummary: World Malaria Day, observed on 25 April 2026, promotes proactive prevention and control of malaria. Malaria is an infectious disease caused by Plasmodium parasites. Transmission from an infected person to a healthy person occurs primarily via vectors, mainly Anopheles mosquitoes. To prevent and control malaria, the article states that the first priority is implementing measures to avoid mosquito bites. The report, from Vietnam News Agency (TTXVN/Bao Tin Tuc and Dan Toc), does not include country-specific case counts or outbreaks. Instead, it emphasizes public health actions to reduce transmission and protect at-risk populations. The central message is that reducing exposure to mosquito bites is the essential frontline strategy in combating malaria, as highlighted in the World Malaria Day coverage dated 25 April 2026.

article.articleHeadline: Descubren en Kenia un nuevo coronavirus en murciélagos capaz de infectar células humanas - La Banda Diario
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: New coronavirus in bats in Kenya capable of infecting human cells discovered - La Banda Diario
article.articleSummary: New coronavirus CcCoV-KY43 detected in bats in Kenya can invade human cells via the CEACAM6 receptor. Researchers screened 27 bat coronavirus spike proteins and found CcCoV-KY43 uses CEACAM6; overexpressing CEACAM6 rendered human cells susceptible. Serology of people near Kenyan bat roosts showed no recent infections by this virus. Related Kenyan bat coronaviruses also use CEACAM6; some bat coronaviruses from Russia and China could use similar receptors in other mammals. The work involved Pirbright Institute confirming cellular infection, York University identifying the receptor, Cambridge University solving the structure, the National Museums of Kenya detecting the virus in bats, and KEMRI-Wellcome Trust analyzing local sera. Recommendations: bolster bat coronavirus surveillance and monitor CEACAM6 as a potential entry pathway. Limitations: the study used synthetic proteins and lab models, not the live virus; real-world behavior remains unknown. The goal is predicting zoonotic risk from sequence alone.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアで発見された人間の細胞に感染可能なコウモリ由来の新型コロナウイルス
triage.triage_reason: 未知のコウモリ由来コロナウイルスが人間の細胞感染能力を有することが実験室で確認されたが、現在のところ人間への自然感染例は報告されていない。今後の流行可能性を監視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事は主にケニアでの新型コロナウイルス（CcCoV-KY43）の検出に焦点を当てているが、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。ロシア・中国のコウモリコロナウイルスについても言及されているが、これらは検出地点が実際の発生地ではなく参考例示であるため、対象国での実際の発生事例が記載されていない。本事例は in vitro 実験段階であり、自然感染例の報告がないため人間への直接的な公衆衛生影響はまだない。

article.articleHeadline: Duy trì bền vững kết quả công tác phòng, chống sốt rét
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Sustaining the results of malaria prevention and control efforts.
article.articleSummary: Malaria, caused by Plasmodium species (P. falciparum, P. vivax, P. malariae, P. ovale, P. knowlesi) and transmitted by Anopheles mosquitoes, remains a public health focus in Lao Cai Province, Vietnam. Local health centers implement ongoing prevention, surveillance, early detection, diagnosis, and treatment, plus community education on bed-net use, personal protection in forests, and environmental hygiene. The highland commune of Pha Long is prioritized due to accessibility challenges and population mobility, with efforts targeting workers and returnees from malaria-endemic areas or abroad. In late 2025, field sampling in Gia Phú under an Artemisinin-resistant malaria project strengthened drug-resistance monitoring. Cross-border collaboration with China–Vietnam partners on tropical diseases was also emphasized. Since 2011–2020, Lao Cai achieved indigenous malaria elimination in 2020; now the focus is on preventing reintroduction and sustaining nationwide elimination by 2030, supported by multi-sector cooperation and international projects.

triage.notes: 記事はベトナム・ラオカイ省でのマラリア排除達成後の継続的な監視・予防取組を報じている。中国との国境を越えた協力言及があるが、実際の発生地域は記事主題の観点ではベトナムのみ。新規症例の急増や重篤な流行の兆候は報告されておらず、制度的・長期的対応の側面が強調されている。情報が限定的で、現況のアウトブレイク段階の判定が難しいため WATCH とした。

article.articleHeadline: Why is India still struggling to end malaria?
article.articleSummary: Malaria in India remains a public health challenge. As of early 2026, India reported an 80.5% decline in cases and 78% in deaths from 2015–2023, with 83 deaths and about 1.765 million suspected/confirmed cases in 2023. India aims to eliminate malaria by 2030, but high-burden tribal areas—Odisha, Chhattisgarh, and northeastern states—remain. WHO has certified over 40 countries malaria-free, including Egypt (2024), China (2021), and Sri Lanka (2016). Experts cite surveillance gaps, inequity, and structural health-system issues, plus diverse epidemiology requiring district-tailored approaches. Mosquitoes are adapting: outdoor biting, dawn/dusk activity, and insecticide resistance reduce indoor spraying and nets. Asymptomatic reservoirs complicate elimination; recommendations include maintaining microscopy, scalable rapid diagnostics, molecular tests, and xenomonitoring. Vaccines are advancing: two licensed vaccines, including Serum Institute’s; R21/MM deployed; vivax vaccines and long-acting injectables in development.

triage.headline_ja: インドはなぜマラリア排除に苦しんでいるのか？
triage.triage_reason: マラリアは既知の地域流行疾患で、インドは著しい進展を示している（2015-2023年で80.5%の症例減少）。異常性や国際的拡大リスクは限定的だが、持続的な公衆衛生課題として注視する価値がある。
triage.notes: インドはマラリア排除に向けた2030年目標を掲げており、着実な進展が報告されている。記事はオディシャ州とチャッティスガル州を高負荷地域として言及しているが、全体的には既知の地域流行パターンであり、IHR通知基準には該当しない。ただし、蚊の行動変化（野外刺咬、薬剤耐性）や無症状保有者の問題は継続的な監視対象。

article.articleHeadline: Prefeitura abre contratação de médicos e enfermeiros para enfrentar Chikungunya
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: City Hall opens recruitment of doctors and nurses to combat Chikungunya.
article.articleSummary: Dourados Municipal Hall opened emergency recruitment for doctors and nurses to combat the Chikungunya epidemic amid a public health emergency. Edital No. 27/2026/SEMS/PMD calls for temporary contracts for physicians and nurses to work in Basic Health Units, Emergency Care Units, and public or contracted hospitals. The move follows decrees establishing a Center for Public Health Emergency Operations (COE) and a declared health calamity due to Chikungunya, with rising cases and risk of public-system collapse. Applications are to be submitted to the Municipal Health Secretariat in Dourados, Rua Coronel Ponciano, 900, 8:00–13:00, with documents including photo ID or professional ID, CPF, proof of education, professional registration, and proof of at least five years’ experience. Selection ranks by verified experience; ties broken by older age. The hires are temporary and limited to the emergency period.

triage.notes: 記事はダウラドス市（ブラジル・マット・グロッソ・ド・スール州）における緊急人員募集に関するもの。公衆衛生上の緊急事態が宣言されており、チクングニア患者数の増加と公衆医療制度の崩壊リスクが言及されているが、具体的な患者数、死亡数、流行の時系列データが提供されていないため情報が限定的。IHR基準は2つ未満だが、WPROスクリーニング基準の3つが該当するため、続報を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Puluhan Siswa Kediri Mual & Muntah, SPPG Ditutup Sementara, Ditemukan Bakteri E. coli di MBG
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dozens of Kediri students with nausea and vomiting; SPPG temporarily closed; Escherichia coli bacteria found at MBG.
article.articleSummary: On 22 April 2026, 69 students from SDN Ketami 1, SDN Ketami 2, and SDN Tempurejo 1 in Ketami, Kediri City, experienced nausea, vomiting, dizziness, and fever after participating in the Free Nutritious Meal Program (MBG/SPPG). The Kediri City MBG Task Force reported that Escherichia coli (E. coli) was detected in MBG meals, indicating the food was not fit for consumption. The program was temporarily closed as authorities investigate. Health authorities collected food samples for laboratory testing and conducted follow-up checks at MBG Tempurejo. No student required inpatient care; most have improved and Puskesmas continues monitoring. The city government, in coordination with the National Nutrition Agency (Badan Gizi Nasional), will review SOPs and monitoring to prevent recurrence while keeping MBG active under tightened oversight.

triage.headline_ja: ケディリ市の数十人の生徒が吐き気と嘔吐を発症、SPPG（栄養給食プログラム）が一時閉鎖、MBG食事からE. coli菌を検出
triage.triage_reason: E. coliの食中毒イベント（69名患者）で公衆衛生への影響があり、異常・予想外な集団発症である。ただし患者が軽症で入院なし、すでに改善傾向にあり、国内対応が可能な状況であるため、WATCH段階での経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 学校給食プログラムにおける食中毒イベント。患者数69名は相応の規模だが、症状は軽症（吐き気・嘔吐・めまい・発熱）で入院患者なし、すでに改善傾向。E. coliは予防・管理可能な病原体であり、当局が封じ込めと再発防止策を実施中。続報を注視し、患者数増加や重症化、地域内での二次拡大が報告された場合はPICKUPへ移行。

article.articleHeadline: World Malaria Day 2026: Symptoms, Prevention, And Latest Treatments | News18
article.articleSummary: World Malaria Day 2026 highlights WHO’s campaign 'Driven to End Malaria: Now We Can. Now We Must' to eliminate malaria, a mosquito-borne disease causing 610,000 deaths annually. Since 2000, 2.3 billion cases and 14 million deaths have been averted. As of 2024, 47 countries have been certified malaria-free (including two in 2024 and three in 2025); endemic countries fell from 108 in 2000 to 80 today. In 2024 there were estimated 282 million cases and 610,000 deaths. RTS,S/AS01 vaccine rolled out in 25 countries, protecting 10 million children; next-generation insecticide-treated nets account for 84% of new nets. Symptoms appear 7–30 days after bites: fever, chills, headaches, muscle/joint pain, fatigue, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea; severe cases cause jaundice, anemia, convulsions, coma. Early diagnosis and ACTs are standard; pregnant women require tailored regimens (often quinine with clindamycin in first trimester). India targets elimination by 2030; diagnostics to detect low-density infections are critical.

article.articleHeadline: Pattaya balances public safety and animal care in new rabies-free initiative - Pattaya Mail
article.articleSummary: As of 25 April 2026, Pattaya, Thailand launches a rabies-control campaign offering free pet sterilization and rabies vaccination to curb stray dogs and cats amid rising stray populations linked to abandonment. The event, chaired by Mayor Poramet Ngampichet at Wat Nong Yai, marks the national Rabies-Free Animals, Safe Communities initiative inspired by Princess Chulabhorn Walailak. Pattaya’s veterinary team pursues mass vaccination, sterilization, and relocation of stray animals to the Pong subdistrict shelter, in cooperation with Pattaya Animal Hospital. Rabies remains fatal once symptoms appear, underscoring preventive vaccination and population management to protect public health and tourism image. Mobile units will operate through late April with Walking Street (April 27), Kophai (April 28), and Thappraya (April 29) visits. Services, including broader health screenings by Pattaya Bhattamakun Hospital, and access details via the Veterinary Division or 1337, are provided to Pattaya residents with registration and ID.
